nodes.summary: Implements `git replay`: replays or reverts a range of commits onto a new base without touching the index or working tree, using the in-core merge-ort machinery per commit, and records the resulting ref updates in a replay_result.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a khash map from original to replayed commit ids so descendants are replayed onto the rewritten parent.

nodes.name: ref_info
nodes.summary: Result of analysing the command line ranges: the commit to replay onto and the sets of positive and negative refs with their expression counts.

nodes.name: peel_committish
nodes.summary: Resolves a name to an object id and peels it to a commit, dying with a message that names the option.

nodes.name: get_author
nodes.summary: Extracts the author header of a commit message so the replayed commit keeps the original author.

nodes.name: generate_revert_message
nodes.summary: Builds a "Revert ..." commit message for a commit using the sequencer helper.

nodes.name: create_commit
nodes.summary: Writes a new commit object with the given tree and parent, copying extra headers (without signatures) and either the original message and author (pick) or a revert message.

nodes.name: get_ref_information
nodes.summary: Walks the command line revision entries to record positive and negative refs, counts them and finds the commit to replay onto.

nodes.name: set_up_branch_mode
nodes.summary: Validates the --advance or --revert argument as a ref, resolves its commit and rejects multiple revision ranges.

nodes.name: set_up_replay_mode
nodes.summary: Decides the replay target from --onto, --advance or --revert, records whether HEAD is detached and which refs may be updated.

nodes.name: get_mapped_commit
nodes.summary: Looks up the replayed counterpart of a commit in the khash map or returns a fallback.

nodes.name: put_mapped_commit
nodes.summary: Records that a commit was replayed as a new commit and fails on duplicates.

nodes.name: pick_regular_commit
nodes.summary: Performs a three-way in-core merge (merge-ort) of one commit onto the replayed base, handles commits that become empty per policy and then creates the new commit.

nodes.name: replay_result_release
nodes.summary: Frees the queued ref updates of a replay_result.

nodes.name: replay_result_queue_update
nodes.summary: Appends a ref update (refname, old and new object id) to the replay_result.

nodes.name: replay_revisions
nodes.summary: Main routine of git replay: sets up the mode, walks the revisions, replays each commit onto its mapped parent (or the linearized base), and queues updates for the affected branches or the given ref.

nodes.name: replay.h
nodes.summary: Declares the replay API: replay_revisions_options, replay_result with its queued ref updates, the empty commit policy enum and replay_revisions().

nodes.name: replay_empty_commit_action
nodes.summary: Policy for replayed commits that become empty: drop, keep or abort.

nodes.name: replay_revisions_options
nodes.summary: Options of replay_revisions: advance, onto, ref, revert, contained, empty policy and linearize.

nodes.name: replay_result
nodes.summary: Out parameter that collects the reference updates caused by replaying the commits.

nodes.name: rerere.h
nodes.summary: Declares the rerere (reuse recorded resolution) API: recording, replaying, forgetting and garbage collecting conflict resolutions and the rerere_id type.

nodes.name: rerere_id
nodes.summary: Identifies one conflict variant inside a rerere directory (collection and variant number).

nodes.name: reset.h
nodes.summary: Declares reset_working_tree(), its options struct and flags, used to update HEAD, the index and the working tree like `git reset --hard` or a detached checkout.

nodes.name: reset_working_tree_flags
nodes.summary: Flags for reset_working_tree: detach, hard reset, run post-checkout hook, refs only, update HEAD and ORIG_HEAD, dry run.

nodes.name: reset_working_tree_options
nodes.summary: Options of reset_working_tree: target oid, source oid for two-way merge, ORIG_HEAD value, branch, flags and reflog messages.

nodes.name: alloc.c
nodes.summary: Specialized slab allocator (blocks of 1024 nodes) for in-memory blob, tree, commit, tag and generic object structs, kept per repository in the parsed-object pool. Commit nodes also get a global running index used by commit slabs.

nodes.name: alloc_state_alloc
nodes.summary: Allocates a zeroed alloc_state that tracks the free node count and slab list for one object type.

nodes.name: alloc_state_free_and_null
nodes.summary: Frees every slab recorded in an alloc_state, then the slab array and the state itself, and nulls the caller pointer.

nodes.name: alloc_node
nodes.summary: Hands out the next node from the current slab, allocating a new 1024-node slab (and recording it) when the current one is exhausted, and zeroes the node.

nodes.name: alloc_blob_node
nodes.summary: Allocates a struct blob from the repository blob_state and tags it OBJ_BLOB.

nodes.name: alloc_tree_node
nodes.summary: Allocates a struct tree from the repository tree_state and tags it OBJ_TREE.

nodes.name: alloc_tag_node
nodes.summary: Allocates a struct tag from the repository tag_state and tags it OBJ_TAG.

nodes.name: alloc_object_node
nodes.summary: Allocates a generic node sized for the largest object union, typed OBJ_NONE, for objects whose type is not yet known.

nodes.name: alloc_commit_index
nodes.summary: Returns the next value of a process-wide commit counter used as the index into commit slabs.

nodes.name: init_commit_node
nodes.summary: Marks a commit as OBJ_COMMIT and assigns it a fresh global commit index.

nodes.name: alloc_commit_node
nodes.summary: Allocates a struct commit from the repository commit_state and initializes it via init_commit_node.

nodes.name: alloc_state
nodes.summary: Bookkeeping for a slab allocator: nodes left, next free node and a list of allocated slabs.

nodes.name: alloc.h
nodes.summary: Public interface of the object node allocator: per-type alloc_*_node functions plus creation and teardown of the alloc_state that backs each object type.

nodes.name: blob.c
nodes.summary: Implements blob object handling: lookup_blob finds or creates the in-memory struct blob for an object ID, and parse_blob_buffer just flags the blob as parsed since blobs have no structure.

nodes.name: lookup_blob
nodes.summary: Looks up an object by ID in the repository object table and returns it as a blob, creating a new blob node if it is not yet known.

nodes.name: parse_blob_buffer
nodes.summary: Sets the parsed flag on a blob, meaning its content was found readable in the object database.

nodes.name: blob.h
nodes.summary: Declares struct blob (a thin wrapper around struct object), the blob_type string, lookup_blob and parse_blob_buffer.

nodes.name: blob
nodes.summary: Blob object: a struct object wrapper without extra fields since blobs are unstructured file content.

nodes.name: backfill.c
nodes.summary: Implements git backfill: walks revisions with the path-walk API and batch-downloads missing blobs from the promisor remote (partial clone), optionally limited to the sparse-checkout.

nodes.name: backfill_context_clear
nodes.summary: Releases the batch of object IDs held in a backfill_context.

nodes.name: download_batch
nodes.summary: Requests the current batch of missing object IDs from the promisor remote, clears the batch and re-prepares the object database so the new packfile is seen.

nodes.name: fill_missing_blobs
nodes.summary: Path-walk callback that, for blob lists, queues IDs not present in the object database and triggers a download once the batch reaches the minimum size.

nodes.name: reject_unsupported_rev_list_options
nodes.summary: Dies if the parsed revision options include features backfill cannot honor, such as pickaxe, diff filters, --follow, -L, diff merges or blob size filters.

nodes.name: do_backfill
nodes.summary: Configures a path_walk_info for blobs only (optionally restricted by sparse-checkout patterns and edge hints), runs walk_objects_by_path with fill_missing_blobs, then downloads the final partial batch.

nodes.name: cmd_backfill
nodes.summary: Entry point for git backfill: parses options, sets up revisions, rejects unsupported options, resolves the sparse default from config and runs do_backfill.

nodes.name: backfill_context
nodes.summary: State for git backfill: repository, pending batch of object IDs, minimum batch size, sparse and edge options and the rev_info.

nodes.name: fast-import.c
nodes.summary: Implements git fast-import: reads a fast-export style command stream from stdin and writes objects straight into packfiles, keeping in-memory trees, branches, tags and marks, then updates refs at the end. Includes delta compression against the previous object, signature handling, notes fan-out, crash reports and checkpoints.
nodes.languageNotes: Large single-file program with static global state and a hand-written line-oriented parser; memory is carved from a mem_pool and tree entries are recycled via free lists.

nodes.name: for_each_mark
nodes.summary: Recursively walks the sparse mark table, calling a callback for every set mark.

nodes.name: write_crash_report
nodes.summary: Writes a fast_import_crash file in the git dir with branch, tag, mark and recent-command diagnostics.

nodes.name: die_nicely
nodes.summary: Replacement die routine that writes a crash report, finalizes the packfile, removes keep files and dumps marks before exiting.

nodes.name: insert_object
nodes.summary: Looks up or creates the object_entry for an object ID in the hash table of written objects.

nodes.name: insert_mark
nodes.summary: Stores an object_entry in the multi-level mark table under a mark number, growing the table as needed.

nodes.name: find_mark
nodes.summary: Looks up the object_entry for a mark number in the mark table.

nodes.name: to_atom
nodes.summary: Interns a name string in the atom hash table so tree entries share names.

nodes.name: lookup_branch
nodes.summary: Finds a branch by name in the branch hash table.

nodes.name: new_branch
nodes.summary: Creates a branch record (validating the ref name) and registers it in the branch table.

nodes.name: new_tree_content
nodes.summary: Gets a tree_content with at least the requested capacity, reusing recycled blocks when possible.

nodes.name: release_tree_content_recursive
nodes.summary: Recursively releases a tree_content and its subtrees back to the free list.

nodes.name: grow_tree_content
nodes.summary: Reallocates a tree_content with more capacity, copying entries.

nodes.name: dup_tree_content
nodes.summary: Duplicates a tree_content including entry versions.

nodes.name: start_packfile
nodes.summary: Creates a temporary pack file with a pack header and registers it as the current output pack.

nodes.name: create_index
nodes.summary: Builds the sorted index entry list for the current pack and writes the .idx file.

nodes.name: keep_pack
nodes.summary: Writes a .keep file, then renames the pack and index files to their final names.

nodes.name: loosen_small_pack
nodes.summary: Feeds a small pack to git unpack-objects so it becomes loose objects instead.

nodes.name: end_packfile
nodes.summary: Finishes the current pack: fixes header and footer, optionally loosens it, writes the index, registers it with the pack store and prints pack edges.

nodes.name: cycle_packfile
nodes.summary: Ends the current pack and starts a new one.

nodes.name: store_object
nodes.summary: Hashes an object, skips duplicates, optionally deltifies against the last object, deflates and appends it to the current pack, cycling packs on size limits.

nodes.name: stream_blob
nodes.summary: Streams a large blob from stdin directly into the pack with deflate while hashing, discarding it if it is a duplicate.

nodes.name: gfi_unpack_entry
nodes.summary: Reads back an object from a pack, including the one currently being written, after flushing and refreshing its length.

nodes.name: load_tree
nodes.summary: Loads a tree object (from the pack in progress or the odb) into in-memory tree_content entries.

nodes.name: mktree
nodes.summary: Serializes an in-memory tree_content version into raw tree object format after sorting entries.

nodes.name: store_tree
nodes.summary: Recursively writes modified trees to the pack, deltifying against the previous version of the tree.

nodes.name: tree_content_set
nodes.summary: Inserts or replaces the entry at a slash-separated path in a tree, creating subtrees as needed.

nodes.name: tree_content_remove
nodes.summary: Removes the entry at a path from a tree, optionally returning a backup of it.

nodes.name: tree_content_get
nodes.summary: Finds the entry at a path in a tree and copies it into a leaf.

nodes.name: update_branch
nodes.summary: Updates a ref to the branch tip through a ref transaction, refusing non-fast-forward updates unless forced and handling refs/replace and deletions.

nodes.name: dump_branches
nodes.summary: Updates the ref of every branch in the table.

nodes.name: dump_tags
nodes.summary: Updates all tag refs in one ref transaction.

nodes.name: dump_marks
nodes.summary: Writes the mark table to the export marks file under a lock file.

nodes.name: read_mark_file
nodes.summary: Parses a marks file of ":mark oid" lines and feeds each pair to an inserter.

nodes.name: read_next_command
nodes.summary: Reads the next input line into the command buffer, keeping a ring of recent commands and skipping comments.

nodes.name: parse_data
nodes.summary: Parses a "data" command, either exact byte count or delimited here-document, into a buffer.

nodes.name: validate_raw_date
nodes.summary: Validates and normalizes a raw "seconds timezone" date from the stream.

nodes.name: parse_ident
nodes.summary: Parses and validates an author, committer or tagger identity string and normalizes its date.

nodes.name: parse_and_store_blob
nodes.summary: Reads blob data and stores it with store_object, or streams it when over the big-file threshold.

nodes.name: parse_new_blob
nodes.summary: Handles the "blob" command: mark, optional original identifier, then data.

nodes.name: unload_one_branch
nodes.summary: Unloads the least recently used active branch tree to limit memory use.

nodes.name: load_branch
nodes.summary: Loads a branch tree and adds the branch to the active list.

nodes.name: do_change_note_fanout
nodes.summary: Recursively walks a notes tree to count notes or re-arrange them to a different fanout directory layout.

nodes.name: file_change_m
nodes.summary: Handles filemodify: parses mode and dataref (mark, sha or inline) and sets the tree entry at the path.

nodes.name: file_change_cr
nodes.summary: Handles filecopy and filerename by getting an entry at one path and setting it at another.

nodes.name: note_change_n
nodes.summary: Handles notemodify: attaches a note to a commit and adjusts the notes tree fanout.

nodes.name: parse_objectish
nodes.summary: Resolves a "from" or "merge" reference (branch, mark or object name) into the branch tip and tree.

nodes.name: parse_merge
nodes.summary: Parses all "merge" lines of a commit into a list of parent object IDs.

nodes.name: parse_new_commit
nodes.summary: Handles the "commit" command: parses author, committer, signatures, message, from, merges and file changes, then builds and stores the commit object.

nodes.name: handle_signature_if_invalid
nodes.summary: Verifies a commit signature and applies the invalid-signature policy (abort, warn or strip).

nodes.name: handle_tag_signature
nodes.summary: Applies the configured signed-tag mode to a tag message (keep, strip, warn or verify).

nodes.name: parse_new_tag
nodes.summary: Handles the "tag" command: parses target, tagger and message, stores an annotated tag object and records it for ref update.

nodes.name: parse_reset_branch
nodes.summary: Handles "reset": clears or creates a branch and sets its new tip.

nodes.name: cat_blob
nodes.summary: Writes a blob (from the pack in progress or the odb) in cat-file --batch format to the cat-blob descriptor.

nodes.name: parse_cat_blob
nodes.summary: Handles "cat-blob" by resolving a mark or object ID and calling cat_blob.

nodes.name: dereference
nodes.summary: Peels an object to the tree it refers to, reading commits or tags as needed.

nodes.name: parse_ls
nodes.summary: Handles "ls": reads the tree entry for a path from a commit tree or tree-ish and prints it.

nodes.name: parse_alias
nodes.summary: Handles "alias": maps a new mark to an existing object.

nodes.name: build_mark_map
nodes.summary: Builds a hash map from submodule old object IDs to new ones from two marks tables.

nodes.name: option_import_marks
nodes.summary: Records the marks file to import, reading any previously queued one.

nodes.name: option_rewrite_submodules
nodes.summary: Reads a submodule marks file for rewrite-submodules-from or -to.

nodes.name: parse_one_option
nodes.summary: Handles a single "option" line from the stream or an in-stream feature switch.

nodes.name: parse_one_feature
nodes.summary: Handles a single "feature" line, enabling supported features and rejecting unknown or unsafe ones.

nodes.name: git_pack_config
nodes.summary: Reads pack.depth, pack.indexVersion, pack.packSizeLimit and unpack-limit configuration.

nodes.name: checkpoint
nodes.summary: Cycles the pack and dumps branches, tags and marks on request.

nodes.name: cmd_fast_import
nodes.summary: Entry point for git fast-import: parses options, sets up the pack and tables, reads and dispatches commands until EOF, then finalizes packs, refs and marks and prints statistics.

nodes.name: write_branch_report
nodes.summary: Prints the status (active, loaded, dirty), tip commit and old and new tree IDs of one branch into a crash report.

nodes.name: new_object
nodes.summary: Takes the next object_entry from the current pool block (allocating a block when full) and sets its object ID.

nodes.name: invalidate_pack_id
nodes.summary: Resets the pack ID to MAX_PACK_ID on every object, branch and tag that pointed at a pack that was discarded.

nodes.name: new_tree_entry
nodes.summary: Allocates a tree_entry from a free list that is refilled in batches.

nodes.name: tree_content_replace
nodes.summary: Replaces a root tree entry with a new tree object ID and content, releasing the old subtree.

nodes.name: read_marks
nodes.summary: Opens the import marks file and loads its marks into the mark table, tolerating a missing file when asked.

nodes.name: parse_mapped_oid_hex
nodes.summary: Parses a hex object ID and, when submodule rewriting is on, maps it through the submodule ID map.

nodes.name: parse_from_commit
nodes.summary: Reads the tree ID out of a commit buffer and sets it as both versions of the branch root tree.

nodes.name: parse_from_existing
nodes.summary: Resolves a branch tip to a commit via the object database and loads its tree ID, or clears the tree when null.

nodes.name: parse_one_signature
nodes.summary: Parses a "gpgsig <hash-algo> <format>" line plus data into a signature_data, validating algorithm and format.

nodes.name: store_signature
nodes.summary: Stores a parsed signature for a hash algorithm, warning and ignoring duplicates.

nodes.name: import_one_signature
nodes.summary: Parses one gpgsig header and stores it as the SHA-1 or SHA-256 signature of the commit.

nodes.name: add_gpgsig_to_commit
nodes.summary: Appends a multi-line gpgsig header to a commit buffer using continuation-line formatting.

nodes.name: finalize_commit_buffer
nodes.summary: Adds the SHA-1 and SHA-256 gpgsig headers and the message to a commit buffer.

nodes.name: warn_invalid_signature
nodes.summary: Prints a warning naming the commit subject and alleged signer when an invalid signature is stripped or kept.

nodes.name: handle_tag_signature_if_invalid
nodes.summary: Verifies a tag signature over the tag payload and applies the invalid-signature policy.

nodes.name: parse_get_mark
nodes.summary: Handles "get-mark" by writing the object ID of a mark to the cat-blob output.

nodes.name: print_ls
nodes.summary: Prints an "ls" result line (mode, type, object ID and quoted path) or "missing" to the cat-blob output.

nodes.name: parse_treeish_dataref
nodes.summary: Parses a mark or object ID for a tree-ish and peels it down to its tree entry.

nodes.name: option_max_pack_size
nodes.summary: Parses --max-pack-size, treating small values as MiB with a warning and enforcing a 1 MiB minimum.

nodes.name: parse_argv
nodes.summary: Parses command-line options once the first data command is seen, then loads import marks and builds the submodule mark map.

nodes.name: parse_path
nodes.summary: Parses a path from a command line either C-quoted or space/EOL delimited.

nodes.name: object_entry
nodes.summary: Record for an object written to a pack: index entry, hash table link, type, pack ID and delta depth.

nodes.name: mark_set
nodes.summary: Sparse multi-level table mapping mark numbers to object entries.

nodes.name: last_object
nodes.summary: The previous object written (data, offset, depth) used as delta base for the next one.

nodes.name: tree_entry
nodes.summary: In-memory tree entry with a name atom and two versions (old and new mode and object ID).

nodes.name: tree_content
nodes.summary: In-memory tree: capacity, count, delta depth and entry pointers.

nodes.name: branch
nodes.summary: Branch state: name, tip commit, root tree entry, active flags, pack ID and note count.

nodes.name: tag
nodes.summary: Annotated tag to be written to refs/tags with its target object ID.

nodes.name: fast_import_state
nodes.summary: Per-run command parser state: arguments, prefix, whether a data command was seen and the option table.

nodes.name: signature_data
nodes.summary: Holds a parsed signature (hash algorithm name and raw data) of a commit being imported.

nodes.name: fsck.c
nodes.summary: Implements git fsck: verifies the object database by checking each object, walking all reachable objects from refs, reflogs, index and cache-tree, and reporting missing, broken, dangling or unreachable objects, then runs ref and commit-graph verification.

nodes.name: printable_type
nodes.summary: Returns a printable object type name, reading the type from the object database when it is still OBJ_NONE.

nodes.name: objerror
nodes.summary: Reports an error for a specific object, records the object error bit and returns -1.

nodes.name: fsck_objects_error_func
nodes.summary: Error callback for per-object fsck messages that prints warnings or errors with the object type and name and returns 1 for errors.

nodes.name: mark_object
nodes.summary: fsck_walk callback that flags a linked object REACHABLE, reports broken links and wrong types, and queues objects that exist so their links are traversed later.

nodes.name: mark_object_reachable
nodes.summary: Marks a single object (typically from a ref, reflog or index) as reachable via mark_object.

nodes.name: traverse_one_object
nodes.summary: Walks the outgoing links of one object with fsck_walk and frees tree buffers afterwards.

nodes.name: traverse_reachable
nodes.summary: Drains the pending object array by traversing each object, showing progress, to propagate reachability.

nodes.name: mark_used
nodes.summary: fsck_walk callback that sets the USED flag on each referenced object so dangling tips can be told apart from interior unreachable objects.

nodes.name: mark_unreachable_referents
nodes.summary: Object iterator callback for connectivity-only mode that walks unreachable objects to mark the objects they point to as USED.

nodes.name: check_reachable_object
nodes.summary: Verifies a reachable object is present (or a promisor or in a pack) and reports missing ones as errors.

nodes.name: check_unreachable_object
nodes.summary: Reports unreachable or dangling objects and optionally writes them into .git/lost-found.

nodes.name: check_object
nodes.summary: Dispatches to the reachable or unreachable check depending on the REACHABLE flag.

nodes.name: check_connectivity
nodes.summary: Traverses reachable objects, optionally marks referents of unreachable ones, then checks every known in-memory object.

nodes.name: fsck_obj_buffer
nodes.summary: Callback for each object read from the database: parses it, runs fsck_walk and fsck_object checks, and prints root commit or tag information.

nodes.name: fsck_handle_reflog_oid
nodes.summary: Marks an object named by a reflog entry as used and reachable, or reports an invalid reflog entry.

nodes.name: fsck_handle_reflog_ent
nodes.summary: Reflog entry callback that processes the old and new object IDs of one entry, ignoring entries newer than the snapshot time.

nodes.name: fsck_handle_reflog
nodes.summary: Iterates all entries of one worktree reflog using fsck_handle_reflog_ent.

nodes.name: snapshot_ref
nodes.summary: Ref iteration callback that parses the target object, validates branches point to commits and records the ref name and ID in a snapshot.

nodes.name: fsck_handle_ref
nodes.summary: Marks the object a ref points to as used and reachable and records its name for reporting.

nodes.name: snapshot_refs
nodes.summary: Snapshots all refs and per-worktree HEADs (or explicit arguments) before walking objects so concurrent ref changes do not affect the check.

nodes.name: free_snapshot_refs
nodes.summary: Frees the ref names and array held by a snapshot.

nodes.name: process_refs
nodes.summary: Replays the ref snapshot into reachability marks, processes reflogs, and warns when there are no default refs.

nodes.name: fsck_cache_tree
nodes.summary: Recursively marks the tree objects named in an index cache-tree as used and verifies they are trees.

nodes.name: fsck_resolve_undo
nodes.summary: Marks blobs recorded in the index resolve-undo data as used and reachable.

nodes.name: fsck_index
nodes.summary: Marks blobs referenced by index entries as reachable (skipping gitlinks) and then checks cache-tree and resolve-undo data.

nodes.name: mark_object_for_connectivity
nodes.summary: Object iterator callback that creates an unknown object entry flagged HAS_OBJ for connectivity-only checks.

nodes.name: fsck_refs
nodes.summary: Runs git refs verify as a child process to validate the ref database.

nodes.name: cmd_fsck
nodes.summary: Entry point for git fsck: configures walk and object options, snapshots refs, verifies objects in the odb, processes refs, reflogs and indexes, checks connectivity and verifies the commit-graph.

nodes.name: ref_snapshot
nodes.summary: One snapshotted ref (name and object ID).

nodes.name: snapshot
nodes.summary: Array of snapshotted refs taken before object walking.

nodes.name: snapshot_ref_data
nodes.summary: Callback context for snapshot_ref holding the repository and snapshot.

nodes.name: hash-object.c
nodes.summary: Implements git hash-object: computes the object ID of file contents (or stdin) for a given type, optionally applying filters and writing the object into the object database.

nodes.name: hash_fd
nodes.summary: Hashes the content of a file descriptor as an object of the given type via index_fd (optionally writing it) and prints the object ID.

nodes.name: hash_object
nodes.summary: Opens a path and hashes it with hash_fd.

nodes.name: hash_stdin_paths
nodes.summary: Reads file names from stdin (with C-style unquoting) and hashes each one.

nodes.name: cmd_hash_object
nodes.summary: Entry point for git hash-object: parses options, sets up the repository (required only when writing), validates option combinations and hashes stdin, files or stdin paths.

nodes.name: index-pack.c
nodes.summary: Implements git index-pack: reads a packfile (from a file or stdin), parses every object, resolves ofs-delta and ref-delta chains (optionally with threads and a delta base cache), completes thin packs, runs collision and fsck checks and writes the .idx (and .rev, .keep, .promisor) files.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a custom input buffer with CRC tracking (fill/use/flush) and a pthread-based second pass with mutex-guarded work and done stacks.

nodes.name: lock_mutex
nodes.summary: Locks a mutex only when worker threads are active.

nodes.name: unlock_mutex
nodes.summary: Unlocks a mutex only when worker threads are active.

nodes.name: init_thread
nodes.summary: Initializes mutexes, thread-specific key and per-thread pack file descriptors for the delta-resolution threads.

nodes.name: cleanup_thread
nodes.summary: Destroys the mutexes, closes per-thread pack descriptors and frees thread data.

nodes.name: mark_link
nodes.summary: fsck_walk callback that flags linked objects with FLAG_LINK so their presence can be verified later.

nodes.name: check_object
nodes.summary: Checks that an object linked from the pack either came in the pack or exists in the odb with the expected type.

nodes.name: check_objects
nodes.summary: Scans all in-memory objects and counts those that must already exist outside the pack, with progress.

nodes.name: flush
nodes.summary: Writes consumed input to the output pack file, updates the running pack checksum and compacts the input buffer.

nodes.name: fill
nodes.summary: Ensures at least min bytes are buffered from the input descriptor, flushing and reading as needed.

nodes.name: use
nodes.summary: Consumes bytes from the input buffer, updating the CRC32, byte counters and enforcing the maximum pack size.

nodes.name: open_pack_file
nodes.summary: Opens the input pack (stdin into a temporary pack file, or an existing file) and starts the pack checksum.

nodes.name: parse_pack_header
nodes.summary: Validates the pack signature and version and reads the object count from the header.

nodes.name: bad_object
nodes.summary: Dies with the pack offset and a formatted message for corrupt pack data.

nodes.name: get_thread_data
nodes.summary: Returns the thread-local data (pack fd) for the current thread or the single-threaded fallback.

nodes.name: free_base_data
nodes.summary: Frees a cached delta base buffer and subtracts its size from the cache usage.

nodes.name: prune_base_data
nodes.summary: Frees cached base data (done stack first, then work stack) until the delta base cache is within its limit, skipping retained bases.

nodes.name: unpack_entry_data
nodes.summary: Inflates one pack entry from the input, hashing non-delta objects on the fly and using a fixed buffer for very large blobs.

nodes.name: unpack_raw_entry
nodes.summary: Parses a pack entry header (type, size, ofs-delta or ref-delta base) and inflates its data while recording offset and CRC32.

nodes.name: unpack_data
nodes.summary: Re-reads and inflates an entry from the pack with pread, either whole or in chunks via a consume callback.

nodes.name: get_data_from_pack
nodes.summary: Returns the inflated data of an object from the pack.

nodes.name: is_delta_type
nodes.summary: Tells whether an object type is OFS_DELTA or REF_DELTA.

nodes.name: compare_ofs_delta_bases
nodes.summary: Orders delta bases by type then offset for binary search.

nodes.name: find_ofs_delta
nodes.summary: Binary-searches the sorted ofs-delta table for entries whose base is at an offset.

nodes.name: find_ofs_delta_children
nodes.summary: Returns the index range of all ofs-delta entries sharing one base offset.

nodes.name: compare_ref_delta_bases
nodes.summary: Orders ref-delta bases by type then object ID.

nodes.name: find_ref_delta
nodes.summary: Binary-searches the sorted ref-delta table for entries whose base has a given object ID.

nodes.name: find_ref_delta_children
nodes.summary: Returns the index range of all ref-delta entries sharing one base object ID.

nodes.name: compare_objects
nodes.summary: Callback comparing streamed pack data with the existing object from the odb, dying on mismatch to detect hash collisions.

nodes.name: check_collison
nodes.summary: For large blobs already present in the odb, streams both copies and compares them to detect SHA-1 collisions.

nodes.name: record_outgoing_link
nodes.summary: Inserts an object ID into the outgoing-links set.

nodes.name: maybe_record_name_entry
nodes.summary: Records tree entries that are directories as outgoing links.

nodes.name: do_record_outgoing_links
nodes.summary: Records the trees and parents of commits, tree subtrees and tagged objects as outgoing links of a pack.

nodes.name: sha1_object
nodes.summary: Verifies a newly read object: tests for collisions against the odb, parses it, runs fsck and strict link checks and records outgoing links.

nodes.name: get_base_data
nodes.summary: Reconstructs a base object by walking up its delta chain and applying patch_delta when its cached data was pruned.

nodes.name: make_base
nodes.summary: Allocates a base_data node for an object and computes the ranges of its ref-delta and ofs-delta children.

nodes.name: resolve_delta
nodes.summary: Applies one delta to its base, hashes the resulting object, validates it via sha1_object and returns it as a new base.

nodes.name: compare_ofs_delta_entry
nodes.summary: qsort comparison for ofs-delta entries by base offset.

nodes.name: compare_ref_delta_entry
nodes.summary: qsort comparison for ref-delta entries by base object ID.

nodes.name: threaded_second_pass
nodes.summary: Worker loop that takes base objects or children from the shared work stack under a mutex, resolves deltas and manages the done stack and base cache.

nodes.name: parse_pack_objects
nodes.summary: First pass over the pack: unpacks every entry, hashes non-delta objects, records delta bases, then verifies the pack checksum and trailing data.

nodes.name: resolve_deltas
nodes.summary: Second pass: sorts the delta tables and runs threaded_second_pass (in threads or inline) to resolve all deltas.

nodes.name: conclude_pack
nodes.summary: Third pass: for thin packs appends missing base objects, rewrites the pack header and trailer and checks for unresolved deltas.

nodes.name: write_compressed
nodes.summary: Deflates a buffer into the pack hashfile and returns the compressed length.

nodes.name: append_obj_to_pack
nodes.summary: Appends a local object (as a full object) to the pack being completed, recording its offset and CRC.

nodes.name: delta_pos_compare
nodes.summary: Compares ref-delta entries by their position in the pack.

nodes.name: fix_unresolved_deltas
nodes.summary: Finds bases for unresolved ref-deltas in the local odb (prefetching from a promisor), appends them to the pack and resolves the dependent deltas.

nodes.name: derive_filename
nodes.summary: Derives a sibling file name for a pack by replacing its suffix.

nodes.name: write_special_file
nodes.summary: Writes a .keep or .promisor marker file next to the pack.

nodes.name: rename_tmp_packfile
nodes.summary: Moves a temporary pack, idx or rev file to its final hash-based name.

nodes.name: final
nodes.summary: Closes and fsyncs the pack, writes keep and promisor files, renames pack, rev and idx into place and reports the pack hash.

nodes.name: git_index_pack_config
nodes.summary: Config callback handling pack.indexVersion, pack.threads, pack.writeReverseIndex and core.deltaBaseCacheLimit.

nodes.name: read_v2_anomalous_offsets
nodes.summary: Scans a v2 idx file for 64-bit offset entries whose high word is zero and records them to reproduce the index.

nodes.name: read_idx_option
nodes.summary: Reads index version and anomaly offsets from an existing pack index when verifying a pack.

nodes.name: show_pack_info
nodes.summary: Prints per-object info and delta chain length statistics for --verify -v or --stat.

nodes.name: repack_local_links
nodes.summary: Feeds local objects referenced from a promisor pack to git pack-objects and creates .promisor files for the result.

nodes.name: cmd_index_pack
nodes.summary: Entry point for git index-pack: parses options and drives the passes (open, header, parse, resolve, conclude), checks objects, writes the idx and finalizes files.

nodes.name: object_entry
nodes.summary: Index-pack record for one pack object: index entry, size, header size, type and resolved real type.

nodes.name: base_data
nodes.summary: Delta base node in the resolution tree with parent, children ranges, cached data, retain count and list links.

nodes.name: thread_local_data
nodes.summary: Per-thread state with the thread handle and its own pack file descriptor.

nodes.name: ofs_delta_entry
nodes.summary: Ofs-delta table entry (base offset and object number).

nodes.name: ref_delta_entry
nodes.summary: Ref-delta table entry (base object ID and object number).

nodes.name: compare_data
nodes.summary: State for streaming comparison of a pack object against the odb copy.

nodes.name: merge-tree.c
nodes.summary: Implements git merge-tree with two modes: the legacy trivial three-way tree merge that prints conflicts and diffs, and --write-tree which runs the in-core ort merge machinery and prints the resulting tree and conflicted files without touching the index or working tree.

nodes.name: add_merge_entry
nodes.summary: Appends an entry to the global merge result list.

nodes.name: explanation
nodes.summary: Describes in words what happened to a path from its stage links, such as added in both or removed in local.

nodes.name: result
nodes.summary: Builds the merged blob content for an entry by reading stage 0 or merging base, ours and theirs with merge_blobs.

nodes.name: origin
nodes.summary: Reads the "ours" (stage 2) version of an entry for diffing.

nodes.name: show_outf
nodes.summary: xdiff output callback that prints diff buffers to stdout.

nodes.name: show_diff
nodes.summary: Prints a diff between the original and merged contents of an entry using xdi_diff.

nodes.name: show_result_list
nodes.summary: Prints an entry explanation and each linked stage with mode, object ID and path.

nodes.name: show_result
nodes.summary: Walks the merge result list printing each entry and its diff.

nodes.name: same_entry
nodes.summary: Returns true when two tree entries have the same non-null object ID and mode.

nodes.name: both_empty
nodes.summary: Returns true when both tree entries are empty.

nodes.name: create_entry
nodes.summary: Allocates a merge_list entry for a stage, mode, blob and path.

nodes.name: traverse_path
nodes.summary: Builds the full path of a tree entry from traverse info.

nodes.name: resolve
nodes.summary: Records a trivially resolved path as a stage-0 result linked to the original "ours" entry.

nodes.name: unresolved_directory
nodes.summary: Recurses into subtrees when entries on any side are directories, merging them with trivial_merge_trees.

nodes.name: link_entry
nodes.summary: Links an entry for one stage into a conflict chain for a path.

nodes.name: unresolved
nodes.summary: Records an unresolved path as linked stage entries (1 base, 2 ours, 3 theirs) after recursing into directories.

nodes.name: threeway_callback
nodes.summary: traverse_trees callback implementing the three-way merge rules: identical changes, take theirs, take ours, otherwise unresolved.

nodes.name: trivial_merge_trees
nodes.summary: Runs a three-way traverse_trees over three tree descriptors using threeway_callback.

nodes.name: get_tree_descriptor
nodes.summary: Resolves a revision to a tree and fills a tree descriptor, dying if it is not a tree.

nodes.name: trivial_merge
nodes.summary: Implements --trivial-merge: builds descriptors for base and two branches, merges them and prints the result.

nodes.name: real_merge
nodes.summary: Implements --write-tree: resolves merge bases or trees, runs merge_incore_recursive or merge_incore_nonrecursive, prints the tree, conflicted files and messages.

nodes.name: cmd_merge_tree
nodes.summary: Entry point for git merge-tree: parses options, rejects incompatible combinations, and dispatches to trivial_merge or real_merge, including --stdin batch input.

nodes.name: merge_list
nodes.summary: Linked list node for a path at one stage with links to other stages of the same path.

nodes.name: merge_tree_options
nodes.summary: Options of merge-tree: mode, unrelated histories, messages, name-only, stdin and merge options.

nodes.name: mktag.c
nodes.summary: Implements git mktag: reads a tag object from stdin, validates it with strict fsck rules and checks that the tagged object exists with the declared type, then writes the tag to the object database.

nodes.name: mktag_fsck_error_func
nodes.summary: fsck error callback that treats both warnings and errors as failures (warnings only warn when not strict).

nodes.name: verify_object_in_tag
nodes.summary: Reads the tagged object, checks its type against the tag header and verifies its hash.

nodes.name: cmd_mktag
nodes.summary: Entry point for git mktag: reads the tag from stdin, runs strict fsck_tag_standalone, verifies the target and writes the tag object.

nodes.name: mktree.c
nodes.summary: Implements git mktree: parses ls-tree formatted lines from stdin, validates modes, types and object existence, sorts the entries and writes a tree object (optionally many trees in batch mode).

nodes.name: append_to_tree
nodes.summary: Appends a validated entry (mode, object ID, name without slash) to the global entry array.

nodes.name: ent_compare
nodes.summary: qsort comparator that orders entries using Git tree name ordering (directories compare as if they end with a slash).

nodes.name: write_tree
nodes.summary: Sorts entries, serializes them into the tree object format (mode, name, NUL, raw OID) and writes the tree to the object database.

nodes.name: mktree_line
nodes.summary: Parses one ls-tree style line, checks that mode, type and object agree and that the object exists without fetching, then appends the entry.

nodes.name: cmd_mktree
nodes.summary: Entry point for git mktree: reads lines (NUL or LF terminated), supports --missing and --batch, writes trees and prints their object IDs.

nodes.name: treeent
nodes.summary: A pending tree entry (mode, object ID, name) collected before writing the tree.

nodes.name: diagnose.c
nodes.summary: Implements the `git diagnose` support code: collects version, disk and object database statistics (and optionally selected .git directories) into a zip archive written through the archive machinery.

nodes.name: archive_dir
nodes.summary: Pairs a repository-relative directory path with a recursive flag; used to describe which .git directories get added to the diagnostics archive.

nodes.name: diagnose_option
nodes.summary: Maps a --diagnose option string ("stats", "all") to the diagnose_mode enum value.

nodes.name: option_parse_diagnose
nodes.summary: parse-options callback for --diagnose: with no argument selects stats mode (or none when negated), otherwise looks the value up in the diagnose_options table and errors on unknown values.

nodes.name: dir_file_stats_objects
nodes.summary: Callback for each file in a pack directory: stat()s the file and appends its name and byte size to a strbuf report.

nodes.name: dir_file_stats
nodes.summary: Odb-source callback that writes a "Contents of <path>" header and lists every file of that source's pack directory with its size.

nodes.name: count_files
nodes.summary: Opens a directory and counts the regular files it contains, skipping . and .. entries.

nodes.name: loose_objs_stats
nodes.summary: Walks the two-hex-digit fan-out subdirectories of an objects directory, counts loose object files in each and prints per-directory and total loose object counts.

nodes.name: add_directory_to_archiver
nodes.summary: Appends --prefix and --add-file arguments for every regular file in a directory (recursing when asked) to the archiver argument vector, warning on missing or odd entries.

nodes.name: create_diagnostics_archive
nodes.summary: Builds the diagnostics zip: redirects stdout to the zip file, adds virtual files with version/disk info, pack and loose object statistics, optionally whole .git subdirectories, then calls write_archive.

nodes.name: fsck.c
nodes.summary: Core of the Git object integrity checker: parses and validates commit, tree, tag and blob contents, maps fsck message ids to error/warn/ignore severities, and walks object links while tracking human-readable object names.

nodes.name: name_stack
nodes.summary: Small dynamic stack of tree entry names used by verify_ordered to detect non-consecutive duplicate directory/file entries.

nodes.name: fsck_gitmodules_data
nodes.summary: Callback context passed to the config parser when validating a .gitmodules blob (oid, options, accumulated result).

nodes.name: prepare_msg_ids
nodes.summary: Lazily builds the lower-case and camelCase spellings of every fsck message id string so config keys and --msg-types can be matched.

nodes.name: parse_msg_id
nodes.summary: Translates a lower-cased message id string into its fsck_msg_id enum index, or -1 if unknown.

nodes.name: list_config_fsck_msg_ids
nodes.summary: Adds every fsck.<MsgId> config item name to a string list for command-completion.

nodes.name: fsck_msg_type
nodes.summary: Returns the severity of a message id: the per-option override if one was set, else the default, promoting warnings to errors in strict mode.

nodes.name: parse_msg_type
nodes.summary: Parses the strings "error", "warn" and "ignore" into fsck_msg_type, dying on anything else.

nodes.name: is_valid_msg_type
nodes.summary: Checks that a message id name exists and that its severity string parses.

nodes.name: fsck_set_msg_type_from_ids
nodes.summary: Sets the severity of one message id, first materialising a per-options severity array initialised from the defaults.

nodes.name: fsck_set_msg_type
nodes.summary: Parses an id/severity pair, handles the largePathname max length suffix, refuses to demote fatal messages and stores the override.

nodes.name: fsck_set_msg_types
nodes.summary: Parses a space, comma or pipe separated list of id=severity items (and skiplist=path) and applies each to the fsck options.

nodes.name: fsck_vreport
nodes.summary: Shared reporting path for object and ref checks: resolves the message severity, drops ignored messages, prefixes the camelCase id and calls the options' error_func callback.

nodes.name: report
nodes.summary: Reports a problem with an object (unless its oid is on the skiplist) by filling a fsck_object_report and delegating to fsck_vreport.

nodes.name: fsck_report_ref
nodes.summary: Public entry point for reporting a problem found while checking a ref, forwarding to fsck_vreport.

nodes.name: fsck_enable_object_names
nodes.summary: Allocates the oid-to-name hash map so later walks can remember how each object was reached.

nodes.name: fsck_get_object_name
nodes.summary: Looks an oid up in the object name map and returns its recorded path-like name or NULL.

nodes.name: fsck_put_object_name
nodes.summary: Records a printf-formatted name for an oid in the object name map unless one already exists.

nodes.name: fsck_describe_object
nodes.summary: Returns "<hex> (<name>)" in one of four rotating static buffers for use in error messages.

nodes.name: fsck_walk_tree
nodes.summary: Parses a tree and invokes the walk callback on every blob and subtree entry (skipping gitlinks), propagating path-like object names and reporting bad modes.

nodes.name: fsck_walk_commit
nodes.summary: Parses a commit, walks its tree and parents via the callback and derives names such as HEAD~2 or HEAD^2 for parent commits.

nodes.name: fsck_walk_tag
nodes.summary: Parses a tag and passes the tagged object to the walk callback, inheriting the tag's name.

nodes.name: fsck_walk
nodes.summary: Dispatches on object type to walk the objects directly linked from a blob, tree, commit or tag.

nodes.name: name_stack_push
nodes.summary: Appends a name to the name_stack, growing the array.

nodes.name: name_stack_pop
nodes.summary: Pops the most recently pushed name from the name_stack or returns NULL.

nodes.name: name_stack_clear
nodes.summary: Frees the backing array of a name_stack.

nodes.name: verify_ordered
nodes.summary: Compares two consecutive tree entries by name, treating directory names as ending in a slash, and reports TREE_UNORDERED or TREE_HAS_DUPS including non-adjacent file/directory duplicates.

nodes.name: fsck_tree
nodes.summary: Validates a raw tree buffer entry by entry (null oids, full paths, ., .., .git, bad modes, zero-padded modes, sort order, duplicates, long names) and queues .gitmodules and .gitattributes blobs for later checking.

nodes.name: verify_headers
nodes.summary: Ensures commit or tag headers end with a blank line or newline and contain no NUL bytes so later linewise parsing is memory safe.

nodes.name: parse_timestamp_from_buf
nodes.summary: Copies digits from a bounded buffer and parses them as a timestamp without reading past the end.

nodes.name: fsck_ident
nodes.summary: Validates an author, committer or tagger line: name, email in angle brackets, space, canonical timestamp without overflow and a +/-hhmm time zone.

nodes.name: fsck_commit
nodes.summary: Validates a commit object: tree and parent lines with valid oids, exactly one author, a committer, well-formed identities and no NUL in the body.

nodes.name: fsck_tag_standalone
nodes.summary: Validates a tag object (object, type, tag name via check_refname_format, tagger, optional gpgsig) and returns the tagged oid and type for callers such as mktag.

nodes.name: fsck_gitmodules_fn
nodes.summary: Config callback that flags disallowed submodule names, urls, paths and update=command settings in a .gitmodules blob.

nodes.name: fsck_blob
nodes.summary: Validates blobs flagged as .gitmodules (parsed as in-memory config) or .gitattributes (size and line length limits), after honouring the skiplist.

nodes.name: fsck_object
nodes.summary: Entry point to check an in-memory object, reporting an error for NULL objects and otherwise calling fsck_buffer.

nodes.name: fsck_buffer
nodes.summary: Dispatches a raw object buffer to the blob, tree, commit or tag checker, reporting unknown types.

nodes.name: fsck_objects_error_function
nodes.summary: Default error callback for object problems: warnings print and return 0, errors print and return 1.

nodes.name: fsck_refs_error_function
nodes.summary: Error callback for ref checks that prints "<path>: <message>" as warning or error.

nodes.name: fsck_blobs
nodes.summary: After the walk, reads each queued .gitmodules or .gitattributes blob from the object database and checks it, reporting missing, non-blob or unreadable objects (promisor objects excepted).

nodes.name: fsck_finish
nodes.summary: Runs the deferred .gitmodules and .gitattributes blob checks collected during the object walk.

nodes.name: fsck_has_queued_checks
nodes.summary: Reports whether queued gitmodules or gitattributes blobs have not yet been checked.

nodes.name: fsck_options_init
nodes.summary: Initialises fsck_options from one of the predefined presets (default, strict, missing-gitmodules, refs) and attaches the repository.

nodes.name: fsck_options_clear
nodes.summary: Frees the severity array, skiplist and queued oidsets and the object name map held by fsck_options.

nodes.name: git_fsck_config
nodes.summary: Config callback handling fsck.skiplist and fsck.<msgid> keys and falling back to default config.

nodes.name: fsck_objects_error_cb_print_missing_gitmodules
nodes.summary: Error callback that prints the oid of missing .gitmodules blobs and otherwise defers to the default object error function.

nodes.name: fsck.h
nodes.summary: Public interface of the object integrity checker: fsck message ids and severities, the fsck_options structure with walk and error callbacks, and functions to check objects, walk links and manage object names.

nodes.name: fsck_msg_type
nodes.summary: Severity levels of an fsck message (ignore, info, fatal, error, warn).

nodes.name: fsck_msg_id
nodes.summary: Enumeration generated from the FOREACH_FSCK_MSG_ID list: one id per kind of problem fsck can report.

nodes.name: fsck_object_report
nodes.summary: Report payload identifying the object (oid and type) a problem was found in.

nodes.name: fsck_ref_report
nodes.summary: Report payload identifying the ref path a problem was found in.

nodes.name: fsck_options
nodes.summary: Configuration and state of an fsck run: repository, walk and error callbacks, strictness, severity overrides, skiplist and queued .gitmodules and .gitattributes blobs and object names.

nodes.name: fsck_options_type
nodes.summary: Presets for fsck_options_init: default, strict, missing-gitmodules and refs.

nodes.name: hash-lookup.h
nodes.summary: Declares binary-search helpers over sorted hash tables: oid_pos for arrays accessed through a callback and bsearch_hash for fanout-indexed raw hash tables as used by pack indexes and MIDX files.

nodes.name: hex.h
nodes.summary: Declares conversions between binary object ids or hashes and their hexadecimal text form, including reentrant and static-buffer variants and parsers that stop at the first invalid character.

nodes.name: http-push.c
nodes.summary: Implements the git-http-push helper: pushes objects and updates refs on a WebDAV HTTP server using LOCK/MKCOL/PUT/MOVE/PROPFIND requests driven through curl slots, with a request queue, lock refresh and expat XML parsing.

nodes.name: repo
nodes.summary: State for the remote repository being pushed to: URL and path, whether info/refs and info/packs exist, the known remote packs and the list of held DAV locks.

nodes.name: transfer_state
nodes.summary: Life cycle states of a transfer_request (fetch loose or packed, mkcol, put, move, aborted, complete).

nodes.name: transfer_request
nodes.summary: Queue entry describing one object being fetched from or pushed to the remote, with its curl slot, URLs, buffer and current transfer_state.

nodes.name: xml_ctx
nodes.summary: Context for the expat callbacks: current dotted element path, character data and the per-purpose handler function.

nodes.name: remote_lock
nodes.summary: A DAV lock held on a remote resource: url, owner, token, temporary file suffix, start time and timeout.

nodes.name: remote_ls_ctx
nodes.summary: Context for a PROPFIND directory listing: path, flags, per-entry callback and the entry currently being parsed.

nodes.name: curl_setup_http
nodes.summary: Configures a curl handle for an upload-style request with a custom method, reading the body from an in-memory buffer and writing the response with the given callback.

nodes.name: get_dav_token_headers
nodes.summary: Builds the curl header list (If, Lock-Token, Timeout) that presents a DAV lock token for a request.

nodes.name: start_fetch_loose
nodes.summary: Starts an HTTP GET of a loose object into the local object store and registers process_response as the slot callback, aborting the request on failure.

nodes.name: start_mkcol
nodes.summary: Issues a WebDAV MKCOL to create the two-hex-digit objects subdirectory on the remote before an object is uploaded.

nodes.name: start_fetch_packed
nodes.summary: Looks up the pack containing a wanted object in the remote's pack list and starts downloading that packfile, avoiding duplicate pack requests.

nodes.name: start_put
nodes.summary: Reads an object from the object database, zlib-compresses its header and body into a buffer and starts a DAV PUT to a temporary lock-suffixed URL with a destination header for the final name.

nodes.name: start_move
nodes.summary: Starts the DAV MOVE that renames the uploaded temporary object file to its final loose object path with Overwrite: T.

nodes.name: refresh_lock
nodes.summary: Sends a DAV LOCK refresh request for a lock before it expires and updates its start time.

nodes.name: check_locks
nodes.summary: Walks held locks and refreshes any whose remaining time is below the refresh threshold, aborting the push if a refresh fails.

nodes.name: release_request
nodes.summary: Unlinks a transfer_request from the global queue and frees its url, destination and buffer.

nodes.name: finish_request
nodes.summary: State machine step run when a curl slot completes: advances MKCOL to PUT to MOVE for pushes or finishes loose and packed fetches, marking objects LOCAL or REMOTE and aborting on errors.

nodes.name: fill_active_slot
nodes.summary: Queue filler callback that picks the next NEED_FETCH or NEED_PUSH request and starts the matching fetch, mkcol or put.

nodes.name: add_fetch_request
nodes.summary: Queues a fetch for an object that is not yet local, listing the remote object subdirectory first if unknown.

nodes.name: add_send_request
nodes.summary: Queues an upload for an object unless it is already on the remote or in a remote pack, returning whether a request was added.

nodes.name: fetch_indices
nodes.summary: Fetches objects/info/packs from the remote to learn which packs it has.

nodes.name: one_remote_object
nodes.summary: Marks an object known to exist on the remote with the REMOTE flag, creating its in-memory object if needed.

nodes.name: handle_lockprop_ctx
nodes.summary: XML callback for a supportedlock PROPFIND reply that records whether exclusive write locks are supported.

nodes.name: handle_new_lock_ctx
nodes.summary: XML callback that extracts owner, timeout and token from a LOCK reply and derives a token-hash temporary file suffix.

nodes.name: xml_start_tag
nodes.summary: Expat start-element handler that appends the namespace-stripped tag to the dotted element path and calls the context callback.

nodes.name: xml_end_tag
nodes.summary: Expat end-element handler that calls the context callback and pops the last element from the dotted path.

nodes.name: lock_remote
nodes.summary: Creates missing parent collections with MKCOL, sends a DAV LOCK for a remote ref or file and parses the reply into a remote_lock added to the repo's lock list.

nodes.name: unlock_remote
nodes.summary: Sends DAV UNLOCK for a lock, removes it from the repo's lock list and frees it.

nodes.name: remove_locks
nodes.summary: Unlocks every lock currently held on the remote repository.

nodes.name: get_oid_hex_from_objpath
nodes.summary: Converts an objects path of the form xx/yyyy... back to an object id.

nodes.name: process_ls_object
nodes.summary: PROPFIND callback for objects/XX/ listings: notes that the directory exists and registers each listed loose object as being on the remote.

nodes.name: process_ls_ref
nodes.summary: PROPFIND callback used while listing refs/ that fetches each remote ref entry.

nodes.name: handle_remote_ls_ctx
nodes.summary: XML callback for PROPFIND multistatus replies: tracks each response's name and collection flag and invokes the user callback, recursing into subcollections when asked.

nodes.name: remote_ls
nodes.summary: Sends a PROPFIND Depth: 1 request for a remote path and parses the XML reply, calling a callback per file or directory entry.

nodes.name: get_remote_object_list
nodes.summary: Lists one objects/XX directory on the remote to learn which loose objects already exist there.

nodes.name: locking_available
nodes.summary: Probes the server with a PROPFIND for supported lock types and returns whether exclusive write locking is available.

nodes.name: process_blob
nodes.summary: Marks a blob as LOCAL and, if not yet seen or uninteresting, appends it to the list of objects to send.

nodes.name: process_tree
nodes.summary: Recursively adds a tree and all of its trees and blobs to the list of objects to send, skipping seen or uninteresting ones and gitlinks.

nodes.name: get_delta
nodes.summary: Consumes a revision walk to collect commits, trees, blobs and tags to push and queues an upload request for each object not marked uninteresting.

nodes.name: update_remote
nodes.summary: PUTs the new object id as the content of the locked remote ref file to complete a ref update.

nodes.name: one_remote_ref
nodes.summary: Fetches one remote ref's value over HTTP, records it in the remote ref list and queues a fetch of its object if missing locally.

nodes.name: add_remote_info_ref
nodes.summary: PROPFIND callback that appends one ref (and its peeled tag target) to the buffer being built for info/refs.

nodes.name: update_remote_info_refs
nodes.summary: Lists all remote refs and PUTs a regenerated info/refs file under lock so dumb HTTP clients see current refs.

nodes.name: remote_exists
nodes.summary: Checks with a GET whether a remote path exists, returning 1, 0 or -1 on error.

nodes.name: fetch_symref
nodes.summary: Fetches a remote file and parses it as either a "ref: name" symbolic reference or a raw object id.

nodes.name: verify_merge_base
nodes.summary: Checks that a remote branch tip is reachable from the local HEAD using merge-base logic.

nodes.name: delete_remote_branch
nodes.summary: Validates a remote branch deletion (single match, not the remote HEAD, ancestor of HEAD unless forced) and sends a DAV DELETE for the ref.

nodes.name: run_request_queue
nodes.summary: Drives the transfer queue by repeatedly filling and finishing active curl slots until the queue is empty or aborted.

nodes.name: cmd_main
nodes.summary: Entry point of git-http-push: parses arguments, initialises HTTP, checks DAV locking, lists remote refs, matches refspecs, locks each remote ref, walks and uploads missing objects, updates the ref and info/refs, then unlocks.

nodes.name: http-walker.c
nodes.summary: Implements the dumb HTTP object walker used by git fetch over http: fetches loose objects, packs, and http-alternates through a queue of curl slots and exposes them through the generic walker interface.

nodes.name: alt_base
nodes.summary: One base URL (the repository itself or an alternate) with its pack list and a flag saying whether its pack indices were fetched.

nodes.name: object_request_state
nodes.summary: States of an object download request: waiting, aborted, active or complete.

nodes.name: object_request
nodes.summary: A queued request for one object oid against an alt_base, wrapping the http_object_request and a list node.

nodes.name: alternates_request
nodes.summary: Context for fetching and parsing the http-alternates or alternates file of a base URL.

nodes.name: walker_data
nodes.summary: Per-walker state: base URL, alternates fetch status and the linked list of alt_base entries.

nodes.name: start_object_request
nodes.summary: Creates the http object request for a queued object and starts its curl slot, marking the request ACTIVE or ABORTED.

nodes.name: process_object_response
nodes.summary: Slot callback for a finished loose object download: on a missing target loads alternates and retries against the next base, otherwise finishes the request.

nodes.name: fill_active_slot
nodes.summary: Queue filler that starts the next WAITING object request unless the object already exists locally.

nodes.name: prefetch
nodes.summary: Adds an object to the request queue and kicks the active slots so the download can start before it is needed.

nodes.name: is_alternate_allowed
nodes.summary: Decides whether an alternate URL may be followed, checking http.followRedirects and the allowed transport protocols.

nodes.name: process_alternates_response
nodes.summary: Parses the downloaded alternates list, resolving ../ relative entries against the base URL, filtering by is_alternate_allowed and appending new alt_base entries; retries the non-HTTP-specific file once.

nodes.name: fetch_alternates
nodes.summary: Downloads objects/info/http-alternates (falling back to alternates) for a base URL, waiting for any concurrent fetch to finish.

nodes.name: fetch_indices
nodes.summary: Downloads objects/info/packs for a repository base to learn which packfiles exist.

nodes.name: http_fetch_pack
nodes.summary: Finds the pack that contains a wanted object, downloads the whole packfile, verifies and installs it.

nodes.name: fetch_object
nodes.summary: Waits for the queued request of an object to finish and validates the result: compression stream end, hash of the contents and rename, reporting corruption or write failures.

nodes.name: fetch
nodes.summary: Walker fetch hook: tries the loose object first, then each alternate's packs, failing if the object is found nowhere.

nodes.name: cleanup
