nodes.summary: Initialises zlib inflation on a loose object and reads enough output to contain the full header.

nodes.name: unpack_loose_rest
nodes.summary: Inflates the remainder of a loose object body, checking stream end and trailing garbage.

nodes.name: parse_loose_header
nodes.summary: Parses "<type> <size>\0" from an inflated header into object_info, enforcing canonical decimal size.

nodes.name: map_fd
nodes.summary: mmaps an open object file and closes the descriptor, rejecting empty files.

nodes.name: check_collision
nodes.summary: Compares two files byte by byte to confirm a colliding object file has identical content.

nodes.name: finalize_object_file
nodes.summary: Moves a temporary object file to its final name.

nodes.name: finalize_object_file_flags
nodes.summary: Hard-links or renames a temp object file into place, falls back when links fail, detects collisions on existing objects and fixes shared permissions.

nodes.name: hash_object_file
nodes.summary: Computes an object's id by hashing its header and content with the chosen algorithm.

nodes.name: odb_transaction_files_prepare
nodes.summary: Lazily creates the quarantine temporary object directory for a transaction.

nodes.name: odb_transaction_files_fsync
nodes.summary: Within a transaction issues a writeout-only fsync, deferring the hardware flush until commit.

nodes.name: index_mem
nodes.summary: Converts a buffer (clean filter, optional format check via fsck) and either writes it as an object or only computes its oid.

nodes.name: index_stream_convert_blob
nodes.summary: Runs a clean filter on a file descriptor and hashes or writes the converted blob.

nodes.name: index_pipe
nodes.summary: Reads an entire non-regular file into memory and indexes it.

nodes.name: index_core
nodes.summary: Indexes a file by reading small files into a buffer or mmapping large ones, then calling index_mem.

nodes.name: already_written
nodes.summary: Checks whether an object already exists in the repository or in the in-progress packfile.

nodes.name: prepare_packfile_transaction
nodes.summary: Lazily creates the temporary packfile and header for a transaction.

nodes.name: hash_stream
nodes.summary: Hashes a streamed object (header plus data) and verifies the declared size.

nodes.name: stream_to_pack
nodes.summary: Deflates data read from a stream into the packfile while hashing, writing in chunks and checking the declared size.

nodes.name: flush_packfile_transaction
nodes.summary: Finalises the transaction's packfile: fixes up the header, writes the index, renames pack and idx into the pack directory and registers them.

nodes.name: odb_transaction_files_write_object_stream
nodes.summary: Writes a large blob stream as a single non-delta entry in the transaction's packfile, truncating it if the object already existed.

nodes.name: index_fd
nodes.summary: Chooses how to index a file descriptor (filter stream, pipe, in-memory, or stream into a packfile for big files) and returns the object id.

nodes.name: index_path
nodes.summary: Indexes a path by file type: regular file, symlink target, or gitlink (submodule HEAD) into an object id.

nodes.name: read_pack_header
nodes.summary: Reads and validates a pack header (signature, version) from a descriptor.

nodes.name: for_each_file_in_obj_subdir
nodes.summary: Iterates one loose-object fan-out directory, calling callbacks for each valid object, cruft file and the directory itself.

nodes.name: for_each_loose_file_in_source
nodes.summary: Iterates all 256 loose subdirectories of an object source with the given callbacks.

nodes.name: check_stream_oid
nodes.summary: Inflates a loose object stream and hashes its contents, comparing with the expected oid.

nodes.name: read_loose_object
nodes.summary: Reads a loose object file, unpacks it, parses its header, verifies the hash and returns the contents for fsck and similar callers.

nodes.name: odb_transaction_files_commit
nodes.summary: Flushes a transaction: does one full hardware fsync, migrates quarantined objects into the main ODB and finishes the packfile.

nodes.name: get_unpack_limit
nodes.summary: Chooses the object-count threshold below which incoming packs are exploded with unpack-objects.

nodes.name: odb_transaction_files_write_pack
nodes.summary: Ingests an incoming pack by running unpack-objects or index-pack on it inside the transaction's quarantine environment.

nodes.name: odb_transaction_files_finalize
nodes.summary: Deletes pack lockfiles and frees transaction state.

nodes.name: odb_transaction_files_env
nodes.summary: Prepares the quarantine and returns environment variables pointing child processes at it.

nodes.name: odb_transaction_files_begin
nodes.summary: Allocates a files-backend transaction, installs its vtable and optionally creates the quarantine eagerly for receive-pack.

nodes.name: object-file.h
nodes.summary: Interface of the loose object file layer: indexing files into objects, loose path construction and iteration, object header formatting, signature checks, finalising object files and the files-backend transaction entry points.

nodes.name: unpack_loose_header_result
nodes.summary: Outcome of unpack_loose_header: header ok, bad data or header too long.

nodes.name: finalize_object_file_flags
nodes.summary: Flags for finalize_object_file_flags, such as skipping the collision check.

nodes.name: object.c
nodes.summary: Core in-memory object layer: per-repository hash table of struct object keyed by oid, type name/number mapping, lookup and creation of typed objects, parsing objects from the ODB with hash verification, tag peeling, and object list and array helpers.

nodes.name: get_max_object_index
nodes.summary: Returns the size of the repository's in-memory object hash table.

nodes.name: get_indexed_object
nodes.summary: Returns the object stored at a given slot of the object hash table.

nodes.name: type_name
nodes.summary: Returns the string name ("commit", "tree", "blob", "tag") of an object type number.

nodes.name: type_from_string_gently
nodes.summary: Maps a type name to its object_type value, returning -1 or dying when unknown.

nodes.name: insert_obj_hash
nodes.summary: Inserts an object into the open-addressed hash table using linear probing.

nodes.name: lookup_object
nodes.summary: Finds an object by oid in the hash table and moves it to its first probe slot for faster later lookups.

nodes.name: grow_object_hash
nodes.summary: Doubles the object hash table and reinserts all entries.

nodes.name: create_object
nodes.summary: Initialises a new object with its oid and inserts it into the hash table, growing it when half full.

nodes.name: object_as_type
nodes.summary: Checks or sets the type of an in-memory object, initialising commit nodes and reporting type mismatches.

nodes.name: lookup_unknown_object
nodes.summary: Returns the existing object for an oid or creates a typeless one.

nodes.name: lookup_object_by_type
nodes.summary: Dispatches to lookup_commit, lookup_tree, lookup_tag or lookup_blob for the given type.

nodes.name: peel_object_ext
nodes.summary: Peels a tag chain to a non-tag object, reading types from the ODB when unknown, and reports the result status and final type.

nodes.name: peel_object
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper for peel_object_ext that ignores the resulting type.

nodes.name: parse_object_buffer
nodes.summary: Parses an in-memory buffer as a blob, tree, commit or tag and attaches the parsed data to the right object.

nodes.name: parse_object_or_die
nodes.summary: Parses an object and dies with a message if it cannot be read.

nodes.name: parse_object_with_flags
nodes.summary: Reads an object by oid, optionally verifying its hash (streaming for blobs), consults the commit graph shortcut and returns the parsed object.

nodes.name: parse_object
nodes.summary: Reads, verifies and parses an object by oid.

nodes.name: object_list_insert
nodes.summary: Prepends an object to a singly linked object list.

nodes.name: object_list_contains
nodes.summary: Checks whether an object is in a linked object list.

nodes.name: object_list_free
nodes.summary: Frees an object list.

nodes.name: object_array_init
nodes.summary: Resets an object_array to the empty state.

nodes.name: add_object_array_with_path
nodes.summary: Appends an object with name, mode and path to an object_array, growing it.

nodes.name: add_object_array
nodes.summary: Appends an object with a name to an object_array.

nodes.name: object_array_pop
nodes.summary: Removes and returns the last object of an object_array.

nodes.name: object_array_filter
nodes.summary: Keeps only entries accepted by a callback, releasing the rest.

nodes.name: object_array_clear
nodes.summary: Releases all entries of an object_array and its storage.

nodes.name: clear_object_flags
nodes.summary: Clears the given flag bits on every object in the hash table.

nodes.name: repo_clear_commit_marks
nodes.summary: Clears flag bits on all commit objects in the hash table.

nodes.name: parsed_object_pool_new
nodes.summary: Allocates a parsed_object_pool with per-type allocators and commit buffer slab for a repository.

nodes.name: parsed_object_pool_reset_commit_grafts
nodes.summary: Frees commit grafts and unparses the commits they affect.

nodes.name: parsed_object_pool_clear
nodes.summary: Frees all object hash contents, buffers, allocation slabs and shallow state of a pool.

nodes.name: object.h
nodes.summary: Central object model header: enum object_type, struct object with parsed bit, type and flag bits, the per-repository parsed_object_pool, object lists and arrays, and lookup, parse and peel APIs.

nodes.name: parsed_object_pool
nodes.summary: Per-repository pool of parsed objects: the oid hash table, allocators for each object type, commit buffer slab, grafts and shallow state.

nodes.name: object_list
nodes.summary: Singly linked list node holding a struct object pointer.

nodes.name: object_array
nodes.summary: Growable array of objects with optional name, path and mode per entry, used for pending objects.

nodes.name: object_type
nodes.summary: Enumeration of Git object types: commit, tree, blob, tag, delta types and sentinels.

nodes.name: object
nodes.summary: Header shared by every in-memory object: parsed bit, type, flag bits and object id.

nodes.name: parse_object_flags
nodes.summary: Flags for parse_object_with_flags to skip hash verification or discard tree buffers.

nodes.name: peel_status
nodes.summary: Result codes of peeling a tag to its target.

nodes.name: odb.h
nodes.summary: Public API of the object database: struct object_database with its object sources and alternates, and functions to read, write, check, iterate, count, repack-optimise, fsck and generate packs of objects, plus struct object_info and its query flags.

nodes.name: object_database
nodes.summary: The object database of a repository: owner repo, current transaction, primary and alternate object sources and caches.

nodes.name: object_info
nodes.summary: Request/response structure for object queries; callers set pointers for the fields they want (type, size, delta base, content).

nodes.name: odb_read_status
nodes.summary: Result codes of odb_read_object_info_extended.

nodes.name: odb_has_object_flags
nodes.summary: Flags for odb_has_object: recheck packs and allow promisor fetch.

nodes.name: odb_write_object_flags
nodes.summary: Flags for writing objects (for example freshen existing, no quarantine).

nodes.name: odb_generate_pack_options
nodes.summary: Options controlling pack generation from the ODB (revision spec, filter, thin and delta settings).

nodes.name: source-files.c
nodes.summary: Implements the 'files' object database source, the on-disk backend that pairs a loose-object source with a packed source. It dispatches reads and writes to those two sub-sources, manages alternates files, and implements repack/gc-style optimization, pack generation through git pack-objects, and fsck.

nodes.name: source-inmemory.c
nodes.summary: Implements an in-memory object database source that stores objects in an oidtree and never persists them to disk. It fills the generic odb_source vtable (read info/stream, iterate, count, abbreviation length, write, freshen) and rejects transactions and alternates.

nodes.name: source-inmemory.h
nodes.summary: Declares struct odb_source_inmemory (an odb_source plus an oidtree of objects), its constructor and a checked downcast helper from a generic odb_source.

nodes.name: source-packed.c
nodes.summary: Implements the packfile-backed object database source: it finds an object across the multi-pack-index and the MRU-ordered pack list, reads info and streams, iterates (optionally via bitmaps or by hex prefix), computes abbreviation lengths, discovers packs on disk and reports garbage, and runs fsck over packs, rev-indexes, bitmaps and the MIDX.

nodes.name: find_cached_object
nodes.summary: Looks up an object in the in-memory oidtree, treating the algorithm's empty tree as always present.

nodes.name: populate_object_info
nodes.summary: Fills the requested fields of an object_info (type, size, content copy, zero disk size and mtime) from an in-memory object.

nodes.name: odb_source_inmemory_read_object_info
nodes.summary: Vtable read_object_info: finds the object and populates the requested info or reports not found.

nodes.name: odb_read_stream_inmemory_read
nodes.summary: Reads the next chunk of an in-memory object stream by memcpy and advancing the offset.

nodes.name: odb_source_inmemory_read_object_stream
nodes.summary: Vtable read_object_stream: creates a stream over the stored buffer of an in-memory object.

nodes.name: odb_source_inmemory_for_each_object_cb
nodes.summary: oidtree callback adapter that builds object_info for the request and forwards to the caller's callback.

nodes.name: odb_source_inmemory_for_each_object
nodes.summary: Vtable for_each_object: iterates the oidtree by optional hex prefix, skipping when promisor-only or local-only filters exclude this source.

nodes.name: find_abbrev_len_cb
nodes.summary: Per-object callback that lengthens the abbreviation if an object shares a longer prefix with the target id.

nodes.name: odb_source_inmemory_find_abbrev_len
nodes.summary: Vtable find_abbrev_len: scans objects sharing the requested prefix to compute the shortest unambiguous abbreviation length.

nodes.name: odb_source_inmemory_write_object
nodes.summary: Vtable write_object: lazily creates the oidtree and stores a copy of the buffer keyed by oid unless it is already present.

nodes.name: odb_source_inmemory_write_object_stream
nodes.summary: Vtable write_object_stream: reads a stream fully into memory checking its declared size, hashes it to get the oid and stores it.

nodes.name: odb_source_inmemory_free
nodes.summary: Frees every stored object, the oidtree and the source itself.

nodes.name: odb_source_inmemory_new
nodes.summary: Allocates an in-memory source and installs its function pointers into the odb_source base.

nodes.name: odb_source_files_reparent
nodes.summary: chdir-notify callback that rewrites a relative source path after the working directory changes.

nodes.name: odb_source_files_create_on_disk
nodes.summary: Creates the object directory with its pack and info subdirectories.

nodes.name: odb_source_files_read_object_info
nodes.summary: Reads object info trying the packed source first and the loose source second, preferring the packed error when both fail for a reason other than not found.

nodes.name: odb_source_files_read_object_stream
nodes.summary: Opens an object stream from the packed source or else the loose source.

nodes.name: odb_source_files_for_each_object
nodes.summary: Iterates objects of the loose source (unless promisor-only) and then of the packed source.

nodes.name: odb_source_files_count_objects
nodes.summary: Counts objects as packed count plus loose count, skipping the loose scan for approximate counts.

nodes.name: odb_source_files_find_abbrev_len
nodes.summary: Computes a unique abbreviation length by consulting the packed source and then the loose source.

nodes.name: odb_source_files_freshen_object
nodes.summary: Updates the timestamp of an existing object in either the packed or loose source so it is not pruned.

nodes.name: odb_source_files_write_object
nodes.summary: Writes an object by delegating to the loose source; packs are only produced by repacking.

nodes.name: odb_source_files_read_alternates
nodes.summary: Reads objects/info/alternates and parses each line into a list of alternate object directories.

nodes.name: odb_source_files_write_alternate
nodes.summary: Adds an alternate path to info/alternates under a lock file, skipping the write if the path is already listed.

nodes.name: too_many_loose_objects
nodes.summary: Estimates the loose object count and compares it with the gc.auto threshold rounded up to a multiple of 256.

nodes.name: find_base_packs
nodes.summary: Selects the packs that repack should keep: all non-cruft packs at or above a size limit, or the single largest one.

nodes.name: too_many_packs
nodes.summary: Counts packs without a .keep file and compares with gc.autoPackLimit.

nodes.name: total_ram
nodes.summary: Returns physical memory using sysinfo, BSD sysctl or the Windows API.

nodes.name: estimate_repack_memory
nodes.summary: Estimates the memory a full repack would need from the object count, struct sizes, delta caches and pack size.

nodes.name: add_repack_all_option
nodes.summary: Chooses the repack flags for a full repack (-a, --cruft or -A with expiry) and adds keep-pack and filter options from config.

nodes.name: odb_source_files_optimize_required
nodes.summary: Decides whether maintenance is needed under the incremental strategy (too many packs or loose objects) or the geometric strategy (packs would merge or loose objects exceed the threshold).

nodes.name: odb_source_files_optimize
nodes.summary: Runs git repack with options derived from the strategy and memory estimates, then runs git prune with the expiry and warns about too many unreachable loose objects.

nodes.name: odb_pack_generator_files_finish
nodes.summary: Waits for the pack-objects child process and turns its exit status into a result, ignoring SIGPIPE.

nodes.name: odb_source_files_generate_pack
nodes.summary: Spawns git pack-objects --revs --stdout (or a pack-objects hook) with the requested options and feeds it the wants, haves and shallow boundary on stdin.

nodes.name: odb_source_files_fsck
nodes.summary: Runs fsck over the loose and packed sub-sources, skipping non-local sources unless a full check is requested.

nodes.name: odb_source_files_new
nodes.summary: Allocates a files source with its loose and packed sub-sources, installs the vtable and registers a chdir callback for relative paths.

nodes.name: find_pack_entry
nodes.summary: Finds the pack and offset of an object by trying the multi-pack-index first and then the MRU pack list (moving hits to the front), with a recovery scan for stale MIDX entries.

nodes.name: odb_source_packed_read_object_info
nodes.summary: Vtable read_object_info: locates the object in the packs, reloads the pack list on a second read, reads its info and marks the pack bad on corruption.

nodes.name: odb_source_packed_read_object_stream
nodes.summary: Vtable read_object_stream: finds the pack entry and opens a streaming reader over it.

nodes.name: odb_source_packed_for_each_object_wrapper
nodes.summary: Callback adapter that optionally resolves object_info for an indexed pack entry before invoking the user callback.

nodes.name: match_hash
nodes.summary: Compares two object-id byte arrays over a hex-digit prefix length, handling an odd nibble.

nodes.name: should_exclude_pack
nodes.summary: Applies local-only, promisor-only and kept-pack flags to decide whether a pack is skipped during iteration.

nodes.name: for_each_prefixed_object_in_midx
nodes.summary: Binary-searches each multi-pack-index layer for a hex prefix and reports every matching object after excluded-pack checks.

nodes.name: for_each_prefixed_object_in_pack
nodes.summary: Binary-searches one pack index for a hex prefix and reports every matching object.

nodes.name: odb_source_packed_for_each_prefixed_object
nodes.summary: Iterates objects matching a prefix across the MIDX and all packs not covered by it, disabling MRU reordering during the loop.

nodes.name: bitmapped_for_each_object
nodes.summary: Bitmap iteration callback that applies pack exclusion and optionally loads object info before calling the user callback.

nodes.name: odb_source_packed_for_each_object
nodes.summary: Vtable for_each_object: uses a reachability bitmap to emit filtered objects when possible, then iterates the remaining packs in index or pack order.

nodes.name: odb_source_packed_count_objects
nodes.summary: Vtable count_objects: sums MIDX objects and objects of packs outside the MIDX.

nodes.name: find_abbrev_len_for_midx
nodes.summary: Finds the abbreviation length needed against the neighbors of an id in each MIDX layer.

nodes.name: find_abbrev_len_for_pack
nodes.summary: Finds the abbreviation length needed against the neighbors of an id in one pack index.

nodes.name: odb_source_packed_find_abbrev_len
nodes.summary: Vtable find_abbrev_len: combines the MIDX and per-pack results into the minimal unique abbreviation length.

nodes.name: odb_source_packed_freshen_object
nodes.summary: Vtable freshen_object: bumps the mtime of the pack that holds an object (skipping cruft packs) so it survives pruning.

nodes.name: odb_source_packed_write_object
nodes.summary: Vtable write_object stub that fails because the packed backend is read-only.

nodes.name: report_pack_garbage
nodes.summary: Sorts the files found in the pack directory and reports those lacking a matching .pack/.idx pair through the garbage callback.

nodes.name: prepare_pack
nodes.summary: Directory-scan callback that loads each .idx not covered by the MIDX as a pack and records stray pack-related files as garbage.

nodes.name: prepare_packed_git_one
nodes.summary: Scans the pack directory of the source with prepare_pack and reports garbage.

nodes.name: sort_pack
nodes.summary: Pack list ordering: local packs first, then newer mtime first.

nodes.name: odb_source_packed_prepare
nodes.summary: Vtable prepare: loads the multi-pack-index and the pack list once (or again after a cache flush) and sorts it.

nodes.name: odb_source_packed_reparent
nodes.summary: chdir-notify callback that rewrites a relative source path.

nodes.name: odb_source_packed_close
nodes.summary: Vtable close: closes every pack and the multi-pack-index.

nodes.name: odb_source_packed_free
nodes.summary: Vtable free: closes the source and frees packs, the path map and the source.

nodes.name: verify_packs
nodes.summary: Verifies every pack's contents with verify_pack, showing progress, and returns an error if any fails.

nodes.name: verify_reverse_indices
nodes.summary: Loads and verifies the .rev file of each pack against an in-memory reverse index.

nodes.name: verify_midx
nodes.summary: Runs git multi-pack-index verify as a child process when the MIDX feature is enabled.

nodes.name: odb_source_packed_fsck
nodes.summary: Vtable fsck: verifies packs (full mode), reverse indexes, bitmap files and the multi-pack-index.

nodes.name: odb_source_packed_new
nodes.summary: Allocates a packed source, installs the vtable and registers a chdir callback for relative paths.

nodes.name: odb_source_inmemory
nodes.summary: Backend struct for the in-memory object database source: an odb_source base plus an oidtree holding objects.

nodes.name: odb_pack_generator_files
nodes.summary: Generator handle of the files backend wrapping the pack-objects child process.

nodes.name: inmemory_object
nodes.summary: Stored in-memory object: type, buffer and size.

nodes.name: odb_read_stream_inmemory
nodes.summary: Stream state reading from an in-memory object buffer.

nodes.name: source-packed.h
nodes.summary: Declares struct odb_source_packed, the store that tracks packfiles in most-recently-used order together with the kept-pack cache, the multi-pack-index and a path-to-pack map, plus its constructor and downcast helper.

nodes.name: streaming.c
nodes.summary: Implements the streaming object interface (struct odb_stream): opening a stream for an object from any source or an in-core fallback, optionally wrapping it in a conversion filter, streaming a blob to a file descriptor with hole detection, and a stream over a file descriptor.

nodes.name: streaming.h
nodes.summary: Declares the odb_stream abstraction (close and read callbacks plus type and size) and the entry points for creating streams from an object or from a file descriptor and for writing a blob to a file descriptor.

nodes.name: oidset.c
nodes.summary: Implements oidset, a khash-backed set of object ids with insert/contains/remove/equality, plus helpers that load a set from a text file of object names with comments and an optional tweak callback.

nodes.name: oidset_init
nodes.summary: Initializes an oidset and optionally preallocates its khash table for an expected number of entries.

nodes.name: oidset_contains
nodes.summary: Returns whether the set holds a given object id by looking it up in the khash table.

nodes.name: oidset_equal
nodes.summary: Compares two sets for equality by checking that sizes match and every id of the first appears in the second.

nodes.name: oidset_insert
nodes.summary: Inserts a copy of an object id and returns 1 if it was already present, enabling check-and-add.

nodes.name: oidset_insert_from_set
nodes.summary: Copies every object id of a source set into a destination set, growing the destination table up front.

nodes.name: oidset_remove
nodes.summary: Removes an object id from the set and reports whether it had been present.

nodes.name: oidset_clear
nodes.summary: Releases the khash storage of the set and reinitializes it to empty.

nodes.name: oidset_parse_file
nodes.summary: Loads object names from a text file into a set by delegating to the careful parser with no tweak callback.

nodes.name: oidset_parse_file_carefully
nodes.summary: Reads a file line by line, strips comments and whitespace, parses each line as a full hex object id (dying on bad input), lets an optional callback skip or rewrite it, and inserts it into the set.

nodes.name: read_istream_filtered
nodes.summary: Reads from a filtered stream by feeding upstream data through a stream filter in buffer-sized chunks, draining the filter when input ends.

nodes.name: attach_stream_filter
nodes.summary: Wraps an existing odb_stream in a filtered stream that applies a conversion filter while reading.

nodes.name: read_istream_incore
nodes.summary: Reads from a fully loaded in-memory buffer, copying at most the remaining bytes.

nodes.name: open_istream_incore
nodes.summary: Fallback stream: loads the whole object into memory via odb_read_object_info_extended and exposes it as a stream.

nodes.name: istream_source
nodes.summary: Tries each object database source for a streaming reader and falls back to the in-core stream when none supports it.

nodes.name: odb_stream_close
nodes.summary: Closes a stream through its close callback and frees it.

nodes.name: odb_stream_read
nodes.summary: Reads bytes from a stream through its read callback.

nodes.name: odb_stream_from_object
nodes.summary: Opens a stream for an object id (following replace refs) from any source and optionally attaches a filter.

nodes.name: odb_stream_blob_to_fd
nodes.summary: Streams a blob to a file descriptor in 16 KiB chunks, turning all-zero chunks into holes with lseek when the target is seekable.

nodes.name: fd_stream_read
nodes.summary: Reads up to the remaining declared size from a file descriptor, failing on short reads.

nodes.name: odb_stream_from_fd
nodes.summary: Creates a read stream over a file descriptor with a known size and object type, without taking ownership of the descriptor.

nodes.name: odb_source_packed
nodes.summary: Backend struct of the packed object source: MRU list of packfiles, kept-pack cache, multi-pack-index, path-to-pack map and MRU-update switch.

nodes.name: odb_stream
nodes.summary: Generic object stream with close and read callbacks plus object type and inflated size.

nodes.name: odb_filtered_read_stream
nodes.summary: Stream state that applies a stream filter with input and output buffers.

nodes.name: odb_incore_read_stream
nodes.summary: Stream over an object fully loaded in memory.

nodes.name: fd_stream
nodes.summary: Stream reading a fixed number of bytes from a file descriptor.

nodes.name: oidset.h
nodes.summary: Declares struct oidset (a khash set of object ids), its API and inline iterator helpers, and the file-parsing entry points.

nodes.name: pack-bitmap-write.c

nodes.name: pack-bitmap.c
nodes.summary: Reads and uses reachability bitmaps: it opens and validates .bitmap files for a pack or MIDX chain, lazily loads per-commit bitmaps through the lookup table and XOR chains, computes the set of objects for a revision walk (wants minus haves, boundary traversal, pseudo-merges), applies object filters, supports partial pack reuse, disk-usage queries, test-tool dumps and verification.

nodes.name: pack-bitmap.h
nodes.summary: Public API for reachability bitmaps: the on-disk header and option flags, struct bitmapped_pack and struct bitmap_writer, and the entry points for loading bitmaps, walking commits and objects through them, filtering, pack reuse, writing bitmaps and test-tool hooks.

nodes.name: bitmap_writer_init
nodes.summary: Initializes a bitmap_writer with the repository, packing data, optional multi-pack-index and the hash map of selected commit bitmaps, and loads pseudo-merge groups from config.

nodes.name: bitmap_writer_free
nodes.summary: Frees all bitmaps, selected-commit records, pseudo-merge groups and caches owned by the writer.

nodes.name: bitmap_writer_show_progress
nodes.summary: Enables or disables progress output for bitmap writing.

nodes.name: bitmap_writer_build_type_index
nodes.summary: Builds the four per-type EWAH bitmaps (commits, trees, blobs, tags) over pack order, resolving object types for delta entries from the object database.

nodes.name: bitmap_writer_has_bitmapped_object_id
nodes.summary: Reports whether an object id has a position in the bitmap object ordering.

nodes.name: bitmap_writer_push_commit
nodes.summary: Registers a commit (or pseudo-merge) as selected for a bitmap, rejecting duplicates and growing the selection array.

nodes.name: bitmap_writer_init_pos_cache
nodes.summary: Lazily allocates the direct-mapped cache of object bit positions.

nodes.name: find_cached_object_pos
nodes.summary: Checks the position cache for an object id and records a hit or miss.

nodes.name: store_cached_object_pos
nodes.summary: Stores an object's bitmap position in its cache slot.

nodes.name: find_object_pos
nodes.summary: Resolves an object id to its bit position, using the cache, the packing data (adding MIDX base offset) or a MIDX search.

nodes.name: bitmapped_commit_date_cmp
nodes.summary: Orders selected commits by commit date for XOR-base search.

nodes.name: compute_xor_offsets
nodes.summary: For each selected commit looks back up to ten commits and picks the XOR base that yields the smallest compressed EWAH bitmap.

nodes.name: bitmap_builder_init
nodes.summary: Walks selected commits in topological, first-parent order building reverse edges and commit masks so that bitmaps can be accumulated from ancestors, reusing commits that already have bitmaps.

nodes.name: fill_bitmap_tree
nodes.summary: Recursively sets bits for a tree and all trees and blobs it references, skipping subtrees whose bit is already set.

nodes.name: fill_bitmap_commit
nodes.summary: Fills one commit's bitmap by walking its ancestors with a priority queue, reusing remapped old bitmaps or stored ancestor bitmaps and filling in trees.

nodes.name: reuse_pseudo_merge_bitmap
nodes.summary: Translates an existing pseudo-merge bitmap from an old bitmap index into the new object ordering.

nodes.name: build_pseudo_merge_bitmap
nodes.summary: Builds the EWAH bitmap of a pseudo-merge by unioning the bitmaps of its parent commits.

nodes.name: build_pseudo_merge_bitmaps
nodes.summary: Builds bitmaps for every pseudo-merge, reusing old ones when possible, and tracks progress.

nodes.name: store_selected
nodes.summary: Converts a computed commit bitmap to EWAH and attaches it to the selected-commit record.

nodes.name: bitmap_writer_build
nodes.summary: Main build step: maps old bitmaps, runs the bitmap builder, fills each commit bitmap from ancestors in topological order, builds pseudo-merge bitmaps and computes XOR offsets.

nodes.name: next_commit_index
nodes.summary: Computes the gap to the next commit to bitmap, dense for the newest commits and sparser for older history.

nodes.name: bitmap_writer_select_commits
nodes.summary: Selects which commits get bitmaps by sorting by date and picking at intervals, preferring merges and NEEDS_BITMAP commits, then selects pseudo-merges.

nodes.name: write_selected_commits_v1
nodes.summary: Writes each selected commit entry: object position, XOR offset, flags and the EWAH bitmap, recording offsets.

nodes.name: pseudo_merge_commit_pos_cmp
nodes.summary: qsort comparator for pseudo-merge commit entries by object id.

nodes.name: write_pseudo_merges
nodes.summary: Serializes the pseudo-merge extension: bitmaps, per-commit index and offsets table.

nodes.name: table_cmp
nodes.summary: Comparator ordering bitmap entries by commit object id for the lookup table.

nodes.name: write_lookup_table
nodes.summary: Writes the commit lookup table as sorted triplets of commit position, bitmap offset and XOR row, enabling lazy loading of single bitmaps.

nodes.name: write_hash_cache
nodes.summary: Writes the name-hash cache with one 32-bit hash per object in pack order.

nodes.name: bitmap_writer_set_checksum
nodes.summary: Stores the pack checksum recorded in the bitmap header.

nodes.name: bitmap_writer_finish
nodes.summary: Writes the .bitmap file to a temp file (header, type bitmaps, entries, pseudo-merges, lookup table, hash cache), finalizes the checksum and renames it into place.

nodes.name: lookup_stored_bitmap
nodes.summary: Resolves a stored bitmap by XORing it with its base chain lazily and caching the result.

nodes.name: read_bitmap
nodes.summary: Reads one EWAH bitmap from a mapped buffer and advances the position.

nodes.name: bitmap_name_hash
nodes.summary: Returns the stored name-hash for an object position, walking MIDX bases.

nodes.name: load_bitmap_header
nodes.summary: Validates the bitmap header (magic, version, flags) and locates the hash cache, lookup table and pseudo-merge extensions.

nodes.name: store_bitmap
nodes.summary: Stores a parsed bitmap with its XOR base in the commit hash map.

nodes.name: load_bitmap_entries_v1
nodes.summary: Eagerly reads all commit bitmap entries.

nodes.name: midx_bitmap_filename
nodes.summary: Derives the MIDX .bitmap path.

nodes.name: pack_bitmap_filename
nodes.summary: Derives the pack .bitmap path.

nodes.name: open_midx_bitmap
nodes.summary: Opens and validates a MIDX bitmap, its checksum and rev-index, and recursively the base layer.

nodes.name: open_pack_bitmap
nodes.summary: Opens and validates the bitmap of a single pack.

nodes.name: load_reverse_index
nodes.summary: Loads reverse indexes needed by the bitmap.

nodes.name: load_all_type_bitmaps
nodes.summary: Collects per-layer type bitmaps of a bitmap chain.

nodes.name: load_bitmap
nodes.summary: Loads type bitmaps and, without lookup table, all entries.

nodes.name: open_bitmap_for_source
nodes.summary: Tries the MIDX bitmap then pack bitmaps for a source.

nodes.name: open_bitmap
nodes.summary: Opens a bitmap from any repository source.

nodes.name: prepare_bitmap_git
nodes.summary: Opens and loads a bitmap index for the repository or returns NULL.

nodes.name: prepare_midx_bitmap_git
nodes.summary: Opens a bitmap for a given MIDX.

nodes.name: prepare_bitmap_git_for_source
nodes.summary: Opens a bitmap for a packed source.

nodes.name: bitmap_index_contains_pack
nodes.summary: Checks whether a bitmap covers a pack.

nodes.name: bitmap_bsearch_pos
nodes.summary: Binary searches the lookup table for a commit.

nodes.name: bitmap_bsearch_triplet_by_pos
nodes.summary: Finds a lookup-table triplet by commit position.

nodes.name: lazy_bitmap_for_commit
nodes.summary: Reads one commit's bitmap through the lookup table, resolving its XOR chain without loading all entries.

nodes.name: find_bitmap_for_commit
nodes.summary: Finds a commit's bitmap in this bitmap or its base layers.

nodes.name: bitmap_for_commit
nodes.summary: Returns the EWAH bitmap of a commit if stored.

nodes.name: bitmap_position_extended
nodes.summary: Position of an object in the extended index.

nodes.name: bitmap_position_midx
nodes.summary: Position of an object in a MIDX's bitmap order.

nodes.name: bitmap_position
nodes.summary: Resolves an object to a bit position in pack, MIDX or extended index.

nodes.name: ext_index_add_object
nodes.summary: Adds an object absent from the pack to the extended index.

nodes.summary: Applies satisfied pseudo-merges for a commit.

nodes.name: should_include

nodes.name: find_objects

nodes.name: show_extended_objects

nodes.name: init_type_iterator
nodes.summary: Prepares an iterator over per-layer type bitmaps.

nodes.name: show_objects_for_type

nodes.name: filter_packed_objects_from_bitmap
nodes.summary: Clears packed objects, keeping unpacked ones.

nodes.summary: Entry point for a bitmap-accelerated revision walk: converts pending objects into wants and haves, computes both bitmaps, subtracts haves and applies filters.

nodes.name: try_partial_reuse
nodes.summary: Checks whether a packed object (and its delta base) can be reused verbatim.

nodes.summary: Reports all result objects through a callback by type.

nodes.name: count_bitmap_commit_list

nodes.summary: Test callback verifying commit bits.

nodes.summary: Prepares test data per layer.

nodes.summary: Test tool: compares bitmap result with a normal walk.

nodes.summary: Test tool: prints commits with offsets and XOR info.

nodes.summary: Converts a bit position to an object id.

nodes.summary: Test tool: prints pseudo-merges.

nodes.name: test_bitmap_pseudo_merge_commits
nodes.summary: Test tool: prints commits of a pseudo-merge.

nodes.name: test_bitmap_pseudo_merge_objects
nodes.summary: Test tool: prints objects of a pseudo-merge.

nodes.name: rebuild_bitmap
nodes.summary: Remaps bits of an old bitmap into a new object ordering.

nodes.summary: Builds a mapping from old bitmap positions to new pack positions.

nodes.name: free_bitmap_index
nodes.summary: Frees a bitmap index and layers.

nodes.name: bitmap_has_oid_in_uninteresting

nodes.name: get_disk_usage_for_type
nodes.summary: Sums on-disk sizes of result objects of a type.

nodes.name: get_disk_usage_for_extended

nodes.name: get_disk_usage_from_bitmap
nodes.summary: Computes disk usage of the result.

nodes.summary: Returns whether the bitmap belongs to a MIDX.

nodes.name: bitmap_preferred_tips

nodes.name: for_each_preferred_bitmap_tip
nodes.summary: Calls a callback for refs under preferred tips.

nodes.name: bitmap_is_preferred_refname
nodes.summary: Checks a ref against preferred tips.

nodes.name: verify_bitmap_file
nodes.summary: Checks a bitmap file checksum.

nodes.name: verify_bitmap_files
nodes.summary: Verifies bitmap files for MIDX and packs of a source.

nodes.name: oidset
nodes.summary: A set of object ids backed by a khash table.

nodes.name: oidset_iter
nodes.summary: Iterator state over an oidset's khash table.

nodes.name: bitmap_disk_header
nodes.summary: On-disk header of a .bitmap file: magic, version, option flags, entry count and pack checksum.

nodes.name: bitmapped_pack
nodes.summary: Describes one pack covered by a bitmap: pack, bit position range and MIDX identifiers.

nodes.name: bitmap_writer
nodes.summary: State used while writing bitmaps: type bitmaps, selected commits, position cache, pseudo-merge groups and the pack checksum.

nodes.name: pack_bitmap_opts
nodes.summary: Enum of option flags stored in a bitmap header (full DAG, hash cache, lookup table, pseudo merges).

nodes.name: bitmapped_commit
nodes.summary: Selected commit with its bitmap, XOR base, flags and pseudo-merge data.

nodes.summary: Per-commit state during bitmap building: reverse edges, masks and bitmap.

nodes.summary: Holds commit slab data and the processing stack of the bitmap builder.

nodes.name: stored_bitmap
nodes.summary: A parsed commit bitmap with optional XOR base and file position.

nodes.name: bitmap_index
nodes.summary: In-memory state of an opened bitmap: pack or MIDX, mapped data, type bitmaps, commit bitmap map, extended index, result and haves.

nodes.name: pack-check.c
nodes.summary: Verifies a packfile: checks the pack and index checksums, walks objects in pack-offset order verifying per-object CRC32s and object signatures (using streaming for large blobs), and invokes an optional per-object callback used by fsck and verify-pack.

nodes.name: pack-mtimes.c
nodes.summary: Loads and validates the .mtimes file that accompanies a cruft pack (signature, version, hash id and size checks, then mmap) and returns the mtime stored for the object at a given index position.

nodes.name: pack-mtimes.h
nodes.summary: Declares the .mtimes file signature and version constants and the two functions that load a cruft pack's mtimes and read the mtime of the nth object.

nodes.name: pack-objects.c

nodes.name: load_pack_mtimes_file
nodes.summary: Opens and mmaps a .mtimes file, validates its signature, version, hash id and exact expected size (header, one 32-bit mtime per object, two trailing hashes) and returns the mapping.

nodes.name: load_pack_mtimes
nodes.summary: Loads the .mtimes data for a cruft pack once, opening the pack index first; non-cruft packs and already loaded packs are no-ops.

nodes.name: nth_packed_mtime
nodes.summary: Returns the big-endian mtime stored for the object at a given index position, with BUG checks that the file is loaded and the position is in range.

nodes.name: pack_mtimes_filename
nodes.summary: Derives the .mtimes path from a pack path by replacing the .pack suffix.

nodes.name: locate_object_entry_hash

nodes.name: closest_pow2

nodes.name: rehash_objects

nodes.name: packlist_find
nodes.summary: Looks up an object id in the packing data and returns its object_entry, or NULL if absent or the index is empty.

nodes.name: prepare_in_pack_by_idx

nodes.name: oe_map_new_pack

nodes.name: prepare_packing_data

nodes.name: clear_packing_data
nodes.summary: Frees all arrays owned by a packing_data structure.

nodes.name: oe_set_delta_ext

nodes.name: verify_pack_index

nodes.name: verify_pack

nodes.name: idx_entry

nodes.name: mtimes_header
nodes.summary: Header of a .mtimes file with signature, version and hash id.

nodes.name: pack-objects.h
nodes.summary: Defines the memory-tight struct object_entry and struct packing_data used while building packs, the dfs_state enum for delta-cycle analysis, name-hash functions that group similar paths for delta search, and many bit-packed accessors (type, in-pack index, tree depth, layer, cruft mtime).

nodes.name: pack-revindex.c
nodes.summary: Implements the reverse index that maps between index position, pack position and byte offset of objects in a pack or multi-pack-index: it builds it in memory with a radix sort, loads and verifies the on-disk .rev file, and provides conversion and binary-search helpers for packs and MIDX pseudo-packs.

nodes.name: pack-revindex.h

nodes.name: pack-write.c

nodes.summary: Adds an object id to the list kept for a path, creating the list on first use and tracking whether any member may be interesting.

nodes.name: add_tree_entries
nodes.summary: Parses a tree and, for each entry (skipping submodules, honoring blob and sparse settings), looks up the child object, builds its path and adds it to that path's list, pushing directories onto the work stack.

nodes.name: walk_path
nodes.summary: Processes one path: skips fully UNINTERESTING lists when pruning, calls the user callback with the batch of ids for that path, and for tree lists expands their children via add_tree_entries.

nodes.name: clear_paths_to_lists
nodes.summary: Frees every oid array in the path map and resets the map.

nodes.name: show_edge
nodes.summary: Edge callback that marks the tree of an UNINTERESTING boundary commit and records it in the root tree list.

nodes.name: setup_pending_objects
nodes.summary: Sorts the pending objects of the revision info into lists for tags, commits, tagged trees and blobs (peeling tags), so directly requested objects are emitted under synthetic paths like /tags.

nodes.name: prepare_filters_one
nodes.summary: Translates one list-objects filter (blob:none, blob:limit, tree depth, object type, combine, sparse) into path-walk settings, returning 0 for unsupported filters.

nodes.name: path_walk_filter_compatible
nodes.summary: Reports whether a set of filter options can be honored by the path-walk API without modifying any state.

nodes.name: walk_objects_by_path
nodes.summary: Main driver: sets up the revision walk, marks edge trees uninteresting, collects commits and root trees, emits the commit batch, then drains the path stack calling walk_path for each path.

nodes.name: path_walk_info_init
nodes.summary: Initializes a path_walk_info to the defaults of PATH_WALK_INFO_INIT.

nodes.name: path_walk_info_clear
nodes.summary: Releases resources held by a path_walk_info such as the sparse pattern list.

nodes.name: odb_pack_name
nodes.summary: Builds the path pack/pack-<hash>.<ext> inside the object directory.

nodes.name: pack_report
nodes.summary: Prints pack window and mmap statistics for debugging.

nodes.name: check_packed_git_idx
nodes.summary: Opens and mmaps a pack index and validates it via load_idx.

nodes.name: load_idx
nodes.summary: Validates an index buffer: signature, version 1 or 2, monotonic fanout and exact size, then records version, object count and CRC offset in the packed_git.

nodes.name: open_pack_index
nodes.summary: Lazily opens the .idx of a pack.

nodes.name: get_pack_fanout
nodes.summary: Returns a fanout table entry of the pack index.

nodes.name: alloc_packed_git
nodes.summary: Allocates a packed_git with space for the name and sets defaults.

nodes.name: pack_path_from_idx
nodes.summary: Derives the .pack path from an .idx path.

nodes.name: parse_pack_index
nodes.summary: Creates a packed_git from an index path and validates the index.

nodes.name: scan_windows
nodes.summary: Finds the least-recently-used unused window in a pack.

nodes.name: unuse_one_window
nodes.summary: Unmaps the globally least-recently-used unused window across all packs.

nodes.name: close_pack_windows
nodes.summary: Unmaps all windows of a pack and dies if any is still in use.

nodes.name: close_pack_fd
nodes.summary: Closes the pack file descriptor.

nodes.name: close_pack_index
nodes.summary: Unmaps the pack index.

nodes.name: close_pack_revindex
nodes.summary: Frees or unmaps the pack's reverse index.

nodes.name: close_pack
nodes.summary: Releases windows, descriptor, index, reverse index, mtimes and bad-object set.

nodes.name: unlink_pack_path
nodes.summary: Deletes all files of a pack (.idx, .pack, .rev, .keep, .bitmap, .promisor, .mtimes) unless a .keep protects it.

nodes.name: find_lru_pack
nodes.summary: Picks the least recently used pack to close when descriptors run out.

nodes.name: close_one_pack
nodes.summary: Closes the LRU pack's file descriptor or windows to free a descriptor.

nodes.name: get_max_fd_limit
nodes.summary: Returns the process file descriptor limit.

nodes.name: pack_basename
nodes.summary: Returns the file name part of a pack's path.

nodes.name: open_packed_git_1
nodes.summary: Opens the pack file, enforcing fd limits, and verifies the header, object count, size and trailer hash against the index.

nodes.name: in_window
nodes.summary: Tests whether an offset (plus one hash) lies within a window.

nodes.name: use_pack
nodes.summary: Returns a pointer to pack bytes at an offset, mapping a new aligned window and evicting old ones as needed.

nodes.name: unuse_pack
nodes.summary: Releases the window cursor reference.

nodes.name: add_packed_git
nodes.summary: Creates a packed_git for an index path, detecting .keep, .promisor and .mtimes siblings and the pack's size and mtime.

nodes.name: packfile_store_add_pack
nodes.summary: Appends a pack to the store list and path map.

nodes.name: packfile_store_load_pack
nodes.summary: Loads a pack for an index path unless already known.

nodes.name: for_each_file_in_pack_subdir
nodes.summary: Iterates file names in a pack directory and calls a callback with the full path.

nodes.name: for_each_file_in_pack_dir
nodes.summary: Iterates files in the main pack directory.

nodes.name: packfile_store_get_packs
nodes.summary: Returns the pack list, preparing the store and opening MIDX packs.

nodes.name: unpack_object_header_buffer
nodes.summary: Decodes a pack entry's type and variable-length size from a buffer.

nodes.name: get_size_from_delta
nodes.summary: Inflates the beginning of a delta and reads the result size from its header.

nodes.name: unpack_object_header
nodes.summary: Reads and decodes an entry header at an offset through windows.

nodes.name: mark_bad_packed_object
nodes.summary: Records an object in the pack's bad-object set.

nodes.name: get_delta_base
nodes.summary: Decodes the base offset of an OFS_DELTA or looks up a REF_DELTA base in the index.

nodes.name: get_delta_base_oid
nodes.summary: Returns the object id of a delta's base.

nodes.name: retry_bad_packed_offset
nodes.summary: Marks an offset's object as bad and tries to read its type from another source.

nodes.name: packed_to_object_type
nodes.summary: Resolves a packed type to its real type by following the delta chain with a stack, retrying on corruption.

nodes.name: get_delta_base_cache_entry
nodes.summary: Looks up a cached delta base by pack and offset.

nodes.name: delta_base_cache_hash_cmp
nodes.summary: hashmap comparator for delta-base-cache keys.

nodes.name: cache_or_unpack_entry
nodes.summary: Returns a copy of a cached base or unpacks it.

nodes.name: clear_delta_base_cache
nodes.summary: Frees all delta base cache entries.

nodes.name: add_delta_base_cache
nodes.summary: Adds an unpacked base to the cache and evicts LRU entries beyond the limit.

nodes.name: packed_object_info_with_index_pos
nodes.summary: Fills object_info for a packed object: type (resolving deltas), size, disk size, mtime (cruft packs), delta base and source info.

nodes.name: packed_object_info
nodes.summary: Wrapper for packed_object_info_with_index_pos with no known index position.

nodes.name: unpack_compressed_entry
nodes.summary: Inflates the zlib data of an entry into a buffer and checks the size.

nodes.name: unpack_entry
nodes.summary: Reconstructs an object by walking its delta chain with an explicit stack, using the delta base cache, inflating the base and applying deltas with patch_delta.

nodes.name: bsearch_pack
nodes.summary: Binary searches the pack index fanout and id table for an object id.

nodes.name: nth_packed_object_id
nodes.summary: Reads the nth object id from the index.

nodes.name: check_pack_index_ptr
nodes.summary: Dies if a pointer lies outside the mapped index.

nodes.name: nth_packed_object_offset
nodes.summary: Reads the nth offset from the index, following the large offset table.

nodes.name: find_pack_entry_one
nodes.summary: Returns an object's offset in one pack, or 0.

nodes.name: is_pack_valid
nodes.summary: Checks the pack is accessible, opening it if necessary.

nodes.name: packfile_fill_entry
nodes.summary: Fills a pack_entry for an id unless it is a known bad object.

nodes.name: maybe_invalidate_kept_pack_cache
nodes.summary: Frees the kept-pack cache when flags differ.

nodes.name: packfile_store_get_kept_pack_cache
nodes.summary: Returns the (cached) list of packs kept by .keep or in-core flags.

nodes.name: has_object_pack
nodes.summary: Reports whether any source's packs contain the object.

nodes.name: has_object_kept_pack
nodes.summary: Reports whether the object is in a kept pack.

nodes.name: for_each_object_in_pack
nodes.summary: Calls a callback for each object of a pack in index or pack order.

nodes.name: add_promisor_object
nodes.summary: Adds the object and what it references to the promisor set.

nodes.name: is_promisor_object
nodes.summary: Returns whether an object is in or referenced from promisor packs, building the set on first use.

nodes.name: parse_pack_header_option
nodes.summary: Parses an 'N,M' option string into a pack header bytes.

nodes.name: read_istream_pack_non_delta
nodes.summary: Streams inflated data of a non-delta packed object.

nodes.name: packfile_read_object_stream
nodes.summary: Opens a stream for a large non-delta packed object.

nodes.name: pack_header
nodes.summary: Pack file header: signature, version and entry count.

nodes.name: pack_idx_option
nodes.summary: Options controlling index writing: flags, version, 32-bit offset limit and anomaly offsets.

nodes.name: pack_idx_header
nodes.summary: Version 2 pack index header with signature and version.

nodes.name: pack_idx_entry
nodes.summary: Object id, CRC32 and offset recorded for each object in an index.

nodes.name: packed_git
nodes.summary: An open packfile: mapped windows, index data, reverse index, mtimes, flags such as local/keep/promisor/cruft, hash and name.

nodes.name: pack_window
nodes.summary: A mmap window into a pack with offset, length, last-use counter and reference count.

nodes.name: pack_entry
nodes.summary: Result of a pack lookup: the pack and the offset of an object.

nodes.name: odb_packed_read_stream
nodes.summary: Streaming state for reading an inflated non-delta packed object.

nodes.name: delta_base_cache_entry
nodes.summary: Entry of the delta base cache with LRU link and cached data.

nodes.name: path_walk_context
nodes.summary: Internal path-walk state: path to list map, priority queue of paths and options.

nodes.name: path-walk.h
nodes.summary: Declares struct path_walk_info (revision info, per-path callback, object-type selection, blob size limit, pruning, sparse patterns) and the init, clear, walk and filter-compatibility functions of the path-walk API.

nodes.name: progress.h
nodes.summary: Declares the progress meter API: start progress (plain, sparse, delayed variants), display progress or throughput, and stop progress with a message.

nodes.name: protocol-caps.c
nodes.summary: Implements the server side of the object-info protocol v2 capability: it parses 'size', 'type' and 'oid' request lines, looks up each object without fetching, and writes back size and type (or an empty answer for unknown objects) as pkt-lines.

nodes.name: prune-packed.c
nodes.summary: Implements removal of loose objects that also exist in a pack: it iterates the loose object directories, deletes (or prints in dry-run) each loose file that has a packed copy, removes emptied fan-out directories and shows progress.

nodes.name: prune_object
nodes.summary: Per-loose-object callback that deletes the loose file (or prints an rm line in dry-run mode) when the object also exists in a pack.

nodes.name: prune_packed_objects
nodes.summary: Walks all loose object fan-out directories of the repository's sources, deleting packed duplicates and emptied directories while showing a delayed progress meter.

nodes.name: parse_oid
nodes.summary: Recognizes an 'oid <hex>' request line and appends the hex string to the list of requested ids.

nodes.name: get_object_info
nodes.summary: Reads an object's type and size through odb_read_object_info_extended with flags that avoid fetching missing objects and avoid rescanning packs.

nodes.name: send_info
nodes.summary: Writes the requested attribute names and then one pkt-line per requested oid with its size and/or type, or a trailing space for objects the server does not have.

nodes.name: cap_object_info
nodes.summary: Entry point for the object-info command: reads request lines until flush, collects size/type flags and oids, rejects malformed input, and sends the response.

nodes.name: path_walk_info
nodes.summary: Configuration of a path walk: revision info, callback, object type selection, size limit, pruning and sparse patterns.

nodes.name: requested_info
nodes.summary: Flags for which object attributes a client asked for.

nodes.name: prune-packed.h
nodes.summary: Declares the dry-run and verbose flags and the prune_packed_objects entry point used by git prune-packed and gc/repack.

nodes.name: archive.c
nodes.summary: Implements the `git archive` builtin: parses -o/--remote/--exec, and either writes a tar/zip archive locally through write_archive or asks a remote git-upload-archive over a transport and relays the sideband stream to stdout.

nodes.name: create_output_file
nodes.summary: Opens the -o output file and dup2s it onto stdout so the archive writer can keep writing to fd 1.

nodes.name: run_remote_archiver
nodes.summary: Connects to a remote upload-archive through a transport, sends `argument` packets (with a format guessed from the output filename), checks the ACK/NAK response and relays the sideband archive stream to stdout.

nodes.name: cmd_archive
nodes.summary: Entry point of `git archive`: parses output/remote/exec options, initializes the archivers and either runs the remote archiver or calls write_archive locally.

nodes.name: cat-file.c
nodes.summary: Implements `git cat-file`: prints an object's type, size or contents, and the --batch family that reads object names from stdin (or enumerates all objects) and prints them through a %(atom) format, with textconv/filter, mailmap rewriting and remote-object-info support.

nodes.name: load_mailmap
nodes.summary: Lazily loads the repository mailmap into the file-static mailmap table.

nodes.name: replace_idents_using_mailmap
nodes.summary: Rewrites the author, committer and tagger header lines of a commit or tag buffer through the mailmap.

nodes.name: filter_object
nodes.summary: Reads a blob from the object database and converts it to its working-tree form (smudge/CRLF filters) for `--filters` and `--textconv`-style output.

nodes.name: cat_one_file
nodes.summary: Handles the non-batch modes of cat-file (-t, -s, -e, -p, -c, -w, type<object>): resolves the object name, then prints type, size, existence, pretty-printed or raw content.

nodes.name: expand_atom
nodes.summary: Expands one %(atom) of a cat-file --batch format (objectname, objecttype, objectsize, objectsize:disk, rest, deltabase, objectmode), or only records which info is needed when in query mode.

nodes.name: expand_format
nodes.summary: Walks a --batch-format string, copying literals and expanding %(...) atoms through expand_atom, dying on malformed formats.

nodes.name: print_object_or_die
nodes.summary: Prints the object body for --batch: streams blobs (or filters/textconvs them), and reads other objects fully, applying mailmap, verifying type consistency.

nodes.name: batch_object_write
nodes.summary: Looks up object info for the current oid, applies filter and missing-object handling, prints the formatted header line and, in contents mode, the object body.

nodes.name: batch_one_object
nodes.summary: Resolves one name from batch input with get_oid_with_context (optionally following symlinks), reports missing/ambiguous/dangling results, otherwise writes the object.

nodes.name: get_remote_info
nodes.summary: Validates oid arguments for remote-object-info, connects to the named remote through a transport and fetches object info (size) without downloading the objects.

nodes.name: batch_unordered_object
nodes.summary: Callback for --unordered: writes an object once, tracking already-seen oids in an oidset so duplicates across packs are skipped.

nodes.name: parse_cmd_remote_object_info
nodes.summary: Handles the `remote-object-info <remote> <oids>` batch-command: splits the line into arguments, queries the remote via get_remote_info and prints each result by format.

nodes.name: batch_objects_command
nodes.summary: Reads --batch-command input, matches each line against the contents/info/mailmap/remote-object-info/flush table, and runs commands immediately or queues them until `flush` in buffered mode.

nodes.name: batch_each_object
nodes.summary: Iterates all objects of the repository (odb_for_each_object_ext with the list-objects filter) invoking a callback with pack and offset when the object is packed.

nodes.name: batch_objects
nodes.summary: Drives all --batch modes: primes the object_info query via a query-mode format expansion, then enumerates all objects (--batch-all-objects, ordered or unordered) or reads names from stdin / batch-command input.

nodes.name: git_cat_file_config
nodes.summary: Config callback for cat-file that registers userdiff (textconv) settings and falls through to the default config handler.

nodes.name: batch_option_callback
nodes.summary: Option callback for --batch, --batch-check and --batch-command that sets the batch mode and optional format.

nodes.name: cmd_cat_file
nodes.summary: Entry point of `git cat-file`: parses options, validates combinations and dispatches to cat_one_file or batch_objects.

nodes.name: print_default_format
nodes.summary: Appends the default `<oid> <type> <size>` line, terminated by the output delimiter, for --batch-check.

nodes.name: parse_cmd_contents
nodes.summary: Handles the `contents <object>` batch-command: switches to contents mode for one object and prints it.

nodes.name: parse_cmd_mailmap
nodes.summary: Handles the `mailmap <bool>` batch-command that toggles mailmap rewriting of idents.

nodes.name: dispatch_calls
nodes.summary: Runs all queued batch-commands in order and flushes stdout, only valid in --buffer mode.

nodes.name: batch_one_object_oi
nodes.summary: Adapter that passes the pack and offset of a packed object (or NULL) to a for-each-object callback.

nodes.name: clone.c
nodes.summary: Implements `git clone`: initializes a new repository, configures the origin remote and refspecs, optionally copies or hardlinks a local object store, downloads bundle URIs, fetches the packfile through a transport, checks connectivity, sets up refs and HEAD, and checks out the working tree.

nodes.name: recurse_submodules_cb
nodes.summary: Option callback for --recurse-submodules that appends the pathspec (or `.`) to the submodule list.

nodes.name: get_repo_path
nodes.summary: Resolves a clone source to an absolute local path or bundle file if it exists on disk, reporting whether it is a bundle.

nodes.name: add_one_reference
nodes.summary: Adds one --reference repository's object directory to the new repository's alternates, checking it is a valid local repo.

nodes.name: copy_alternates
nodes.summary: Copies the source repository's objects/info/alternates entries into the clone's alternates file, rewriting relative paths.

nodes.name: copy_or_link_directory
nodes.summary: Recursively copies or hardlinks the source objects directory into the clone for local clones, refusing directories not owned by the user and falling back to copy when linking fails.

nodes.name: clone_local
nodes.summary: Local-clone path: either records the source as an alternate (--shared) or copies/hardlinks its objects directory into the new repository.

nodes.name: remove_junk
nodes.summary: atexit/signal cleanup that deletes the partially created work tree and git dir when the clone fails.

nodes.name: find_remote_branch
nodes.summary: Looks up the ref named by --branch among remote refs/heads/ and refs/tags/.

nodes.name: wanted_peer_refs
nodes.summary: Builds the list of remote refs to fetch for the clone from the refspec, honoring --single-branch and whether HEAD is wanted.

nodes.name: write_remote_refs
nodes.summary: Writes the fetched local refs (remote-tracking refs) into the new repository in one ref transaction.

nodes.name: write_followtags
nodes.summary: Creates tag refs for tags that point at fetched commits (follow-tags behaviour for clone).

nodes.name: update_remote_refs
nodes.summary: After the fetch, runs check_connected on the fetched refs (unless the transport already verified it), then writes the remote refs and followed tags.

nodes.name: update_head
nodes.summary: Creates local HEAD after clone: points it at the remote's HEAD branch or detaches it at the remote commit, handles unborn HEAD and the origin/HEAD symref.

nodes.name: git_sparse_checkout_init
nodes.summary: Runs `git sparse-checkout set` in the new repository for --sparse clones.

nodes.name: checkout
nodes.summary: Checks out the working tree after clone: reads the tree of HEAD, runs unpack_trees to populate files and the index, runs post-checkout hook and updates submodules.

nodes.name: git_clone_config
nodes.summary: Config callback reading clone.defaultRemoteName, clone.rejectShallow and clone.filterSubmodules before the default handler.

nodes.name: write_one_config
nodes.summary: Writes one -c key=value option into the new repository's config.

nodes.name: write_refspec_config
nodes.summary: Writes the remote's fetch refspec (tailored for --single-branch/--branch/mirror) into the new repo config.

nodes.name: dissociate_from_references
nodes.summary: Runs `git repack -a -d` to copy borrowed objects locally and removes the alternates file for --dissociate.

nodes.name: cmd_clone
nodes.summary: Entry point of `git clone`: validates options, creates and initializes the repository, writes config, downloads bundles and the pack through a transport, checks connectivity, sets up refs/HEAD, and checks out files.

nodes.name: mkdir_if_missing
nodes.summary: Creates a directory, accepting an existing directory but dying if the path exists as a non-directory.

nodes.name: write_config
nodes.summary: Writes each -c option given on the command line into the new repository's config.

nodes.name: credential-cache.c
nodes.summary: Client side of the `git credential-cache` helper: sends get/store/erase/exit requests over a Unix domain socket to the credential-cache--daemon, spawning the daemon on store when needed.

nodes.name: send_request
nodes.summary: Connects to the cache daemon's Unix socket, writes the request and copies the daemon's reply to stdout.

nodes.name: spawn_daemon
nodes.summary: Starts `git credential-cache--daemon` for the given socket and waits for its `ok` startup message.

nodes.name: do_cache
nodes.summary: Builds the action/timeout request, relays stdin credentials if needed, sends it and spawns the daemon on first store.

nodes.name: get_socket_path
nodes.summary: Chooses the cache socket path: the legacy ~/.git-credential-cache directory if present, otherwise the XDG cache dir.

nodes.name: announce_capabilities
nodes.summary: Prints the helper capabilities (authtype) via credential_announce_capabilities.

nodes.name: cmd_credential_cache
nodes.summary: Entry point of the credential-cache helper: parses --timeout/--socket and dispatches get/store/erase/exit/capability to the daemon.

nodes.name: credential-store.c
nodes.summary: Implements the `git credential-store` helper, which keeps credentials as URL lines in ~/.git-credentials or the XDG credentials file, looking up, storing and erasing entries with a lock-file rewrite.

nodes.name: parse_credential_file
nodes.summary: Reads a credentials file line by line, parsing each as a URL into a credential and invoking a callback on matches or on non-matching lines.

nodes.name: rewrite_credential_file
nodes.summary: Rewrites the credentials file under a lock, optionally prepending a new entry and dropping matching old ones.

nodes.name: store_credential_file
nodes.summary: Formats a credential as a percent-encoded URL line and adds it to the credentials file.

nodes.name: store_credential
nodes.summary: Validates the credential has protocol, host or path, username and password, then stores it in the first existing credentials file (or the first path).

nodes.name: remove_credential
nodes.summary: Erases matching entries from every existing credentials file, refusing an empty pattern.

nodes.name: lookup_credential
nodes.summary: Prints the first stored username/password matching the request.

nodes.name: cmd_credential_store
nodes.summary: Entry point of credential-store: picks the credential file(s), reads the request from stdin and runs get, store or erase.

nodes.name: is_rfc3986_reserved_or_unreserved
nodes.summary: Character class predicate used to percent-encode URL paths while keeping reserved characters.

nodes.name: fetch-pack.c
nodes.summary: Implements the plumbing command `git fetch-pack`: parses its options and refs (including from stdin), connects to a remote upload-pack, reads the advertised refs and downloads the matching packfile via fetch_pack.

nodes.name: add_sought_entry
nodes.summary: Parses an argument as `<oid>`, `<oid> <ref>` or `<ref>` and appends a struct ref to the sought array.

nodes.name: cmd_fetch_pack
nodes.summary: Entry point of `git fetch-pack`: parses options, connects with git_connect, reads advertised refs (v0/v1/v2), calls fetch_pack and prints the fetched ref ids.

nodes.name: fetch.c
nodes.summary: Implements `git fetch`: builds the ref map from remote refs and refspecs, downloads objects through a transport, updates remote-tracking refs and FETCH_HEAD in a ref transaction, handles pruning, tag auto-following, shallow/deepen, remote HEAD updates, multi-remote parallel fetch and submodule recursion.

nodes.name: git_fetch_config
nodes.summary: Config callback reading fetch.all/prune/pruneTags/showForcedUpdates/recurseSubmodules/parallel/output/followRemoteHEAD and submodule settings.

nodes.name: add_merge_config
nodes.summary: Adds the branch's configured upstream (branch.<name>.merge) refs to the fetch map for a default `git fetch`.

nodes.name: find_non_local_tags
nodes.summary: Finds remote tags that point at objects we now have locally but whose tag refs we lack, for automatic tag following.

nodes.name: filter_prefetch_refspec
nodes.summary: Rewrites refspecs for --prefetch so destinations are placed under refs/prefetch/ and tags are excluded.

nodes.name: get_ref_map
nodes.summary: Builds the list of refs to fetch from the remote advertisement using command-line refspecs or the remote's configured refspecs and upstream, plus opportunistic remote-tracking updates and tag auto-following.

nodes.name: display_state_init
nodes.summary: Initializes the output formatter for fetch results, computing column widths and URL display.

nodes.name: display_ref_update
nodes.summary: Prints one fetch update line (new branch, fast-forward, forced update, rejected, pruned) in full, compact or porcelain format.

nodes.name: update_local_ref
nodes.summary: Decides and applies the update for one fetched ref: new ref, tag update, fast-forward, forced update or rejection of non-fast-forward, via ref transaction and ancestry check.

nodes.name: append_fetch_head
nodes.summary: Writes one entry (oid, merge status, ref description, URL) into FETCH_HEAD.

nodes.name: store_updated_refs
nodes.summary: After the pack arrives, checks connectivity, then writes FETCH_HEAD entries (merge entries first) and updates local refs through update_local_ref.

nodes.name: check_exist_and_connected
nodes.summary: Checks whether all wanted refs already exist and are connected locally so the fetch can skip the transfer.

nodes.name: fetch_and_consume_refs
nodes.summary: Fetches the packfile through the transport when needed and then calls store_updated_refs to consume the refs.

nodes.name: prune_refs
nodes.summary: Finds stale remote-tracking refs (no longer on the remote) and deletes them, in the transaction when atomic, and prints [deleted] lines.

nodes.name: add_negotiation_tips
nodes.summary: Resolves --negotiation-restrict/--negotiation-tip revisions to oids and passes them to the transport as negotiation tips.

nodes.name: prepare_transport
nodes.summary: Creates and configures the transport for a remote: upload-pack path, depth/deepen options, filter, server options, negotiation settings.

nodes.name: backfill_tags
nodes.summary: Performs a second fetch for tags that point at commits just downloaded (auto tag following).

nodes.name: warn_set_head
nodes.summary: Prints a warning when the remote's HEAD differs from the locally recorded refs/remotes/<remote>/HEAD or a detached HEAD.

nodes.name: set_head
nodes.summary: Implements fetch.followRemoteHEAD: guesses the remote's default branch and creates or updates refs/remotes/<name>/HEAD.

nodes.name: ref_transaction_rejection_handler
nodes.summary: Callback that records per-ref rejection reasons when a batched ref transaction partially fails.

nodes.name: commit_ref_transaction
nodes.summary: Commits the fetch's ref transaction (atomic or batched) and handles rejection results.

nodes.name: do_fetch
nodes.summary: Performs the fetch for one transport: gets remote refs (ls-refs prefixes), builds ref map, prunes, fetches objects and updates refs, backfills tags, commits the transaction, writes FETCH_HEAD and optionally sets remote HEAD.

nodes.name: add_options_to_argv
nodes.summary: Re-serializes the current fetch options into a child `git fetch` command line for multi-remote fetching.

nodes.name: fetch_next_remote
nodes.summary: Task generator for parallel fetch: starts the next `git fetch <remote>` child process.

nodes.name: fetch_multiple
nodes.summary: Fetches several remotes by running child `git fetch --append` processes, sequentially or with run_processes_parallel.

nodes.name: fetch_one_setup_partial
nodes.summary: Applies and persists partial-clone filter settings for a remote before fetching (registers a new filter or inherits the stored default).

nodes.name: fetch_one
nodes.summary: Fetches from one remote or URL: resolves refspecs from args, sets up partial clone, prepares the transport and runs do_fetch, with cleanup.

nodes.name: cmd_fetch
nodes.summary: Entry point of `git fetch`: parses many options, handles --all/--multiple/--negotiate-only/--unshallow, bundle-uri, runs fetch_one or fetch_multiple, then submodule fetch, gc and commit-graph.

nodes.name: parse_refmap_arg
nodes.summary: Option callback for --refmap that appends a refspec to the refmap list.

nodes.name: s_update_ref
nodes.summary: Queues a ref update or creation in the fetch's ref transaction with a reflog message, honoring dry-run and old-value checks.

nodes.name: refcol_width
nodes.summary: Computes the display column width needed for the local ref names, bounded by the terminal width.

nodes.name: print_compact
nodes.summary: Writes the compact `remote -> local` form of a ref update, abbreviating when both names share a suffix.

nodes.name: open_fetch_head
nodes.summary: Opens FETCH_HEAD for appending when it is being written.

nodes.name: check_not_current_branch
nodes.summary: Dies if a fetch would update a branch that is checked out in a worktree.

nodes.name: truncate_fetch_head
nodes.summary: Truncates FETCH_HEAD at the start of a non-append fetch.

nodes.name: set_option
nodes.summary: Sets a transport option, dying on invalid values and warning when the option is ignored.

nodes.name: set_head_advice_msg
nodes.summary: Prints the advice text on how to follow a changed remote HEAD via `git remote set-head` or configuration.

nodes.name: fetch_finished
nodes.summary: Completion callback of a parallel fetch child that records a failure with its exit code.

nodes.name: ls-remote.c
nodes.summary: Implements `git ls-remote`: asks a remote through a transport for its ref advertisement, filters by branch/tag type and pattern, sorts the result and prints object ids and ref names.

nodes.name: tail_match
nodes.summary: Matches a ref name against the given patterns by prepending `/` and using wildmatch.

nodes.name: cmd_ls_remote
nodes.summary: Entry point of ls-remote: connects to the remote, retrieves refs (with ref-prefix filtering for protocol v2), filters, sorts and prints oid/ref (and symref) lines.

nodes.name: push.c
nodes.summary: Implements `git push`: resolves the remote and default refspecs (push.default modes), configures a transport with options such as force-with-lease, thin pack and signed pushes, calls transport_push, and prints advice for rejected updates.

nodes.name: refspec_append_mapped
nodes.summary: Appends a refspec for the given ref, using remote.<name>.push mapping or the branch's upstream when push.default=upstream.

nodes.name: set_refspecs
nodes.summary: Appends the command-line refs as push refspecs, expanding the `tag <name>` shorthand and delete refspecs.

nodes.name: die_push_simple
nodes.summary: Dies with an explanatory message when push.default=simple would push to a differently named upstream branch.

nodes.name: setup_default_push_refspecs
nodes.summary: Chooses the default push refspec from push.default (matching, nothing, simple, upstream, current) and sets auto-upstream flags.

nodes.name: push_with_options
nodes.summary: Configures a transport (verbosity, receive-pack, thin, force-with-lease), runs transport_push, reports failures and prints advice per rejection reason.

nodes.name: do_push
nodes.summary: Pushes to every push URL of a remote with the chosen refspecs, applying push options.

nodes.name: git_push_config
nodes.summary: Config callback for push.followTags/autoSetupRemote/gpgSign/recurseSubmodules/pushOption/useForceIfIncludes and color.push.

nodes.name: push_multiple
nodes.summary: For a remote group, runs a child `git push` per remote with the options re-serialized.

nodes.name: die_if_repo_looks_like_ref
nodes.summary: Dies with a hint when the repository argument looks like `<remote>/<branch>` of a configured remote rather than a push target.

nodes.name: cmd_push
nodes.summary: Entry point of `git push`: parses options, resolves the remote or group, and runs do_push or push_multiple.

nodes.name: option_parse_recurse_submodules
nodes.summary: Option callback for --recurse-submodules that maps check, on-demand, only and no onto the push setting.

nodes.name: set_push_cert_flags
nodes.summary: Translates the --signed setting (never, always, if-asked) into transport push flags.

nodes.name: receive-pack.c
nodes.summary: Server side of `git push`: advertises refs, reads the command list and pack, unpacks objects into a quarantine, checks connectivity, runs pre-receive/update/post-receive and proc-receive hooks, applies ref updates (atomically or one by one) under the deny* configuration, and reports status to the client.

nodes.name: receive_pack_config
nodes.summary: Config callback for receive.* settings (deny*, fsckObjects, unpackLimit, advertisePushOptions, certNonce, hideRefs, procReceiveRefs).

nodes.name: show_ref
nodes.summary: Advertises one ref (with capabilities on the first line) in the receive-pack ref advertisement.

nodes.name: write_head_info
nodes.summary: Writes the full ref advertisement, including alternate refs and capability list, for a push.

nodes.name: proc_receive_ref_matches
nodes.summary: Checks if a command's ref matches the configured proc-receive ref prefixes.

nodes.name: copy_to_sideband
nodes.summary: Async worker that copies hook/rev-list stderr to sideband channel 2 with keepalive packets.

nodes.name: hmac_hash
nodes.summary: Computes an HMAC with the configured hash for the push certificate nonce.

nodes.name: prepare_push_cert_nonce
nodes.summary: Generates a signed nonce for push certificates from the path and timestamp.

nodes.name: check_nonce
nodes.summary: Validates a push certificate nonce against the one issued and returns a NONCE_* status (OK, BAD, MISSING, UNSOLICITED or SLOP).
