nodes.name: prepare_push_cert_sha1
nodes.summary: Verifies the push certificate signature and exports its status to hooks via GIT_PUSH_CERT_* variables.

nodes.name: feed_receive_hook_cb
nodes.summary: Pipe feeder that writes `old new refname` lines for commands to a hook's stdin.

nodes.name: run_receive_hook
nodes.summary: Runs pre-receive or post-receive hooks, feeding the commands and push options, returning rejection.

nodes.name: run_update_hook
nodes.summary: Runs the `update` hook for one ref update and returns whether it declined.

nodes.name: read_proc_receive_report
nodes.summary: Parses the proc-receive hook's reply into per-command ok/ng/ok-with-new-ref results.

nodes.name: run_proc_receive_hook
nodes.summary: Starts the proc-receive hook, sends commands and push options and applies its report to the commands.

nodes.name: update_shallow_ref
nodes.summary: Updates shallow boundaries for one ref: sets up an alternate shallow file with the needed roots, runs check_connected on that command, then commits or rolls back the shallow file.

nodes.name: push_to_deploy
nodes.summary: Updates the checked-out working tree for push-to-deploy when updateInstead is configured.

nodes.name: push_to_checkout
nodes.summary: Runs the push-to-checkout hook to update the working tree for updateInstead.

nodes.name: update_worktree
nodes.summary: Updates the working tree of the current branch after a push (updateInstead), using hook or default push-to-deploy.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Core per-ref decision: checks refname, deny* settings (current branch, deletions, non-fast-forward), shallow status, update hook, then updates or deletes the ref in a transaction.

nodes.name: run_update_post_hook
nodes.summary: Runs the post-update hook with the names of successfully updated refs.

nodes.name: check_aliased_update_internal
nodes.summary: For a symref update, skips it or marks a conflict when another command in the same push targets the symref's destination.

nodes.name: set_connectivity_errors
nodes.summary: After a failed connectivity check, re-checks each command individually to mark which ones are missing objects.

nodes.name: reject_updates_to_hidden
nodes.summary: Rejects commands that target refs hidden by receive.hideRefs.

nodes.name: BUG_if_skipped_connectivity_check
nodes.summary: Asserts that no command still needing a shallow connectivity check was left unchecked.

nodes.name: ref_transaction_rejection_handler
nodes.summary: Callback marking commands rejected by a ref transaction with an error string.

nodes.name: execute_commands_non_atomic
nodes.summary: Applies commands one transaction at a time so some updates may succeed while others fail.

nodes.name: execute_commands_atomic
nodes.summary: Applies all commands in a single ref transaction; any failure rejects them all.

nodes.name: execute_commands
nodes.summary: Orchestrates a push: connectivity check, hidden-ref rejection, pre-receive hook, object migration from quarantine, proc-receive hook, then atomic or non-atomic ref updates.

nodes.name: queue_command
nodes.summary: Parses one `old new ref` command line and appends it to the command list.

nodes.name: queue_commands_from_cert
nodes.summary: Extracts commands from the signed push certificate body, dying if unsigned commands were also sent.

nodes.name: read_head_info
nodes.summary: Reads the client's commands, shallow lines, push-cert and capability list from pkt-lines.

nodes.name: unpack_with_sideband
nodes.summary: Runs unpack-objects or index-pack on the incoming pack, relaying progress via sideband, inside the quarantine transaction.

nodes.name: update_shallow_info
nodes.summary: Updates shallow info after unpack, computing which refs have new shallow roots and rejecting those with incomplete history.

nodes.name: report
nodes.summary: Sends the v1 report-status (unpack result and ok/ng per ref).

nodes.name: report_v2
nodes.summary: Sends the v2 report-status with `ok`/`ng` lines and optional per-ref report options for rewritten refs.

nodes.name: cmd_receive_pack
nodes.summary: Entry point of `git receive-pack`: enters the repository, advertises refs, reads commands and pack, unpacks, executes commands, reports and runs post hooks and gc.

nodes.name: parse_deny_action
nodes.summary: Parses the receive.deny* value (ignore, warn, refuse, updateInstead) into a deny_action.

nodes.name: show_ref_cb
nodes.summary: Reference iterator callback that advertises a ref, treating refs outside the namespace as `.have` and skipping hidden refs.

nodes.name: show_one_alternate_ref
nodes.summary: Advertises an alternate's ref tip as a `.have` line once per object id.

nodes.name: proc_receive_ref_append
nodes.summary: Parses a receive.procReceiveRefs prefix with its optional modifiers and appends it to the pattern list.

nodes.name: report_message
nodes.summary: Formats a prefixed message and sends it to the client on sideband channel 2 or stderr.

nodes.name: prepare_sideband_async
nodes.summary: Redirects stderr into an async sideband copier when sideband is in use.

nodes.name: finish_sideband_async
nodes.summary: Restores stderr and waits for the sideband async worker to finish.

nodes.name: check_cert_push_options
nodes.summary: Verifies that push options in a push certificate match the ones the client sent.

nodes.name: check_aliased_update
nodes.summary: Resolves the symref target of one command and checks it for aliasing conflicts.

nodes.name: check_aliased_updates
nodes.summary: Builds a map of commands by ref name and checks every command for symref aliasing conflicts.

nodes.name: free_commands
nodes.summary: Frees a linked list of push commands with their reports.

nodes.name: read_push_options
nodes.summary: Reads push-option packet lines into a string list until the flush.

nodes.name: prepare_shallow_update
nodes.summary: Builds the per-ref bitmaps of shallow commits and reachability tests used to decide which refs are affected by a shallow push.

nodes.name: remote-ext.c
nodes.summary: Implements the `git remote-ext` transport helper, which runs a user-specified external command (with %s/%S/%G/%V placeholder expansion) and pipes the git smart protocol through it.

nodes.name: strip_escapes
nodes.summary: Parses one argument of the ext command, expanding %s/%S and extracting %G (git service request) and %V (virtual host) placeholders.

nodes.name: parse_argv
nodes.summary: Splits the user's command into argv entries via strip_escapes.

nodes.name: send_git_request
nodes.summary: Writes the git:// style service request packet (optionally with host) to the child's stdin.

nodes.name: run_child
nodes.summary: Spawns the external command and pipes data between it and git with bidirectional_transfer_loop.

nodes.name: command_loop
nodes.summary: Handles the remote-helper commands `capabilities` and `connect` read from stdin.

nodes.name: cmd_remote_ext
nodes.summary: Entry point of git-remote-ext.

nodes.name: remote-fd.c
nodes.summary: Implements the `git remote-fd` transport helper, which speaks the remote-helper protocol over already-open file descriptors and copies data bidirectionally between them and git.

nodes.name: command_loop
nodes.summary: Handles `capabilities` and `connect` helper commands, then bridges the file descriptors with bidirectional_transfer_loop.

nodes.name: cmd_remote_fd
nodes.summary: Entry point of git-remote-fd: parses the fd URL (in,out) and starts the command loop.

nodes.name: send-pack.c
nodes.summary: Implements the plumbing command `git send-pack`: connects to a remote receive-pack, matches local refs against push refspecs, calls send_pack to transfer a pack and ref updates, and optionally prints helper-style status lines.

nodes.name: print_helper_status
nodes.summary: Prints per-ref push results as `ok`/`error` lines for remote helpers.

nodes.name: send_pack_config
nodes.summary: Config callback that maps push.gpgSign (true, false, if-asked) onto the send-pack push certificate mode.

nodes.name: cmd_send_pack
nodes.summary: Entry point of `git send-pack`: parses options, connects (or uses stateless-rpc stdio), reads remote heads, matches push refspecs, calls send_pack and reports status.

nodes.name: upload-archive.c
nodes.summary: Server side of `git archive --remote`: the parent process ACKs, then multiplexes the stdout/stderr of an upload-archive--writer child onto sideband channels, while the writer reads `argument` packets and calls write_archive.

nodes.name: cmd_upload_archive_writer
nodes.summary: Writer child: reads `argument` pkt-lines and invokes write_archive to produce the archive.

nodes.name: error_clnt
nodes.summary: Sends an error message to the client on sideband channel 3 and dies.

nodes.name: process_input
nodes.summary: Reads data from a child fd and forwards it on a sideband band.

nodes.name: cmd_upload_archive
nodes.summary: Entry point: spawns the writer, sends ACK and multiplexes its output to the client with poll.

nodes.name: upload-pack.c
nodes.summary: Implements `git upload-pack`, the server side of fetch and clone: enters the repository, determines the protocol version, and dispatches to the protocol v0/v1 upload_pack or the v2 serve loop.

nodes.name: cmd_upload_pack
nodes.summary: Entry point of upload-pack: parses options, enters the repository and runs the version-appropriate fetch server.

nodes.name: url-parse.c
nodes.summary: Implements `git url-parse`, a small command that validates URLs with url_parse and prints a selected component (scheme, user, password, host, port, path).

nodes.name: parse_or_die
nodes.summary: Parses a URL with url_parse, giving helpful errors for local paths.

nodes.name: get_component_or_die
nodes.summary: Maps a component name to the url_component enum or dies.

nodes.name: extract_component
nodes.summary: Returns a copy of the requested component from a parsed url_info.

nodes.name: cmd_url_parse
nodes.summary: Entry point of url-parse: parses each URL and prints the selected component.

nodes.name: bundle-uri.c
nodes.summary: Implements the bundle-uri feature: parses bundle lists from config or protocol-v2 lines, downloads bundles (file copy or via git-remote-https), recursively resolves nested lists, applies bundles by creationToken or in any order, and answers the bundle-uri server command.

nodes.name: compare_bundles
nodes.summary: Hashmap comparison callback that compares two remote_bundle_info entries by id.

nodes.name: init_bundle_list
nodes.summary: Initializes a bundle_list with an empty hashmap keyed by bundle id.

nodes.name: clear_remote_bundle_info
nodes.summary: Frees the id, uri and file of one remote_bundle_info.

nodes.name: clear_bundle_list
nodes.summary: Frees every bundle in the list and the hashmap, plus the baseURI.

nodes.name: for_all_bundles_in_list
nodes.summary: Iterates the bundle hashmap calling an iterator callback, stopping on a non-zero return.

nodes.name: print_bundle_list
nodes.summary: Prints a bundle list (version, mode, heuristic and per-bundle uri/creationToken) in config format, used by test-tool and debugging.

nodes.name: bundle_list_update
nodes.summary: Applies one `bundle.*` config key/value to the list: sets version, mode, heuristic, or creates and updates a bundle's uri and creationToken.

nodes.name: config_to_bundle_list
nodes.summary: Config callback that feeds each key/value into bundle_list_update.

nodes.name: bundle_uri_parse_config_format
nodes.summary: Parses a downloaded bundle list file in git-config format into a bundle_list and resolves relative URIs against the base URI.

nodes.name: download_https_uri_to_file
nodes.summary: Downloads an http(s) URI to a file by driving `git remote-https` through its capabilities/get remote-helper protocol on stdin/stdout.

nodes.name: copy_uri_to_file
nodes.summary: Fetches a bundle URI to a local file: copies from file paths or delegates to download_https_uri_to_file.

nodes.name: unbundle_from_file
nodes.summary: Reads a bundle header, runs unbundle into the object database and creates refs/bundles/* refs pointing at the new tips.

nodes.name: download_bundle_to_file
nodes.summary: Iterator callback that downloads one bundle (respecting BUNDLE_MODE_ANY), recursing through fetch_bundle_uri_internal.

nodes.name: append_bundle
nodes.summary: Appends a bundle to an array for sorting by creation token.

nodes.name: compare_creation_token_decreasing
nodes.summary: qsort comparator ordering bundles by descending creationToken.

nodes.name: fetch_bundles_by_token
nodes.summary: Implements the creationToken heuristic: sorts bundles newest first, skips the download if fetch.bundleCreationToken is current, downloads and unbundles the minimum set in order, and records the new maximum token.

nodes.name: download_bundle_list
nodes.summary: Downloads every bundle of a list according to its mode (all or any) via download_bundle_to_file.

nodes.name: fetch_bundle_list_in_config_format
nodes.summary: Parses a downloaded bundle list file, sets the list mode and heuristic, then downloads the listed bundles (or applies the creationToken heuristic).

nodes.name: fetch_bundle_uri_internal
nodes.summary: Downloads one URI to a temp file and decides whether it is a bundle (adds it to the list) or a bundle list (recurses, with a depth limit).

nodes.name: attempt_unbundle
nodes.summary: Iterator callback that tries to unbundle one downloaded bundle and marks it unbundled on success.

nodes.name: unbundle_all_bundles
nodes.summary: Repeatedly sweeps the list attempting to unbundle each bundle until no more progress, so bundles that depend on others apply in the right order.

nodes.name: unlink_bundle
nodes.summary: Deletes the temp file of a downloaded bundle.

nodes.name: fetch_bundle_uri
nodes.summary: Public entry for clone/fetch: downloads a bundle or bundle list URI, applies all bundles to the repository and cleans up temp files, reporting whether a heuristic was in use.

nodes.name: fetch_bundle_list
nodes.summary: Downloads and applies the bundle list advertised by a server over protocol v2.

nodes.name: bundle_uri_advertise
nodes.summary: Server-side capability advertisement: returns whether bundle-uri is enabled by config.

nodes.name: config_to_packet_line
nodes.summary: Config callback that writes each `bundle.*` setting as a key=value packet line to the client.

nodes.name: bundle_uri_command
nodes.summary: Server implementation of the protocol v2 `bundle-uri` command: reads the request and streams the repository's bundle.* configuration as packet lines.

nodes.name: bundle_uri_parse_line
nodes.summary: Parses one `key=value` packet line received from the server into the bundle list.

nodes.name: summarize_bundle
nodes.summary: Iterator callback that prints one bundle's id and uri in config format.

nodes.name: bundle-uri.h
nodes.summary: Public interface of bundle-uri: the remote_bundle_info and bundle_list structures, list mode and heuristic enums, and the functions for parsing, fetching and advertising bundle lists.

nodes.name: bundle.h
nodes.summary: Declares the bundle file API: struct bundle_header, reading and verifying bundle headers, creating bundles, unbundling into the object store and listing bundle refs.

nodes.name: checkout.c
nodes.summary: Provides unique_tracking_name, which finds the single remote-tracking ref that matches a branch name across all remotes (used by checkout/switch DWIM), honoring checkout.defaultRemote to break ties.

nodes.name: check_tracking_name
nodes.summary: for_each_remote callback that tests whether a remote-tracking ref for the branch exists and records matching remotes, preferring the default remote.

nodes.name: unique_tracking_name
nodes.summary: Returns the single remote-tracking ref matching a branch name across remotes (setting the oid), or the one on checkout.defaultRemote when ambiguous, else NULL.

nodes.name: remote_bundle_info
nodes.summary: One bundle in a list: id, uri, local temp file, unbundled flag and creationToken.

nodes.name: bundle_list_mode
nodes.summary: Whether all bundles of a list are required or any one suffices.

nodes.name: bundle_list_heuristic
nodes.summary: Heuristics for incremental bundle download (none or creationToken).

nodes.name: bundle_list
nodes.summary: A parsed bundle list: version, mode, hashmap of bundles keyed by id, base URI and heuristic.

nodes.name: bundle_header
nodes.summary: Parsed header of a bundle file: version, prerequisites, references, hash algorithm and filter.

nodes.name: verify_bundle_flags
nodes.summary: Flags for verify_bundle: verbose, quiet and fsck.

nodes.name: unbundle_opts
nodes.summary: Options for unbundle: verify flags and optional fsck message severity configuration.

nodes.name: connect.c
nodes.summary: Core of the client side of the transport connection: opens git://, ssh:// and local connections (including proxies and ssh variant detection), parses the v0/v1/v2 ref advertisements and capabilities, and implements ls-refs and bundle-uri requests for protocol v2.

nodes.name: check_ref
nodes.summary: Filters a ref name by flags (REF_NORMAL, REF_BRANCHES, REF_TAGS), skipping peeled and special refs.

nodes.name: check_ref_type
nodes.summary: Applies check_ref to a struct ref using its name.

nodes.name: die_initial_contact
nodes.summary: Dies with the standard 'could not read from remote repository' message, distinguishing unexpected EOF.

nodes.name: server_supports_v2
nodes.summary: Checks whether the server advertised a protocol v2 command.

nodes.name: ensure_server_supports_v2
nodes.summary: Dies if the server did not advertise a protocol v2 command.

nodes.name: server_feature_v2
nodes.summary: Looks up a v2 capability and returns its value if present.

nodes.name: server_supports_feature
nodes.summary: Checks whether a v2 command supports a given feature, optionally dying when it does not.

nodes.name: process_capabilities_v2
nodes.summary: Reads the v2 capability advertisement lines into the server_capabilities_v2 list.

nodes.name: discover_version
nodes.summary: Peeks the first packet of the server response to determine protocol version v0, v1 or v2 and consumes the capability advertisement for v2.

nodes.name: parse_one_symref_info
nodes.summary: Parses one `symref=<src>:<dst>` capability value into a symref string list.

nodes.name: annotate_refs_with_symref_info
nodes.summary: Attaches advertised symref targets (such as HEAD to refs/heads/main) to the matching refs.

nodes.name: process_capabilities
nodes.summary: Splits the capability list from the first v0/v1 ref line and records it with the object-format and symref info.

nodes.name: process_dummy_ref
nodes.summary: Detects the placeholder `capabilities^{}` ref sent for an empty repository.

nodes.name: check_no_capabilities
nodes.summary: Warns if a ref line unexpectedly contains capabilities after the first line.

nodes.name: process_ref
nodes.summary: Parses one v0/v1 advertised ref line (oid and refname) and appends it to the ref list, collecting `.have` extra refs.

nodes.name: process_shallow
nodes.summary: Parses a `shallow <oid>` line from the advertisement into the shallow list.

nodes.name: get_remote_heads
nodes.summary: Reads the v0/v1 ref advertisement with a small state machine (first ref with capabilities, refs, shallow lines, flush) and builds the list of struct ref.

nodes.name: process_ref_v2
nodes.summary: Parses one ls-refs response line (oid, refname, symref-target, peeled, unborn) into a struct ref.

nodes.name: check_stateless_delimiter
nodes.summary: Verifies the response-end packet that stateless RPC transports must send after a v2 response.

nodes.name: send_capabilities
nodes.summary: Sends the client capabilities (agent, object-format) in a v2 request.

nodes.name: get_remote_bundle_uri
nodes.summary: Sends the v2 `bundle-uri` command and parses the returned lines into a bundle_list.

nodes.name: get_remote_refs
nodes.summary: Sends the v2 `ls-refs` command with ref prefixes, peel/symrefs/unborn arguments and reads the refs.

nodes.name: parse_feature_value
nodes.summary: Finds a feature in a space separated capability string and returns its `=value` part with length and offset.

nodes.name: server_supports_hash
nodes.summary: Checks the server's object-format capability against a wanted hash algorithm.

nodes.name: parse_feature_request
nodes.summary: Returns whether a feature is present in a feature list.

nodes.name: server_feature_value
nodes.summary: Returns the value of a server capability from the current advertisement.

nodes.name: server_supports
nodes.summary: Returns whether the server advertised a capability.

nodes.name: write_command_and_capabilities
nodes.summary: Builds a v2 request buffer with command, agent and object-format capabilities, optional server options and a delimiter.

nodes.name: get_host_and_port
nodes.summary: Splits a host string into host and port parts, handling bracketed IPv6 literals.

nodes.name: enable_keepalive
nodes.summary: Enables TCP keepalive on a socket.

nodes.name: git_tcp_connect_sock
nodes.summary: Resolves the host (getaddrinfo or gethostbyname) and connects a TCP socket for git://, returning the fd.

nodes.name: git_connection_is_socket
nodes.summary: Tells whether a connection child is the dummy socket connection created for git://.

nodes.name: git_tcp_connect
nodes.summary: Opens a TCP connection and returns a dummy child_process whose fds are the socket.

nodes.name: git_proxy_command_options
nodes.summary: Config callback for core.gitProxy settings of the form `proxy for host`.

nodes.name: git_use_proxy
nodes.summary: Determines whether a core.gitProxy applies to the host.

nodes.name: git_proxy_connect
nodes.summary: Starts the configured proxy command with host and port and uses its pipes as the connection.

nodes.name: parse_connect_url
nodes.summary: Splits a remote URL into scheme, host and path, recognizing git://, ssh://, file://, scp-like syntax and local paths.

nodes.name: override_ssh_variant
nodes.summary: Reads GIT_SSH_VARIANT or ssh.variant to force the ssh variant.

nodes.name: determine_ssh_variant
nodes.summary: Determines whether the ssh command is ssh, plink, putty or tortoiseplink from config, environment or command name.

nodes.name: git_connect_git
nodes.summary: Connects to a git:// daemon via TCP or proxy and sends the initial request packet with program, path, virtual host and protocol version.

nodes.name: push_ssh_options
nodes.summary: Appends ssh options (SendEnv for protocol version, IPv4/IPv6, port) according to the detected variant.

nodes.name: fill_ssh_args
nodes.summary: Builds the ssh command line (GIT_SSH or GIT_SSH_COMMAND, variant options, host) for the connection process.

nodes.name: git_connect
nodes.summary: Main client connection entry: parses the URL and starts a git:// connection, an ssh child or a local child running the service program, returning the connection and its fds.

nodes.name: finish_connect
nodes.summary: Waits for the connection child process to finish and frees it.

nodes.name: connect.h
nodes.summary: Header for the connection layer: git_connect/finish_connect, the git_connect_service enum, CONNECT_* flags, and server capability query helpers for protocol v0/v1/v2.

nodes.name: connected.c
nodes.summary: Implements the connectivity check: feeds new ref tips to `git rev-list --objects --not --all` (skipping tips already known to be in a self-contained new pack) to prove every needed object exists, with a promisor-remote shortcut.

nodes.name: promised_object_cb
nodes.summary: Callback that records whether any object came from a promisor remote.

nodes.name: check_connected_promisor
nodes.summary: Fast path for partial clones: counts oids as connected when they are promisor objects, avoiding a full rev-list walk.

nodes.name: check_connected
nodes.summary: Runs `git rev-list --objects --stdin --not --all` over the new ref tips to verify every needed object is present, skipping tips contained in a fresh self-contained pack.

nodes.name: git_connect_service
nodes.summary: The service a connection is for: upload-pack, receive-pack or upload-archive.

nodes.name: connected.h
nodes.summary: Declares check_connected and struct check_connected_options used after fetch, clone and receive-pack to verify that new refs are fully connected to existing objects.

nodes.name: credential.c
nodes.summary: Implements the credential subsystem: struct credential lifecycle, URL parsing, config matching by urlmatch, the helper protocol (key=value lines, capabilities, state), running credential helpers for get/store/erase, and interactive prompting.

nodes.name: credential_init
nodes.summary: Initializes a credential struct to its default empty state.

nodes.name: credential_clear
nodes.summary: Frees all strings and helper lists of a credential and resets it.

nodes.name: credential_next_state
nodes.summary: Moves the credential's multistage state to the next value, clearing the transient state.

nodes.name: credential_clear_secrets
nodes.summary: Clears password, credential, expiry and OAuth fields without touching other data.

nodes.name: credential_set_capability
nodes.summary: Sets a capability bit set for a given operation type.

nodes.name: credential_set_all_capabilities
nodes.summary: Sets every known capability for an operation type.

nodes.name: credential_announce_capabilities
nodes.summary: Writes `version` and capability lines that this client supports to a helper.

nodes.name: credential_match
nodes.summary: Returns whether a credential template matches another on protocol, host, path, username and optionally password.

nodes.name: credential_config_callback
nodes.summary: Config callback applying credential.helper, username, useHttpPath and related settings for the matching URL.

nodes.name: proto_is_http
nodes.summary: Returns whether a protocol is http or https.

nodes.name: match_partial_url
nodes.summary: urlmatch fallback that matches config sections for partially specified URLs like `example.com`.

nodes.name: credential_apply_config
nodes.summary: Applies credential.* config for the credential's URL (helpers, username, useHttpPath) using urlmatch.

nodes.name: credential_describe
nodes.summary: Builds a user-facing `user@host/path` description for a prompt.

nodes.name: credential_format
nodes.summary: Formats a credential as a URL string.

nodes.name: credential_getpass
nodes.summary: Prompts interactively for username and password unless credential.interactive disables it.

nodes.name: credential_has_capability
nodes.summary: Checks whether a capability struct supports an operation type.

nodes.name: credential_read
nodes.summary: Parses key=value lines from a helper or stdin into a credential, handling capabilities, state and multi-valued fields.

nodes.name: credential_write_item
nodes.summary: Writes one key=value line of a credential if the value is set.

nodes.name: credential_write
nodes.summary: Serializes a credential and its capabilities as key=value lines to a helper.

nodes.name: run_credential_helper
nodes.summary: Spawns a helper command, writes the credential to its stdin and optionally reads the response from stdout.

nodes.name: credential_do
nodes.summary: Builds the helper command (`git credential-<name>`, absolute path or `!shell`) and runs an operation (get/store/erase) on it.

nodes.name: credential_fill
nodes.summary: Obtains credentials by asking each configured helper for `get` in order, discarding expired secrets, and falling back to interactive prompting.

nodes.name: credential_approve
nodes.summary: Reports a good credential to every helper with `store`.

nodes.name: credential_reject
nodes.summary: Tells every helper to `erase` a rejected credential and clears secrets locally.

nodes.name: check_url_component
nodes.summary: Validates that a URL component does not contain newlines or other forbidden characters.

nodes.name: credential_from_url_1
nodes.summary: Parses a URL (or partial URL) into protocol, user, password, host and path fields of a credential.

nodes.name: credential_from_potentially_partial_url
nodes.summary: Parses a possibly partial URL into a credential.

nodes.name: credential_from_url_gently
nodes.summary: Parses a full URL into a credential, returning an error instead of dying.

nodes.name: credential_from_url
nodes.summary: Parses a full URL into a credential, dying on error.

nodes.name: credential.h
nodes.summary: Declares struct credential, the capability and operation enums, and the API (fill/approve/reject, read/write, from_url, match) used by HTTP, imap-send and credential helpers.

nodes.name: check_connected_options
nodes.summary: Options for check_connected: quiet, shallow file, transport, err_fd, progress, env, deepening and hidden-refs section.

nodes.name: credential_op_type
nodes.summary: Which stage of the helper protocol a credential is being read or written for: initial, helper or response.

nodes.name: credential_capability
nodes.summary: Bit set recording which protocol stages support a capability.

nodes.name: credential
nodes.summary: One login credential with its context: helpers, username, password, protocol, host, path, state and capabilities.

nodes.name: fetch-object-info.c
nodes.summary: Client side of the protocol v2 object-info command: sends a request for the size and type of given objects to a remote and parses the per-object answers into result arrays.

nodes.name: fetch-object-info.h
nodes.summary: Declares struct fetch_object_info_results (sizes, types, unrecognized flags) and the fetch_object_info and free functions used by transport to ask a remote about objects without fetching them.

nodes.name: send_object_info_request
nodes.summary: Builds an object-info command request in a strbuf (command, capabilities, optional size and type attributes, one oid line per object, flush) and writes it to the remote fd.

nodes.name: parse_object_size
nodes.summary: Strictly parses a decimal string into a size_t, rejecting empty input, non-digits and values over SIZE_MAX.

nodes.name: fetch_object_info
nodes.summary: Runs the protocol v2 object-info exchange: checks server capabilities, sends the request, validates the attribute list and then one answer line per oid, filling size, type and unrecognized arrays in the results, and checks the closing flush.

nodes.name: free_fetch_object_info_results
nodes.summary: Frees the size, type and unrecognized arrays of a fetch_object_info_results and zeroes the struct.

nodes.name: fetch_object_info_results
nodes.summary: Result arrays (sizes, types, unrecognized flags) and wants flags for an object-info request.

nodes.name: fetch-pack.c
nodes.summary: Client side of git fetch-pack: negotiates with an upload-pack server over protocol v0/v1 and v2 (want, have, ACK, shallow, filter), then receives the packfile through index-pack or unpack-objects and updates shallow state.

nodes.name: fetch-pack.h
nodes.summary: Public interface of fetch-pack: struct fetch_pack_args with all fetch options plus fetch_pack, negotiate_using_fetch, report_unmatched_refs and the fsck config helpers.

nodes.name: print_verbose
nodes.summary: Prints a printf-style message to stderr only when the fetch-pack args have verbose set.

nodes.name: cache_one_alternate
nodes.summary: Callback that parses an object from an alternate's ref tip and records it once, flagged ALTERNATE, in a growing cache.

nodes.name: for_each_cached_alternate
nodes.summary: Lazily fills a static cache of alternate object-database ref tips and then calls a callback with the negotiator for each cached object.

nodes.name: deref_without_lazy_fetch
nodes.summary: Resolves an oid to a commit without triggering a lazy fetch: tries the commit-graph first, then peels tags through the object database, optionally marking tags COMPLETE.

nodes.name: consume_shallow_list
nodes.summary: In stateless RPC deepen mode, reads and discards the repeated shallow/unshallow lines and the flush that follow each block of haves.

nodes.name: get_ack
nodes.summary: Reads one ACK or NAK packet and classifies it as ACK, ACK continue, ACK common or ACK ready, filling in the acked object id.

nodes.name: send_request
nodes.summary: Sends a request buffer to the remote: via sideband plus flush in stateless RPC mode, otherwise with a plain write_in_full.

nodes.name: next_flush
nodes.summary: Computes the next flush window size for the haves exchange, doubling at first and then growing linearly (or by 10 percent in stateless RPC).

nodes.name: mark_tips
nodes.summary: Feeds the negotiator the local ref tips (or only the restricted negotiation tips) as starting points for the commit walk.

nodes.name: send_filter
nodes.summary: Appends a "filter <spec>" line to the request when the server supports object filtering, otherwise warns and ignores it, and records trace2 data.

nodes.name: add_oids_to_set
nodes.summary: Inserts each oid of an array into an oidset after verifying that the object exists locally, dying if it does not.

nodes.name: find_common
nodes.summary: Protocol v0/v1 negotiation: sends want lines with capabilities, handles deepen and shallow lines, then streams batches of have lines while reading ACK/NAK replies until the server is ready or the commit walk gives up.

nodes.name: mark_complete
nodes.summary: Marks a commit (reached from a local ref) as COMPLETE and queues it in the date-ordered priority queue.

nodes.name: mark_recent_complete_commits
nodes.summary: Pops commits from the priority queue, marking them and their parents COMPLETE, while they are newer than the cutoff date.

nodes.name: filter_refs
nodes.summary: Matches the sorted remote ref list against the wanted (sought) refs, keeps matching refs, optionally keeps all for fetch --all, and appends unadvertised requested oids when the server allows it.

nodes.name: mark_complete_and_common_ref
nodes.summary: Finds a recency cutoff from remote ref commits we already have, marks local refs and their ancestry COMPLETE, and tells the negotiator which remote tips are already common.

nodes.name: everything_local
nodes.summary: Returns true if every remote ref tip is already present locally and flagged COMPLETE, so no pack needs to be fetched.

nodes.name: create_promisor_file
nodes.summary: Derives the .promisor file name from a pack's .keep name and writes a promisor marker for a partial-clone pack.

nodes.name: parse_gitmodules_oids
nodes.summary: Reads fixed-width hex object ids (one per line) from a pipe and inserts them into an oidset of .gitmodules blobs.

nodes.name: get_pack
nodes.summary: Receives the pack: optionally demultiplexes sideband, peeks the pack header to choose between unpack-objects and index-pack, builds the child command line (thin, keep, fsck, shallow, promisor) and runs it.

nodes.name: do_fetch_pack
nodes.summary: Drives a protocol v0/v1 fetch: sorts refs, reads server capabilities into globals, finds local complete commits, negotiates with find_common, sets up shallow state, then downloads the pack with get_pack and runs fsck.

nodes.name: add_shallow_requests
nodes.summary: Adds shallow, deepen, deepen-since, deepen-not and deepen-relative lines to a v2 fetch request.

nodes.name: add_wants
nodes.summary: Adds want or want-ref lines for every remote ref that is not already COMPLETE locally.

nodes.name: add_common
nodes.summary: Writes a have line for every oid in the set of commits already acknowledged as common.

nodes.name: add_haves
nodes.summary: Writes unconditional negotiation-include haves, then pulls up to N haves from the negotiator and grows the next batch size.

nodes.name: send_fetch_request
nodes.summary: Builds and sends one protocol v2 fetch command: capabilities, thin-pack, shallow, filter, packfile-uris, wants, common and haves, adding done when no more haves remain or the walk is in vain.

nodes.name: process_section_header
nodes.summary: Peeks or consumes a section header line from a v2 response and dies when the expected section is missing.

nodes.name: process_ack
nodes.summary: Reads the acknowledgments section of a v2 response, registering ACK oids with the negotiator and noting a "ready" line, and checks the terminating delim or flush.

nodes.name: receive_shallow_info
nodes.summary: Parses the shallow-info section of a v2 response, recording shallow and unshallow commits and updating the shallow state.

nodes.name: receive_wanted_refs
nodes.summary: Parses the wanted-refs section and copies each returned oid into the matching sought ref, found by binary search.

nodes.name: receive_packfile_uris
nodes.summary: Reads the packfile-uris section into a string list of "<hash> <uri>" entries.

nodes.name: do_fetch_pack_v2
nodes.summary: Drives a protocol v2 fetch as a state machine (check local, send request, process acks, get pack), then downloads any packfile URIs with http-fetch and runs fsck.

nodes.name: fetch_pack_fsck_config
nodes.summary: Handles fetch.fsck.* and skiplist config keys by appending them to an fsck message-type string, returning 0 for handled, 1 for unrelated keys.

nodes.name: fetch_pack_config
nodes.summary: Reads fetch and transfer settings (unpack limits, ofs-delta, fsckobjects, uriprotocols) into static variables and processes the config callback.

nodes.name: fetch_pack_setup
nodes.summary: One-time setup that loads the config and picks the effective unpack limit.

nodes.name: remove_duplicates_in_refs
nodes.summary: Compacts an array of refs in place so that each ref name appears only once, returning the new count.

nodes.name: update_shallow
nodes.summary: After a fetch, commits or rolls back the shallow file and decides which fetched refs are safe to update, rejecting those that would need new shallow roots.

nodes.name: iterate_ref_map
nodes.summary: Iterator callback that returns the old_oid of each ref in a linked list, used to feed check_connected.

nodes.name: fetch_pack_fsck_objects
nodes.summary: Returns whether received objects should be checked, from fetch.fsckObjects or transfer.fsckObjects.

nodes.name: fetch_pack
nodes.summary: Public entry point of fetch-pack: loads config, dedupes sought refs, dispatches to the v2 or v0/v1 implementation, reloads the object database, checks connectivity for deepening fetches and updates shallow data.

nodes.name: clear_common_flag
nodes.summary: Clears the COMMON flag from every object in an oidset after negotiation.

nodes.name: negotiate_using_fetch
nodes.summary: Implements fetch --negotiate-only: repeatedly sends haves with wait-for-done, collects acked commits and stops when all restricted tips are reachable from common commits.

nodes.name: report_unmatched_refs
nodes.summary: Prints an error for each requested ref that was not matched or not allowed as an unadvertised object and returns 1 if any failed.

nodes.name: alternate_object_cache
nodes.summary: Growable array of objects found at alternate object-database ref tips, cached for negotiation.

nodes.name: ack_type
nodes.summary: Enum of ACK kinds seen during v0/v1 negotiation (NAK, ACK, continue, common, ready).

nodes.name: fetch_state
nodes.summary: Enum of the protocol v2 fetch state machine states from local check to done.

nodes.name: fetch_pack_args
nodes.summary: All options of one fetch-pack run: depth, deepen settings, filter, server options, negotiation tips and many behavior flags.

nodes.name: git-curl-compat.h
nodes.summary: Centralizes libcurl version checks by defining GIT_CURL_HAVE_* macros for each curl feature git uses, so the oldest supported libcurl is documented in one place.

nodes.name: http-fetch.c
nodes.summary: Implements the git http-fetch command: fetches commits and objects over dumb HTTP through the walker, or downloads a single packfile and indexes it.

nodes.name: fetch_using_walker
nodes.summary: Fetches commits over dumb HTTP: initializes libcurl, creates an HTTP walker, runs walker_fetch for the requested commits and writes optional refs, then warns about corrupt loose objects and cleans up.

nodes.name: fetch_single_packfile
nodes.summary: Downloads one packfile by direct URL into a temporary file with an active curl slot, then runs index-pack on it through finish_http_pack_request.

nodes.name: cmd_main
nodes.summary: Entry point of git http-fetch: parses options (-v, -w, --recover, --stdin, --packfile, --index-pack-arg), then either fetches a single packfile or runs the dumb-HTTP walker.

nodes.name: http.c
nodes.summary: HTTP transport layer built on libcurl: configuration, authentication and proxies, a pool of active request slots on a curl multi handle, request retry and rate limiting, and download helpers for refs, pack indexes, packfiles and loose objects.

nodes.name: http.h
nodes.summary: Declares the HTTP layer API: request slots, GET helpers with options and result codes, and request structs for downloading packfiles and loose objects.

nodes.name: fread_buffer
nodes.summary: libcurl read callback that copies bytes from an in-memory buffer struct into the upload stream.

nodes.name: seek_buffer
nodes.summary: libcurl seek callback that repositions the read offset of an in-memory buffer, failing for out-of-range offsets.

nodes.name: fwrite_buffer
nodes.summary: libcurl write callback that appends received bytes to a strbuf.

nodes.name: fwrite_wwwauth
nodes.summary: libcurl header callback that collects WWW-Authenticate header values (including folded continuation lines) into the credential's wwwauth_headers.

nodes.name: fwrite_null
nodes.summary: libcurl write callback that discards the response body.

nodes.name: finish_active_slot
nodes.summary: Marks a slot finished, records HTTP code and auth-availability results, and runs the slot's completion callback.

nodes.name: process_curl_messages
nodes.summary: Drains the curl multi handle's message queue and finishes the slot that matches each completed transfer.

nodes.name: http_options
nodes.summary: Config callback that maps http.* settings (ssl, proxy, auth, retries, cookies, timeouts, followRedirects) onto static variables, including URL-specific values.

nodes.name: curl_empty_auth_enabled
nodes.summary: Decides whether to send empty credentials so libcurl can try Negotiate or other non-basic auth methods.

nodes.name: http_append_auth_header
nodes.summary: Appends an Authorization header built from a credential's authtype and credential string to a curl header list.

nodes.name: init_curl_http_auth
nodes.summary: Sets curl username and password options, filling credentials from the credential helper when needed.

nodes.name: http_reauth_prepare
nodes.summary: Refreshes credentials before retrying a request after a 401 response.

nodes.name: set_proxyauth_name_password
nodes.summary: Applies proxy username and password, or an auth header, to a curl handle.

nodes.name: init_curl_proxy_auth
nodes.summary: Fills proxy credentials and selects the proxy authentication method from http.proxyAuthMethod.

nodes.name: has_cert_password
nodes.summary: Returns whether a client certificate password is required and still missing, prompting for it through the credential layer.

nodes.name: has_proxy_cert_password
nodes.summary: Same as has_cert_password but for the proxy client certificate.

nodes.name: find_socks_proxy_type
nodes.summary: Looks up a SOCKS proxy scheme name in the static table of supported SOCKS types.

nodes.name: set_curl_proxy_type
nodes.summary: Sets the curl proxy type from the proxy URL scheme: plain http needs nothing, socks variants use the SOCKS table, https enables an HTTPS proxy with optional client certificate.

nodes.name: redact_sensitive_header
nodes.summary: Replaces secrets in Authorization and Cookie style header lines with a redaction marker for trace output.

nodes.name: match_curl_h2_trace
nodes.summary: Recognizes HTTP/2 trace lines from curl and extracts the header text for dumping.

nodes.name: redact_sensitive_info_header
nodes.summary: Applies redaction to a header and prepends a note when something was hidden.

nodes.name: curl_dump_header
nodes.summary: Prints a header block from curl's debug callback line by line, hiding sensitive values.

nodes.name: curl_dump_data
nodes.summary: Hex and text dumps a data chunk from curl's trace callback.

nodes.name: curl_dump_info
nodes.summary: Copies a curl informational message, redacts sensitive parts and prints it to the GIT_CURL_VERBOSE trace key.

nodes.name: curl_trace
nodes.summary: curl debug callback that routes header, data and info events to the GIT_CURL_VERBOSE dump helpers.

nodes.name: http_trace_curl_no_data
nodes.summary: Turns on curl tracing but skips dumping body data.

nodes.name: setup_curl_trace
nodes.summary: Installs curl_trace as the debug function on a curl handle and enables verbose mode.

nodes.name: get_curl_allowed_protocols
nodes.summary: Builds the curl protocol bitmask (http, https, ftp and so on) from git's transport allow rules.

nodes.name: get_curl_http_version_opt
nodes.summary: Maps a http.version string such as "HTTP/2" to the matching curl option constant.

nodes.name: get_curl_handle
nodes.summary: Creates and configures the default curl easy handle: SSL verification, certificates, proxy, auth, timeouts, keepalive, user agent, protocols and encoding options.

nodes.name: set_long_from_env
nodes.summary: Overrides a long config variable from an environment variable with strict numeric parsing.

nodes.name: http_init
nodes.summary: Initializes HTTP support: loads URL-matched http.* config, sets up the SSL backend, curl global init, the curl multi handle, credentials from the URL and the default handle.

nodes.name: http_cleanup
nodes.summary: Releases all active slots, the multi handle, the default handle, headers and global curl state.

nodes.name: get_active_slot
nodes.summary: Returns an idle request slot (creating one by duplicating the default handle if needed), blocking while the maximum parallel requests are in use, and resets curl options for a fresh request.

nodes.name: start_active_slot
nodes.summary: Adds a slot's curl handle to the multi handle and performs the first step of the transfer.

nodes.name: add_fill_function
nodes.summary: Registers a callback in the fill chain that starts more requests when slots are free.

nodes.name: fill_active_slots
nodes.summary: Calls each registered fill function until all slots are busy or no function adds work.

nodes.name: step_active_slots
nodes.summary: Advances the curl multi transfer and processes completion messages.

nodes.name: run_active_slot
nodes.summary: Runs the event loop with select until the given slot's request has finished.

nodes.name: release_active_slot
nodes.summary: Removes a slot from the multi handle and optionally closes its curl session if above the minimum.

nodes.name: finish_all_active_slots
nodes.summary: Runs steps until no active request remains.

nodes.name: needs_quote
nodes.summary: Returns whether a character must be percent-encoded in a ref URL, allowing only letters, digits, slash, hyphen and dot.

nodes.name: quote_ref_url
nodes.summary: Appends a ref name to a base URL, percent-encoding characters that need quoting.

nodes.name: append_remote_object_url
nodes.summary: Appends objects/xx/ (and the rest of the hex) to a base URL for a loose object.

nodes.name: get_remote_object_url
nodes.summary: Returns a newly allocated loose-object URL string for a given hex name.

nodes.name: normalize_curl_result
nodes.summary: Converts a successful curl result with an HTTP error or redirect status into a curl failure with a message.

nodes.name: handle_curl_result
nodes.summary: Maps a finished request result to HTTP_OK, REAUTH, NOAUTH, MISSING_TARGET, RATE_LIMITED or ERROR and approves or rejects credentials accordingly.

nodes.name: run_one_slot
nodes.summary: Starts a slot, runs it to completion and returns the translated HTTP result code.

nodes.name: http_copy_default_headers
nodes.summary: Returns a copy of the default curl header list.

nodes.name: curlinfo_strbuf
nodes.summary: Reads a string curl info value into a strbuf.

nodes.name: extract_param
nodes.summary: Extracts a named parameter from a Content-Type header value.

nodes.name: extract_content_type
nodes.summary: Splits a raw Content-Type into the media type and charset.

nodes.name: write_accept_language
nodes.summary: Builds an Accept-Language header from the locale list with descending q values.

nodes.name: http_get_accept_language_header
nodes.summary: Returns the cached Accept-Language header string, building it on first use.

nodes.name: http_request
nodes.summary: Performs one GET request into a strbuf or FILE, adding headers (Pragma, Accept-Language, extra, auth), runs the slot and captures content type, effective URL and retry-after.

nodes.name: strip_url_credential
nodes.summary: Returns a URL with embedded credentials stripped, using curl's URL API.

nodes.name: match_effective_url
nodes.summary: Checks whether the effective URL after a redirect equals the requested one, ignoring embedded credentials.

nodes.name: update_url_from_redirect
nodes.summary: Computes a new base URL from the redirect target so later requests use it.

nodes.name: handle_rate_limit_retry
nodes.summary: Computes the delay for a 429 response from the Retry-After header or config, failing when above http.maxRetryTime.

nodes.name: http_request_recoverable
nodes.summary: Wraps http_request with recovery: credential refresh on 401, redirect base update and rate-limit retries with sleeping.

nodes.name: http_get_strbuf
nodes.summary: Fetches a URL into a strbuf, recovering from auth and rate-limit responses.

nodes.name: http_get_file
nodes.summary: Fetches a URL into a local file, resuming a partial download when the file already exists.

nodes.name: http_fetch_ref
nodes.summary: Fetches a dumb-HTTP ref file and fills the ref's oid or symref target.

nodes.name: fetch_pack_index
nodes.summary: Downloads objects/pack/pack-<hash>.idx into a temporary file registered for cleanup.

nodes.name: fetch_and_setup_pack_index
nodes.summary: Downloads and verifies a remote pack index, skipping packs already present locally, and adds it to a pack list.

nodes.name: http_get_info_packs
nodes.summary: Downloads objects/info/packs and fetches the index of every listed pack.

nodes.name: release_http_pack_request
nodes.summary: Closes the temp pack file and frees an http_pack_request.

nodes.name: finish_http_pack_request
nodes.summary: Closes the downloaded temp pack, runs index-pack on it as a child process, then removes the temp file.

nodes.name: http_install_packfile
nodes.summary: Moves a downloaded pack from the pending list into the repository's packed store.

nodes.name: new_http_pack_request
nodes.summary: Builds the pack URL objects/pack/pack-<hash>.pack and delegates to new_direct_http_pack_request.

nodes.name: new_direct_http_pack_request
nodes.summary: Opens a resumable temp file for a pack, grabs an active slot and configures a curl download (with range resume) to a given URL.

nodes.name: fwrite_sha1_file
nodes.summary: curl write callback for loose objects that writes bytes to the temp file while inflating and hashing them on the fly.

nodes.name: new_http_object_request
nodes.summary: Prepares a loose-object download: opens a temp file, replays any previous partial download through inflate and hash, and configures a curl slot.

nodes.name: process_http_object_request
nodes.summary: Copies the slot's result into the request and detaches the slot.

nodes.name: finish_http_object_request
nodes.summary: Validates a downloaded loose object (stream end and oid match) and moves it into the object directory.

nodes.name: abort_http_object_request
nodes.summary: Deletes the temp file and frees the request.

nodes.name: release_http_object_request
nodes.summary: Frees an object request: closes the file, releases the slot, ends zlib and the hash context.

nodes.name: socks_proxy_type
nodes.summary: Table entry type mapping a SOCKS proxy scheme name to its libcurl proxy-type constant.

nodes.name: fill_chain
nodes.summary: Linked-list node holding a callback and data that tops up the pool of active request slots.

nodes.name: slot_results
nodes.summary: Results copied out of a finished request slot: curl code, HTTP code, available auth methods and retry-after.

nodes.name: active_request_slot
nodes.summary: One pooled curl easy handle with its in-use flag, results and completion callback.

nodes.name: buffer
nodes.summary: In-memory byte buffer with a read position used as curl upload source.

nodes.name: http_follow_config
nodes.summary: Enum for the http.followRedirects setting (none, always, initial).

nodes.name: http_get_options
nodes.summary: Options and output fields for GET requests: no-cache, content type, charset, effective URL, base URL, extra headers and retry-after.

nodes.name: http_pack_request
nodes.summary: State of one packfile download: URL, temp file, curl slot and index-pack arguments.

nodes.name: http_object_request
