nodes.name: imap-send.c
nodes.summary: Implements git imap-send: reads mbox patches from stdin and appends them to an IMAP folder (for example Drafts) using either libcurl or a built-in IMAP client with TLS and several SASL authentication methods.

nodes.name: list-objects-filter-options.c
nodes.summary: Parses and serializes object filter specifications (blob:none, blob:limit, tree, sparse:oid, object:type, combine) for partial clone, and stores the default filter per promisor remote.

nodes.name: socket_perror
nodes.summary: Prints a socket or SSL error with the failing function name, using the SSL error queue when the connection is TLS.

nodes.name: host_matches
nodes.summary: Compares a certificate name against the requested host, rejecting embedded NUL bytes and supporting a leading wildcard label.

nodes.name: verify_hostname
nodes.summary: Checks that the server certificate matches the host through subjectAltName entries or the common name.

nodes.name: ssl_socket_connect
nodes.summary: Wraps the IMAP socket in OpenSSL (TLS only or negotiated), loads CA settings, verifies the certificate when ssl_verify is on and reports failures.

nodes.name: socket_read
nodes.summary: Reads from the IMAP socket through SSL_read or read.

nodes.name: socket_write
nodes.summary: Writes to the IMAP socket through SSL_write or write.

nodes.name: socket_shutdown
nodes.summary: Shuts down SSL and closes the read and write file descriptors of a socket.

nodes.name: buffer_gets
nodes.summary: Reads one CRLF-terminated line from the buffered IMAP socket into a string, refilling the buffer as needed.

nodes.name: imap_info
nodes.summary: printf-style informational output controlled by verbosity.

nodes.name: imap_warn
nodes.summary: printf-style warning output controlled by verbosity.

nodes.name: next_arg
nodes.summary: Tokenizes the next space-separated, optionally quoted or parenthesized argument of an IMAP response line.

nodes.name: issue_imap_cmd
nodes.summary: Formats a tagged IMAP command, writes it (and literal data when LITERAL+ is available) to the socket and appends it to the in-progress queue.

nodes.name: imap_exec
nodes.summary: Issues an IMAP command and waits for its result.

nodes.name: imap_exec_m
nodes.summary: Issues a command (used for APPEND) and maps the IMAP result to DRV_OK, DRV_MSG_BAD or DRV_STORE_BAD.

nodes.name: skip_imap_list_l
nodes.summary: Skips over a possibly nested parenthesized list in a response, handling quoted strings and escapes.

nodes.name: parse_capability
nodes.summary: Parses the CAPABILITY response into a bit mask of supported features.

nodes.name: parse_response_code
nodes.summary: Interprets bracketed response codes such as UIDVALIDITY, UIDNEXT and CAPABILITY.

nodes.name: get_cmd_result
nodes.summary: Reads server lines until the tagged result of a command (or the next literal prompt) arrives, handling untagged responses and continuation requests.

nodes.name: imap_close_server
nodes.summary: Sends LOGOUT when the socket is open, shuts the socket down and frees the imap state.

nodes.name: plain_base64
nodes.summary: Builds the base64 SASL PLAIN blob from user and password.

nodes.name: cram
nodes.summary: Computes the CRAM-MD5 response (HMAC-MD5 of the challenge) and base64 encodes it.

nodes.name: oauthbearer_base64
nodes.summary: Builds the base64 OAUTHBEARER initial client response from the user and access token.

nodes.name: xoauth2_base64
nodes.summary: Builds the base64 XOAUTH2 initial client response from the user and access token.

nodes.name: auth_plain
nodes.summary: AUTHENTICATE continuation handler that sends the PLAIN credentials.

nodes.name: auth_cram_md5
nodes.summary: AUTHENTICATE continuation handler that answers the CRAM-MD5 challenge.

nodes.name: auth_oauthbearer
nodes.summary: AUTHENTICATE continuation handler that sends the OAUTHBEARER token.

nodes.name: auth_xoauth2
nodes.summary: AUTHENTICATE continuation handler that sends the XOAUTH2 token.

nodes.name: server_fill_credential
nodes.summary: Fills missing user and password for the IMAP server from the credential helper.

nodes.name: try_auth_method
nodes.summary: Checks that the server advertises a SASL mechanism and runs AUTHENTICATE with the matching handler.

nodes.name: imap_open_store
nodes.summary: Opens an IMAP session: tunnel or TCP connection with optional TLS, greeting, CAPABILITY, STARTTLS, login or SASL auth, then EXAMINE or CREATE of the target mailbox.

nodes.name: lf_to_crlf
nodes.summary: Rewrites a message so every LF is preceded by CR, as IMAP requires.

nodes.name: imap_store_msg
nodes.summary: Converts a message to CRLF line endings and uploads it with APPEND as a literal, marking it as a draft when --draft is set.

nodes.name: wrap_in_html
nodes.summary: Rewrites a message into text/html with the body wrapped in a pre block.

nodes.name: count_messages
nodes.summary: Counts messages in an mbox stream by scanning "From " separators.

nodes.name: split_msg
nodes.summary: Cuts the next message out of the concatenated mbox buffer and advances the offset.

nodes.name: git_imap_config
nodes.summary: Config callback that reads the imap.* settings (host, folder, user, tunnel, SSL, auth method) into a server configuration.

nodes.name: append_msgs_to_imap
nodes.summary: Builtin-protocol path: opens the store, sends each message with APPEND while showing progress and closes the session.

nodes.name: list_imap_folders
nodes.summary: Builtin-protocol path: opens a session and prints the folders from a LIST command.

nodes.name: setup_curl
nodes.summary: Creates and configures a libcurl easy handle for the IMAP URL with credentials, SSL verification, auth method and tracing.

nodes.name: curl_append_msgs_to_imap
nodes.summary: libcurl path: uploads each message to the IMAP folder URL with a read callback and reports progress.

nodes.name: curl_list_imap_folders
nodes.summary: libcurl path: lists the IMAP folders through a curl request and prints them.

nodes.name: cmd_main
nodes.summary: Entry point of git imap-send: reads imap config and options, validates host and folder, reads an mbox from stdin and sends the messages by the curl, tunnel or builtin path.

nodes.name: imap_server_conf
nodes.summary: Settings for the target IMAP server: host, port, folder, user, password, tunnel, TLS and auth method.

nodes.name: imap_socket
nodes.summary: Pair of file descriptors plus optional OpenSSL state for an IMAP connection.

nodes.name: imap_buffer
nodes.summary: Read buffer wrapping an imap_socket for line-oriented reading.

nodes.name: imap
nodes.summary: State of one IMAP session: capabilities, command tag counter, queue of in-progress commands and the read buffer.

nodes.name: imap_store
nodes.summary: An open IMAP mailbox: server config, selected folder name, UIDVALIDITY and the session.

nodes.name: imap_cmd_cb
nodes.summary: Callback and literal data attached to an IMAP command for continuation responses.

nodes.name: imap_cmd
nodes.summary: One queued IMAP command with its tag, text and callback data.

nodes.name: CAPABILITY
nodes.summary: Enum of IMAP server capabilities the client tracks (LITERAL+, STARTTLS, AUTH mechanisms).

nodes.name: list_object_filter_config_name
nodes.summary: Returns the config and wire name (blob:none, tree, sparse:oid and so on) of a filter choice enum.

nodes.name: gently_parse_list_objects_filter
nodes.summary: Parses a filter spec string (auto, blob:none, blob:limit, tree, sparse:oid, object:type, combine) into the filter options struct, writing an error to a buffer instead of dying.

nodes.name: has_reserved_character
nodes.summary: Rejects sub-filter specs that contain reserved characters that would be ambiguous in combine specs.

nodes.name: parse_combine_subfilter
nodes.summary: Percent-decodes and parses one sub-filter of a combine spec, forbidding auto inside a combination.

nodes.name: parse_combine_filter
nodes.summary: Splits a combine: spec on plus signs and parses every sub-filter.

nodes.name: transform_to_combine_type
nodes.summary: Converts an existing single filter into a combine filter holding it as its first sub-filter.

nodes.name: list_objects_filter_die_if_populated
nodes.summary: Dies when a filter has already been chosen so that multiple specs are rejected.

nodes.name: parse_list_objects_filter
nodes.summary: Parses a --filter argument and, when a filter is already set, turns the options into a combined filter.

nodes.name: opt_parse_list_objects_filter
nodes.summary: parse-options callback for --filter and --no-filter.

nodes.name: list_objects_filter_spec
nodes.summary: Returns the stored filter spec string, failing if none exists.

nodes.name: expand_list_objects_filter_spec
nodes.summary: Returns the spec string, rebuilding blob:limit with the numeric value.

nodes.name: list_objects_filter_release
nodes.summary: Frees a filter and its sub-filters and resets it while keeping allow_auto_filter.

nodes.name: partial_clone_register
nodes.summary: Marks a remote as a promisor remote, upgrades the repository format and records the remote's partial clone filter spec in config.

nodes.name: partial_clone_get_default_filter_spec
nodes.summary: Loads the remote's stored partial-clone filter spec as the default filter, ignoring invalid values.

nodes.name: list_objects_filter_copy
nodes.summary: Deep-copies a filter options struct including the spec string, sparse oid name and sub-filters.

nodes.name: list_objects_filter_init
nodes.summary: Resets a filter options struct to the blank initial state.

nodes.name: ls-refs.h
nodes.summary: Declares the server side ls-refs command handler and its capability advertisement for protocol v2.

nodes.name: oid-array.h
nodes.summary: Declares struct oid_array, a growable array of object ids with lazy sorting, binary-search lookup, unique iteration and filtering.

nodes.name: oid_array
nodes.summary: Growable array of object ids with a sorted flag, used for sets of object ids.

nodes.name: oid_array_next_unique
nodes.summary: Static inline helper returning the index of the next distinct oid after a position in a sorted array.

nodes.name: pkt-line.c
nodes.summary: Implements the pkt-line wire framing used by every git transport: four-digit hex length headers, flush, delimiter and response-end packets, reading with status, sideband demultiplexing and the packet reader and writer helpers.

nodes.name: pkt-line.h
nodes.summary: Declares the pkt-line API: packet write functions, read options and statuses, struct packet_reader and struct packet_writer, and maximum packet size constants.

nodes.name: packet_trace_identity
nodes.summary: Sets the program name prefix used in GIT_TRACE_PACKET output.

nodes.name: packet_trace_pack
nodes.summary: Traces packfile data carried in sideband packets into the GIT_TRACE_PACK key and decides if normal packet tracing is suppressed.

nodes.name: packet_trace
nodes.summary: Writes a packet to the GIT_TRACE_PACKET trace, printing text lines readably and binary data as hex, and noting when pack data starts.

nodes.name: packet_flush
nodes.summary: Writes the flush packet 0000 to a file descriptor, dying on error.

nodes.name: packet_delim
nodes.summary: Writes the delimiter packet 0001 (protocol v2 section separator).

nodes.name: packet_response_end
nodes.summary: Writes the response-end packet 0002 used by stateless protocol v2.

nodes.name: packet_flush_gently
nodes.summary: Writes a flush packet and returns an error code instead of dying.

nodes.name: packet_buf_flush
nodes.summary: Appends a flush packet to a strbuf.

nodes.name: packet_buf_delim
nodes.summary: Appends a delimiter packet to a strbuf.

nodes.name: set_packet_header
nodes.summary: Writes the four lowercase hex digits of a packet's total length into a header buffer.

nodes.name: format_packet
nodes.summary: Formats a printf-style payload with a prefix and a four-digit hex length header into a strbuf, dying when the line is too long.

nodes.name: packet_write_fmt_1
nodes.summary: Formats a packet in a shared static buffer and writes it, either dying or returning an error on failure.

nodes.name: packet_write_fmt
nodes.summary: Writes one printf-formatted packet to a file descriptor, dying on error.

nodes.name: packet_write_fmt_gently
nodes.summary: Writes one printf-formatted packet and returns an error code instead of dying.

nodes.name: do_packet_write
nodes.summary: Writes the length header and then the payload as two writes, enforcing the maximum packet payload size.

nodes.name: packet_write_gently
nodes.summary: Writes a data packet to a file descriptor and reports failure with an error return.

nodes.name: packet_write
nodes.summary: Writes a data packet and dies if it fails.

nodes.name: packet_fwrite
nodes.summary: Writes a packet to a stdio FILE with a hex length header, dying if it exceeds the maximum payload size.

nodes.name: packet_fwrite_fmt
nodes.summary: Writes a printf-formatted packet to a stdio FILE.

nodes.name: packet_fflush
nodes.summary: Flushes a stdio stream and dies on error (used after packet_fwrite).

nodes.name: packet_buf_write
nodes.summary: Appends a printf-formatted packet to a strbuf.

nodes.name: write_packetized_from_fd_no_flush
nodes.summary: Copies data from a file descriptor to another as a series of maximum-size packets, without a final flush.

nodes.name: write_packetized_from_buf_no_flush_count
nodes.summary: Writes a memory buffer as maximum-size packets without a final flush, counting the number of packets written.

nodes.name: get_packet_data
nodes.summary: Reads a requested number of bytes from either a file descriptor or an in-memory source, handling EOF and read errors by option flags.

nodes.name: packet_length
nodes.summary: Decodes a four-digit hex packet length header into an integer.

nodes.name: find_packfile_uri_path
nodes.summary: Finds the path part of a packfile-uris line so it can be redacted in traces.

nodes.name: packet_read_with_status
nodes.summary: Core packet reader: reads the length header, classifies flush, delimiter, response-end or data packets, and returns the payload with options such as chomp newline, die on ERR and sideband handling.

nodes.name: packet_read
nodes.summary: Reads one packet into a buffer and returns its payload length, a thin wrapper over packet_read_with_status.

nodes.name: packet_read_line
nodes.summary: Reads one text packet into a shared buffer with newline stripped, returning NULL for flush.

nodes.name: packet_read_line_gently
nodes.summary: Reads one packet gently (EOF is not fatal, newline chomped) and returns its length, optionally storing the length and a pointer to the line.

nodes.name: read_packetized_to_strbuf
nodes.summary: Reads packets until a flush and appends their payloads to a strbuf.

nodes.name: recv_sideband
nodes.summary: Reads sideband-multiplexed packets, copying band 1 to the output and reporting errors from other bands.

nodes.name: packet_reader_init
nodes.summary: Initializes a packet_reader over a file descriptor or in-memory buffer with a shared packet buffer and options.

nodes.name: packet_reader_read
nodes.summary: Reads the next packet into the reader's line pointer, optionally demultiplexing sideband progress and honoring a peeked packet.

nodes.name: packet_reader_peek
nodes.summary: Reads the next packet and marks it peeked so the following read returns the same packet.

nodes.name: packet_writer_init
nodes.summary: Initializes a packet_writer for a destination file descriptor.

nodes.name: packet_writer_write
nodes.summary: Writes a formatted packet through a packet_writer, prefixing it with sideband band 1 when sideband is enabled.

nodes.name: packet_writer_error
nodes.summary: Writes an error packet through a packet_writer, either as sideband band 3 or with an ERR prefix.

nodes.name: packet_writer_delim
nodes.summary: Writes a delimiter packet through a packet_writer.

nodes.name: packet_writer_flush
nodes.summary: Writes a flush packet through a packet_writer.

nodes.name: packet_read_status
nodes.summary: Enum of results of reading one packet: EOF, normal data, flush, delimiter, response-end.

nodes.name: packet_reader
nodes.summary: Reader state over a file descriptor or buffer: options, current line, peek flag, sideband mode and hash algorithm.

nodes.name: packet_writer
nodes.summary: Writer state holding a destination descriptor and whether sideband framing is used.

nodes.name: progress.c
nodes.summary: Terminal progress meter used by long operations: timer-driven redraws, percentages, throughput estimates, delayed and sparse modes and trace2 reporting.

nodes.name: progress_test_force_update
nodes.summary: Test hook that forces the next display to be treated as a timer update.

nodes.name: set_progress_signal
nodes.summary: Installs a SIGALRM handler and a one-second interval timer that triggers progress updates.

nodes.name: clear_progress_signal
nodes.summary: Stops the interval timer and ignores SIGALRM.

nodes.name: display
nodes.summary: Renders the progress line (title, count, percent, optional throughput) to stderr when due, handling delay, sparse mode and terminal width.

nodes.name: display_throughput
nodes.summary: Updates the moving-average transfer rate every half second and stores the "KiB/s" display text.

nodes.name: display_progress
nodes.summary: Public update call that forwards a new count to the display routine when a progress object exists.

nodes.name: start_progress_delay
nodes.summary: Allocates a progress object, records start time, sets up the signal and opens a trace2 region.

nodes.name: start_delayed_progress
nodes.summary: Starts a progress meter that only appears after the default delay.

nodes.name: start_progress
nodes.summary: Starts a progress meter that appears immediately.

nodes.name: start_sparse_progress
nodes.summary: Starts an immediate progress meter in sparse mode that only prints on percent change.

nodes.name: start_delayed_sparse_progress
nodes.summary: Starts a delayed sparse progress meter.

nodes.name: force_last_update
nodes.summary: Computes the final throughput and forces a last display with the done message.

nodes.name: log_trace2
nodes.summary: Logs total objects and bytes to trace2 and closes the progress region.

nodes.name: stop_progress_msg
nodes.summary: Ends a progress meter: flushes the final line with a message, logs trace2 data, clears the timer and frees the object.

nodes.name: throughput
nodes.summary: Rolling window of byte counts and elapsed times used to compute the displayed transfer rate.

nodes.name: progress
nodes.summary: State of one progress meter: title, counters, percent, delay, sparse flag and timing.

nodes.name: pseudo-merge.c
nodes.summary: Implements pseudo-merges for reachability bitmaps: reads bitmapPseudoMerge.* config groups, selects unbitmapped ref tips into synthetic merge commits (stable and decaying unstable groups) when writing a bitmap, and applies, cascades and looks them up from a memory-mapped .bitmap file when reading.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses ewah bitmaps and big-endian on-disk lookups (get_be32/get_be64) with a bsearch over fixed-size records, plus a power-series decay formula to size groups.

nodes.name: pseudo-merge.h
nodes.summary: Public interface and data structures for pseudo-merges: group configuration, per-group match lists, the commit-to-pseudo-merge index, and the lazily loaded pseudo_merge_map used when reading a .bitmap file.

nodes.name: gitexp
nodes.summary: Computes base raised to an integer exponent by repeated squaring; used to evaluate the n^-k decay term for pseudo-merge group sizes.

nodes.name: pseudo_merge_group_size
nodes.summary: Returns the size of the i-th unstable pseudo-merge group from a power series f(n)=C*n^-k, with C normalised so that all groups together cover the unstable commits.

nodes.name: pseudo_merge_group_init
nodes.summary: Zeroes a pseudo_merge_group, initialises its matches strmap and applies the default decay, max merges, sample rate, threshold and stable size.

nodes.name: pseudo_merge_group_release
nodes.summary: Frees a group: the compiled regex, every per-capture match list in the strmap, and the array of generated pseudo-merge commits.

nodes.name: pseudo_merge_config
nodes.summary: Config callback for bitmapPseudoMerge.<name>.* keys: creates the named group on first use and parses pattern, decay, sampleRate, threshold, maxMerges, stableThreshold and stableSize with validation and warnings.

nodes.name: load_pseudo_merges_from_config
nodes.summary: Reads the repository config into a string_list of pseudo-merge groups and dies if a group lacks a pattern or has its unstable threshold before its stable one.

nodes.name: find_pseudo_merge_group_for_ref
nodes.summary: Ref iterator callback: peels the ref to a commit that is being packed, matches the ref name against each group pattern, joins capture groups into a key, and files the commit into the stable or unstable list by committer date.

nodes.name: push_pseudo_merge
nodes.summary: Allocates a synthetic commit node flagged BITMAP_PSEUDO_MERGE and appends it to the group merges array.

nodes.name: pseudo_merge_idx
nodes.summary: Looks up or creates the pseudo_merge_commit_idx entry for a commit ID in the oid-keyed hash map used to record which pseudo-merges contain it.

nodes.name: select_pseudo_merges_1
nodes.summary: Builds the pseudo-merge commits for one match set: fixed-size stable merges first, then up to max_merges decaying unstable merges honouring the sample rate, adding the chosen commits as parents and registering them with the bitmap writer.

nodes.name: commit_date_cmp
nodes.summary: qsort comparator ordering commits by ascending committer date.

nodes.name: select_pseudo_merges
nodes.summary: Entry point for bitmap writing: walks all refs to fill each group, sorts the matches by date and generates pseudo-merges for every capture-group match, with an optional progress meter.

nodes.name: free_pseudo_merge_map
nodes.summary: Frees the ewah bitmaps held by each pseudo-merge in a map and the backing array, leaving the mmapped .bitmap file alone.

nodes.name: pseudo_merge_commit_ext
nodes.summary: Parsed view of an extended pseudo-merge table: the number of offsets and a pointer to them in the mapped file.

nodes.name: pseudo_merge_ext_at
nodes.summary: Reads an extended pseudo-merge table header at an offset in the mapped .bitmap file with bounds checks, returning its count and data pointer.

nodes.name: pseudo_merge_bitmap
nodes.summary: Lazily reads the object bitmap of a pseudo-merge from the mapped file and caches it; requires the commits bitmap to be loaded first.

nodes.name: use_pseudo_merge
nodes.summary: Lazily loads the commits bitmap of a pseudo-merge, recording where the object bitmap starts.

nodes.name: pseudo_merge_at
nodes.summary: Binary-searches the pseudo-merge array for the entry at a file offset and returns it loaded, or warns when none is found.

nodes.name: pseudo_merge_commit
nodes.summary: Decoded record pairing a bitmap commit position with the offset (or extended-table flag) of its pseudo-merge.

nodes.name: nth_pseudo_merge_ext
nodes.summary: Reads the n-th offset from an extended pseudo-merge table with bounds checks.

nodes.name: apply_pseudo_merge
nodes.summary: ORs a pseudo-merge object bitmap into the result when its commit set is a subset of the result (or roots) bitmap, marking it satisfied.

nodes.name: pseudo_merge_commit_cmp
nodes.summary: bsearch comparator comparing a commit position key against a serialized pseudo-merge commit record.

nodes.name: find_pseudo_merge
nodes.summary: Binary-searches the fixed-width pseudo-merge commit table for a bitmap position and decodes the matching record.

nodes.name: apply_pseudo_merges_for_commit
nodes.summary: Applies every pseudo-merge that contains a given commit (directly or via an extended table) to a result bitmap and cascades if any were satisfied.

nodes.name: cascade_pseudo_merges
nodes.summary: Repeatedly applies unsatisfied pseudo-merges until no more become satisfied, so one satisfied merge can unlock others.

nodes.name: pseudo_merge_for_parents
nodes.summary: Finds the pseudo-merge whose commits bitmap exactly equals a parents bitmap, marking it satisfied.

nodes.name: pseudo_merge_group
nodes.summary: In-memory description of one configured group: the ref regex, per-capture match lists, the generated merge commits and the decay, sample rate and threshold parameters.

nodes.name: pseudo_merge_matches
nodes.summary: Stable and unstable commit arrays collected for one capture-group key of a pseudo-merge group.

nodes.name: pseudo_merge_commit_idx
nodes.summary: Per-commit list of the pseudo-merge numbers that include it.

nodes.name: pseudo_merge_map
nodes.summary: Serialized view of the pseudo-merges in a .bitmap file: lazily filled array, commit table pointer and the mapped region.

nodes.name: pseudo_merge
nodes.summary: One pseudo-merge with lazily loaded commit and object ewah bitmaps, their file offsets and satisfied/loaded flags.

nodes.name: reachable.c
nodes.summary: Marks every object reachable from refs, the index, reflogs, worktree rebase state and optionally recent unreachable objects (gc.recentObjectsHook), using a bitmap walk when available or a revision walk otherwise. It is the object-database reachability helper used by prune and pack-objects.

nodes.name: reachable.h
nodes.summary: Declares the reachability helpers mark_reachable_objects and add_unseen_recent_objects_to_traversal, plus the callback type used to report recent objects found in packs.

nodes.name: repack-cruft.c
nodes.summary: Builds the stdin list for a pack-objects --cruft child process so that unreachable objects are written into a cruft pack, optionally combining small existing cruft packs and honouring an expiration time.

nodes.name: repack-filtered.c
nodes.summary: Supports filtered repacks: writes a pack of objects excluded by a partial-clone filter via pack-objects --stdin-packs, and enumerates promisor blobs that a blob:limit filter would drop.

nodes.name: repack-geometry.c
nodes.summary: Implements geometric repacking: sorts the existing packs by object count, finds the split line where pack sizes stop forming a geometric progression, tracks the preferred pack, and removes the packs that were rolled up.

nodes.name: connectivity_progress
nodes.summary: Progress meter state with a running object count for reachability traversal.

nodes.name: add_one_file
nodes.summary: Reads a one-line object ID file and adds the parsed object to the revision walk pending list.

nodes.name: add_rebase_files
nodes.summary: For every worktree adds objects named in rebase-apply and rebase-merge autostash and orig-head files so an in-progress rebase keeps them reachable.

nodes.name: add_one_ref
nodes.summary: Ref callback that adds a ref tip to the pending list, skipping dangling symbolic refs with a warning.

nodes.name: recent_data
nodes.summary: State for collecting recent objects: the rev_info, mtime cutoff, report callback and a lazily loaded set of extra recent OIDs from hooks.

nodes.name: run_one_gc_recent_objects_hook
nodes.summary: Runs a gc.recentObjectsHook program and reads its output lines of object IDs into an oidset.

nodes.name: load_gc_recent_objects
nodes.summary: Loads extra recent object IDs by running every configured gc.recentObjectsHook, dying on failure.

nodes.name: obj_is_recent
nodes.summary: Decides whether an object counts as recent by its mtime or by membership in the hook-provided set.

nodes.name: add_recent_object
nodes.summary: odb iteration callback that loads recent, unseen objects of any type, adds them to the pending list and reports their pack and offset.

nodes.name: add_unseen_recent_objects_to_traversal
nodes.summary: Walks all local objects in pack order and adds those newer than a timestamp and not yet SEEN to the traversal, used to keep recent unreachable objects.

nodes.name: mark_object_seen
nodes.summary: Bitmap-walk callback that looks up each reachable object and sets its SEEN flag.

nodes.name: mark_reachable_objects
nodes.summary: Adds the index, all refs, HEAD, rebase state and optionally reflogs to a revision walk, traverses via bitmaps or a normal walk, and then optionally adds recent objects.

nodes.name: combine_small_cruft_packs
nodes.summary: Writes pack-objects stdin lines that fold cruft packs below a size threshold into the new cruft pack while retaining larger ones.

nodes.name: write_cruft_pack
nodes.summary: Runs pack-objects --cruft with the just-written packs as kept and existing packs as inputs to write a cruft pack, then collects the generated pack names.

nodes.name: write_filtered_pack
nodes.summary: Runs pack-objects --stdin-packs to write a pack of objects excluded by a filter, using kept, non-kept and cruft packs as input.

nodes.name: collect_cb_data
nodes.summary: Callback state holding the repository and the set of collected promisor blob IDs.

nodes.name: collect_promisor_blob
nodes.summary: odb callback that adds an object ID to a set when it is a blob, without triggering a lazy fetch.

nodes.name: enumerate_promisor_blobs
nodes.summary: Collects all promisor blobs and applies the list-objects filter to find those exceeding the blob:limit threshold, filling a to-drop set.

nodes.name: pack_geometry_cmp
nodes.summary: qsort comparator ordering packs by number of objects.

nodes.name: pack_geometry_init
nodes.summary: Collects the packs eligible for a geometric repack (skipping non-local, kept, cruft and out-of-layer packs), separating promisor packs, and sorts them by object count.

nodes.name: compute_pack_geometry_split
nodes.summary: Finds the split index: counts the largest packs that already form a geometric progression, then extends the rollup to absorb heavier packs whose size would otherwise break it.

nodes.name: pack_geometry_split
nodes.summary: Computes the split for normal and promisor packs and records whether the tip MIDX layer will be rewritten.

nodes.name: pack_geometry_preferred_pack
nodes.summary: Returns the largest local pack above the split line as the MIDX preferred pack, or NULL if none.

nodes.name: remove_redundant_packs
nodes.summary: Deletes rolled-up packs that are not new and not kept.

nodes.name: pack_geometry_remove_redundant
nodes.summary: Removes the rolled-up normal and promisor packs after a geometric repack.

nodes.name: pack_geometry_release
nodes.summary: Frees the pack and promisor pack arrays of a geometry.

nodes.name: repack-midx.c
nodes.summary: Writes the multi-pack-index during repack, either as a single MIDX or as an incremental chain. It computes which packs are included, plans append or compaction steps over existing MIDX layers, runs git multi-pack-index as a subprocess and updates the chain file under a lock.
nodes.languageNotes: The compaction plan models the MIDX chain like a geometric progression: adjacent layers are merged until the merged size would fall below the next layer divided by the split factor.

nodes.name: repack-promisor.c
nodes.summary: Repacks promisor objects (objects that can be refetched from a promisor remote) into their own pack by streaming object IDs to pack-objects, then creates the matching empty .promisor files; also supports repacking promisor packs below a geometric split.

nodes.name: midx_snapshot_ref_data
nodes.summary: State for writing the refs snapshot: repository, tempfile, seen-OID set and a preferred marker.

nodes.name: midx_snapshot_ref_one
nodes.summary: Ref callback that peels a ref and prints its commit ID (prefixed with + for preferred tips) once to the snapshot file.

nodes.name: midx_snapshot_refs
nodes.summary: Writes a snapshot of preferred bitmap tips and then all ref tips to a tempfile for use when writing MIDX bitmaps.

nodes.name: midx_has_unknown_packs
nodes.summary: Checks whether the existing MIDX contains a pack that the new MIDX will not otherwise include or roll up.

nodes.name: midx_included_packs
nodes.summary: Builds the sorted list of .idx names that belong in a new MIDX from kept packs, new packs, packs above the split or non-deleted packs, and cruft packs when needed.

nodes.name: remove_redundant_bitmaps
nodes.summary: Unlinks per-pack .bitmap files for packs now covered by the MIDX bitmap.

nodes.name: repack_prepare_midx_command
nodes.summary: Starts a multi-pack-index child command with progress and bitmap options.

nodes.name: repack_fill_midx_stdin_packs
nodes.summary: Feeds the included pack names to the MIDX command on stdin and optionally captures its output lines.

nodes.name: write_midx_included_packs
nodes.summary: Writes a single MIDX over the included packs, choosing a preferred pack from the geometry or the first non-cruft new pack.

nodes.name: midx_compaction_step
nodes.summary: One step of a MIDX chain plan: copy an existing layer, write a new layer from packs, or compact a range of layers, with its resulting checksum.

nodes.name: midx_compaction_step_base
nodes.summary: Returns the checksum of the layer that the previous step builds on, rejecting write and unknown steps as bases.

nodes.name: midx_compaction_step_exec_write
nodes.summary: Executes a WRITE step by running multi-pack-index write --incremental over a pack list and capturing the new layer checksum.

nodes.name: midx_compaction_step_exec_compact
nodes.summary: Executes a COMPACT step by running multi-pack-index compact between two layers and reading the resulting checksum.

nodes.name: midx_compaction_step_exec
nodes.summary: Dispatches a plan step to its copy, write or compact executor.

nodes.name: repack_make_midx_append_plan
nodes.summary: Builds an append-only plan: one WRITE step for new packs followed by COPY steps for every existing layer.

nodes.name: repack_make_midx_compaction_plan
nodes.summary: Plans a compacted MIDX chain: a first WRITE layer from new and unmodified packs absorbing older layers while sizes stay geometric, then copies or compacts the remaining layers with the same size condition.

nodes.name: write_midx_incremental
nodes.summary: Under a lock on the MIDX chain file, builds a plan, executes each step and writes the new chain, then prunes unreferenced layer files.

nodes.name: repack_write_midx
nodes.summary: Writes the MIDX according to the requested mode: a single MIDX or an incremental chain.

nodes.name: write_oid_context
nodes.summary: Context carrying the pack-objects child, hash algorithm and the set of object IDs to drop.

nodes.name: write_oid
nodes.summary: odb callback that starts pack-objects on first use and writes each promisor object ID to its stdin, skipping IDs scheduled to drop.

nodes.name: finish_repacking_promisor_objects
nodes.summary: Reads new pack names from pack-objects, creates the empty .promisor marker for each and registers the generated pack files.

nodes.name: repack_promisor_objects
nodes.summary: Streams all promisor object IDs into pack-objects to rebuild them as a promisor pack, optionally dropping a set of objects.

nodes.name: pack_geometry_repack_promisors
nodes.summary: Repacks promisor packs below the geometric split with pack-objects --stdin-packs, excluding those above it.

nodes.name: repack.c
nodes.summary: Shared plumbing for git repack: building the pack-objects command line, tracking existing packs (kept, non-kept, cruft, MIDX) with deletion and retain marks, finishing pack-objects output, and installing the generated temporary pack files into the pack directory.

nodes.name: repack.h
nodes.summary: Declares the data structures and APIs shared by the repack-*.c files: pack-objects arguments, existing pack bookkeeping, generated packs, pack geometry, and MIDX writing options.

nodes.name: replace-object.c
nodes.summary: Implements git replace support: lazily loads refs/replace/* into an oidmap, resolves replacement objects recursively up to a depth limit, and decides whether replace refs are enabled for a repository or process.

nodes.name: prepare_pack_objects
nodes.summary: Fills a child_process with the pack-objects arguments derived from a pack_objects_args struct.

nodes.name: pack_objects_args_release
nodes.summary: Frees the strings and filter options held by pack_objects_args.

nodes.name: repack_remove_redundant_pack
nodes.summary: Deletes a pack and its sidecar files, clearing a MIDX first when it references that pack.

nodes.name: write_pack_opts_pack_prefix
nodes.summary: Derives the pack file prefix by stripping the pack directory from the temporary path.

nodes.name: write_pack_opts_is_local
nodes.summary: True when the write destination is inside the repository pack directory.

nodes.name: finish_pack_objects_cmd
nodes.summary: Reads full hex pack names from a finished pack-objects child, registering generated packs for local destinations.

nodes.name: existing_packs_collect
nodes.summary: Classifies local packs into kept, cruft and non-kept lists and records packs in the MIDX.

nodes.name: existing_packs_has_non_kept
nodes.summary: True when there are non-kept or cruft packs that a repack could replace.

nodes.name: existing_pack_is_marked_for_deletion
nodes.summary: Tests the delete bit stored in a pack list item.

nodes.name: existing_packs_mark_for_deletion_1
nodes.summary: Marks packs not named by the new set for deletion, un-marking packs that were retained.

nodes.name: existing_packs_retain_cruft

nodes.name: existing_packs_mark_for_deletion
nodes.summary: Marks non-kept and cruft packs for deletion when they are not part of the newly written set.

nodes.name: existing_packs_retain_midx_packs
nodes.summary: Marks every pack referenced by the existing MIDX chain as retained so incremental layers stay valid.

nodes.name: remove_redundant_packs_1
nodes.summary: Removes every pack in a list that is marked for deletion.

nodes.name: existing_packs_remove_redundant
nodes.summary: Removes marked non-kept and cruft packs after a successful repack.

nodes.name: existing_packs_release
nodes.summary: Clears all string lists in existing_packs.

nodes.name: generated_pack
nodes.summary: Per-pack array of tempfiles for each extension (.pack, .rev, .mtimes, .bitmap, .promisor, .idx).

nodes.name: generated_pack_populate
nodes.summary: Registers temporary files of a new pack for each extension that exists on disk.

nodes.name: generated_pack_has_ext
nodes.summary: Reports whether a generated pack produced a file with a given extension.

nodes.name: generated_pack_install
nodes.summary: Moves each generated temp file into the pack directory as read-only, and unlinks stale optional files.

nodes.name: pack_objects_args
nodes.summary: Options forwarded to pack-objects: window, depth, threads, size limits, reuse flags, delta base offset and filter options.

nodes.name: write_pack_opts
nodes.summary: Bundle of pack_objects_args plus destination, pack directory and temp prefix for writing a pack.

nodes.name: existing_packs

nodes.name: repack_write_midx_mode

nodes.name: repack_write_midx_opts

nodes.name: register_replace_ref

nodes.name: do_lookup_replace_object

nodes.name: replace_refs_enabled

nodes.name: replace-object.h
nodes.summary: Declares replace-object lookups, including the inline lookup_replace_object fast path that skips the map when replacement is disabled or empty, and the struct that maps an original object ID to its replacement.

nodes.name: repo-settings.c

nodes.name: repository.h

nodes.name: server-info.c

nodes.name: server-info.h

nodes.name: replace_object
nodes.summary: oidmap entry holding an original object ID and its replacement ID.

nodes.name: lookup_replace_object
nodes.summary: Inline fast path that returns the OID unchanged when replace refs are disabled or the map is empty, else calls do_lookup_replace_object.

nodes.name: prepare_repo_settings
nodes.summary: Populates struct repo_settings once per repository from config, applying feature.manyfiles and feature.experimental cascades and defaults for commit-graph, index, pack, fetch and cache limits.

nodes.name: repo_settings_clear

nodes.name: repo_settings_get_big_file_threshold

nodes.name: repo_settings_set_big_file_threshold

nodes.name: repo_settings_get_warn_ambiguous_refs
nodes.summary: Returns core.warnAmbiguousRefs, loading it lazily with a default of true.

nodes.name: repo_settings_get_hooks_path
nodes.summary: Returns the cached core.hooksPath pathname.

nodes.name: repo_settings_get_shared_repository
nodes.summary: Returns core.sharedRepository parsed to a permission mode, caching the result.

nodes.name: repo_settings_set_shared_repository
nodes.summary: Overrides the shared repository mode and marks it initialised.

nodes.name: repo_settings_reset_shared_repository
nodes.summary: Forces the shared repository mode to be re-read from config.

nodes.name: ref_storage_format

nodes.name: repo_path_cache
nodes.summary: Cache of frequently used git directory file paths such as MERGE_HEAD and FETCH_HEAD.

nodes.name: repository
nodes.summary: The in-process representation of a repository: paths, object database, parsed object pool, ref stores, settings, config, index, remote state, hash algorithms and ref storage format.

nodes.name: set_gitdir_args

nodes.name: update_info_ctx

nodes.name: update_info_file
nodes.summary: Writes a generated file to a temp file via a generator callback and only renames it into place when it differs from the existing one.

nodes.summary: Ref callback that prints "<oid> <name>" and the peeled "^{}" line for annotated tags into info/refs.

nodes.summary: Comparator that keeps the old order of known packs, puts new packs last and stays stable.

nodes.summary: Collects local packs, loads old order unless forced, and renumbers them.

nodes.summary: Generator callback that prints "P <pack>" lines for info/packs.

nodes.summary: Regenerates objects/info/packs for the repository.

nodes.name: update_server_info
nodes.summary: Refreshes info/refs and objects/info/packs and removes any leftover rev-cache.

nodes.name: statinfo.c
nodes.summary: Converts struct stat data into the compact stat_data stored in index entries, compares it with a later lstat result to detect modified files, and provides stat_validity helpers for checking that a file is unchanged since it was read.

nodes.name: statinfo.h
nodes.summary: Declares the stat_data and cache_time structures used by the index to detect changed files, the MTIME/CTIME/OWNER/INODE/DATA_CHANGED flags, and the stat_validity API; also defines the DTYPE dirent portability macros.

nodes.name: tag.c
nodes.summary: Handles annotated tag objects: lookup, parsing the "object/type/tag/tagger" header into struct tag, peeling nested tags with deref_tag, and verifying a tag signature through the GPG interface.

nodes.name: tree-diff.c
nodes.summary: Core tree-to-tree diff: walks a tree and one or more parent trees in lock-step, emitting added, deleted and modified paths (including combined-diff paths for merges), honouring pathspecs and max depth, and implementing rename following for a single path.
nodes.languageNotes: The long comment above ll_diff_tree_paths derives the multi-parent algorithm: it keeps the minimum parent entry (imin) and compares the new tree entry t against it in three cases (t < p, t > p, t = p).

nodes.name: munge_st_size
nodes.summary: Truncates st_size to 32 bits but avoids a zero value for exact multiples of 4 GiB.

nodes.name: fill_stat_data
nodes.summary: Copies the stat fields Git tracks (ctime, mtime, dev, ino, uid, gid, size) into a stat_data.

nodes.name: set_times
nodes.summary: Restores ctime and mtime seconds and nanoseconds into a struct stat using platform-specific fields.

nodes.name: fake_lstat_data
nodes.summary: Fills a struct stat from stat_data to simulate lstat for an up-to-date index entry.

nodes.name: match_stat_data
nodes.summary: Compares stat_data with a stat and returns changed flags (mtime, ctime, owner, inode, data) honouring core.trustctime and checkstat.

nodes.name: stat_validity_clear
nodes.summary: Frees the saved stat data.

nodes.name: stat_validity_check
nodes.summary: Checks that a path is still a regular file matching saved stat data.

nodes.name: stat_validity_update
nodes.summary: Saves stat data from an open file descriptor.

nodes.name: cache_time
nodes.summary: Low 32 bits of a timestamp stored in index entries as seconds and nanoseconds.

nodes.name: stat_data
nodes.summary: Subset of struct stat saved in an index entry to detect file changes.

nodes.name: stat_validity
nodes.summary: Holder of the saved stat_data used to validate a cached file.

nodes.name: run_gpg_verify
nodes.summary: Splits the tag buffer into payload and signature, checks the signature and prints its status.

nodes.name: gpg_verify_tag
nodes.summary: Reads the tag object from the object database and verifies its GPG signature.

nodes.name: deref_tag
nodes.summary: Follows tagged pointers through nested tags to the final non-tag object.

nodes.name: lookup_tag
nodes.summary: Returns the in-memory tag object for an OID, creating it if needed.

nodes.name: parse_tag_date
nodes.summary: Extracts the tagger timestamp from a tag buffer.

nodes.name: release_tag_memory
nodes.summary: Frees the tag name and resets parse state.

nodes.name: parse_tag_buffer
nodes.summary: Parses the object, type, tag and tagger headers of a tag buffer and links the tagged object by type.

nodes.name: parse_tag
nodes.summary: Reads a tag object and parses it into struct tag.

nodes.name: get_tagged_oid
nodes.summary: Returns the OID of the object a tag points to.

nodes.name: check_recursion_depth
nodes.summary: Decides whether recursing into a directory stays within the max-depth limit relative to the longest matching pathspec.

nodes.name: should_recurse
nodes.summary: Returns whether the diff should descend into a directory given recursion flags and max depth.

nodes.name: tree_entry_pathcmp
nodes.summary: Compares two tree descriptors by path and directory-ness, sorting empty descriptors last.

nodes.name: emit_diff_first_parent_only

nodes.name: skip_uninteresting
nodes.summary: Advances a tree descriptor past entries not interesting for the pathspec.

nodes.name: ll_diff_tree_paths

nodes.name: diff_tree_paths
nodes.summary: Computes the list of changed paths between a tree and its parents.

nodes.name: try_to_follow_renames
nodes.summary: For log --follow, reruns a copy-detecting diff and swaps in a rename source when found.

nodes.name: ll_diff_tree_oid

nodes.name: diff_tree_oid

nodes.name: diff_root_tree_oid
nodes.summary: Diffs an empty tree against a root tree.

nodes.name: tree-walk.c

nodes.name: tree-walk.h
nodes.summary: Declares struct name_entry, tree_desc and traverse_info, the cursor and callback types for walking one or several trees in parallel, and the entry lookup and pathspec interest APIs.

nodes.name: decode_tree_entry
nodes.summary: Decodes the next mode, name and OID record from a tree buffer into a tree_desc entry, reporting malformed entries.

nodes.name: init_tree_desc_internal
nodes.summary: Initialises a tree_desc over a buffer and decodes its first entry.

nodes.name: init_tree_desc
nodes.summary: Initialises a tree descriptor, dying on a corrupt first entry.

nodes.name: init_tree_desc_gently
nodes.summary: Initialises a tree descriptor with flags, returning an error instead of dying.

nodes.name: fill_tree_descriptor

nodes.name: update_tree_entry_gently

nodes.name: tree_desc_x

nodes.summary: Searches a tree for a path name, recursing into subtrees.

nodes.summary: Reads a tree by OID and finds the OID and mode at a path inside it.

nodes.summary: Client side of git push over the smart protocol: advertises capabilities, sends ref update commands (optionally a signed push certificate), streams a packfile built by pack-objects, and parses the server's per-ref status report.

nodes.name: send-pack.h
nodes.summary: Declares struct send_pack_args (the option bundle for a push), the push-certificate mode constants, the send_pack entry point and the --signed option parser.

nodes.name: serve.c
nodes.summary: Implements the protocol v2 server loop: a table of capabilities (agent, ls-refs, fetch, object-format, session-id, object-info, bundle-uri, promisor-remote), capability advertisement, and request parsing that dispatches to the requested command.

nodes.name: serve.h
nodes.summary: Declares the two entry points of the protocol v2 server: advertising capabilities and running the request loop.

nodes.name: shallow.c
nodes.summary: Manages shallow repositories: reading and writing .git/shallow as commit grafts, computing shallow boundaries for depth and deepen-since/deepen-not requests, pruning, and tracking which refs need which shallow commits after a fetch.

nodes.name: option_parse_push_signed
nodes.summary: parse-options callback for --signed: maps false/true/if-asked (or --no-signed) to the SEND_PACK_PUSH_CERT_* constants, dying on a bad value.

nodes.name: append_negative_object
nodes.summary: Adds an object the remote advertised to the pack generator's exclusion (haves) list, but only if the object exists locally.

nodes.name: pack_objects
nodes.summary: Builds the pack for a push: fills wants from new ref values and haves from advertised, negotiated and old values, runs the pack generator, and either lets it write to the socket or wraps its output in side-band packets for stateless RPC.

nodes.name: receive_unpack_status
nodes.summary: Reads the first status packet of the server's report and checks that it says 'unpack ok'.

nodes.name: receive_status
nodes.summary: Parses the report-status stream from receive-pack: ok/ng lines per ref and 'option' lines (refname, old-oid, new-oid, forced-update) that build ref_push_report entries, updating each local ref's status.

nodes.name: check_to_send_update
nodes.summary: Decides whether a ref update should be sent, skipped, or counted as rejected or up to date, based on the status set earlier by set_ref_status_for_push.

nodes.name: generate_push_cert
nodes.summary: Builds a signed push certificate text (pusher, pushee URL, nonce, push options, ref updates), signs it and writes it as push-cert pkt-lines; returns whether any update was included.

nodes.name: reject_invalid_nonce
nodes.summary: Dies if the server-provided push-cert nonce is too long or contains characters outside a safe set.

nodes.name: get_commons_through_negotiation
nodes.summary: Runs 'git fetch --negotiate-only' as a child to learn which commits the remote already has, collecting the resulting object ids to use as pack boundaries.

nodes.name: send_pack
nodes.summary: Main push routine: derives usable capabilities from the server's advertisement, marks refs to send, writes update commands or a push certificate, sends push options and the pack, then reads and validates the status report.

nodes.name: send_pack_args
nodes.summary: Option bundle for send_pack: URL, negotiation settings, and flags such as dry_run, atomic, thin pack, push_cert mode and stateless_rpc.

nodes.name: promisor_remote_advertise
nodes.summary: Advertises the promisor-remote capability with the server's promisor remote information when it is available.

nodes.name: object_format_receive
nodes.summary: Records the hash algorithm requested by the client, dying if the name is missing or unknown.

nodes.name: session_id_advertise
nodes.summary: Advertises the trace2 session id when transfer.advertiseSID is enabled, caching the config lookup.

nodes.name: object_info_advertise
nodes.summary: Advertises object-info (size and type) only when transfer.advertiseObjectInfo is set.

nodes.name: protocol_capability
nodes.summary: Describes one protocol v2 capability: its name plus advertise, command and receive callbacks; instances form the server's capability table.

nodes.name: protocol_v2_advertise_capabilities
nodes.summary: Writes 'version 2' and then one pkt-line per capability whose advertise callback says yes, with an optional =value, ending with a flush.

nodes.name: get_capability
nodes.summary: Looks up a capability by key, accepting 'name' or 'name=value' and returning the value part.

nodes.name: receive_client_capability
nodes.summary: Handles a non-command capability sent by the client by calling its receive callback if it is advertised.

nodes.name: parse_command
nodes.summary: Recognizes a 'command=<name>' line, rejecting duplicate or unsupported commands, and records the selected capability.

nodes.name: process_request
nodes.summary: Reads one v2 request: capability lines and a command up to a flush or delim packet, checks the object format against the repository, then runs the command with the packet reader.

nodes.name: protocol_v2_serve_loop
nodes.summary: Top-level v2 server: advertises capabilities for non-stateless connections, then serves one request (stateless RPC) or loops until the client ends the session.

nodes.name: set_alternate_shallow_file
nodes.summary: Overrides the path of the shallow file for the repository (used by --shallow-file); must be called before shallow state is read.

nodes.name: register_shallow
nodes.summary: Marks a commit as a shallow boundary by registering a graft with no parents and clearing its in-memory parent list.

nodes.name: unregister_shallow
nodes.summary: Removes a commit's shallow graft from the in-memory graft table so its parents become visible again.

nodes.name: is_repository_shallow
nodes.summary: Lazily reads the shallow file, registers each listed commit as shallow and caches the result; returns whether the repository is shallow.

nodes.name: commit_shallow_file
nodes.summary: Commits the lock on the shallow file and reloads shallow state from the new content.

nodes.name: rollback_shallow_file
nodes.summary: Releases the shallow file lock without writing and resets cached shallow state.

nodes.name: get_shallows_or_depth
nodes.summary: Depth-limited walk from the given heads, using a commit slab of depths and a stack; returns the border commits to mark shallow, or computes the current depth to the nearest known shallow commit.

nodes.name: get_shallows_depth
nodes.summary: Returns the smallest depth at which one of the given shallow commits is reached from the heads.

nodes.name: get_shallow_commits
nodes.summary: Computes the shallow boundary for a --depth request, adding the current shallow depth first when deepening relatively.

nodes.name: get_shallow_commits_by_rev_list
nodes.summary: Runs a rev-list walk from caller-supplied arguments, marks reachable commits NOT_SHALLOW and returns border commits (those with an unreachable parent) flagged SHALLOW.

nodes.name: write_one_shallow
nodes.summary: Callback that writes one shallow graft to the output, optionally skipping commits that are missing locally or were not seen by a reachability walk.

nodes.name: write_shallow_commits_1
nodes.summary: Serializes all shallow grafts, plus any extra object ids, either as pkt-line 'shallow' lines or as a plain hex list.

nodes.name: write_shallow_commits
nodes.summary: Public wrapper that writes the current shallow commits (and extras) into a strbuf.

nodes.name: setup_temporary_shallow
nodes.summary: Writes the shallow commits plus extras to a temporary file and returns its path, or an empty string when there are none.

nodes.name: setup_alternate_shallow
nodes.summary: Locks the real shallow file, writes the shallow commits plus extras into the lock file and returns its path for use as an alternate shallow file.

nodes.name: advertise_shallow_grafts
nodes.summary: Sends a 'shallow <oid>' pkt-line to the given fd for each shallow commit if the repository is shallow.

nodes.name: prune_shallow
nodes.summary: Rewrites the shallow file without entries for commits that no longer exist or are unreachable (or only reports them with PRUNE_SHOW_ONLY), removing the file when empty.

nodes.name: prepare_shallow_info
nodes.summary: Splits the shallow commits sent by a peer into 'ours' (already known locally) and 'theirs' (new) lists.

nodes.name: clear_shallow_info
nodes.summary: Frees the arrays and bitmaps held by a shallow_info.

nodes.name: remove_nonexistent_theirs_shallow
nodes.summary: After the pack arrived, drops entries from 'theirs' whose commits are still missing locally.

nodes.name: paint_alloc
nodes.summary: Allocates a zeroed-size bitmap slot from a chunked memory pool for ref reachability painting.

nodes.name: paint_down
nodes.summary: Walks from a ref's commit through parents until it hits SEEN, UNINTERESTING or BOTTOM commits, OR-ing the ref's bit into each visited commit's bitmap.

nodes.name: mark_uninteresting
nodes.summary: Ref callback that marks the ref's commit and its ancestors UNINTERESTING so later traversals stop at already-known history.

nodes.name: assign_shallow_commits_to_refs
nodes.summary: Determines which new refs need which shallow commits by painting history from each ref down to the shallow bottoms, then either reports per-shallow ref bitmaps or prunes unneeded shallow commits.

nodes.name: post_assign_shallow
nodes.summary: Removes unreachable shallow commits from 'theirs' and, using merge-base checks against all current refs, from 'ours', and counts per-ref use.

nodes.name: delayed_reachability_test
nodes.summary: Lazily tests whether shallow commit c is reachable from existing refs and caches the result.

nodes.name: shallow.h
nodes.summary: Public API for shallow clone support: registering shallow commits, the shallow lock, depth computation, shallow file rewriting, and struct shallow_info used by fetch and receive-pack.

nodes.name: sideband.c
nodes.summary: Implements the side-band multiplexing of the pack protocol: demultiplexes band 1 (data), 2 (progress) and 3 (error) from a pkt-line stream, colorizes and sanitizes remote messages (ANSI control character policy), and frames outgoing data into side-band packets.

nodes.name: sideband.h
nodes.summary: Declares the sideband_type enum, the demultiplex and send helpers for the side-band protocol, and the config hooks that control which control characters remote output may contain.

nodes.name: sigchain.h
nodes.summary: Declares sigchain, a tiny per-signal handler stack that lets independent pieces of code install cleanup handlers and chain to the previous handler.

nodes.name: sub-process.c
nodes.summary: Generic long-running subprocess infrastructure: keeps started commands in a hashmap keyed by command line, performs the pkt-line version and capability handshake, reads status lines, and shuts the process down cleanly.

nodes.name: shallow_lock
nodes.summary: Wrapper around a lock_file used while rewriting the shallow file.

nodes.name: shallow_info
nodes.summary: State shared by fetch and receive-pack: the peer's shallow commits split into ours/theirs, refs, per-shallow ref bitmaps and reachability results.

nodes.name: sideband_allow_control_characters_config
nodes.summary: Parses sideband.allowControlCharacters (boolean or a comma list of color, cursor, erase, true, false) into the allowed control-character mask.

nodes.name: sideband_apply_url_config
nodes.summary: Applies sideband.<url>.allowControlCharacters settings by matching the remote URL against the config.

nodes.name: use_sideband_colors
nodes.summary: Resolves and caches whether remote messages are colorized (color.remote, color.ui) and loads per-keyword colors; also sets the default ANSI policy.

nodes.name: handle_ansi_sequence
nodes.summary: Checks whether an escape sequence at the start of src is an allowed color, cursor or erase sequence and copies it through if so.

nodes.name: strbuf_add_sanitized
nodes.summary: Copies text into a strbuf, replacing disallowed control characters with ^X notation while keeping tab, newline and permitted ANSI sequences.

nodes.name: maybe_colorize_sideband
nodes.summary: Highlights a leading hint, warning, success or error keyword in a remote message line when colors are on, then appends the sanitized rest.

nodes.name: demultiplex_sideband
nodes.summary: Handles one pkt-line from a side-band stream: band 1 returns data, band 2 is printed with a 'remote: ' prefix line by line, band 3 reports or dies on a remote error, with protocol errors for EOF or unknown bands.

nodes.name: send_sideband
nodes.summary: Splits data into pkt-lines of at most packet_max bytes, optionally tagged with a band number, and writes header and payload with writev.

nodes.name: cmd2process_cmp
nodes.summary: Hashmap comparison callback that matches subprocess entries by their command string.

nodes.name: subprocess_find_entry
nodes.summary: Finds an already started subprocess for a command in the given hashmap.

nodes.name: subprocess_read_status
nodes.summary: Reads pkt-lines until a flush and keeps the last status=<value> line.

nodes.name: subprocess_stop
nodes.summary: Terminates a subprocess with SIGTERM, waits for it and removes it from the hashmap.

nodes.name: subprocess_exit_handler
nodes.summary: Clean-on-exit handler that closes the child's pipes to request shutdown and waits for it to finish.

nodes.name: subprocess_start
nodes.summary: Starts a long-running command through the shell with piped stdin and stdout, runs the caller's startup function, and registers the process in the hashmap.

nodes.name: handshake_version
nodes.summary: Sends the client welcome and supported versions, reads the server welcome and chosen version, and verifies it is supported.

nodes.name: handshake_capabilities
nodes.summary: Sends the wanted capabilities, then reads the subprocess's reply and sets bits for those it supports, dying on unknown ones.

nodes.name: subprocess_handshake
nodes.summary: Runs the version and then capability handshake with SIGPIPE ignored.

nodes.name: sideband_type
nodes.summary: Result type of demultiplexing one packet: protocol error, remote error, flush or primary data.

nodes.name: trace.h
nodes.summary: Declares the GIT_TRACE API: struct trace_key, trace_printf/trace_performance macros that expand to cheap checks, and the underlying output functions and nanosecond clock.

nodes.name: trace2.c
nodes.summary: Implementation of the Trace2 event API: fans each event (command start/exit, child process, thread, region, data, timers, counters) out to the enabled normal, perf and event targets, with URL credential redaction and atexit/signal summary handling.

nodes.name: trace2.h
nodes.summary: Public Trace2 API: macros that add file and line to every call, plus declarations for command, child, exec, thread, region, data, timer and counter events.

nodes.name: transport-helper.c
nodes.summary: Implements the transport layer for remote helpers (git-remote-<name>): spawns the helper, negotiates capabilities, and drives list, fetch, import, export, push and connect over a line protocol; also holds the bidirectional stdin/stdout copy loop used for connect.

nodes.name: transport-internal.h
nodes.summary: Defines struct transport_vtable, the table of function pointers (set_option, get_refs_list, fetch_refs, push_refs, connect, disconnect...) that each transport implementation fills in.

nodes.name: trace_key
nodes.summary: Identifies one GIT_TRACE* channel: its environment variable name, fd and initialization flags.

nodes.name: tr2_tgt_want_builtins
nodes.summary: Initializes every builtin target (normal, perf, event) and returns how many are enabled.

nodes.name: tr2_tgt_emit_a_timer
nodes.summary: Passes a timer record to each wanted target that implements pfn_timer.

nodes.name: tr2_tgt_emit_a_counter
nodes.summary: Passes a counter record to each wanted target that implements pfn_counter.

nodes.name: tr2main_atexit_handler
nodes.summary: atexit hook that unwinds regions, emits per-thread and final timers and counters, notifies targets of exit and releases all trace2 state.

nodes.name: tr2main_signal_handler
nodes.summary: Signal handler that tells each target about the signal, then chains to the next handler by re-raising.

nodes.name: trace2_initialize_clock
nodes.summary: Starts the process clock used for absolute elapsed times.

nodes.name: trace2_initialize_fl
nodes.summary: Enables trace2 if any target is requested: loads settings, installs atexit and SIGPIPE handlers, sets up thread-local storage and emits the version event.

nodes.name: trace2_is_enabled
nodes.summary: Returns whether trace2 has been enabled.

nodes.name: redact_arg
nodes.summary: Replaces the password part of an http(s)://user:password@host URL argument with <REDACTED>.

nodes.name: redact_argv
nodes.summary: Returns argv unchanged, or a copy with credential-bearing URLs redacted.

nodes.name: free_redacted_argv
nodes.summary: Frees an argv copy made by redact_argv.

nodes.name: trace2_cmd_start_fl
nodes.summary: Emits the command-start event with a redacted argv.

nodes.name: trace2_cmd_exit_fl
nodes.summary: Emits the exit event, collects process info and remembers the exit code for the atexit summary.

nodes.name: trace2_cmd_error_va_fl
nodes.summary: Emits an error event with a formatted message.

nodes.name: trace2_cmd_path_fl
nodes.summary: Emits the executable path of the current command.

nodes.name: trace2_cmd_ancestry_fl
nodes.summary: Emits the names of parent processes.

nodes.name: trace2_cmd_name_fl
nodes.summary: Emits the command name and its hierarchy, then also lists configured config keys and environment variables.

nodes.name: trace2_cmd_mode_fl
nodes.summary: Emits a sub-mode of the current command.

nodes.name: trace2_cmd_alias_fl
nodes.summary: Emits the alias and its expanded argv.

nodes.name: trace2_cmd_list_config_fl
nodes.summary: Emits configured config entries that match the trace2 key patterns.

nodes.name: trace2_cmd_list_env_vars_fl
nodes.summary: Emits environment variables selected by trace2 settings.

nodes.name: trace2_cmd_set_config_fl
nodes.summary: Emits a config key and value being set.

nodes.name: trace2_child_start_fl
nodes.summary: Assigns the child an id and start time and emits a child-start event with a temporarily redacted argv.

nodes.name: trace2_child_exit_fl
nodes.summary: Emits a child-exit event with pid, exit code and elapsed time.

nodes.name: trace2_child_ready_fl
nodes.summary: Emits whether a child became ready or failed to start.

nodes.name: trace2_exec_fl
nodes.summary: Allocates an exec id and emits an exec event with a redacted argv; returns the id.

nodes.name: trace2_exec_result_fl
nodes.summary: Emits the result code of a failed exec.

nodes.name: trace2_thread_start_fl
nodes.summary: Creates thread-local trace2 state for the new thread and emits a thread-start event.

nodes.name: trace2_thread_exit_fl
nodes.summary: Unwinds the thread's regions, emits its timers and counters, folds them into the totals and emits thread-exit.

nodes.name: trace2_def_param_fl
nodes.summary: Emits a definition event for a config parameter with its value and origin.

nodes.name: trace2_def_repo_fl
nodes.summary: Assigns a trace2 id to a repository and emits its definition.

nodes.name: trace2_region_enter_printf_va_fl
nodes.summary: Emits a region-enter event with a formatted message and pushes a new nesting level.

nodes.name: trace2_region_enter_fl
nodes.summary: Region-enter event with a simple category and label.

nodes.name: trace2_region_enter_printf_fl
nodes.summary: Printf-style wrapper for region-enter.

nodes.name: trace2_region_leave_printf_va_fl
nodes.summary: Pops the nesting level and emits a region-leave event carrying the region's elapsed time.

nodes.name: trace2_region_leave_fl
nodes.summary: Region-leave event with a simple category and label.

nodes.name: trace2_region_leave_printf_fl
nodes.summary: Printf-style wrapper for region-leave.

nodes.name: trace2_data_string_fl
nodes.summary: Emits a key/value data event with a string value inside the current region.

nodes.name: trace2_data_intmax_fl
nodes.summary: Formats an intmax_t and emits it as a string data event.

nodes.name: trace2_data_json_fl
nodes.summary: Emits a data event whose value is a JSON writer object.

nodes.name: trace2_printf_va_fl
nodes.summary: Emits a free-text message event.

nodes.name: trace2_printf_fl
nodes.summary: Variadic wrapper around trace2_printf_va_fl.

nodes.name: trace2_timer_start
nodes.summary: Starts the named stopwatch timer for the current thread.

nodes.name: trace2_timer_stop
nodes.summary: Stops the named stopwatch timer and adds the interval to the thread total.

nodes.name: trace2_counter_add
nodes.summary: Adds a value to the named global counter's per-thread sum.

nodes.name: trace2_session_id
nodes.summary: Returns the trace2 session id string that identifies this process tree.

nodes.name: trace2_timer_id
nodes.summary: Compile-time list of stopwatch timers (currently two test timers) plus the timer count.

nodes.name: trace2_counter_id
nodes.summary: Compile-time list of global counters (test counters, packed-refs jumps, reftable reseeks, fsync counts).

nodes.name: trace2_process_info_reason
nodes.summary: Reasons for collecting process information (start or exit).

nodes.name: helper_data
nodes.summary: State of one running remote helper: its process, output stream, capability flags (fetch, import, export, push, connect...), refspecs and transport options.

nodes.name: recvline_fh
nodes.summary: Reads one line from the helper output, dying on EOF and logging in debug mode.

nodes.name: do_take_over
nodes.summary: Hands the helper process over to the builtin smart transport (transport_take_over) after a successful connect.

nodes.name: get_helper
nodes.summary: Starts git-remote-<name> if not yet running, sends 'capabilities' and records each capability (fetch, push, import, export, refspec, connect, marks...), dying on unknown mandatory ones.

nodes.name: disconnect_helper
nodes.summary: Sends the closing newline unless disabled, closes pipes and waits for the helper to exit.

nodes.name: strbuf_set_helper_option
nodes.summary: Sends an 'option' command and maps the helper's ok/unsupported/error reply to 0, 1 or -1.

nodes.name: string_list_set_helper_option
nodes.summary: Sends one option line per item of a string list, such as deepen-not.

nodes.name: set_helper_option
nodes.summary: Transport vtable set_option: formats a name and boolean or C-quoted value and sends it to the helper, skipping options the helper protocol does not carry.

nodes.name: standard_options
nodes.summary: Pushes verbosity, progress, followtags and depth style options to the helper when it is started.

nodes.name: release_helper
nodes.summary: Frees refspecs and transport options held for a helper and disconnects it.

nodes.name: fetch_with_fetch
nodes.summary: Sends 'fetch <oid> <ref>' commands, then reads 'lock' lines (pack lock files) and connectivity-ok until a blank line, and refreshes the object database.

nodes.name: get_importer
nodes.summary: Starts 'git fast-import' reading from the helper's output, optionally with a cat-blob fd for bidi-import helpers.

nodes.name: get_exporter
nodes.summary: Starts 'git fast-export' writing to the helper, with signed-tag handling and marks files.

nodes.name: fetch_with_import
nodes.summary: Fetches through the import capability: sends 'import <ref>' lines, lets fast-import create objects and refs, then reads each resulting ref to get its new value.

nodes.name: run_connect
nodes.summary: Sends a connect or stateless-connect command and interprets the empty-line (ready) or 'fallback' reply.

nodes.name: connect_service_cmd
nodes.summary: Maps a git_connect_service value to the matching git-upload-pack, git-receive-pack or git-upload-archive name.

nodes.name: process_connect_service
nodes.summary: Tries 'connect' or, for protocol v2 fetches, 'stateless-connect' for the service, and sets the servpath option when a custom executable is used.

nodes.name: process_connect
nodes.summary: Attempts a connect for fetch or push and, on success, converts the transport into the smart transport.

nodes.name: connect_helper
nodes.summary: Vtable connect: asks the helper to connect to a subservice and returns its pipes after taking the transport over.

nodes.name: fetch_refs
nodes.summary: Vtable fetch_refs: tries a smart connect first, otherwise sets options (cloning, update-shallow, filter, refetch) and uses the fetch or import capability.

nodes.name: fetch_object_info_helper
nodes.summary: Vtable fetch_object_info: only works when the helper can connect, otherwise dies because object-info needs protocol v2.

nodes.name: push_update_ref_status
nodes.summary: Parses one ok/error/option line from a push, mapping messages such as non-fast forward or fetch first to REF_STATUS_* values and attaching report options.

nodes.name: push_update_refs_status
nodes.summary: Reads push status lines until a blank line and, unless dry-run, updates private refs for successfully pushed refs via the helper refspec.

nodes.name: set_common_push_options
nodes.summary: Passes dry-run, signed, atomic, force-if-includes and push-option settings to the helper, dying if it does not support one.

nodes.name: push_refs_with_push
nodes.summary: Sends 'push <src>:<dst>' commands for refs that can be updated, with force markers and cas options, then reads the helper's status.

nodes.name: push_refs_with_export
nodes.summary: Pushes through the export capability by running fast-export over the selected refs into the helper, then reads the status.

nodes.name: push_refs
nodes.summary: Vtable push_refs: tries a smart connect, then uses the push or export capability.

nodes.name: has_attribute
nodes.summary: Checks whether a space-separated attribute list in a ref-list line contains a given attribute.

nodes.name: get_refs_list
nodes.summary: Vtable get_refs_list: uses the smart connection when available, otherwise the helper's 'list' command.

nodes.name: get_refs_list_using_list
nodes.summary: Sends 'list' (or 'list for-push') and parses lines of '<oid|@symref|?> <name> [attrs]' into a struct ref list, including :object-format and 'unchanged' handling.

nodes.name: get_bundle_uri
nodes.summary: Vtable get_bundle_uri: delegates to the smart transport after a connect, otherwise reports failure.

nodes.name: transport_helper_init
nodes.summary: Attaches helper state and the helper vtable to a transport after checking the protocol is allowed.

nodes.name: transfer_debug
nodes.summary: Prints transfer loop debug messages when GIT_TRANSLOOP_DEBUG is set.

nodes.name: unidirectional_transfer
nodes.summary: State of one copy direction: source and destination fds, state (transferring, flushing, finished) and a 64 KB buffer.

nodes.name: udt_close_if_finished
nodes.summary: Closes the destination (or shuts down the socket for writing) once flushing is complete.

nodes.name: udt_do_read
nodes.summary: Reads available data into the buffer and switches to flushing on EOF.

nodes.name: udt_do_write
nodes.summary: Writes buffered data to the destination and compacts the remaining bytes.

nodes.name: udt_copy_task_routine
nodes.summary: Thread (or process) body that loops read, write and close until its direction finishes.

nodes.name: tloop_spawnwait_tasks
nodes.summary: Runs the two copy directions concurrently (pthreads, or fork when threads are unavailable) and waits for both; returns nonzero on failure.

nodes.name: bidirectional_transfer_loop
nodes.summary: Sets up two unidirectional transfers (stdin to remote, remote to stdout) and runs them until both finish; used by remote helpers that implement connect.

nodes.name: reject_atomic_push
nodes.summary: Marks every pending ref update as failed (REF_STATUS_ATOMIC_PUSH_FAILED) when an atomic push cannot proceed.

nodes.name: transport_vtable
nodes.summary: Function-pointer table every transport fills in: set_option, get_refs_list, get_bundle_uri, fetch_refs, fetch_object_info, push_refs, connect and disconnect.

nodes.name: transport.c
nodes.summary: Core transport layer: chooses a transport for a URL (bundle, smart git/ssh, or remote helper), implements the builtin smart transport over fetch-pack and send-pack, protocol allow-list checks, and the high-level transport_push that matches refs, runs pre-push hooks and reports status.

nodes.name: transport.h
nodes.summary: Public transport API: struct transport and git_transport_options, push flags, TRANS_OPT_* option names, and functions to get a transport, list remote refs, fetch, push and disconnect.

nodes.name: upload-pack.c
nodes.summary: Server side of git fetch and clone: advertises refs (v0/v1), reads wants/haves, negotiates common commits with multi_ack, handles shallow, deepen and filter requests, and streams a packfile produced by pack-objects; also implements the protocol v2 fetch command state machine.

nodes.name: upload-pack.h
nodes.summary: Declares the upload-pack entry points: the v0/v1 loop, the protocol v2 fetch command handler and its capability advertisement.

nodes.name: url.h
nodes.summary: Declares URL helpers: scheme detection, percent decoding, trailing-slash handling, local-versus-ssh classification and RFC 3986 character predicates.

nodes.name: transport_color_config
nodes.summary: Reads color.transport and its reset and rejected colors once.

nodes.name: set_upstreams
nodes.summary: After a successful push, sets branch.<name> upstream config for refs/heads pairs (or prints what would be set for dry-run).

nodes.name: get_refs_from_bundle_inner
nodes.summary: Opens the bundle file, reads its header and records its hash algorithm.

nodes.name: get_refs_from_bundle
nodes.summary: Vtable get_refs_list for bundles: builds a ref list from the bundle header (none for push).

nodes.name: fetch_fsck_config_cb
nodes.summary: Config callback collecting fsck message-type settings for unbundling.

nodes.name: fetch_refs_from_bundle
nodes.summary: Vtable fetch_refs for bundles: unpacks the bundle's pack into the repository, optionally with fsck.

nodes.name: set_git_option
nodes.summary: Maps TRANS_OPT_* names (uploadpack, thin, depth, deepen-since, filter, refetch...) onto git_transport_options fields.

nodes.name: connect_setup
nodes.summary: Opens the connection to upload-pack or receive-pack via git_connect with the right IP family flags.

nodes.name: handshake
nodes.summary: Connects, discovers the protocol version, and lists refs: v2 via ls-refs, v0/v1 via get_remote_heads which also captures extra haves and shallow lines.

nodes.name: get_bundle_uri
nodes.summary: Fetches the server's advertised bundle-uri list after the handshake, silently doing nothing on servers without it.

nodes.name: fetch_object_info_via_pack
nodes.summary: Connects and runs the protocol v2 object-info command for a list of object ids.

nodes.name: transport_fetch_object_info
nodes.summary: Calls the transport's fetch_object_info callback or dies if unsupported.

nodes.name: fetch_refs_via_pack
nodes.summary: Vtable fetch_refs for the smart transport: fills fetch_pack_args from options, performs the handshake if needed, optionally negotiates only, then calls fetch_pack.

nodes.name: push_had_errors
nodes.summary: Returns true if any ref has a status other than none, up to date or ok.

nodes.name: transport_refs_pushed
nodes.summary: Returns true if at least one ref was actually pushed (not none or up to date).

nodes.name: update_one_tracking_ref
nodes.summary: Updates or deletes the remote-tracking ref that corresponds to a pushed ref.

nodes.name: transport_update_tracking_ref
nodes.summary: Updates remote-tracking refs for a pushed ref, honoring detailed per-ref reports from the server.

nodes.name: print_ref_status
nodes.summary: Prints one line of the push summary in human or porcelain form.

nodes.name: print_ok_ref_status
nodes.summary: Prints a successfully pushed ref as new, deleted, forced or fast-forward with abbreviated old and new ids.

nodes.name: print_one_push_report
nodes.summary: Prints one push result line, with the right flag and reason for each ref status including rejections.

nodes.name: print_one_push_status
