nodes.summary: Computes the mode to store in an index entry from lstat data, keeping the old entry's symlink or executable state on filesystems without symlinks or trustworthy executable bits.

nodes.name: ce_to_dtype
nodes.summary: Maps a cache entry's mode to a DT_* directory-entry type (regular file, directory for gitlinks, symlink or unknown).

nodes.name: ce_path_match
nodes.summary: Checks a cache entry's path against a pathspec, treating directories and gitlinks as directories.

nodes.name: rerere.c
nodes.summary: Implements rerere (reuse recorded resolution): normalizes conflict hunks into a conflict id, stores preimage and postimage files under .git/rr-cache, replays recorded resolutions through a three-way merge, tracks conflicted paths in MERGE_RR, and supports forget, remaining, clear and garbage collection.

nodes.name: assign_variant
nodes.summary: Picks the first unused variant number for a conflict id within its rr-cache directory (or keeps the given one) and grows the status array to fit.

nodes.name: rerere_path
nodes.summary: Builds the path inside .git/rr-cache for a conflict id and file name (preimage, postimage, thisimage), appending the variant number when it is above zero.

nodes.name: scan_rerere_dir
nodes.summary: Scans one rr-cache/<conflict-id> directory and records for each variant whether it has a preimage and/or postimage file.

nodes.name: read_rr
nodes.summary: Parses .git/MERGE_RR, whose NUL-terminated records are conflict id, optional variant, tab and path, into a string list mapping each conflicted path to its rerere_id.

nodes.name: write_rr
nodes.summary: Writes the string list of conflicted paths and their conflict ids back to MERGE_RR as NUL-terminated records and commits the lock file.

nodes.name: handle_conflict
nodes.summary: Reads one conflict hunk (recursing into nested hunks), discards the diff3 base section, orders the two sides alphabetically, writes the normalized hunk and feeds both sides into the hash that becomes the conflict id.

nodes.name: handle_path
nodes.summary: Reads a file with conflicts through a rerere_io abstraction, normalizing each hunk with handle_conflict while computing the SHA of all hunks as the conflict id; returns 1 if hunks were found.

nodes.name: handle_file
nodes.summary: Opens a conflicted worktree file, runs handle_path on it with the path's conflict marker size, optionally writes the normalized copy to an output file and returns the number of hunks or an error.

nodes.name: check_one_conflict
nodes.summary: Classifies the index entries for one path as resolved, three-staged (rerere can handle it) or punted (e.g. deletion or mode conflict), returning the next index position to examine.

nodes.name: find_conflict
nodes.summary: Reads the index and collects the names of paths that have all three conflict stages, the only conflicts rerere handles.

nodes.name: rerere_remaining
nodes.summary: Fills the merge_rr list with conflicted paths rerere does not handle and marks resolved ones, for git rerere remaining.

nodes.name: try_merge
nodes.summary: Replays a recorded resolution by doing a three-way low-level merge with the stored preimage as base, the current conflicted content as ours and the postimage as theirs.

nodes.name: merge
nodes.summary: Normalizes the conflicts in a path to a thisimage file, tries the recorded resolution with try_merge, touches the postimage for gc accounting and rewrites the worktree file with the merged result.

nodes.name: update_paths
nodes.summary: Stages every path that was resolved by a recorded resolution (rerere.autoupdate) into the index and writes the locked index.

nodes.name: remove_variant
nodes.summary: Deletes the postimage and preimage files of a conflict variant and clears its status.

nodes.name: do_rerere_one_path
nodes.summary: Handles one conflicted path: records the postimage if the user has resolved it, otherwise tries every recorded variant for a clean replay (optionally staging it), and if none applies records a new preimage variant.

nodes.name: do_plain_rerere
nodes.summary: Main rerere pass: finds conflicted paths in the index, computes their conflict ids, creates rr-cache directories, runs do_rerere_one_path for every tracked path, stages auto-resolved ones and writes MERGE_RR.

nodes.name: is_rerere_enabled
nodes.summary: Determines whether rerere is active from rerere.enabled, falling back to whether .git/rr-cache exists, and creates the directory when explicitly enabled.

nodes.name: setup_rerere
nodes.summary: Reads rerere config, returns -1 when rerere is disabled, otherwise takes the MERGE_RR lock (unless read-only) and loads its records into merge_rr.

nodes.name: repo_rerere
nodes.summary: Main entry called from mergy operations: sets up rerere, runs do_plain_rerere and frees the in-memory rr-cache directory table.

nodes.name: handle_cache
nodes.summary: Recreates a conflicted merge in memory from the three index stages of a path (reading the blobs from the object database), runs ll_merge and normalizes the resulting hunks to obtain the conflict id and optionally the preimage.

nodes.name: rerere_forget_one_path
nodes.summary: Finds the recorded resolution that cleanly applies to a path's reconstructed conflict, deletes its postimage, rewrites the preimage so the user can re-resolve, and queues the conflict in MERGE_RR.

nodes.name: rerere_forget
nodes.summary: Implements git rerere forget: un-merges the matching paths from resolve-undo data, finds the conflicts and calls rerere_forget_one_path for each path that matches the pathspec.

nodes.name: rerere_gc_cutoffs
nodes.summary: Reads gc.rerereResolved and gc.rerereUnresolved expiry settings, defaulting to 60 and 15 days.

nodes.name: rerere_id_is_stale
nodes.summary: Decides whether a recorded conflict variant is older than the resolved or unresolved cutoff based on its last use or creation time.

nodes.name: rerere_gc_needed
nodes.summary: Estimates whether enough stale rr-cache entries exist to justify a gc by sampling directories whose names start with 17 and counting stale variants against a limit.

nodes.name: rerere_gc
nodes.summary: Prunes stale resolved and unresolved conflict variants from rr-cache using the configured cutoffs and removes directories that became empty.

nodes.name: rerere_clear
nodes.summary: Abandons preimages of conflicts that were not resolved or recorded and removes MERGE_RR.

nodes.name: rerere_dir
nodes.summary: One rr-cache/<conflict-id> directory: its name and a status byte array flagging per variant whether preimage and postimage exist.

nodes.name: rerere_io
nodes.summary: Small vtable-like struct (getline, output file, write-error) that lets handle_path read conflicted text from either a file or an in-memory buffer.

nodes.name: reset.c
nodes.summary: Shared helper behind git reset, checkout and similar commands: moves the index and working tree to a target tree using unpack_trees and then updates ORIG_HEAD, HEAD or a branch with reflog messages and the post-checkout hook.

nodes.name: update_refs
nodes.summary: Updates ORIG_HEAD, then HEAD (or the target branch plus a symbolic HEAD) to the new object id with reflog messages, and finally runs the post-checkout hook.

nodes.name: reset_working_tree
nodes.summary: Shared engine for reset and checkout: locks the index, resolves HEAD, merges the index and working tree to the target tree with unpack_trees (oneway for hard reset, twoway otherwise), primes the cache tree, writes the index and updates the refs.

nodes.name: resolve-undo.c
nodes.summary: Maintains the resolve-undo (REUC) index extension: records the three conflict stages of a path when it is resolved, serializes and parses them, and can restore the unmerged entries into the index.

nodes.name: record_resolve_undo
nodes.summary: Remembers the mode and object id of a conflicted stage of a path that is about to be removed from the index, so the conflict can be recreated later by git checkout -m or update-index --unresolve.

nodes.name: resolve_undo_write
nodes.summary: Serializes the resolve-undo list for the REUC index extension as path, three octal modes and the raw object ids of the non-empty stages.

nodes.name: resolve_undo_read
nodes.summary: Parses the REUC extension back into a string list of path to resolve_undo_info, validating lengths and returning NULL with an error on corrupt data.

nodes.name: resolve_undo_clear_index
nodes.summary: Drops all resolve-undo information from an index and marks that extension as changed.

nodes.name: unmerge_index_entry
nodes.summary: Recreates the conflicted stage 1 to 3 entries of a path from saved resolve-undo data, replacing the resolved stage-0 entry in the index.

nodes.name: unmerge_index
nodes.summary: Walks all resolve-undo records, un-merges those matching the pathspec into conflicted stages, and frees the consumed records after expanding a sparse index.

nodes.name: resolve-undo.h
nodes.summary: Declares struct resolve_undo_info (mode and object id for each of the three stages) and the API to record, write, read, clear and undo resolved conflicts in the index.

nodes.name: resolve_undo_info
nodes.summary: Saved state of a resolved conflict: the mode and object id of each of the three merge stages.

nodes.name: sparse-index.c
nodes.summary: Implements the sparse index: collapsing entries outside the sparse-checkout cone into sparse-directory entries using the cache tree, expanding them back on demand by reading trees, deciding whether sparsity is allowed, and clearing skip-worktree bits for files that exist on disk.

nodes.name: construct_sparse_dir_entry
nodes.summary: Builds a sparse-directory index entry (mode S_IFDIR, flagged skip-worktree) whose object id is the tree id from the cache tree.

nodes.name: convert_to_sparse_rec
nodes.summary: Recursively collapses runs of entries that are outside the sparse cone, merged, non-gitlink and skip-worktree into one sparse-directory entry per cache-tree subtree, rewriting the entry array in place.

nodes.name: set_sparse_index_config
nodes.summary: Writes index.sparse to the worktree config and updates the in-memory repository setting.

nodes.name: is_sparse_index_allowed
nodes.summary: Decides whether the index may be sparse: requires sparse-checkout cone mode, no split index, index.sparse enabled (unless memory-only) and cone-mode patterns.

nodes.name: convert_to_sparse
nodes.summary: Converts a full index into a sparse index when allowed and there are no unmerged entries: ensures a valid cache tree, collapses entries with convert_to_sparse_rec, recomputes the cache tree and clears fsmonitor state.

nodes.name: add_path_to_index
nodes.summary: read_tree callback used while expanding a sparse directory: recurses into directories that match the pattern list and otherwise adds entries (or still-sparse directory entries) flagged skip-worktree.

nodes.name: expand_index
nodes.summary: Expands sparse-directory entries into their file entries by reading each tree, fully or only as far as a cone pattern list requires, building a new entry array and recomputing the cache tree.

nodes.name: ensure_full_index
nodes.summary: Expands a sparse index completely, by calling expand_index with no pattern list.

nodes.name: ensure_correct_sparsity
nodes.summary: Makes the index sparse if repository settings allow, otherwise makes sure it is a full index.

nodes.name: path_found
nodes.summary: Checks whether a path exists in the working tree, caching the topmost missing directory so later paths below it are answered without another lstat.

nodes.name: clear_skip_worktree_from_present_files_sparse
nodes.summary: First pass over a possibly sparse index clearing the skip-worktree bit for files present on disk; asks for a restart on a full index if a sparse directory exists on disk.

nodes.name: clear_skip_worktree_from_present_files_full
nodes.summary: Pass over a fully expanded index clearing skip-worktree for every entry whose path exists in the working tree.

nodes.name: clear_skip_worktree_from_present_files
nodes.summary: Public entry that clears skip-worktree for files present on disk, expanding the index only when a sparse directory exists on disk.

nodes.name: expand_to_path
nodes.summary: If a path is not in the index but one of its parent directories is a sparse-directory entry, expands the index so the path can be looked up.

nodes.name: modify_index_context
nodes.summary: Context handed to add_path_to_index: the index being built and the cone pattern list.

nodes.name: sparse-index.h
nodes.summary: Public interface of the sparse index: converting to sparse, expanding fully or to a path or pattern list, correcting sparsity and clearing skip-worktree bits.

nodes.name: split-index.h
nodes.summary: Declares struct split_index and the functions that let the index be stored as a small file of changes over a shared base index (reading and writing the link extension, merging, saving and replacing entries).

nodes.name: split_index
nodes.summary: State of a split index: the shared base index and its oid, delete and replace bitmaps, saved entries and counters, so the main index file only stores changes relative to a shared index file.

nodes.name: stash.h
nodes.summary: Defines enum stash_apply_result, the clean, conflict and error outcomes of applying a stash entry.

nodes.name: stash_apply_result
nodes.summary: Enum of git stash apply outcomes: applied cleanly, conflicted (entry kept) or error.

nodes.name: submodule-config.c
nodes.summary: Reads and caches submodule configuration from .gitmodules in the working tree or in any revision, with hashmaps by name and path, validation of submodule names and URLs, tree traversal that lists the submodules of a treeish, and the parsing of recurse, update and job settings.

nodes.name: submodule_cache_init
nodes.summary: Initializes the two hashmaps of the submodule cache, one keyed by path and one by name.

nodes.name: submodule_cache_clear
nodes.summary: Frees every cached submodule configuration and clears both hashmaps.

nodes.name: submodule_cache_free
nodes.summary: Clears and frees a submodule cache object.

nodes.name: cache_add
nodes.summary: Inserts a submodule configuration into the by-name hashmap keyed on .gitmodules blob id and name.

nodes.name: cache_lookup_path
nodes.summary: Looks up a submodule configuration by path within a given .gitmodules blob.

nodes.name: cache_lookup_name
nodes.summary: Looks up a submodule configuration by name within a given .gitmodules blob.

nodes.name: check_submodule_name
nodes.summary: Rejects empty submodule names and names containing a .. path component, in a platform-independent way.

nodes.name: check_submodule_url
nodes.summary: Validates a submodule URL: rejects command-line-option lookalikes, newlines after URL decoding (header injection), relative URLs that escape their root with ../ (CVE-2020-11008) and malformed absolute URLs.

nodes.name: name_and_item_from_var
nodes.summary: Splits a config key submodule.<name>.<item> into the submodule name and item name.

nodes.name: parse_fetch_recurse
nodes.summary: Parses a fetch.recurseSubmodules style value (bool, on-demand) into a recurse mode, optionally dying on a bad value.

nodes.name: parse_submodule_fetchjobs
nodes.summary: Parses submodule.fetchJobs and dies on a negative value.

nodes.name: option_fetch_parse_recurse_submodules
nodes.summary: Option callback for --recurse-submodules in fetch that stores the parsed recurse mode.

nodes.name: parse_push_recurse
nodes.summary: Parses push.recurseSubmodules style values (check, on-demand, only, no, true/false) into a recurse mode.

nodes.name: parse_config
nodes.summary: Config callback that parses submodule.<name>.* keys (path, fetchRecurseSubmodules, ignore, url, update, shallow, branch) into the cached struct submodule, warning on duplicates and rejecting unsafe values.

nodes.name: gitmodule_oid_from_commit
nodes.summary: Resolves treeish:.gitmodules to the object id of that revision's .gitmodules blob (the null oid means the working-tree file).

nodes.name: config_from
nodes.summary: Looks up a submodule by name or path for a given treeish, reading and parsing that revision's .gitmodules blob into the cache on a miss.

nodes.name: submodule_cache_check_init
nodes.summary: Allocates and initializes the repository's submodule cache on first use.

nodes.name: config_from_gitmodules
nodes.summary: Runs a config callback over the working-tree .gitmodules, or over the blob in the index or HEAD when the file is absent.

nodes.name: repo_read_gitmodules
nodes.summary: Reads the index and, if .gitmodules is not unmerged, loads the working-tree .gitmodules into the submodule cache once.

nodes.name: gitmodules_config_oid
nodes.summary: Loads the .gitmodules blob of a given commit into the submodule cache.

nodes.name: submodule_from_name
nodes.summary: Public lookup of a submodule's configuration by its name in a given commit or tree.

nodes.name: submodule_from_path
nodes.summary: Public lookup of the submodule bound to a path in a given commit or tree.

nodes.name: traverse_tree_submodules
nodes.summary: Recursively walks a tree collecting every active submodule gitlink entry, with its config and an initialized repository handle, without descending into nested submodules.

nodes.name: submodules_of_tree
nodes.summary: Returns every submodule in a treeish and its subtrees by traversing the tree.

nodes.name: submodule_entry_list_release
nodes.summary: Frees the entries of a submodule_entry_list, including their repository structs.

nodes.name: submodule_free
nodes.summary: Clears the repository's submodule cache.

nodes.name: print_config_from_gitmodules
nodes.summary: Prints the value of a key from .gitmodules, used by git submodule--helper config.

nodes.name: config_set_in_gitmodules_file_gently
nodes.summary: Sets a key in the .gitmodules file and only warns when that fails.

nodes.name: fetch_config_from_gitmodules
nodes.summary: Reads submodule.fetchJobs and fetch.recurseSubmodules from .gitmodules for backward compatibility with git fetch.

nodes.name: update_clone_config_from_gitmodules
nodes.summary: Reads submodule.fetchJobs from .gitmodules to size the parallel job count of submodule update.

nodes.name: submodule_cache
nodes.summary: Per-repository cache of parsed submodule configurations, indexed by path and by name.

nodes.name: submodule-config.h
nodes.summary: Public API and structs (struct submodule, submodule_tree_entry, submodule_entry_list) for looking up submodule configuration by path or name in a revision, plus parsers for recurse options and validators for names and URLs.

nodes.name: submodule
nodes.summary: Holds the parsed configuration of one submodule (path, name, url, fetch recurse mode, ignore, branch, update strategy, owning .gitmodules blob id, shallow hint) returned by the lookup functions.

nodes.name: submodule_tree_entry
nodes.summary: One submodule found in a tree: its tree entry, an optional repository handle (NULL if not populated) and its parsed configuration.

nodes.name: submodule_entry_list
nodes.summary: Growable array of submodule_tree_entry values filled by submodules_of_tree.

nodes.name: submodule.c
nodes.summary: Implements submodule handling in the superproject: editing and validating .gitmodules, deciding which submodules are active, printing submodule diff summaries, parallel recursive fetch, pushing unpushed submodule commits, checkout-time head moves, and absorbing or validating submodule git directories.

nodes.name: is_gitmodules_unmerged
nodes.summary: Checks the index for unmerged (staged) .gitmodules entries so that parsing of the file can be disabled until the conflict is resolved.

nodes.name: is_writing_gitmodules_ok
nodes.summary: Tells whether it is safe to write .gitmodules: it exists in the work tree, or it is in neither the index nor HEAD so a brand new file will be created.

nodes.name: is_staging_gitmodules_ok
nodes.summary: Returns false if the .gitmodules index entry differs from the work tree file, so staging later would not sweep in unrelated user edits.

nodes.name: update_path_in_gitmodules
nodes.summary: Rewrites the submodule.<name>.path setting in .gitmodules when a submodule is moved; dies on an unmerged .gitmodules and warns when no section matches the old path.

nodes.name: remove_path_from_gitmodules
nodes.summary: Deletes the whole submodule.<name> section from .gitmodules for a path being removed, warning rather than failing if the section is already gone.

nodes.name: stage_updated_gitmodules
nodes.summary: Adds the edited .gitmodules file to the index and dies if staging fails.

nodes.name: set_diffopt_flags_from_submodule_config
nodes.summary: Sets the diff ignore-submodules flags from submodule.<name>.ignore config or the .gitmodules value, and ignores submodules entirely when .gitmodules is unmerged.

nodes.name: git_default_submodule_config
nodes.summary: Config callback that only reads submodule.recurse into the module-level recurse mode used to decide whether submodule work trees are updated.

nodes.name: option_parse_recurse_submodules_worktree_updater
nodes.summary: parse-options callback for --recurse-submodules that sets the global flag controlling whether checkouts also update submodule work trees.

nodes.name: is_tree_submodule_active
nodes.summary: Decides whether the submodule at a path in a given tree is active by checking submodule.<name>.active, then the submodule.active pathspecs, and finally whether a URL is configured.

nodes.name: is_submodule_active
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper that checks submodule activity against the current index (null tree).

nodes.name: is_submodule_populated_gently
nodes.summary: Reports whether <path>/.git resolves to a valid git repository, optionally returning the resolve error code instead of dying.

nodes.name: die_in_unpopulated_submodule
nodes.summary: Scans gitlink entries in the index and dies if the given prefix lies inside a submodule path that is not populated.

nodes.name: die_path_inside_submodule
nodes.summary: Dies if any pathspec item descends into a gitlink entry of the index, preventing superproject commands from reaching inside a submodule.

nodes.name: parse_submodule_update_type
nodes.summary: Maps a submodule.<name>.update value (none, checkout, rebase, merge, or !command) to the submodule_update_type enum.

nodes.name: parse_submodule_update_strategy
nodes.summary: Parses an update value into a submodule_update_strategy, storing the custom command text when it starts with a bang.

nodes.name: submodule_update_strategy_release
nodes.summary: Frees the command string held by a submodule_update_strategy.

nodes.name: submodule_update_type_to_string
nodes.summary: Converts a submodule_update_type back to its config string and treats unspecified or command types as bugs.

nodes.name: handle_ignore_submodules_arg
nodes.summary: Translates an --ignore-submodules argument (all, untracked, dirty, none) into diff option flags, dying on unknown values.

nodes.name: prepare_submodule_diff_summary
nodes.summary: Sets up a revision walk between the old and new submodule commits, marking merge bases as uninteresting, so the log of the submodule change can be listed.

nodes.name: print_submodule_diff_summary
nodes.summary: Walks the prepared revisions and emits one line per commit, marked as added or deleted depending on the left/right side of the symmetric diff.

nodes.name: prepare_submodule_repo_env
nodes.summary: Clears repository-specific environment variables for a child process that will run inside a submodule, keeping config passed through the environment.

nodes.name: open_submodule
nodes.summary: Initializes a repository struct for a submodule from its path via its gitdir, or returns NULL if it is not present.

nodes.name: show_submodule_header
nodes.summary: Emits the 'Submodule path old..new' header of a diff, noting new, deleted, missing or corrupt cases, and looks up the left and right commits and merge bases to detect fast-forward and rewind.

nodes.name: show_submodule_diff_summary
nodes.summary: Shows a submodule change in a diff as a header plus a short log of the commits between the old and new submodule heads.

nodes.name: show_submodule_inline_diff
nodes.summary: Shows a submodule change as a full inline diff by spawning a child 'git diff --submodule=diff' inside the submodule and streaming its output through the diff emitter.

nodes.name: should_update_submodules
nodes.summary: Returns whether recursion into submodules is currently set to on for work tree updates.

nodes.name: submodule_from_ce
nodes.summary: Returns the submodule struct for an index entry if it is a gitlink and submodule updating is enabled, otherwise NULL.

nodes.name: collect_changed_submodules_cb
nodes.summary: Diff callback that records, for each gitlink changed in a commit, the submodule name, first superproject commit and new submodule commits, skipping names that collide with configured ones.

nodes.name: collect_changed_submodules
nodes.summary: Walks the given revision range and diffs each commit against its parents to build a list of submodules with new commits.

nodes.name: check_has_commit
nodes.summary: Per-oid callback that opens the submodule repository and checks that the object exists in its object database and is a commit, dying if it is another type.

nodes.name: submodule_has_commits
nodes.summary: Checks that all given commits exist in the submodule and are reachable from a ref, by running 'git rev-list --not --all' inside it.

nodes.name: submodule_needs_pushing
nodes.summary: Decides whether a submodule has commits that are not yet on any remote-tracking ref by running 'git rev-list --not --remotes' in the submodule.

nodes.name: find_unpushed_submodules
nodes.summary: Finds submodules changed in the given superproject commits whose new commits still need pushing, returning their paths in a string list.

nodes.name: push_submodule
nodes.summary: Pushes one submodule by running a child 'git push --recurse-submodules=only-is-on-demand', forwarding remote, refspecs, push options and dry-run.

nodes.name: submodule_push_check
nodes.summary: Runs 'submodule--helper push-check' in a submodule to verify the remote and refspec can be propagated, dying if it fails.

nodes.name: push_unpushed_submodules
nodes.summary: Pushes every submodule that has unpushed commits before the superproject is pushed, after verifying the remote and refspec in each one.

nodes.name: check_for_new_submodule_commits
nodes.summary: Records ref tips before and after a fetch so new superproject commits can later be scanned for submodule changes.

nodes.name: repo_has_absorbed_submodules
nodes.summary: Returns true when .git/modules exists and is not empty, meaning submodule git directories were absorbed.

nodes.name: calculate_changed_submodule_paths
nodes.summary: After a fetch, walks the newly fetched commits to find submodules whose new commits are not yet present locally, to drive on-demand submodule fetches.

nodes.name: submodule_touches_in_range
nodes.summary: Reports how many submodules changed in the range a..b (or all ancestors of b when a is null).

nodes.name: get_fetch_recurse_config
nodes.summary: Resolves the effective fetch recurse mode for a submodule from the command line, submodule.<name>.fetchRecurseSubmodules, .gitmodules and the default.

nodes.name: get_non_gitmodules_submodule
nodes.summary: Builds a fake submodule struct for a gitlink that has a repository in place but no .gitmodules entry.

nodes.name: fetch_task_free
nodes.summary: Releases a fetch task including its repository, owned submodule struct and argument vector.

nodes.name: get_submodule_repo_for
nodes.summary: Allocates and initializes a repository struct for the submodule at a path in a given tree-ish, or returns NULL on failure.

nodes.name: fetch_task_create
nodes.summary: Creates a fetch task for a gitlink path, skipping duplicates and submodules whose recurse mode or change status excludes them, and picks the 'yes' or 'on-demand' argument.

nodes.name: get_fetch_task_from_index
nodes.summary: Iterates gitlink entries of the index and returns the next submodule fetch task, reporting submodules that cannot be accessed.

nodes.name: get_fetch_task_from_changed
nodes.summary: Iterates submodules found changed in newly fetched commits and returns a fetch task for the next active one, working around stale core.worktree values.

nodes.name: get_next_submodule
nodes.summary: Task-supplier callback for run_processes_parallel that builds the next 'git fetch' child process for a submodule, or a follow-up fetch by commit id from the default remote.

nodes.name: fetch_start_failure
nodes.summary: Callback invoked when a submodule fetch process fails to start; marks the overall result as failed and frees the task.

nodes.name: fetch_finish
nodes.summary: Callback invoked when a submodule fetch finishes; records errors and, if some wanted commits are still missing, queues a second fetch by object id.

nodes.name: fetch_submodules
nodes.summary: Entry point for recursive submodule fetch: computes changed submodules after the fetch and runs the per-submodule fetches in parallel, reporting errors at the end.

nodes.name: is_submodule_modified
nodes.summary: Runs 'git status --porcelain=2' inside a submodule and derives the dirty flags (untracked, modified), stopping early once enough is known.

nodes.name: submodule_uses_gitfile
nodes.summary: Checks that a submodule and all nested submodules use a .git file (not a directory) by running 'git submodule foreach'.

nodes.name: bad_to_remove_submodule
nodes.summary: Decides whether removing a submodule would lose work by running 'git status --porcelain' inside it, honoring the ignore-untracked and die-on-error flags.

nodes.name: submodule_unset_core_worktree
nodes.summary: Removes the core.worktree setting from a submodule's own config file, warning if that fails.

nodes.name: submodule_has_dirty_index
nodes.summary: Runs 'git diff-index --quiet --cached HEAD' in a submodule to see whether its index has staged changes.

nodes.name: submodule_reset_index
nodes.summary: Resets a submodule's index and work tree to the empty tree with 'git read-tree -u --reset', used when a submodule is being removed by a checkout.

nodes.name: submodule_move_head
nodes.summary: Moves a submodule's HEAD, index and work tree from an old to a new commit by running 'git read-tree --recurse-submodules', handling dry-run, force, absorbing the git dir and unpopulating.

nodes.name: check_casefolding_conflict
nodes.summary: Scans .git/modules for a directory that differs from the new submodule name only in case, to prevent clashes on case-insensitive file systems.

nodes.name: find_conflict_by_gitdir_cb
nodes.summary: Config callback that sets a conflict flag when another submodule's configured gitdir resolves to the same absolute path.

nodes.name: submodule_conflicts_with_existing
nodes.summary: Reads repo config and reports whether the proposed gitdir collides with a gitdir already used by another submodule.

nodes.name: validate_submodule_encoded_git_dir
nodes.summary: Validates a git dir when extensions.submodulePathConfig is on: no slash in the encoded name, no collision with existing gitdirs, and no case-folding clash.

nodes.name: validate_submodule_legacy_git_dir
nodes.summary: Validates a legacy .git/modules/<name> git dir by rejecting any case where a parent directory of the path is already a git directory (nested sibling submodules).

nodes.name: validate_submodule_git_dir
nodes.summary: Dispatches git dir validation to the legacy or the encoded variant depending on the submodulePathConfig extension.

nodes.name: validate_submodule_path
nodes.summary: Rejects a submodule path in which any component is a symbolic link, using lstat on each prefix.

nodes.name: relocate_single_git_dir_into_superproject
nodes.summary: Moves a submodule's own .git directory into the superproject's .git/modules and leaves a gitfile behind, refusing when multiple work trees exist.

nodes.name: absorb_git_dir_into_superproject_recurse
nodes.summary: Runs 'submodule--helper absorbgitdirs' in a submodule so nested submodules are absorbed as well.

nodes.name: absorb_git_dir_into_superproject
nodes.summary: Absorbs a submodule's git directory into the superproject (or repairs the gitfile link if already moved) and then recurses into nested submodules.

nodes.name: get_superproject_working_tree
nodes.summary: Determines whether the current repository is a submodule of a superproject by running 'git ls-files --stage' on the parent directory and looking for mode 160000, returning the superproject root.

nodes.name: submodule_to_gitdir
nodes.summary: Resolves a submodule path in the index to the location of its git directory, following a gitfile or falling back to the modules directory.

nodes.name: submodule_name_to_gitdir
nodes.summary: Builds the git directory path for a submodule name, either .git/modules/<name> or from submodule.<name>.gitdir config, and validates it.

nodes.name: changed_submodule_data
nodes.summary: Per-submodule record of the first superproject commit that points at it, its path there, and the list of new submodule commits found in the walk.

nodes.name: submodule_parallel_fetch
nodes.summary: State of a recursive submodule fetch: iteration counters, fetch arguments, changed and already-seen submodule names, pending by-oid fetch tasks and error accumulator.

nodes.name: fetch_task
nodes.summary: One pending submodule fetch: its repository, submodule config, default fetch mode, extra git arguments and optional commits to fetch by id.

nodes.name: submodule.h
nodes.summary: Public interface of submodule support: the recurse and update-type enums, the update strategy struct, and declarations for .gitmodules maintenance, activity checks, diff summaries, fetch/push recursion, submodule git directory handling and head moves.

nodes.name: submodule_recurse_mode
nodes.summary: Enum of --recurse-submodules modes (only, check, error, none, on-demand, off, default, on) shared by fetch, push and checkout code.

nodes.name: submodule_update_type
nodes.summary: Enum of the strategies for 'git submodule update' (checkout, rebase, merge, none, custom command).

nodes.name: submodule_update_strategy
nodes.summary: Struct pairing a submodule_update_type with the command string used when the type is a custom command.

nodes.name: symlinks.h
nodes.summary: Declares the lstat cache used to answer 'is there a symlink in the leading path' questions, plus helpers for scheduling directory removal; the cache_def struct holds the cached path state.

nodes.name: cache_def
nodes.summary: Struct holding a cached path and flags of the last lstat results so leading-path symlink checks avoid repeated lstat calls.

nodes.name: thread-utils.h
nodes.summary: Thread portability header: includes pthreads when available or defines no-op macros and dummy functions when built with NO_PTHREADS, and declares online_cpus and init_recursive_mutex.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses #define macros instead of typedefs for pthread types so that system headers pulling in pthreads cannot conflict when NO_PTHREADS is set.

nodes.name: unpack-trees.c
nodes.summary: Implements unpack_trees(), the engine behind read-tree, checkout, merge and reset: it walks up to eight trees in parallel with the index, applies a merge function (oneway, twoway, threeway, bind) per path, checks that the work tree can be safely changed, handles sparse checkout and sparse index, and then updates the work tree.
nodes.languageNotes: Merge strategies are plain C function pointers (merge_fn_t) stored in unpack_trees_options and called through call_unpack_fn, a C idiom for strategy dispatch.

nodes.name: super_prefixed
nodes.summary: Returns a path prefixed with the super-prefix (when running inside a submodule) using two rotating static buffers so it can be fed to error() templates.

nodes.name: setup_unpack_trees_porcelain
nodes.summary: Installs the user-facing error and warning message templates for checkout, merge or another command, including optional advice, and enables collecting all errors.

nodes.name: clear_unpack_trees_porcelain
nodes.summary: Frees the message templates set up for porcelain use and discards the result index.

nodes.name: do_add_entry
nodes.summary: Applies set/clear flag bits to a cache entry and adds it to the result index, replacing an existing entry if needed.

nodes.name: add_rejected_path
nodes.summary: Records a path that blocked the operation, either printing an error immediately or queueing it for a grouped message later.

nodes.name: display_error_msgs
nodes.summary: Prints the collected rejected paths grouped by error type and prints 'Aborting' if anything was shown.

nodes.name: display_warning_msgs
nodes.summary: Prints grouped sparse-checkout warnings and suggests running 'git sparse-checkout reapply'.

nodes.name: check_submodule_move_head
nodes.summary: Does a dry-run submodule_move_head for a gitlink entry and records an error if the submodule could not be updated.

nodes.name: load_gitmodules_file
nodes.summary: Re-reads .gitmodules from the index or checks it out first so submodule config is correct while the work tree is being updated.

nodes.name: get_progress
nodes.summary: Counts entries that will be updated or removed and starts a delayed 'Updating files' progress meter.

nodes.name: report_collided_checkout
nodes.summary: Lists paths that collided on a case-insensitive file system, where only one of the colliding files ended up in the work tree.

nodes.name: check_updates
nodes.summary: Applies the merged result to the work tree: removes files, checks out updated entries (optionally in parallel and with delayed checkout), shows progress, and handles gitmodules and promisor prefetch.

nodes.name: apply_sparse_checkout
nodes.summary: Reconciles an entry's skip-worktree bit with the new sparse patterns, marking it to be removed from or added to the work tree and checking the safety of doing so.

nodes.name: warn_conflicted_path
nodes.summary: Warns that an unmerged path will not be removed by a sparse update and returns how many stage entries share that path.

nodes.name: mark_ce_used
nodes.summary: Marks a source index entry as consumed by the traversal and advances cache_bottom past consumed entries.

nodes.name: locate_in_src_index
nodes.summary: Returns the position at which a cache entry's name is, or would be, in the source index.

nodes.name: mark_ce_used_same_name
nodes.summary: Marks all stage entries in the source index that share a name with the given entry as used.

nodes.name: next_cache_entry
nodes.summary: Returns the next unconsumed entry of the source index starting at cache_bottom.

nodes.name: add_same_unmerged
nodes.summary: Copies all stage entries of an unmerged path into the result unchanged and marks them used.

nodes.name: unpack_index_entry
nodes.summary: Runs the merge function on an index entry that has no matching tree entry, handling unmerged stages.

nodes.name: switch_cache_bottom
nodes.summary: Repositions cache_bottom to the first index entry under the directory about to be traversed and returns the old position.

nodes.name: all_trees_same_as_cache_tree
nodes.summary: Checks that all trees have the same directory oid and that the cache-tree has a valid matching node, allowing a whole subtree to be handled at once.

nodes.name: index_pos_by_traverse_info
nodes.summary: Finds the index position of the first entry under a directory being traversed and sanity-checks it.

nodes.name: traverse_by_cache_tree
nodes.summary: Optimized path that processes all entries under an unchanged directory directly from the index using the cache-tree, building transient entries for the merge function.

nodes.name: traverse_trees_recursive
nodes.summary: Descends into a subdirectory present in the trees: first tries the cache-tree shortcut, otherwise loads each peer tree from the object database and recurses with traverse_trees.

nodes.name: do_compare_entry_piecewise
nodes.summary: Compares an index entry name with a path component by recursing through the traverse_info chain when no precomputed path exists.

nodes.name: do_compare_entry
nodes.summary: Compares an index entry's name against the current tree entry using the precomputed traverse path when available.

nodes.name: compare_entry
nodes.summary: Orders an index entry against a tree entry, treating a sparse directory as an exact match and sorting a leading directory before its contents.

nodes.name: ce_in_traverse_path
nodes.summary: Tells whether an index entry lies inside the directory currently being traversed.

nodes.name: create_ce_entry
nodes.summary: Builds a cache entry (transient or from the index pool) from a tree entry, computing its full path and marking sparse directory entries.

nodes.name: entry_is_new_sparse_dir
nodes.summary: Decides whether a tree directory outside the sparse cone and absent from the index should become a new sparse directory entry.

nodes.name: unpack_single_entry
nodes.summary: Builds the per-tree cache entries for one path (assigning merge stages) and either calls the merge function or adds the entries to the result index directly.

nodes.name: unpack_failed
nodes.summary: Discards the partially built result index and returns an error unless quiet or exiting early.

nodes.name: find_cache_pos
nodes.summary: Searches the source index from cache_bottom for the entry matching a tree path component, returning its position or a negative value for a directory prefix.

nodes.name: sparse_dir_matches_path
nodes.summary: Checks whether a sparse directory index entry corresponds exactly to the given tree entry path.

nodes.name: find_cache_entry
nodes.summary: Finds the index entry for a tree path, also looking back for a sparse directory entry named 'path/'.

nodes.name: debug_unpack_callback
nodes.summary: Debug helper that prints the masks and tree entries seen by the unpack callback.

nodes.name: unpack_sparse_callback
nodes.summary: Traversal callback used when merging inside a sparse directory, treating the first tree as the index side and reusing unpack_single_entry.

nodes.name: unpack_callback
nodes.summary: Main traverse_trees callback: matches each tree path to an index entry, merges it with unpack_single_entry, and recurses into directories or skips them using the cache-tree.

nodes.name: clear_ce_flags_dir
nodes.summary: Clears flags for all entries in a directory at once when a cone-mode sparse pattern matches recursively, otherwise falls back to per-entry matching.

nodes.name: clear_ce_flags_1
nodes.summary: Recursive worker that walks index entries directory by directory, matching them against sparse patterns and clearing the given flag bits when they match.

nodes.name: clear_ce_flags
nodes.summary: Clears a flag mask on index entries matching a pattern list, with progress display and trace2 region timing.

nodes.name: mark_new_skip_worktree
nodes.summary: Computes the new skip-worktree state in two steps: assume the narrowest checkout, then widen it with the sparse patterns.

nodes.name: update_sparsity_for_prefix
nodes.summary: Ensures the index is expanded when a prefix points at or inside a sparse directory.

nodes.name: unpack_trees
nodes.summary: Main entry point: merges up to eight trees with the source index using a merge function, applies sparse-checkout rules, updates the work tree via check_updates, and replaces the destination index.

nodes.name: update_sparsity
nodes.summary: Updates the work tree and index to reflect new sparse-checkout patterns without changing commits, adding or removing files and collecting warnings.

nodes.name: same
nodes.summary: Compares two cache entries for equality by presence, mode and object id, treating conflicted entries as different.

nodes.name: verify_uptodate_1
nodes.summary: Verifies that the work tree file for an index entry still matches the index (via lstat), or that a submodule can be updated, before it may be overwritten.

nodes.name: verify_uptodate
nodes.summary: Public check that a tracked file has no local modifications, skipping entries that sparse checkout will drop.

nodes.name: verify_clean_submodule
nodes.summary: Checks that a submodule can move from the old to the new commit by a dry-run move_head.

nodes.name: verify_clean_subdirectory
nodes.summary: Ensures a directory that is about to be replaced by a file has no local changes or untracked, non-ignored files and does not hold the original cwd.

nodes.name: check_ok_to_remove
nodes.summary: Decides whether an existing work tree path may be overwritten: ignored files, case-only differences and clean directories are fine, others are rejected.

nodes.name: verify_absent_1
nodes.summary: Checks that a path about to be created does not exist in the work tree, or that the existing thing may be removed, including leading-path and submodule cases.

nodes.name: merged_entry
nodes.summary: Adds the merge result entry for a path to the result index with the right update flags, after checking that the old index entry and work tree allow it.

nodes.name: merged_sparse_dir
nodes.summary: Merges the contents of a sparse directory by traversing the corresponding subtrees of all input trees file by file.

nodes.name: deleted_entry
nodes.summary: Handles a path deleted by the merge: checks that it is safe to remove and records a removal in the result index.

nodes.name: show_stage_entry
nodes.summary: Debug-only helper printing a stage entry with its mode, object id and stage number.

nodes.name: threeway_merge
nodes.summary: Merge function for 'git read-tree -m' with ancestor, head and remote: resolves trivial cases per the documented table and otherwise keeps the stage 1, 2 and 3 entries as unmerged.

nodes.name: twoway_merge
nodes.summary: Merge function for switching from one tree to another while keeping local index changes (checkout and read-tree -m with two trees).

nodes.name: bind_merge
nodes.summary: Merge function that overlays one tree onto the index at a prefix and fails if entries overlap.

nodes.name: oneway_merge
nodes.summary: Merge function that makes the index match a single tree, used by reset and read-tree without -m.

nodes.name: stash_worktree_untracked_merge
nodes.summary: Merge function used by stash to combine the work tree commit tree with the untracked files tree, rejecting duplicate paths.

nodes.name: unpack-trees.h
nodes.summary: Public interface of the tree-unpacking engine: the error and warning type enums, unpack_trees_options (flags, merge function, source and destination index, internal state), unpack_trees, update_sparsity, verify_uptodate and the standard merge functions.

nodes.name: unpack_trees_error_types
nodes.summary: Enum of error kinds (would overwrite, not up to date, untracked loss, bind overlap, submodule) followed by sparse-checkout warning kinds, used to index message templates and reject lists.

nodes.name: unpack_trees_reset_type
nodes.summary: Enum describing how a reset treats untracked files: none, invalid legacy value, protect or overwrite untracked.

nodes.name: unpack_trees_options
nodes.summary: Options struct for unpack_trees: mode flags (merge, update, reset, sparse, quiet), merge callback, head index, source and destination index, checkout metadata and an internal state block.

nodes.name: update_sparsity_result
nodes.summary: Enum of results of update_sparsity: success, warnings, index update failures and work tree update failures.

nodes.name: varint.h
nodes.summary: Declares the variable-length integer encoding functions used by index and pack structures.

nodes.name: wt-status.c
nodes.summary: Implements the machinery behind 'git status' and the commit message template: collects staged, unstaged, unmerged, untracked and ignored paths into struct wt_status, detects in-progress operations (merge, rebase, am, cherry-pick, revert, bisect, sparse checkout) and prints the long, short, porcelain v1 and porcelain v2 formats.

nodes.name: status_vprintf
nodes.summary: Formats a message, prefixes each line with the comment character when requested, and prints it in the given color with an optional trailer.

nodes.name: status_printf_ln
nodes.summary: printf-style helper that prints a colored status line ending with a newline.

nodes.name: status_printf
nodes.summary: printf-style helper that prints colored status text at the beginning of a line without a trailing newline.

nodes.name: wt_status_prepare
nodes.summary: Initializes a wt_status with default colors, repository, current branch, output file, index file and unspecified options.

nodes.name: wt_longstatus_print_unmerged_header
nodes.summary: Prints the 'Unmerged paths' header and picks the hint (add, rm, restore) according to the kinds of conflicts present.

nodes.name: wt_longstatus_print_cached_header
nodes.summary: Prints the 'Changes to be committed' header and the hint on how to unstage.

nodes.name: wt_longstatus_print_dirty_header
nodes.summary: Prints the 'Changes not staged for commit' header and hints for add, restore and dirty submodules.

nodes.name: wt_longstatus_print_other_header
nodes.summary: Prints the header and hint for untracked or ignored file sections.

nodes.name: wt_status_unmerged_status_string
nodes.summary: Maps an unmerged stage mask to its label such as 'both modified:' or 'deleted by us:'.

nodes.name: wt_status_diff_status_string
nodes.summary: Maps a diff status letter (added, copied, deleted, modified, renamed, typechange) to its translated label.

nodes.name: maxwidth
nodes.summary: Computes the widest displayed label over a range using utf8 width, for column alignment.

nodes.name: wt_longstatus_print_unmerged_data
nodes.summary: Prints one unmerged path line with an aligned stage label.

nodes.name: wt_longstatus_print_change_data
nodes.summary: Prints one staged or unstaged change line with aligned label, rename arrow and submodule annotations.

nodes.name: short_submodule_status
nodes.summary: Returns the one-letter short status for a submodule (new commits, modified, untracked content).

nodes.name: wt_status_collect_changed_cb
nodes.summary: Diff callback for index versus work tree that fills in worktree status, modes, object ids, renames and submodule state per path.

nodes.name: unmerged_mask
nodes.summary: Computes a bit mask of which stages (1 to 3) exist in the index for a path.

nodes.name: wt_status_collect_updated_cb
nodes.summary: Diff callback for HEAD versus index that records staged changes, renames, modes and object ids and sets the committable flag.

nodes.name: wt_status_collect_changes_trees
nodes.summary: Collects staged changes by diffing two arbitrary trees through the diff machinery, with rename detection settings, and then reads the in-progress state.

nodes.name: wt_status_collect_changes_worktree
nodes.summary: Runs a diff of the index against the work tree (run_diff_files) with submodule options to collect unstaged changes.

nodes.name: wt_status_collect_changes_index
nodes.summary: Runs a diff of HEAD against the index (run_diff_index cached) to collect staged changes, never ignoring submodule pointer changes.

nodes.name: add_file_to_list
nodes.summary: read_tree callback that marks files in a tree as added, used to expand sparse directory entries during the initial-commit scan.

nodes.name: wt_status_collect_changes_initial
nodes.summary: Collects staged changes before the first commit by treating every index entry as added, expanding sparse directories and marking unmerged stages.

nodes.name: wt_status_collect_untracked
nodes.summary: Scans the work tree for untracked and ignored files using the directory walker and untracked cache, and records timing for the advice hint.

nodes.name: has_unmerged
nodes.summary: Returns whether any collected path has conflict stages.

nodes.name: wt_status_collect
nodes.summary: Top-level collection: gathers work tree changes, staged changes (initial or normal), untracked files and the in-progress operation state.

nodes.name: wt_status_collect_free_buffers
nodes.summary: Frees the state buffers held by a wt_status after collection.

nodes.name: wt_status_state_free_buffers
nodes.summary: Frees the branch, onto, detached-from and bisect strings of a wt_status_state.

nodes.name: wt_longstatus_print_unmerged
nodes.summary: Prints the unmerged section of long format status.

nodes.name: wt_longstatus_print_updated
nodes.summary: Prints the 'Changes to be committed' section of long format status.

nodes.name: wt_status_check_worktree_changes
nodes.summary: Scans collected paths and reports whether there are worktree changes, deletions and dirty submodules.

nodes.name: wt_longstatus_print_changed
nodes.summary: Prints the 'Changes not staged for commit' section of long format status.

nodes.name: stash_count_refs
nodes.summary: Reflog callback that increments a counter for each entry of refs/stash.

nodes.name: wt_longstatus_print_stash_summary
nodes.summary: Prints how many entries the stash currently has, using plural-aware messages.

nodes.name: wt_longstatus_print_submodule_summary
nodes.summary: Runs 'git submodule summary' as a child process and prints its output as the submodule changes sections of status.

nodes.name: wt_longstatus_print_other
nodes.summary: Prints untracked or ignored files, optionally laid out in columns.

nodes.name: wt_status_locate_end
nodes.summary: Finds where the cut-line scissors marker starts in a commit message buffer and returns the length before it.

nodes.name: wt_status_append_cut_line
nodes.summary: Appends the scissors line and its explanation to a buffer.

nodes.name: wt_status_add_cut_line
nodes.summary: Writes the cut line to the status output once, so the diff below it is stripped on commit.

nodes.name: wt_longstatus_print_verbose
nodes.summary: Prints the verbose (-v) part of the commit template: the staged diff and, with -vv, the unstaged diff.

nodes.name: wt_longstatus_print_tracking
nodes.summary: Prints how the current branch relates to its upstream (ahead, behind, diverged), with a warning if computing it was slow.

nodes.name: show_merge_in_progress
nodes.summary: Prints the 'merge in progress' notice with hints depending on unresolved conflicts.

nodes.name: show_am_in_progress
nodes.summary: Prints the 'am session' notice and hints for continue, skip, allow-empty and abort.

nodes.name: read_line_from_git_path
nodes.summary: Reads the first line of a file under the git directory and returns it as a string.

nodes.name: split_commit_in_progress
nodes.summary: Detects an in-progress commit split during an interactive rebase by comparing HEAD, ORIG_HEAD and rebase-merge files.

nodes.name: abbrev_oid_in_line
nodes.summary: Shortens a hex object id in a rebase todo line to its unique abbreviation, skipping labels and refnames.

nodes.name: skip_dash_c
nodes.summary: Skips a -C or -c option in a todo line and reports whether it was present.

nodes.name: format_todo_line
nodes.summary: Rewrites a rebase todo line, abbreviating object ids according to the command kind and dropping comment lines.

nodes.name: read_rebase_todolist
nodes.summary: Reads a rebase todo or done file from the git directory into a list of formatted lines.

nodes.name: show_rebase_information
nodes.summary: Prints the last commands done and the next commands to do of an interactive rebase.

nodes.name: print_rebase_state
nodes.summary: Prints which branch is being rebased onto which base.

nodes.name: show_rebase_in_progress
nodes.summary: Prints the rebase notice and the right hints for conflicts, finished conflicts, splitting or editing a commit.

nodes.name: show_cherry_pick_in_progress
nodes.summary: Prints the cherry-pick notice with the commit being picked and continue, skip and abort hints.

nodes.name: show_revert_in_progress
nodes.summary: Prints the revert notice with the commit being reverted and continue, skip and abort hints.

nodes.name: show_bisect_in_progress
nodes.summary: Prints that a bisect is in progress and how to reset.

nodes.name: show_sparse_checkout_in_use
nodes.summary: Prints that sparse checkout is in use and the percentage of tracked files present.

nodes.name: get_branch
nodes.summary: Reads a state file (such as head-name or onto) from a worktree git dir and returns a short branch name or abbreviated object id.

nodes.name: grab_1st_switch
nodes.summary: Reflog callback that finds the most recent 'checkout: moving from X to Y' entry and extracts the target.

nodes.name: wt_status_get_detached_from
nodes.summary: Uses the HEAD reflog to work out what a detached HEAD was checked out from and whether HEAD is still at that point.

nodes.name: wt_status_check_rebase
nodes.summary: Detects an am or rebase in progress in a worktree by looking for rebase-apply and rebase-merge directories.

nodes.name: wt_status_check_bisect
nodes.summary: Detects a bisect in progress by the BISECT_LOG file and records the starting branch.

nodes.name: wt_status_check_sparse_checkout
nodes.summary: Computes the percentage of tracked files present in the work tree, or marks sparse index or disabled.

nodes.name: wt_status_get_state
nodes.summary: Fills a wt_status_state with merge, rebase, cherry-pick, revert, bisect, detached-from and sparse checkout information.

nodes.name: wt_longstatus_print_state
nodes.summary: Chooses which in-progress operation notices to print for long format.

nodes.name: wt_longstatus_print
nodes.summary: Prints the full long-format status: branch line, tracking, state, staged, unmerged, unstaged, submodules, untracked and the final summary message.

nodes.name: wt_shortstatus_unmerged
nodes.summary: Prints one unmerged path in short format with the two-letter conflict code (UU, AA, DU and so on).

nodes.name: wt_shortstatus_status
nodes.summary: Prints one short-format line: index status letter, work tree status letter, path and rename source.

nodes.name: wt_shortstatus_other
nodes.summary: Prints an untracked (??) or ignored (!!) path in short format.

nodes.name: wt_shortstatus_print_tracking
nodes.summary: Prints the '## branch...upstream [ahead N, behind M]' line of short and porcelain v1 status.

nodes.name: wt_shortstatus_print
nodes.summary: Prints short-format status: optional branch line, changes, untracked and ignored files.

nodes.name: wt_porcelain_v2_print_tracking
nodes.summary: Prints the '# branch.*' header lines of porcelain v2 (oid, head, upstream, ahead/behind).

nodes.name: wt_porcelain_v2_submodule_state
nodes.summary: Fills the four character submodule state token (N... or SCMU) for porcelain v2 lines.

nodes.name: wt_porcelain_v2_fix_up_changed
nodes.summary: Copies index data into the head or worktree columns when only one of the two scans produced data for a path.

nodes.name: wt_porcelain_v2_print_changed_entry
nodes.summary: Prints one ordinary or renamed entry (types '1' and '2') of porcelain v2 with modes and object ids.

nodes.name: wt_porcelain_v2_print_unmerged_entry
nodes.summary: Prints one unmerged entry (type 'u') of porcelain v2 with the three stage modes and object ids read from the index.

nodes.name: wt_porcelain_v2_print_other
nodes.summary: Prints an untracked or ignored path in porcelain v2.

nodes.name: wt_porcelain_v2_print
nodes.summary: Prints porcelain v2 status: headers, stash, changed entries, unmerged entries, then untracked and ignored.

nodes.name: wt_status_print
nodes.summary: Dispatches printing to the long, short, porcelain or porcelain v2 formatter with trace2 data on counts.

nodes.name: has_unstaged_changes
nodes.summary: Returns whether the work tree differs from the index using a quick diff-files.

nodes.name: has_uncommitted_changes
nodes.summary: Returns whether the index differs from HEAD (or the empty tree) using a quick cached diff-index.

nodes.name: require_clean_work_tree
nodes.summary: Refreshes the index and errors out or dies if there are unstaged or uncommitted changes before an operation such as pull --rebase.

nodes.name: xdiff-interface.h
nodes.summary: Git-side wrapper API over the xdiff library: diff with size limits and line/hunk callbacks, reading files and blobs into mmfile_t, binary detection, function-name regex setup, conflict style parsing and whitespace-aware line comparison and hashing.

nodes.name: worktree.c
nodes.summary: Implements the `git worktree` builtin with its add, list, lock, unlock, move, remove, prune and repair subcommands. It manages linked worktrees by creating and deleting per-worktree metadata under `$GIT_COMMON_DIR/worktrees/<id>`, writing the gitdir/commondir link files and setting up a separate HEAD ref store for each linked checkout.
nodes.languageNotes: Subcommands are plain static functions registered with OPT_SUBCOMMAND and dispatched through a function pointer in cmd_worktree.

nodes.name: add_opts
nodes.summary: Option bundle for `git worktree add` (force, detach, quiet, checkout, orphan, relative paths and the keep_locked reason) passed down to add_worktree and its helpers.

nodes.name: git_worktree_config
nodes.summary: Config callback for the worktree builtin that reads worktree.* settings (such as worktree.useRelativePaths) into file-level flags and falls back to git_default_config.

nodes.name: delete_git_dir
nodes.summary: Removes the per-worktree administrative directory `worktrees/<id>` under the common dir (recursively, or by unlink when it is not a directory) and reports an error on failure.

nodes.name: prune_worktrees
nodes.summary: Walks every entry of `worktrees/`, prunes those that should_prune_worktree reports as stale, collects the gitdir paths of the survivors, drops duplicate registrations and deletes the worktrees directory when it ends up empty.

nodes.name: prune
nodes.summary: Subcommand handler for `git worktree prune` that parses --dry-run, --verbose and --expire and then calls prune_worktrees.

nodes.name: remove_junk
nodes.summary: atexit cleanup that deletes the half-created worktree git dir and work tree when an add did not finish, but only in the process that started it.

nodes.name: check_candidate_path
nodes.summary: Validates the destination of an add or move: dies if the path exists and is not an empty directory, and handles a path that is a registered but missing worktree depending on --force and whether it is locked.

nodes.name: copy_sparse_checkout
nodes.summary: Copies the main repository's `info/sparse-checkout` file into a new worktree's git dir so sparse patterns carry over.

nodes.name: copy_filtered_worktree_config
nodes.summary: Copies `config.worktree` into the new worktree, then uses a configset to unset core.bare and core.worktree in the copy so the linked worktree does not inherit them.

nodes.name: checkout_worktree
nodes.summary: Runs `git reset --hard --no-recurse-submodules` as a child process with the new worktree's GIT_DIR and GIT_WORK_TREE to populate its files and index.

nodes.name: make_worktree_orphan
nodes.summary: For `add --orphan`, validates the new branch name and runs `git symbolic-ref HEAD` inside the new worktree so HEAD points at an unborn branch.

nodes.name: setup_alternate_ref_dir
nodes.summary: When the repository keeps refs in a separate payload location, creates the matching `worktrees/<id>` directories there and writes stub files in the worktree git dir pointing at them.

nodes.name: add_worktree
nodes.summary: Core of `worktree add`: checks the candidate path, picks a unique `worktrees/<name>` id, writes `locked`, `gitdir` and `commondir` link files, creates the worktree's own ref store with HEAD pointing at the branch or commit, copies sparse and config files, optionally checks out files and finally runs the post-checkout hook. Partial state is removed by remove_junk on failure.

nodes.name: can_use_local_refs
nodes.summary: Reports whether the repository has a usable HEAD or any local branch so a plain add can proceed, warning when HEAD is orphaned.

nodes.name: can_use_remote_refs
nodes.summary: Checks whether remote-tracking refs exist for the --guess-remote DWIM path and dies with a hint when no refs exist at all despite a configured remote.

nodes.name: dwim_orphan
nodes.summary: Decides whether `worktree add` should fall back to creating an orphan branch because no local or remote refs exist, rejecting combinations with --track or --no-checkout.

nodes.name: dwim_branch
nodes.summary: Guesses the branch for `worktree add <path>` from the path basename: uses an existing local branch of that name, or with --guess-remote finds a unique remote-tracking branch, dying when several remotes match.

nodes.name: add
nodes.summary: Subcommand handler for `git worktree add`: parses and cross-checks options, resolves the commit-ish or DWIMs a branch, optionally creates a new branch via a `git branch` child process, then calls add_worktree.

nodes.name: show_worktree_porcelain
nodes.summary: Prints one worktree in the stable `--porcelain` format (worktree, HEAD, branch or detached, bare, locked and prunable lines) using a configurable line terminator.

nodes.name: worktree_display
nodes.summary: Holds a worktree path string and its display width so list output can align columns.

nodes.name: show_worktree
nodes.summary: Prints one worktree in the human format: padded path, abbreviated HEAD object id, branch name or "(detached HEAD)", plus locked and prunable annotations.

nodes.name: list
nodes.summary: Subcommand handler for `git worktree list`: validates --porcelain, --verbose and -z, loads all worktrees, sorts the linked ones by path and prints each in human or porcelain form.

nodes.name: lock_worktree
nodes.summary: Subcommand handler for `git worktree lock`: finds the worktree, refuses the main one or one already locked and writes the optional reason into `worktrees/<id>/locked`.

nodes.name: unlock_worktree
nodes.summary: Subcommand handler for `git worktree unlock`: verifies the worktree is linked and locked, then unlinks its `locked` file.

nodes.name: validate_no_submodules
nodes.summary: Dies if a worktree has a `modules` directory or an index containing a populated gitlink, because worktrees with submodules cannot be moved or removed.

nodes.name: move_worktree
nodes.summary: Subcommand handler for `git worktree move`: resolves the destination, validates it, rejects locked worktrees and submodules, renames the directory and rewrites the link files with update_worktree_location.

nodes.name: check_clean_worktree
nodes.summary: Runs `git status --porcelain --ignore-submodules=none` inside a worktree and dies if it prints anything, so remove refuses dirty trees without --force.

nodes.name: delete_git_work_tree
nodes.summary: Recursively deletes the working directory of a worktree.

nodes.name: remove_worktree
nodes.summary: Subcommand handler for `git worktree remove`: rejects the main or locked worktree, validates it, checks it is clean unless forced, then deletes the work tree and its admin dir.

nodes.name: repair
nodes.summary: Subcommand handler for `git worktree repair` that fixes the gitdir and `.git` link files for given paths and for all registered worktrees, reporting each repair on stderr.

nodes.name: cmd_worktree
nodes.summary: Entry point of `git worktree`: loads worktree config, parses the subcommand with OPT_SUBCOMMAND, prepares repo settings and dispatches to the chosen handler.

nodes.name: chdir-notify.c
nodes.summary: Keeps a global list of callbacks that want to know when the process changes its working directory, and provides chdir_notify() to chdir and invoke them. Also offers reparent_relative_path() so stored relative paths can be rewritten for the new cwd.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the intrusive struct list_head list from list.h and embeds the list node in each registered entry.

nodes.name: chdir_notify_entry
nodes.summary: One registered subscriber: a callback pointer, its user data and the intrusive list node linking it into the global list.

nodes.name: chdir_notify_register
nodes.summary: Appends a callback and its data to the global subscriber list; callbacks run in registration order.

nodes.name: chdir_notify_unregister
nodes.summary: Removes every entry with a matching callback and data pointer from the subscriber list and frees it.

nodes.name: chdir_notify
nodes.summary: Remembers the old cwd, calls chdir(), traces the change under GIT_TRACE_SETUP and then invokes every registered callback with the old and new directory.

nodes.name: reparent_relative_path
nodes.summary: Rewrites a path that was relative to the old cwd so it is relative to the new one, returning absolute paths unchanged.

nodes.name: chdir-notify.h
nodes.summary: Public API for the chdir notification mechanism: register or unregister a callback, chdir with notification, and reparent a relative path.

nodes.name: config.c
nodes.summary: The Git configuration subsystem: a byte-level parser for config files, blobs, stdin and -c/GIT_CONFIG_* parameters, include and includeIf handling, typed value accessors, an in-memory hashmap configset per repository, and the file rewriter that sets, unsets, renames and copies keys and sections while preserving comments and layout.
nodes.languageNotes: Parsing is a hand-written character state machine over a config_source with swappable fgetc/ungetc/ftell function pointers so one parser handles FILE* and in-memory buffers.

nodes.name: config_source
nodes.summary: Parser state for one config input: FILE* or memory buffer, origin type and name, line number, accumulated key and value buffers and swappable getc/ungetc/ftell callbacks.

nodes.name: config_include_data
nodes.summary: Context carried through include processing: recursion depth, the wrapped callback, config options, source and repository, and the lazily collected remote URLs for hasconfig conditions.

nodes.name: handle_path_include
nodes.summary: Expands an include.path value, resolves relative paths against the including file, enforces the maximum include depth of 10 and recursively parses the target through git_config_include.

nodes.name: include_by_path
nodes.summary: Evaluates a gitdir: or worktree: includeIf condition by matching the real (and absolute) path of the git dir or work tree against a wildmatch pattern, optionally case-insensitively.

nodes.name: include_by_branch
nodes.summary: Evaluates an onbranch: condition by resolving HEAD through the main ref store and wildmatching the short branch name against the pattern.

nodes.name: include_by_remote_url
nodes.summary: Evaluates hasconfig:remote.*.url: by lazily scanning the config for remote URLs and checking whether any matches the glob.

nodes.name: include_condition_is_true
nodes.summary: Dispatches an includeIf condition on its prefix (gitdir, gitdir/i, worktree, worktree/i, onbranch, hasconfig:remote.*.url); unknown conditions are false.

nodes.name: git_config_include
nodes.summary: Wrapper callback that forwards every key to the real callback and, on include.path or a true includeIf.<cond>.path, parses the referenced file.

nodes.name: git_config_push_parameter
nodes.summary: Splits a `-c key=value` string at the first = and appends the shell-quoted pair to the GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS environment variable so child processes inherit it.

nodes.name: git_config_push_env
nodes.summary: Handles `--config-env key=ENVVAR` by reading the named environment variable and pushing the pair as a config parameter.

nodes.name: do_parse_config_key
nodes.summary: Validates a `section[.subsection].name` key, returning the base length and a lowercased copy that keeps the subsection untouched.

nodes.name: git_config_parse_parameter
nodes.summary: Parses a `key=value` string from the command line into a key and value and feeds it to the callback with command-line key-value info.

nodes.name: git_config_from_parameters
nodes.summary: Replays config given outside files: the numbered GIT_CONFIG_KEY_n / GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_n pairs and the legacy GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS list, calling fn with scope command.

nodes.name: get_next_char
nodes.summary: Reads the next byte from the config source, folding CRLF to LF, counting lines and bytes (refusing inputs over INT_MAX) and synthesizing a final newline at EOF.

nodes.name: parse_value
nodes.summary: Parses the right-hand side of a key = value line, handling double quotes, backslash escapes, trailing-whitespace trimming and ; or # comments.

nodes.name: get_value
nodes.summary: Reads a variable name and optional value after a section header, then invokes the callback with the full lowercased key and the line number set for error messages.

nodes.name: get_extended_base_var
nodes.summary: Parses the `[section "subsection"]` header form, with escapes inside the quoted subsection, and appends `.subsection` to the section name.

nodes.name: git_parse_source
nodes.summary: Main config parser loop: skips a UTF-8 BOM, tracks whitespace, comments, [section] headers and entries, emits parser events used by the rewriter, calls the callback per entry and reports "bad config line" errors according to the error action.

nodes.name: die_bad_number
nodes.summary: Dies with a message naming the value, key and origin (file, blob, stdin, command line) when a numeric config value is out of range or has a bad unit.

nodes.name: git_config_int
nodes.summary: Parses a config value as an int with k/m/g suffixes, dying with die_bad_number on failure; sibling functions cover uint, int64, ulong, size_t and double.

nodes.name: git_config_bool
nodes.summary: Interprets a config value as a boolean (true/yes/on/1 and false/no/off/0, empty meaning true) and dies on anything else.

nodes.name: git_config_pathname
nodes.summary: Reads a path value, honoring the :(optional) prefix and ~ expansion, and stores NULL when an optional file is missing.

nodes.name: do_config_from
nodes.summary: Initializes a config_source stack frame (line, buffers, key-value info) and runs git_parse_source over it.

nodes.name: do_config_from_file
nodes.summary: Wraps a FILE* in a config_source using stdio-based getc/ungetc/ftell, locks the stream and parses it with the die-on-error policy.

nodes.name: git_config_from_file_with_options
nodes.summary: Opens a file (warning on failure) and parses it as config with the given scope and options.

nodes.name: git_config_from_mem
nodes.summary: Parses config text from a memory buffer using the buffer-based getc callbacks and the error-return policy.

nodes.name: git_config_from_blob_oid
nodes.summary: Loads a blob from the object database by object id, checks it is a blob and parses its contents as config (as used for .gitmodules in a tree).

nodes.name: git_system_config
nodes.summary: Returns the system config path from GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM or the compiled-in ETC_GITCONFIG via system_path.

nodes.name: git_global_config_paths
nodes.summary: Computes the global config locations: GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL if set, otherwise ~/.gitconfig and the XDG config file.

nodes.name: do_git_config_sequence
nodes.summary: Reads the standard config cascade in order: system, XDG, user, repository config, per-worktree config and finally command-line parameters, each with its scope.

nodes.name: config_with_options
nodes.summary: Central entry point for reading config: optionally wraps the callback with include handling, then reads from stdin, a given file, a blob, or the normal config sequence.

nodes.name: read_early_config
nodes.summary: Reads config before the repository is fully set up by discovering the git dir without changing global state, with includes enabled.

nodes.name: read_very_early_config
nodes.summary: Reads only trusted scopes (system, global, command line) and ignores repository and worktree config, for use before the repo is trusted.

nodes.name: configset_find_element
nodes.summary: Normalizes a user-supplied key and looks it up in the configset hashmap.

nodes.name: configset_add_value
nodes.summary: Appends a value (with its key-value info) to the hashmap entry for a key and to the ordered list that preserves reading order.

nodes.name: git_configset_init
nodes.summary: Initializes an empty configset: the key hashmap and the ordered item list.

nodes.name: git_configset_clear
nodes.summary: Frees all keys, value lists and the hashmap and list of a configset.

nodes.name: git_configset_get_value
nodes.summary: Returns the last value for a key ("last one wins") along with its key-value info.

nodes.name: comment_char_config
nodes.summary: Tracks where core.commentChar or core.commentString was set (including auto) so a deprecation warning can tell the user which files to fix.

nodes.name: comment_char_callback
nodes.summary: Config callback that records each file that sets core.commentChar/commentString and whether it occurs more than once, and notes the auto value.

nodes.name: repo_config
nodes.summary: Per-read state binding a repository to the comment-char tracking while its configset is being filled.

nodes.name: repo_read_config
nodes.summary: Builds a repository's in-memory configset: clears and re-initializes it, reads all config with includes through config_with_options into the configset and then checks for deprecated settings.

nodes.name: repo_config
nodes.summary: Iterates over every cached config entry of a repository, reading the config first if needed; with a NULL repository it reads very early config.

nodes.name: git_protected_config
nodes.summary: Iterates the lazily built configset of protected scopes (system, global, command) for settings that must not come from the repository.

nodes.name: git_die_config
nodes.summary: Dies with an error that names the file and line where a bad config key was set, or just the key when its origin is unknown.

nodes.name: config_store_data
nodes.summary: Bookkeeping for the config rewriter: the key and value matching rule, parsed events with byte offsets, and the list of matching positions.

nodes.name: matches
nodes.summary: Decides whether a parsed key/value pair is the one the rewriter targets, using exact key, optional fixed value or regex value pattern.

nodes.name: store_aux_event
nodes.summary: Parser-event callback that records the byte range and type of each section, entry, comment and whitespace token and flags sections matching the key being set.

nodes.name: store_aux
nodes.summary: Entry callback used while rewriting: records positions of values that match the key and warns when a key has multiple values.

nodes.name: write_pair
nodes.summary: Writes a `\tname = value` line, quoting and escaping the value (newline, tab, quote, backslash) and appending an optional comment.

nodes.name: maybe_remove_section
nodes.summary: When unsetting the only entry of a section, extends the removed range to cover the now-empty section header unless comments are present.

nodes.name: git_config_prepare_comment_string
nodes.summary: Normalizes a user-provided comment so it begins with a space and #, rejecting multi-line comments.

nodes.name: repo_config_set_multivar_in_file_gently
nodes.summary: The general config writer: takes config.lock, parses the existing file with events to find the target key and section, then copies unchanged bytes and inserts, replaces or removes values before committing the lock file atomically.

nodes.name: section_name_match
nodes.summary: Compares a `[section "sub"]` header in a buffer with a dotted section name and returns the header length on match.

nodes.name: repo_config_copy_or_rename_section_in_file
nodes.summary: Rewrites a config file line by line under a lock to rename, copy or delete a whole section, preserving other content.

nodes.name: parse_config_key
nodes.summary: Splits a key such as `remote.origin.url` into optional subsection and final key when the section prefix matches; used by callbacks to filter keys.

nodes.name: git_config_string
