nodes.summary: Returns nanoseconds since the epoch from gettimeofday.

nodes.name: getnanotime
nodes.summary: Returns epoch nanoseconds for performance tracing by combining one gettimeofday sample with a high resolution counter, falling back if unavailable.

nodes.name: print_command_performance_atexit
nodes.summary: atexit handler that prints the total performance time of the git command.

nodes.name: trace_command_performance
nodes.summary: Starts performance tracing of the whole command, remembering the quoted command line for the exit message.

nodes.name: worktree.c
nodes.summary: Implements the worktree abstraction: listing the main and linked worktrees, finding one by path or suffix, reading lock and prune reasons, validating and relocating worktrees, repairing the .git file and gitdir backlinks, detecting HEAD shared across worktrees (rebase/bisect) and upgrading to per-worktree config.
nodes.languageNotes: Linked worktrees live in <commondir>/worktrees/<id> with a gitdir file pointing back at the checkout; relative and absolute path forms are both supported.

nodes.name: free_worktree
nodes.summary: Frees a single worktree and its strings.

nodes.name: free_worktrees
nodes.summary: Frees a NULL-terminated array of worktrees.

nodes.name: add_head_info
nodes.summary: Resolves HEAD in the worktree ref store and records head oid, symbolic ref or detached state.

nodes.name: is_current_worktree
nodes.summary: Returns whether a worktree gitdir equals the repository gitdir.

nodes.name: get_current_worktree
nodes.summary: Builds a worktree struct for the current repository from its gitdir, commondir and worktree path.

nodes.name: is_main_worktree_bare
nodes.summary: Reads core.bare from the main worktree config.worktree to tell if the main worktree is bare when running in a secondary one.

nodes.name: get_main_worktree
nodes.summary: Builds the main worktree entry from the common dir, deciding current, bare and optionally loading HEAD.

nodes.name: get_linked_worktree
nodes.summary: Builds a linked worktree entry by reading worktrees/<id>/gitdir and resolving its path, optionally loading HEAD.

nodes.name: get_worktrees_internal
nodes.summary: Lists the main worktree first and every linked worktree found under the worktrees directory.

nodes.name: get_worktrees
nodes.summary: Returns all worktrees including their HEAD info.

nodes.name: get_worktrees_without_reading_head
nodes.summary: Returns all worktrees without reading HEAD, safe when the ref database may be inconsistent.

nodes.name: get_worktree_git_dir
nodes.summary: Returns the git directory of a worktree: the common dir for the main one, worktrees/<id> for linked ones.

nodes.name: find_worktree_by_suffix
nodes.summary: Finds a worktree whose path ends with a given suffix at a directory boundary, only if the match is unique.

nodes.name: find_worktree
nodes.summary: Finds a worktree by unique path suffix or by (prefix-relative) path.

nodes.name: find_worktree_by_path
nodes.summary: Finds the worktree whose real path equals the given path.

nodes.name: is_main_worktree
nodes.summary: Returns true if the worktree has no id, i.e. is the main one.

nodes.name: worktree_lock_reason
nodes.summary: Lazily reads the locked file of a linked worktree and returns the lock reason.

nodes.name: worktree_prune_reason
nodes.summary: Lazily computes and caches why a worktree should be pruned, using should_prune_worktree.

nodes.name: strbuf_addf_gently
nodes.summary: printf-style append to a strbuf that does nothing when the buffer is NULL.

nodes.name: validate_worktree
nodes.summary: Checks that a worktree is healthy: for linked ones the gitdir path is absolute, .git exists and points back to worktrees/<id>.

nodes.name: update_worktree_location
nodes.summary: Moves a linked worktree record to a new path by rewriting the .git and gitdir link files.

nodes.name: is_worktree_being_rebased
nodes.summary: Returns whether a worktree is in the middle of a rebase of the target branch.

nodes.name: is_worktree_being_bisected
nodes.summary: Returns whether a worktree is bisecting from the target branch.

nodes.name: is_shared_symref
nodes.summary: Returns whether a symref in a worktree (including a detached HEAD during rebase or bisect) points at the target ref.

nodes.name: find_shared_symref
nodes.summary: Returns the first worktree whose symref points at the target.

nodes.name: submodule_uses_worktrees
nodes.summary: Returns whether a submodule has linked worktrees, treating an unreadable format as using them.

nodes.name: strbuf_worktree_ref
nodes.summary: Adds main-worktree/ or worktrees/<id>/ before per-worktree refs so they are addressable from another worktree.

nodes.name: other_head_refs
nodes.summary: Calls a callback for the HEAD of every other worktree.

nodes.name: repair_gitfile
nodes.summary: Repairs a linked worktree .git file that is missing, broken, incorrect or using the wrong absolute/relative form.

nodes.name: repair_noop
nodes.summary: Default repair callback that ignores messages.

nodes.name: repair_worktrees
nodes.summary: Repairs the .git file of every linked worktree and reports through a callback.

nodes.name: repair_worktree_after_gitdir_move
nodes.summary: Fixes the gitdir backlink of one linked worktree after the main repository directory moved.

nodes.name: repair_worktrees_after_gitdir_move
nodes.summary: Repairs every linked worktree after the gitdir was moved.

nodes.name: is_main_worktree_path
nodes.summary: Returns whether a path refers to the main worktree.

nodes.name: infer_backlink
nodes.summary: Infers the worktrees/<id> directory by reading the id from a worktree .git file when both sides were moved.

nodes.name: repair_worktree_at_path
nodes.summary: Repairs worktrees/<id>/gitdir for the worktree at a path, handling moved, copied and broken cases using the .git file and inferred backlink.

nodes.name: should_prune_worktree
nodes.summary: Decides whether a worktree entry is stale (invalid directory, missing or unreadable gitdir, missing location) while honoring locks and an expiry grace period.

nodes.name: move_config_setting
nodes.summary: Moves a config key from one file to another by setting it in the target and unsetting it in the source.

nodes.name: init_worktree_config
nodes.summary: Enables extensions.worktreeConfig and moves core.bare and core.worktree from the common config to the main worktree config.worktree.

nodes.name: write_worktree_linking_files
nodes.summary: Writes the worktree .git file and the gitdir backlink file in absolute or relative form, upgrading the repository format for relative paths.

nodes.name: worktree.h
nodes.summary: Public header of the worktree API: struct worktree describing the main or a linked worktree, plus the functions to list, find, validate, relocate, repair and prune worktrees and to detect branches shared across worktrees.

nodes.name: worktree
nodes.summary: Describes a worktree: owning repository, path, id, HEAD ref or oid, detached/bare/current flags and lazily loaded lock and prune reasons.

nodes.name: revision.c
nodes.summary: Implements Git's revision walking machinery: parsing revision arguments and options into struct rev_info, building the pending object list, traversing and limiting commit history (uninteresting marking, history simplification, topological ordering, Bloom filter path limiting) and iterating results with get_revision.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of object flag bits (SEEN, UNINTERESTING, TREESAME, ...) stored on each struct object, commit slabs and decorations for per-commit side data, and prio_queue for date or generation ordered traversal.

nodes.name: revision.h
nodes.summary: Public header of the revision walking API: the rev_info state structure and its flag bits, the setup/prepare/get_revision calling sequence, pending object helpers, ref exclusion helpers and commit filter enums.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines per-object flag bits as macros that must stay consistent with the flag allocation list in object.h.

nodes.name: path_and_oids_entry
nodes.summary: Hashmap entry associating a tree path with the set of tree object ids found at that path, used by the sparse uninteresting-tree walk.

nodes.name: treesame_state
nodes.summary: Per-merge-commit record with the parent count and a flexible array of flags saying which parents the commit is TREESAME to.

nodes.name: all_refs_cb
nodes.summary: Callback data for ref and reflog iteration: flags to apply, owning rev_info, worktree and a bad-reflog warning marker.

nodes.name: merge_simplify_state
nodes.summary: Decoration payload recording the commit a given commit simplifies to during --simplify-merges.

nodes.name: topo_walk_info
nodes.summary: State of the incremental topological walk: minimum generation, explore, indegree and topo priority queues, indegree and author-date slabs.

nodes.name: rev_walk_mode
nodes.summary: Enum of walk strategies (reflog, topological, limited, no-walk, streaming) selected by get_walk_mode.

nodes.name: rev_cmdline_info
nodes.summary: Growable record of the revisions the user named on the command line, each with its object, name, origin (ref, parents-only, left, right, merge-base, rev) and flags.

nodes.name: ref_exclusions
nodes.summary: Holds --exclude wildmatch patterns and hidden-ref patterns used to skip refs while expanding --all, --branches and similar options.

nodes.name: rev_info
nodes.summary: The central revision-walk state: pending objects, commit list and queue, traversal and diff flags, pathspec, grep and format options, limits, decorations, topo-walk and Bloom filter data used by log, rev-list and many other builtins.

nodes.name: setup_revision_opt
nodes.summary: Optional parameters for setup_revisions: default revision, tweak callback and flags for dashdash assumption, promisor objects and argv ownership.

nodes.name: commit_action
nodes.summary: Enum result of the commit filter: commit_ignore, commit_show or commit_error.

nodes.name: rewrite_result
nodes.summary: Enum result of a parent rewrite step: ok, no parents left, or error.

nodes.name: mark_tree_contents_uninteresting
nodes.summary: Parses a tree and walks its entries, recursively flagging subtrees and blobs UNINTERESTING (subproject entries are ignored), then frees the tree buffer.

nodes.name: mark_tree_uninteresting
nodes.summary: Sets UNINTERESTING on a tree object and, if it was not already flagged, marks its whole contents so objects reachable only from an excluded revision are omitted from a walk.

nodes.name: path_and_oids_cmp
nodes.summary: Hashmap comparison callback that orders path_and_oids_entry records by their path string.

nodes.name: paths_and_oids_clear
nodes.summary: Releases every path_and_oids_entry in the hashmap, clearing each oidset of tree ids and freeing the path strings.

nodes.name: paths_and_oids_insert
nodes.summary: Looks up (or creates) the hashmap entry for a path and inserts a tree object id into that path's oidset.

nodes.name: add_children_by_path
nodes.summary: Reads one tree and groups child tree ids by entry path into a hashmap, propagating UNINTERESTING from the parent tree to child trees and blobs.

nodes.name: mark_trees_uninteresting_sparse
nodes.summary: Marks trees uninteresting using a path-by-path sparse walk: only descends when a set of trees contains both interesting and uninteresting trees, grouping children by path and recursing.

nodes.name: mark_one_parent_uninteresting
nodes.summary: Flags one commit UNINTERESTING and pushes its parents on a stack so the caller can mark ancestors without recursion (first parent only when exclude_first_parent_only is set).

nodes.name: mark_parents_uninteresting
nodes.summary: Marks all ancestors of a commit UNINTERESTING iteratively with an explicit commit stack, honoring exclude_first_parent_only.

nodes.name: add_pending_object_with_path
nodes.summary: Adds an object plus mode and path to the rev_info pending array; for reflog walks it instead registers the commit with the reflog-walk machinery.

nodes.name: add_pending_object
nodes.summary: Public API to queue an object on the rev_info pending list under a name, with no mode or path information.

nodes.name: add_head_to_pending
nodes.summary: Resolves HEAD to an object and adds it to the pending list, doing nothing if HEAD does not exist.

nodes.name: get_reference
nodes.summary: Parses an object id into a struct object with the given flags, honoring ignore_missing, promisor-object and missing-commit tracking, and dies on a bad object otherwise.

nodes.name: add_pending_oid
nodes.summary: Public helper that looks up an object id via get_reference and queues it on the pending list.

nodes.name: handle_commit
nodes.summary: Turns one pending entry into work for the walker: peels tags to their targets, returns commits (marking parents when UNINTERESTING), and re-queues or drops trees and blobs depending on --objects and flags.

nodes.name: everybody_uninteresting
nodes.summary: Scans a priority queue (with a cached interesting commit) and returns true only when every queued commit is UNINTERESTING.

nodes.name: one_relevant_parent
nodes.summary: Picks the single relevant parent of a commit (or the first parent for single-parent or first-parent-only walks) so a TREESAME commit can be simplified to it; returns NULL when ambiguous.

nodes.name: file_add_remove
nodes.summary: Diff callback for added or removed files that ORs REV_TREE_NEW or REV_TREE_OLD into tree_difference and decides when the diff can stop early.

nodes.name: file_change
nodes.summary: Diff callback for modified files that sets tree_difference to REV_TREE_DIFFERENT and flags a change so the tree diff can end early.

nodes.name: trace2_bloom_filter_statistics_atexit
nodes.summary: At process exit emits a trace2 JSON event with counters for how often the changed-path Bloom filter said maybe, definitely not, false positive, or was missing.

nodes.name: forbid_bloom_filters
nodes.summary: Returns true if a pathspec uses magic other than from-top, maxdepth, literal, glob or attr, which makes changed-path Bloom filters unusable.

nodes.name: convert_pathspec_to_bloom_keyvec
nodes.summary: Converts one pathspec item into a Bloom key vector, trimming wildcard tails and trailing slashes down to the literal directory prefix.

nodes.name: prepare_to_use_bloom_filter
nodes.summary: Decides whether changed-path Bloom filters can speed up a path-limited walk and, if so, builds the per-pathspec key vectors from the commit-graph settings.

nodes.name: check_maybe_different_in_bloom_filter
nodes.summary: Consults a commit's changed-path Bloom filter for each key vector and returns whether the paths might differ, updating statistics, or -1 when no filter is available.

nodes.name: rev_compare_tree
nodes.summary: Compares a parent and commit tree under the pathspec (using the Bloom filter and decoration shortcuts first) and returns REV_TREE_SAME, NEW, OLD or DIFFERENT.

nodes.name: rev_same_tree_as_empty
nodes.summary: Checks whether a commit's tree is identical to the empty tree under the pathspec, using the Bloom filter when possible; used for root commits.

nodes.name: compact_treesame
nodes.summary: Removes the nth parent from the per-parent treesame[] decoration after a parent was dropped, fixing the TREESAME flag if the commit became a non-merge.

nodes.name: update_treesame
nodes.summary: Recomputes a merge commit's TREESAME flag from its per-parent treesame[] data, considering only relevant parents when any exist.

nodes.name: limiting_can_increase_treesame
nodes.summary: Returns true when limiting the commit list could turn commits TREESAME, which requires prune and dense without simplify_history or first_parent_only.

nodes.name: try_to_simplify_commit
nodes.summary: Core history simplification: compares a commit to each parent under the pathspec, cuts the parent list down to a single TREESAME parent when allowed, and sets TREESAME and PULL_MERGE flags.

nodes.name: process_parents
nodes.summary: Expands one commit during traversal: parses its parents, passes SYMMETRIC_LEFT and ANCESTRY_PATH flags down, queues unseen parents, and simplifies history for interesting commits.

nodes.name: cherry_pick_list
nodes.summary: Implements --cherry-pick and --cherry-mark on a symmetric-difference list by computing patch-ids of one side and flagging commits on the other side with matching patches.

nodes.name: still_interesting
nodes.summary: Heuristic used by limit_list to decide whether to keep walking, returning a slop counter that decreases once only uninteresting, older commits remain.

nodes.name: limit_to_ancestry
nodes.summary: Implements --ancestry-path by marking descendants of bottom commits with TMP_MARK and flagging commits not on any such path as UNINTERESTING.

nodes.name: limit_left_right
nodes.summary: For --left-only or --right-only, sets SHOWN on commits from the unwanted side of a symmetric difference.

nodes.name: limit_list
nodes.summary: Eagerly walks the whole commit list through a date-ordered priority queue, applying age limits, UNINTERESTING propagation, cherry-pick, left-right and ancestry-path filters, and stores the limited list in revs->commits.

nodes.name: add_rev_cmdline
nodes.summary: Appends an entry (object, name, origin kind, flags) to the rev_info command-line record that remembers what the user asked for.

nodes.name: add_rev_cmdline_list
nodes.summary: Adds every commit of a commit_list to the command-line record with the same origin and flags.

nodes.name: ref_excluded
nodes.summary: Returns true if a ref name matches any --exclude wildmatch pattern or a configured hidden ref, so ref expansion options skip it.

nodes.name: init_ref_exclusions
nodes.summary: Initializes a ref_exclusions structure to its blank state.

nodes.name: clear_ref_exclusions
nodes.summary: Frees the excluded-ref patterns and hidden-ref list and resets the configured flag.

nodes.name: add_ref_exclusion
nodes.summary: Appends one wildmatch pattern to the list of excluded refs.

nodes.name: exclude_hidden_refs
nodes.summary: Loads transfer.hideRefs style configuration for fetch, receive or uploadpack into the exclusion set, rejecting unknown sections and repeated use.

nodes.name: handle_one_ref
nodes.summary: Callback for each ref during --all, --branches and similar options: skips excluded refs, loads the object, records it on the command line and queues it as pending.

nodes.name: handle_refs
nodes.summary: Runs a ref-iterator function over a ref store with handle_one_ref, tolerating a missing store such as an uninitialized submodule.

nodes.name: handle_one_reflog_commit
nodes.summary: Adds one reflog entry object id to the pending list, warning once per reflog if it references a pruned commit.

nodes.name: handle_one_reflog_ent
nodes.summary: Reflog entry callback that queues both the old and new object ids of the entry.

nodes.name: handle_one_reflog
nodes.summary: Iterates all entries of one worktree reflog, building the worktree-qualified ref name for diagnostics.

nodes.name: add_other_reflogs_to_pending
nodes.summary: Adds the reflogs of all linked worktrees other than the current one to the pending list.

nodes.name: add_reflogs_to_pending
nodes.summary: Implements --reflog: queues every object mentioned in the main reflogs and, unless --single-worktree, in other worktrees' reflogs.

nodes.name: add_cache_tree
nodes.summary: Recursively adds the tree objects recorded in the index cache-tree to the pending list with their paths.

nodes.name: add_resolve_undo_to_pending
nodes.summary: Queues the blobs recorded in the index resolve-undo extension (the three conflict stages) as pending objects with their paths.

nodes.name: do_add_index_objects_to_pending
nodes.summary: Queues every non-gitlink blob in an index plus its cache-tree and resolve-undo objects as pending, flagging them with the caller's flags.

nodes.name: add_index_objects_to_pending
nodes.summary: Implements --indexed-objects: queues objects of the repository index and of each other worktree's index.

nodes.name: add_one_alternate_ref
nodes.summary: Callback for each alternate repository ref tip that loads the object and adds it to the command line and pending list.

nodes.name: add_parents_only
nodes.summary: Implements the rev^@ and rev^-N notations: queues the parents of a commit (all, or all but a chosen one) with flags and command-line records.

nodes.name: repo_init_revisions
nodes.summary: Initializes a rev_info with defaults: wires the pruning diff callbacks, sets up grep, diff options, notes, object filters and ref exclusions.

nodes.name: add_pending_commit_list
nodes.summary: Queues every commit of a commit_list as a pending object with the given flags.

nodes.name: lookup_other_head
nodes.summary: Finds which of MERGE_HEAD, CHERRY_PICK_HEAD, REVERT_HEAD or REBASE_HEAD exists and returns its name and object id, dying if none does.

nodes.name: prepare_show_merge
nodes.summary: Sets up --merge: queues HEAD and the other head, excludes their merge bases, and narrows the pathspec to files that are unmerged in the index.

nodes.name: handle_dotdot_1
nodes.summary: Resolves both sides of A..B or A...B, adding exclusions and merge bases for the symmetric form and queuing both endpoints with the correct flags.

nodes.name: handle_dotdot
nodes.summary: Splits an argument at ".." or "..." and delegates to handle_dotdot_1, releasing the object contexts afterwards.

nodes.name: handle_revision_arg_1
nodes.summary: Parses one non-option revision argument: ranges, ^@, ^!, ^-N, leading ^, and plain names, then adds the resolved object to the pending list and the command-line record.

nodes.name: handle_revision_arg
nodes.summary: Public wrapper around handle_revision_arg_1 that records that at least one revision input was given.

nodes.name: parse_age
nodes.summary: Parses a seconds-since-epoch timestamp for --max-age and --min-age and dies if it is not a number.

nodes.name: overwrite_argv
nodes.summary: Moves a recognized-but-passed-through option into the unknown-options array, tracking ownership so the string is freed later.

nodes.name: handle_revision_opt
nodes.summary: Large option parser for rev-list style flags such as --max-count, --since, --first-parent, --ancestry-path, --topo-order, --graph, --grep, --pretty and --objects, setting rev_info fields and diff options.

nodes.name: parse_revision_opt
nodes.summary: parse-options adapter that applies handle_revision_opt to the current argument and errors with usage if the option is unknown.

nodes.name: revision_opts_finish
nodes.summary: Finalizes option interactions after parsing, such as rejecting --graph with --show-linear-break and forcing topo order and parent rewriting for --graph.

nodes.name: for_each_bisect_ref
nodes.summary: Iterates refs under refs/bisect/<term> for the given good or bad bisect term.

nodes.name: handle_revision_pseudo_opt
nodes.summary: Handles options that add revisions: --all, --branches, --tags, --remotes, --glob, --exclude, --reflog, --indexed-objects, --bisect, --not, --no-walk and --filter.

nodes.name: read_revisions_from_stdin
nodes.summary: Implements --stdin: reads revisions, pseudo-options and an optional "--" pathspec list from standard input.

nodes.name: diagnose_missing_default
nodes.summary: Prints a specific fatal message when the default revision (HEAD) cannot be resolved, distinguishing a broken branch from an unborn one.

nodes.name: setup_revisions
nodes.summary: Main entry for argument handling: splits revisions from pathspecs at "--", dispatches options and revisions, builds the pruning pathspec, applies the default revision and validates option combinations.

nodes.name: setup_revisions_from_strvec
nodes.summary: strvec-based wrapper of setup_revisions that marks removed argv strings to be freed with the rev_info and truncates the vector.

nodes.name: release_revisions
nodes.summary: Frees all resources owned by a rev_info: commit lists, queues, pending arrays, grep and diff options, decorations, reflog and topo-walk state.

nodes.name: remove_duplicate_parents
nodes.summary: Removes duplicate parents from a commit's parent list using TMP_MARK, keeping the per-parent treesame data in sync.

nodes.name: locate_simplify_state
nodes.summary: Returns (allocating on first use) the merge_simplify_state decoration that records what a commit simplifies to.

nodes.name: mark_redundant_parents
nodes.summary: Uses reduce_heads to find parents that are ancestors of other parents and marks them TMP_MARK for removal, returning how many were marked.

nodes.name: mark_treesame_root_parents
nodes.summary: Marks TREESAME root-commit parents of a merge as removable.

nodes.name: leave_one_treesame_to_parent
nodes.summary: Keeps one TREESAME parent unmarked when all TREESAME parents were marked for removal, so --simplify-merges retains the path the default walk would follow.

nodes.name: remove_marked_parents
nodes.summary: Deletes the TMP_MARK-ed parents of a commit, compacting treesame data and recomputing TREESAME if the commit can only have become more TREESAME.

nodes.name: simplify_one
nodes.summary: One step of --simplify-merges: once all relevant parents have simplified, rewrites the commit's parents, removes redundant or TREESAME parents and records what this commit simplifies to.

nodes.name: simplify_merges
nodes.summary: Drives --simplify-merges by iterating simplify_one over the limited list until fixed, then keeping only commits that simplify to themselves.

nodes.name: set_children
nodes.summary: Records the child list of each commit in the children decoration for --children.

nodes.name: reset_revision_walk
nodes.summary: Clears the SEEN, ADDED, SHOWN and topo-walk flags on all objects so another revision walk can run in the same process.

nodes.name: trace2_topo_walk_statistics_atexit
nodes.summary: At exit emits a trace2 JSON event with the number of commits visited by the explore, indegree and topo phases.

nodes.name: explore_walk_step
nodes.summary: Pops one commit from the explore queue, parses it, processes its parents and enqueues them, advancing the generation-number-aware exploration phase.

nodes.name: indegree_walk_step
nodes.summary: Pops one commit from the indegree queue and increments the in-degree of each parent, enqueuing parents, to count children for the topological sort.

nodes.name: release_revisions_topo_walk_info
nodes.summary: Frees the priority queues and slabs of a topo_walk_info.

nodes.name: init_topo_walk
nodes.summary: Sets up incremental topological ordering: chooses the queue comparator for the sort order, seeds explore and indegree queues from the tips, and computes initial indegrees using generation numbers.

nodes.name: next_topo_commit
nodes.summary: Pops the next commit from the topo queue and resets its indegree entry.

nodes.name: expand_topo_walk
nodes.summary: After a commit is emitted in topo order, processes its parents and decrements their indegree, queueing those that become ready.

nodes.name: rev_info_commit_list_to_queue
nodes.summary: Drains the revs->commits linked list into the commit priority queue.

nodes.name: prepare_revision_walk
nodes.summary: Turns pending objects into the initial commit list and prepares the walk: Bloom filters, date sort, limit_list or topological initialization, line-log filtering, merge simplification and children tracking.

nodes.name: rewrite_one_1
nodes.summary: Follows a TREESAME commit down through its single relevant parent chain, reporting ok, no-parents or error, to find the parent a commit should be rewritten to.

nodes.name: rewrite_parents
nodes.summary: Rewrites each parent of a commit with a callback (dropping parents that vanish) and then removes duplicate parents.

nodes.name: commit_match
nodes.summary: Applies --grep, --author, --committer and note filters to a commit by building a re-encoded message (with reflog, mailmap and notes text) and running grep over it.

nodes.name: commit_early_ignore
nodes.summary: Cheap checks that ignore a commit already shown, a non-maximal commit, one in a pack when --unpacked or kept, or UNINTERESTING.

nodes.name: get_commit_action
nodes.summary: Pure predicate deciding whether a commit is shown, ignored or an error, applying age, parent-count, grep and TREESAME (history simplification) rules.

nodes.name: save_parents
nodes.summary: Saves a copy of the original parent list in a commit slab (once per commit) so --full-diff can still see the true parents after simplification.

nodes.name: get_saved_parents
nodes.summary: Returns the original parent list saved before history simplification, or commit->parents when nothing was saved.

nodes.name: simplify_commit
nodes.summary: Per-commit step after traversal: folds -L line ranges, asks get_commit_action, and when ancestry is wanted saves and rewrites parents.

nodes.name: track_linear
nodes.summary: Maintains the linear flag for --show-linear-break by comparing each commit with the previous commit's parents.

nodes.name: get_walk_mode
nodes.summary: Classifies the current walk as reflog, topological, limited, no-walk or streaming from the rev_info state.

nodes.name: get_revision_1
nodes.summary: Produces the next commit of the walk according to the walk mode (reflog, topo, limited, no-walk or streaming), expands parents and applies simplify_commit, skipping ignored commits.

nodes.name: create_boundary_commit_list
nodes.summary: After the normal walk ends, builds the list of boundary commits (parents of shown commits that were not shown) and sorts it topologically.

nodes.name: get_revision_internal
nodes.summary: Wraps get_revision_1 with --max-count, --skip and --boundary handling, marking commits SHOWN and tracking boundary parents.

nodes.name: retrieve_oldest_commits
nodes.summary: Implements --max-count-oldest by running the walk to the end while keeping only the oldest N commits in two queues, then returning them in order.

nodes.name: next_commit_to_show
nodes.summary: Returns the next commit to display, either from the normal walk or from the pre-computed list of the --max-count-oldest stage.

nodes.name: get_revision
nodes.summary: Public iterator over the revision walk: handles --max-count-oldest and --reverse staging, graph lookahead and cleanup, returning commits until NULL.

nodes.name: get_revision_mark
nodes.summary: Returns the marker string for a commit in output: "-" boundary, "^" uninteresting, "=" patch-same, "<" or ">" for left-right, "*" for graph, "+" for cherry-mark.

nodes.name: put_revision_mark
nodes.summary: Prints the revision mark followed by a space to stdout when the mark is non-empty.

nodes.name: sequencer.c
nodes.summary: Implements the sequencer behind cherry-pick, revert and interactive rebase: todo script parsing and generation, the pick, merge and commit machinery, state files under .git/sequencer and rebase-merge, autostash and update-refs.
nodes.languageNotes: Large C file with GIT_PATH_FUNC macros that define path helpers and a static todo_command_info table indexed by the todo_command enum.

nodes.name: replay_ctx_new
nodes.summary: Allocates the private replay_ctx (message buffer, current fixup chain buffer, fixup count) that hangs off every replay_opts and holds sequencer state between picks.

nodes.name: git_sequencer_config
nodes.summary: Config callback that reads commit.cleanup, commit.gpgsign, pull.twohead and revert.reference into replay_opts, then falls through to the basic diff config.

nodes.name: sequencer_init_config
nodes.summary: Sets the default commit message cleanup mode and loads sequencer related configuration into a replay_opts before command line parsing.

nodes.name: has_conforming_footer
nodes.summary: Uses the trailer iterator to decide whether a commit message already ends in a trailer block and whether a given Signed-off-by line is present or last in it.

nodes.name: replay_opts_release
nodes.summary: Frees every owned member of a replay_opts (gpg key, strategy, xopts, revs, trailer args and the replay_ctx).

nodes.name: sequencer_remove_state
nodes.summary: Deletes the refs/rewritten labels recorded in refs-to-delete during an interactive rebase and then removes the whole sequencer or rebase-merge state directory.

nodes.name: action_name
nodes.summary: Returns the human readable action name ("revert", "cherry-pick" or "rebase") used in reflog and error messages.

nodes.name: get_message
nodes.summary: Fills a commit_message from a commit object: re-encoded log message, subject, and the "<abbrev> (<subject>)" and "parent of ..." labels used by the merge machinery.

nodes.name: print_advice
nodes.summary: Prints merge-conflict advice for a failed pick: the rebase resolve message or the GIT_CHERRY_PICK_HELP text when a porcelain drives the pick (and then removes CHERRY_PICK_HEAD), otherwise the cherry-pick or revert hints.

nodes.name: write_message
nodes.summary: Writes a buffer to a path under a lock file, optionally with a trailing newline, so that message and state files are updated atomically.

nodes.name: read_oneliner
nodes.summary: Reads a one line state file written by shell scripts, strips the last end of line and optionally skips empty or warns on missing files.

nodes.name: error_dirty_index
nodes.summary: Reports that the index differs from HEAD and prints advice before a cherry-pick or revert can start.

nodes.name: fast_forward_to
nodes.summary: Fast-forwards HEAD to a target commit by updating the working tree and index with checkout_fast_forward and then moving HEAD in a ref transaction with a reflog entry.

nodes.name: get_cleanup_mode
nodes.summary: Translates a --cleanup argument (strip, whitespace, verbatim, scissors, default) into a commit_msg_cleanup_mode value.

nodes.name: append_conflicts_hint
nodes.summary: Appends a commented "Conflicts:" list of unmerged index paths to a commit message so the editor shows what was conflicted.

nodes.name: do_recursive_merge
nodes.summary: Performs the three-way merge for a pick or revert with merge-ort (merge_incore_nonrecursive), switches the index and worktree to the result and reports whether it was clean.

nodes.name: is_index_unchanged
nodes.summary: Compares the cache tree of the index to the tree of HEAD (or the empty tree on an unborn branch) to see whether committing would create an empty commit.

nodes.name: write_author_script
nodes.summary: Extracts the author name, email and date from a commit message and writes them as shell-quoted GIT_AUTHOR_* assignments into the rebase author-script file.

nodes.name: parse_key_value_squoted
nodes.summary: Parses lines of KEY='value' with single-quote escaping from the author-script file into a string_list of key and value pairs.

nodes.name: read_author_script
nodes.summary: Reads and validates the author-script file and returns the stored author name, email and date, rejecting duplicate or unknown keys.

nodes.name: run_git_commit
nodes.summary: Builds and runs a child "git commit" with the flags for amend, edit, cleanup, signing, allow-empty and author date handling, used when the sequencer must hand control to the commit command.

nodes.name: cleanup_message
nodes.summary: Applies a cleanup mode to a message buffer (strip comments and whitespace, or cut at the scissors line) as git commit does.

nodes.name: message_is_empty
nodes.summary: Tells whether a commit message is empty after applying the cleanup mode, so an empty message can abort the commit.

nodes.name: template_untouched
nodes.summary: Checks whether an edited message still equals the unmodified commit template, which means the user gave no real message.

nodes.name: update_head_with_reflog
nodes.summary: Moves HEAD to a new commit in a ref transaction and writes a reflog line made of the action and the first line of the commit message.

nodes.name: run_rewrite_hook
nodes.summary: Runs the post-rewrite hook for a single old to new commit mapping after amend or rebase, feeding it through a pipe.

nodes.name: commit_post_rewrite
nodes.summary: After an amend, copies notes from the old to the new commit using the notes.rewrite configuration and runs the post-rewrite hook.

nodes.name: run_prepare_commit_msg_hook
nodes.summary: Runs the prepare-commit-msg hook on the commit message file with the right source argument and re-reads the result.

nodes.name: print_commit_summary
nodes.summary: Prints the "[branch hash] subject" summary line, author and committer notes, and a shortstat diff after a commit is created.

nodes.name: parse_head
nodes.summary: Resolves HEAD to a commit object and parses it, tolerating an unborn branch by returning no commit.

nodes.name: try_to_commit
nodes.summary: Creates a commit in-process from the current index: writes the tree, picks parents, runs prepare-commit-msg, applies cleanup, author and committer dates, writes the commit object with commit_tree_extended, updates HEAD and runs post-commit.

nodes.name: do_commit
nodes.summary: Commits the staged changes, either in-process via try_to_commit or by spawning "git commit", and prints the summary or advice.

nodes.name: is_original_commit_empty
nodes.summary: Tests whether the commit being picked introduced no change relative to its parent, by comparing tree object ids.

nodes.name: allow_empty
nodes.summary: Decides what to do when a pick leaves the index unchanged: keep it as an originally empty commit, keep or drop a redundant one, or stop for the user.

nodes.name: command_to_string
nodes.summary: Maps a todo_command enum value to its full word via todo_command_info, or to the comment prefix for comments.

nodes.name: update_squash_message_for_fixup
nodes.summary: Rewrites a combined fixup chain message so that earlier messages are commented out in the "This is a combination of N commits" text.

nodes.name: append_squash_message
nodes.summary: Appends the next commit message to the squash message buffer, adding the numbered "commit message #N" header and commenting out fixup messages.

nodes.name: update_squash_messages
nodes.summary: Maintains the squash-msg and fixup-msg files during a fixup or squash chain, building the combined message and tracking the current-fixups list.

nodes.name: flush_rewritten_pending
nodes.summary: Moves the pending list of rewritten commits to the final rewritten-list, mapping every pending old id to the newly created HEAD.

nodes.name: record_in_rewritten
nodes.summary: Appends a replaced commit id to the pending rewritten list and flushes it unless a fixup follows.

nodes.name: reflog_message
nodes.summary: Builds the GIT_REFLOG_ACTION text for a rebase step, such as "rebase (pick): subject".

nodes.name: do_pick_commit
nodes.summary: Core of cherry-pick, revert and rebase pick: checks the index, finds base and parent for merge commits, fast-forwards when allowed, merges via merge-ort or an external strategy, builds the message and commits, returning ok, conflicts, error or dropped.

nodes.name: prepare_revs
nodes.summary: Reverses the walk order for picked ranges and calls prepare_revision_walk on the replay revs.

nodes.name: read_and_refresh_cache
nodes.summary: Reads the index and refreshes stat data under a lock, failing early if the repository cannot be refreshed.

nodes.name: todo_list_release
nodes.summary: Frees a todo_list: its buffer, item array and counters.

nodes.name: append_new_todo
nodes.summary: Grows the todo_list item array by one entry and returns it.

nodes.name: todo_item_get_arg
nodes.summary: Returns a pointer to the argument text of a todo item inside the shared todo buffer.

nodes.name: sequencer_parse_todo_command
nodes.summary: Matches the command word at a position (full name, one-letter abbreviation or comment character) and returns the todo_command.

nodes.name: check_label_or_ref_arg
nodes.summary: Rejects invalid label, reset or update-ref names such as ones that are only a hash or contain bad characters.

nodes.name: check_merge_commit_insn
nodes.summary: Validates that a "merge" instruction has a legal form: -C or -c with a commit, or none.

nodes.name: parse_insn_line
nodes.summary: Parses one line of the todo script into a todo_item, resolving the commit named after pick, fixup, merge, label, reset, exec or update-ref commands.

nodes.name: sequencer_get_last_command
nodes.summary: Looks at the todo or opts files to tell whether the unfinished operation is a pick, revert or interactive rebase.

nodes.name: todo_list_parse_insn_buffer
nodes.summary: Parses a whole todo script buffer line by line into a todo_list, reporting errors per line and re-reading commit ids.

nodes.name: have_finished_the_last_pick
nodes.summary: Checks whether only the final pick remains in the sequencer todo file.

nodes.name: sequencer_post_commit_cleanup
nodes.summary: After a manual commit, removes CHERRY_PICK_HEAD, REVERT_HEAD and AUTO_MERGE and the sequencer directory when the last pick is done.

nodes.name: read_populate_todo
nodes.summary: Reads the todo file, parses it, checks commit ids and counts done and total steps for progress output.

nodes.name: populate_opts_cb
nodes.summary: Config style callback that reads keys of the sequencer opts file (edit, signoff, strategy, gpg-sign and so on) into replay_opts.

nodes.name: read_populate_opts
nodes.summary: Loads replay_opts from the sequencer opts file or from the many single-line files under rebase-merge, including gpg sign, strategy, rerere and trailer settings.

nodes.name: write_basic_state
nodes.summary: Writes the basic rebase-merge state files (head-name, onto, orig-head, quiet, verbose, strategy, gpg and signoff options) for an interactive rebase.

nodes.name: walk_revs_populate_todo
nodes.summary: Walks the revision list and fills the todo_list with a pick or revert item for each commit, using the abbreviated subject as the line text.

nodes.name: create_seq_dir
nodes.summary: Creates the sequencer directory, refusing when another cherry-pick, revert or rebase sequence is already in progress.

nodes.name: rollback_is_safe
nodes.summary: Compares the abort-safety file with the current HEAD so that "--abort" does not discard commits made after the sequence stopped.

nodes.name: sequencer_rollback
nodes.summary: Implements --abort for a multi-commit cherry-pick or revert: checks safety, resets the working tree and index to the saved HEAD and removes the state.

nodes.name: sequencer_skip
nodes.summary: Implements --skip: drops the current pick by resetting to HEAD and continues with the remaining todo items.

nodes.name: save_todo
nodes.summary: Writes the remaining todo items to the todo file under a lock and appends finished items to the done file for rebase -i.

nodes.name: save_opts
nodes.summary: Persists replay_opts to the sequencer opts file in config format so the sequence can be continued later.

nodes.name: make_patch
nodes.summary: Writes the stopped commit id, REBASE_HEAD and the patch of the commit being picked so that a stopped interactive rebase shows what failed.

nodes.name: error_with_patch
nodes.summary: Handles a stopped pick: records the message, calls make_patch, prints advice and returns the exit code that stops the sequencer.

nodes.name: error_failed_squash
nodes.summary: Handles a conflict in a fixup or squash step by copying the combined squash message into the rebase message and merge message files and then stopping through error_with_patch.

nodes.name: do_exec
nodes.summary: Runs an "exec" line of the todo script in a shell, re-reads the index and checks the worktree is clean afterward, stopping the rebase on failure.

nodes.name: safe_append
nodes.summary: Appends a formatted line to a file under a lock file, used for lists such as refs-to-delete.

nodes.name: do_label
nodes.summary: Implements "label": creates refs/rewritten/<name> pointing at HEAD in a ref transaction and records the ref for later deletion.

nodes.name: lookup_label
nodes.summary: Resolves a label name to a commit, falling back from refs/rewritten/<label> to an ordinary revision name.

nodes.name: do_reset
nodes.summary: Implements "reset": resolves a label or commit (or the "[new root]" fake commit), then runs unpack_trees to switch the index and worktree to its tree and moves HEAD.

nodes.name: do_merge
nodes.summary: Implements "merge" in a rebase: resolves the merge parents by label, fast-forwards if possible, otherwise runs merge-ort or an external strategy and commits a real merge commit.

nodes.name: write_update_refs_state
nodes.summary: Writes the list of branch refs and their before and after object ids to the update-refs file of a rebase.

nodes.name: todo_list_filter_update_refs
nodes.summary: Reconciles the update-refs state with the todo list, dropping refs that no longer appear and adding new ones, then rewrites the state file.

nodes.name: do_update_ref
nodes.summary: Implements the "update-ref" todo command by recording the current HEAD as the new value for a branch.

nodes.name: do_update_refs
nodes.summary: At the end of a rebase, moves each branch recorded in update-refs to its rewritten commit with a compare-and-swap ref update and reports failures.

nodes.name: create_autostash_internal
nodes.summary: Stashes uncommitted changes with "git stash create", records the stash commit id in a file or a ref, and resets the worktree hard, as --autostash needs.

nodes.name: create_autostash
nodes.summary: Creates an autostash whose commit id is stored in the given file.

nodes.name: create_autostash_ref
nodes.summary: Creates an autostash whose commit id is stored in a ref, with a custom message and an option to stay silent.

nodes.name: do_stash_apply
nodes.summary: Runs "git stash apply" with optional ours, theirs and base labels on a stash commit and maps the exit status to a stash_apply_result.

nodes.name: apply_save_autostash_oid
nodes.summary: Optionally applies an autostash commit; when it conflicts or is not applied, stores it as an ordinary stash entry with "git stash store" and prints advice so the changes are not lost.

nodes.name: apply_save_autostash
nodes.summary: Reads the autostash id from a file, applies it, and removes the file.

nodes.name: apply_autostash_oid
nodes.summary: Public wrapper to apply an autostash given its stash commit id.

nodes.name: apply_save_autostash_ref
nodes.summary: Resolves an autostash ref, applies it with merge labels, and deletes the ref when it was applied.

nodes.name: checkout_onto
nodes.summary: Detaches HEAD at the onto commit at the start of a rebase through reset_working_tree, updating ORIG_HEAD, the reflog and running the post-checkout hook.

nodes.name: stopped_at_head
nodes.summary: Prints the commit rebase stopped at ("Stopped at <hash>") and returns the stop status for edit and break commands.

nodes.name: reread_todo_if_changed
nodes.summary: Detects that the user edited the todo file during an exec and re-parses it so changes take effect immediately.

nodes.name: pick_one_commit
nodes.summary: Runs do_pick_commit for one todo item and translates the result into continue, stop for editing, reschedule or error, recording the commit as rewritten.

nodes.name: pick_commits
nodes.summary: Main loop of the sequencer: iterates the todo list, saves state before each step, dispatches pick, exec, label, reset, merge and update-ref, and finishes with post-rewrite hooks, autostash and update-refs.

nodes.name: continue_single_pick
nodes.summary: Resumes a single-commit cherry-pick or revert after conflicts were resolved by running "git commit".

nodes.name: commit_staged_changes
nodes.summary: On "rebase --continue", commits staged changes, applying the stored message, amend and fixup state, and checks for unstaged changes or an unfinished squash.

nodes.name: sequencer_continue
nodes.summary: Implements --continue for cherry-pick, revert and rebase -i: reloads options and todo, commits what was staged and resumes pick_commits.

nodes.name: single_pick
nodes.summary: Applies a single commit as "git cherry-pick <commit>" without touching the sequencer state directory.

nodes.name: sequencer_pick_revisions
nodes.summary: Entry point of cherry-pick and revert: validates the named revisions, handles the single-commit case, otherwise builds the todo list, saves state and runs pick_commits.

nodes.name: sequencer_format_revert_message
nodes.summary: Formats a revert commit message ("Revert \"subject\"" or "Reapply" with "This reverts commit ...") using either the full hash or an abbreviated reference with date.

nodes.name: append_signoff
nodes.summary: Adds a Signed-off-by trailer for the committer to a message, placed after existing trailers and deduplicated when the flag asks.

nodes.name: label_oid
nodes.summary: Chooses a unique, valid label name for a commit when generating a rebase-merges script, from a branch decoration or the commit subject, and records it.

nodes.name: make_script_with_merges
nodes.summary: Generates the todo script for "rebase --rebase-merges": walks commits in topological order, emits pick, label, reset and merge lines for the branch structure and handles cousins and root-with-onto.

nodes.name: sequencer_make_script
nodes.summary: Builds the default interactive rebase todo script from a revision range, picking linear commits or delegating to make_script_with_merges.

nodes.name: todo_list_add_exec_commands
nodes.summary: Inserts the user supplied "exec" lines after each pick (and its fixup chain) in the todo list for --exec.

nodes.name: todo_list_to_strbuf
nodes.summary: Serializes a todo list to text with optional abbreviated commands and ids, optionally shortening commit names.

nodes.name: todo_list_write_to_file
nodes.summary: Writes the todo list, with revision and onto help text appended, to a file for the user to edit.

nodes.name: skip_unnecessary_picks
nodes.summary: Skips leading picks whose parent is already the base, moving them to the done file and advancing the base, so fast-forwardable commits are not replayed.

nodes.name: add_decorations_to_list
nodes.summary: Adds "update-ref" lines after commits that have local branch decorations so --update-refs can move those branches.

nodes.name: todo_list_add_update_ref_commands
nodes.summary: Walks the todo list and inserts update-ref commands for branches pointing into the rebased range.

nodes.name: complete_action
nodes.summary: Finishes preparing an interactive rebase: adds update-ref, autosquash and exec lines, opens the editor on the todo list, checks it and starts the sequencer.

nodes.name: todo_list_rearrange_squash
nodes.summary: Implements --autosquash by moving "fixup!" and "squash!" commits after their target commit in the todo list using a subject hashmap.

nodes.name: sequencer_determine_whence
nodes.summary: Inspects CHERRY_PICK_HEAD, the sequencer dir and REBASE_HEAD to say whether the commit in progress is a single cherry-pick, a multi-pick or a rebase pick, returning 0 when none is in progress.

nodes.name: sequencer_get_update_refs_state
nodes.summary: Reads the update-refs state file of a worktree into a string_list of refs with their before and after object ids.

nodes.name: apply_autostash_ref
nodes.summary: Public wrapper that applies an autostash ref with merge labels and stash message, then removes the ref.

nodes.name: get_author
nodes.summary: Extracts the "author" header line from a commit buffer and returns a copy for reuse when amending.

nodes.name: get_cache_tree_oid
nodes.summary: Returns the tree object id of the index root from the cache tree, or null when it is not valid.

nodes.name: rebase_path_update_refs
nodes.summary: Builds the path of the update-refs file under a worktree git directory.

nodes.name: init_update_ref_record
nodes.summary: Allocates an update_ref_record and initializes its before value from the current ref.

nodes.name: empty_tree
nodes.summary: Returns the parsed empty tree object of the repository.

nodes.name: get_dir
nodes.summary: Returns the state directory of the current operation, rebase-merge or sequencer.

nodes.name: get_todo_path
nodes.summary: Returns the path of the todo file for the current operation.

nodes.name: gpg_sign_opt_quoted
nodes.summary: Returns the -S gpg sign option quoted for inclusion in advice text.

nodes.name: replay_ctx
nodes.summary: Private state of the sequencer: the commit message under construction, the buffer of completed fixups in the current chain, their count and a have_message flag.

nodes.name: update_ref_record
nodes.summary: Pair of object ids (before and after) stored per branch ref for the rebase --update-refs feature.

nodes.name: commit_message
nodes.summary: Holds the pieces of a loaded commit used while picking: the re-encoded message, its subject, a display label and the label of its parent.

nodes.name: labels_entry
nodes.summary: Hashmap entry that maps a label name to the commit id it was given while generating a rebase-merges script.

nodes.name: string_entry
nodes.summary: Oidmap entry carrying a string, used to map commit ids to labels or todo lines.

nodes.name: label_state
nodes.summary: Bookkeeping for label generation: commit-to-label map, set of used labels, scratch buffer and maximum label length.

nodes.name: subject2item_entry
nodes.summary: Hashmap entry that maps a commit subject to its index in the todo list for --autosquash lookups.

nodes.name: sequencer.h
nodes.summary: Public interface of the sequencer: replay options, todo list structures and commands, and the entry points used by cherry-pick, revert and interactive rebase.

nodes.name: replay_action
nodes.summary: Kinds of replayed operation: revert, pick (cherry-pick) and interactive rebase.

nodes.name: commit_msg_cleanup_mode
nodes.summary: How a commit message is cleaned up: space, none, scissors or all.

nodes.name: replay_opts
nodes.summary: Options of a cherry-pick, revert or rebase -i run: edit, signoff, strategy, gpg sign, cleanup, trailers, reflog action and the private replay_ctx.

nodes.name: todo_command
nodes.summary: Commands of the rebase todo script (pick, revert, edit, reword, fixup, squash, exec, break, label, reset, merge, update-ref, noop, drop, comment), ordered by section.

nodes.name: todo_item
nodes.summary: One line of the todo script: command, commit, flags and the offset and length of its argument in the shared buffer.

nodes.name: todo_list
nodes.summary: The parsed todo script: text buffer, array of items, current position and done and total counts.

nodes.name: shortlog.h
nodes.summary: Declares struct shortlog and the functions that collect commits grouped by author, committer or trailer and print the git shortlog summary.

nodes.name: shortlog
nodes.summary: State of a shortlog run: per-author string_list, output formatting options (summary, wrap, sort by number), grouping flags (author, committer, trailer, format) and mailmap.

nodes.name: string-list.h
nodes.summary: The string_list API: an array of strings with an optional util pointer per item, usable as an unsorted list or as a sorted set keyed by string.

nodes.name: string_list_item
nodes.summary: One entry of a string_list: the string and an arbitrary util pointer.

nodes.name: string_list
nodes.summary: Growable array of string_list_item with a strdup flag and an optional comparison function; sorted or unsorted use.

nodes.name: tag.h
nodes.summary: Declares struct tag, the in-memory form of an annotated tag object, with parsing, lookup, dereferencing and signature verification functions.

nodes.name: tag
nodes.summary: In-memory annotated tag object: the tagged object, tag name and tagger date.

nodes.name: trailer.c
nodes.summary: Implements commit message trailers: locating the trailer block, parsing trailer lines, applying trailer.* configuration and ifExists/ifMissing policies, and formatting or adding trailers for interpret-trailers and commit --trailer.

nodes.name: after_or_end
nodes.summary: Tells whether a trailer placement (after or end) means insertion walks the list from the end backwards.

nodes.name: same_token
nodes.summary: Compares an existing trailer token with a configured or command line one, using the configured key prefix and token length ignoring the separator.

nodes.name: same_value
nodes.summary: Compares the values of an input trailer and an argument trailer for exact equality.

nodes.name: same_trailer
nodes.summary: Returns true when both token and value of two trailers are equal.

nodes.name: free_trailer_item
nodes.summary: Frees the token and value of a parsed trailer_item and the item itself.

nodes.name: free_arg_item
nodes.summary: Frees an arg_item together with the configuration strings it owns.

nodes.name: trailer_from_arg
nodes.summary: Converts an arg_item into a trailer_item, transferring ownership of token and value.

nodes.name: add_arg_to_input_list
nodes.summary: Inserts a new trailer into the parsed trailer list after or before a given position.

nodes.name: check_if_different
nodes.summary: Scans neighbouring (or all) trailers with the same token to see whether the new value already appears, for add-if-different policies.

nodes.name: apply_command
nodes.summary: Runs the trailer.<token>.cmd or .command shell command (substituting $ARG) and captures its output as a trailer value.

nodes.name: apply_item_command
nodes.summary: Replaces an argument trailer value with the output of its configured command, passing the existing value as argument.

nodes.name: apply_arg_if_exists
nodes.summary: Applies the ifExists policy (replace, add, add-if-different, add-if-different-neighbor, do-nothing) when a trailer with the same token is already present.

nodes.name: apply_arg_if_missing
nodes.summary: Applies the ifMissing policy (add or do nothing) and places the new trailer at start, end, before or after according to the where setting.

nodes.name: find_same_and_apply_arg
nodes.summary: Finds an existing trailer with the same token, searching forward or backward by placement, and delegates to apply_arg_if_exists.

nodes.name: process_trailers_lists
nodes.summary: Merges the configured and command line argument trailers into the parsed trailer list, one at a time, applying the exists and missing policies.

nodes.name: trailer_set_where
nodes.summary: Parses a "where" setting (after, before, end, start) into a trailer_where enum.

nodes.name: trailer_set_if_exists
nodes.summary: Parses an ifExists setting into the trailer_if_exists enum.

nodes.name: trailer_set_if_missing
nodes.summary: Parses an ifMissing setting into the trailer_if_missing enum.

nodes.name: duplicate_conf
nodes.summary: Deep copies a conf_info so a token specific entry can start from the defaults.

nodes.name: get_conf_item
nodes.summary: Looks up or creates the arg_item that holds configuration for a trailer.<name>.* section.

nodes.name: git_trailer_default_config
nodes.summary: Config callback for the trailer.* default keys (where, ifexists, ifmissing, separators).

nodes.name: git_trailer_config
nodes.summary: Config callback for the per trailer keys trailer.<token>.key, command, cmd, where, ifexists and ifmissing.

nodes.name: trailer_config_init
nodes.summary: Loads all trailer related configuration once into the global configuration list.

nodes.name: token_matches_item
nodes.summary: Checks whether a token typed on the command line or in a message matches a configured trailer by name or key prefix.

nodes.name: find_separator
nodes.summary: Finds the first separator character in a line (default colon), allowing only token characters before it.

nodes.name: parse_trailer
nodes.summary: Splits a trailer line or argument into token and value around the separator, applying a configured key when a token matches.

nodes.name: add_trailer_item
nodes.summary: Appends a trailer_item with token and value to a list.

nodes.name: add_arg_item
nodes.summary: Creates an arg_item from a token and value and attaches the matching configuration before adding it to the list.

nodes.name: parse_trailers_from_config
nodes.summary: Creates arg items for configured trailers that have a command, so they are added automatically.

nodes.name: parse_trailers_from_command_line_args
nodes.summary: Parses each --trailer argument (key=value or key:value) into arg items, applying configuration and placement overrides.

nodes.name: validate_trailer_args
nodes.summary: Checks that every command line trailer argument has a valid token before any commit work is done.

nodes.name: last_line
nodes.summary: Finds the start offset of the last line in a buffer.

nodes.name: find_end_of_log_message
nodes.summary: Returns where the log message ends by skipping the "---" patch divider and ignorable trailing bytes.

nodes.name: find_trailer_block_start
nodes.summary: Scans backward from the end of a message to find the first line of the trailer block using the 25 percent rule, recognised prefixes and continuation lines.

nodes.name: ends_with_blank_line
nodes.summary: Tells whether the text before a given offset ends in a blank line.

nodes.name: unfold_value
nodes.summary: Unfolds a multi-line trailer value into a single line by collapsing continuation whitespace.

nodes.name: trailer_block_new
nodes.summary: Allocates an empty trailer_block.

nodes.name: trailer_block_get
nodes.summary: Locates the trailer block of a message, splits it into trailer strings and joins continuation lines.

nodes.name: parse_trailers
nodes.summary: Parses a message into a trailer_block and fills a list of trailer_items (token and value, or a raw line) for later formatting.

nodes.name: free_trailers
nodes.summary: Frees a whole list of trailer_items.

nodes.name: trailer_block_start
nodes.summary: Returns the offset where the trailer block starts.

nodes.name: trailer_block_end
nodes.summary: Returns the offset where the trailer block ends.

nodes.name: blank_line_before_trailer_block
nodes.summary: Reports whether a blank line precedes the trailer block.

nodes.name: trailer_block_release
nodes.summary: Frees a trailer_block and its trailer strings.

nodes.name: format_trailers
nodes.summary: Writes a trailer list to a strbuf applying options such as filter, unfold, key-only, value-only, trim-empty and custom separators.

nodes.name: format_trailers_from_commit
nodes.summary: Parses the trailers of a commit message and formats them into a strbuf, as used by pretty format %(trailers).

nodes.name: trailer_iterator_init
nodes.summary: Starts an iterator over the trailers of a message by parsing the trailer block.

nodes.name: trailer_iterator_advance
nodes.summary: Advances to the next trailer and exposes its raw line, key and value.

nodes.name: trailer_iterator_release
nodes.summary: Frees the state of a trailer iterator.

nodes.name: trailer_create_in_place_tempfile
nodes.summary: Creates a temporary file next to a target so a file can be rewritten in place with an atomic rename.

nodes.name: amend_strbuf_with_trailers
nodes.summary: Adds the --trailer arguments to a commit message buffer in memory, creating new trailer items and processing them against the existing block.

nodes.name: write_file_in_place
nodes.summary: Writes a buffer to a path through a tempfile and commits it by rename, preserving the file mode.

nodes.name: amend_file_with_trailers
nodes.summary: Reads a file, adds trailers to its content and writes it back in place.

nodes.name: process_trailers
nodes.summary: Main entry for interpret-trailers: parses the input, merges config and command line trailers, and prints text before the block, the trailer block, and the rest.

nodes.name: trailer_block
nodes.summary: Result of locating a trailer block in a message: start and end offsets, whether a blank line precedes it, and the array of trailer strings.

nodes.name: conf_info
nodes.summary: Per trailer configuration: name, key, command, cmd, where, ifExists and ifMissing settings.

nodes.name: trailer_item
nodes.summary: A parsed trailer in a doubly linked list, with token and value (token NULL for non-trailer lines).

nodes.name: arg_item
nodes.summary: A trailer to add from config or the command line, with its token, value and conf_info.

nodes.name: trailer.h
nodes.summary: Public API of the trailer module: enums for trailer placement and policy, option structs, and functions to parse, format, iterate and add trailers in commit messages.

nodes.name: trailer_where
nodes.summary: Where a new trailer goes: default, end, after, before or start.

nodes.name: trailer_if_exists
nodes.summary: What to do when a trailer with the same token exists: add, replace, add-if-different (or neighbor), or do nothing.

nodes.name: trailer_if_missing
nodes.summary: What to do when no trailer with the token exists: add or do nothing.

nodes.name: new_trailer_item
nodes.summary: A trailer requested by the caller, as text plus where, ifExists and ifMissing settings.

nodes.name: process_trailer_options
nodes.summary: Options for formatting and processing trailers: in-place, trim-empty, only-trailers, unfold, key-only, separators and a filter callback.

nodes.name: trailer_iterator
nodes.summary: State for iterating over the trailers of a message, exposing raw line, key and value.

nodes.name: utf8.h
nodes.summary: Declares UTF-8 and encoding helpers: display width, validation, BOM handling, re-encoding via iconv, text wrapping and alignment, and HFS .git name checks.

nodes.name: align_type
nodes.summary: Alignment choice (left, middle, right) for strbuf_utf8_align.

nodes.name: wildmatch.h
nodes.summary: Declares wildmatch(), Git's glob pattern matcher, and its flags and result codes.

nodes.name: wt-status.h
nodes.summary: Declares the working tree status model (struct wt_status and wt_status_state), output formats and helpers used by git status, commit and the sequencer to detect in-progress operations and dirty trees.

nodes.name: color_wt_status
nodes.summary: Color slots for status output (header, updated, changed, untracked, branch, unmerged).

nodes.name: untracked_status_type
nodes.summary: How untracked files are shown: none, normal or all.

nodes.name: show_ignored_type
nodes.summary: How ignored files are shown: none, traditional or matching.

nodes.name: commit_whence
nodes.summary: Origin of a commit in progress: normal commit, merge, single or multi cherry-pick, or rebase pick.

nodes.name: wt_status_change_data
nodes.summary: Per path change record: worktree and index status, modes, object ids, rename info and submodule flags.

nodes.name: wt_status_format
nodes.summary: Output formats of git status: long, short, porcelain and porcelain v2.

nodes.name: wt_status_state
nodes.summary: Flags and values describing an operation in progress: merge, am, rebase, cherry-pick, revert, bisect, detached HEAD and sparse checkout.

nodes.name: wt_status
nodes.summary: Complete status request and result: repository, pathspec, display options, in-progress state, and lists of changed, untracked and ignored paths.

nodes.name: xdiff.h
nodes.summary: Public interface of the bundled xdiff library: diff and merge flags, buffer and parameter structs, and the xdl_diff and xdl_merge entry points.

nodes.name: s_mmfile
nodes.summary: mmfile_t: a pointer and size describing an in-memory file to diff.

nodes.name: s_mmbuffer
nodes.summary: mmbuffer_t: a pointer and size of an output buffer chunk.

nodes.name: s_xpparam
nodes.summary: xpparam_t: diff preprocessing parameters, including algorithm and whitespace flags, ignore regexes and anchors.

nodes.name: s_xdemitcb
nodes.summary: xdemitcb_t: callbacks that receive hunks and lines of diff output.

nodes.name: s_xdemitconf
nodes.summary: xdemitconf_t: output configuration such as context length, function context and hunk callback.

nodes.name: s_xmparam
nodes.summary: xmparam_t: three-way merge parameters: conflict marker size, level, favor, style and labels.

nodes.name: xmacros.h
nodes.summary: Small internal macros of xdiff: min, max, abs, digit and space tests, hash helpers, little endian get and put, and array allocation helpers.

nodes.name: pack-objects.c
nodes.summary: Implements git pack-objects: enumerates the objects to send (revision walk, bitmaps, path-walk, stdin lists, cruft), picks delta bases with a sliding window across threads, and writes a packfile or .idx pair, reusing existing pack data where it can.
nodes.languageNotes: Large builtin with file-scope globals for options; object entries live in a struct packing_data (to_pack) that stores several fields in side arrays to save memory.

nodes.name: get_delta
nodes.summary: Recomputes a delta between an entry and its base by reading both objects and running diff_delta, bugging if the size differs from the one recorded earlier.

nodes.name: oe_delta
nodes.summary: Returns the delta base entry of an object_entry from the packing_data side table, translating the stored 1-based index to a pointer.

nodes.name: oe_delta_size
nodes.summary: Returns the stored delta size of an entry, or reads it from the delta_size side array when it did not fit the inline bitfield.

nodes.name: oe_size
nodes.summary: Returns the object size from the inline field when valid, otherwise falls back to oe_get_size_slow to read it from the pack.

nodes.name: oe_set_delta
nodes.summary: Sets or clears an entry's delta base by storing a 1-based index into to_pack.objects.

nodes.name: oe_delta_sibling
nodes.summary: Returns the next delta sibling of an entry in the intrusive delta child/sibling tree.

nodes.name: oe_delta_child
nodes.summary: Returns the first object that is deltified against this entry.

nodes.name: oe_set_delta_child
nodes.summary: Stores the first-child link of an entry in the delta tree as an index into the object array.

nodes.name: oe_set_delta_sibling
nodes.summary: Stores the next-sibling link of an entry in the delta tree as an index into the object array.

nodes.name: oe_set_size
nodes.summary: Records an object's size inline when it fits in the bitfield, else allocates the size side array and stores it there.

nodes.name: oe_set_delta_size
nodes.summary: Records the delta size inline or in the delta_size side array, marking whether it overflowed the inline width.

nodes.name: validate_name_hash_version
nodes.summary: Validates --name-hash-version (must be 1 or 2) and forces version 1 when writing a bitmap index, which only supports it.

nodes.name: pack_name_hash_fn
nodes.summary: Hashes a path with the selected name-hash version and aborts if the version changes mid-process.

nodes.name: do_compress
nodes.summary: Deflates a buffer with the configured pack compression level and returns the compressed length.

nodes.name: write_large_blob_data
nodes.summary: Streams a large blob out of the object database through zlib deflate straight into the pack hashfile without loading it whole.

nodes.name: check_pack_inflate
nodes.summary: Inflates a reused pack entry to verify it is not corrupt and has the expected size before it is copied verbatim.

nodes.name: copy_pack_data
nodes.summary: Copies a byte range from an existing pack window into the output hashfile.

nodes.name: oe_size_greater_than
nodes.summary: Compares an entry's size to a limit, using the size_limit shortcut before falling back to a pack read.

nodes.name: write_no_reuse_object
nodes.summary: Writes one object into the pack from scratch: reads or streams the content, optionally deltifies against its base, deflates it and emits the pack entry header.

nodes.name: write_reuse_object
nodes.summary: Copies an object's existing on-disk pack representation into the new pack, adjusting delta base references and verifying CRC when needed.

nodes.name: write_object
nodes.summary: Chooses between reusing the on-disk representation and writing the object anew, enforces the pack size limit and records its offset and CRC32.

nodes.name: write_one
nodes.summary: Writes an object after first writing its delta base (recursively), so bases precede deltas in the pack.

nodes.name: mark_tagged
nodes.summary: Ref iterator callback that flags objects (and their peeled targets) pointed to by tags so they can be placed first in write order.

nodes.name: oe_layer
nodes.summary: Returns the delta-island layer of an entry from the layer side array.

nodes.name: add_to_write_order
nodes.summary: Appends an entry to the write order unless already filled or in a different layer.

nodes.name: add_descendants_to_write_order
nodes.summary: Walks the delta tree depth-first from an entry and adds it and its delta descendants to the write order.

nodes.name: add_family_to_write_order
nodes.summary: Finds the root of an entry's delta chain and adds the root and all its descendants to the write order.

nodes.name: compute_layer_order
nodes.summary: Builds the write order for one layer: untagged commits first, then tagged objects, trees and blobs, keeping delta families together.

nodes.name: compute_write_order
nodes.summary: Allocates and computes the full recency-based write order of all objects, layer by layer, for locality in the final pack.

nodes.name: record_reused_object
nodes.summary: Records a (original offset, shift) pair when reused data moves, so later delta offsets can be adjusted.

nodes.name: find_reused_offset
nodes.summary: Binary-searches the reused chunk table to find how far an original pack offset has shifted in the new pack.

nodes.name: write_reused_pack_one
nodes.summary: Copies one object from a bitmap-selected reused pack, rewriting an OFS_DELTA offset or converting a REF_DELTA when the base moved.

nodes.name: write_reused_pack_verbatim
nodes.summary: Copies whole runs of fully-reused objects from the reuse packfile byte-for-byte, falling back to per-object copy at boundaries.

nodes.name: write_reused_pack
nodes.summary: Writes the objects chosen for reuse from a bitmapped pack, using verbatim copy where possible, then per-object copy for the rest.

nodes.name: write_excluded_by_configs
nodes.summary: Prints one line per configured excluded pack (pack hash and URI) to stdout so a client can fetch those packs separately via packfile URIs.

nodes.name: write_pack_file
nodes.summary: Main output loop: writes pack header, each object in write order, handles --max-pack-size splitting, finalizes checksum, writes .idx, .rev and bitmap, and moves the files into place.

nodes.name: no_try_delta
nodes.summary: Checks the 'delta' gitattribute for a path to decide whether the object should be excluded from delta search.

nodes.name: have_duplicate_entry
nodes.summary: Detects whether an object is already in the packing list (or covered by the reuse bitmap) and updates its exclude flag.

nodes.name: want_cruft_object_mtime
nodes.summary: Decides whether a cruft object should be included based on its mtime relative to kept packs in each object source.

nodes.name: want_found_object
nodes.summary: Applies the --local, --incremental and kept-pack rules to an object found in a given pack and picks which pack to read it from.

nodes.name: want_object_in_pack_one
nodes.summary: Checks one pack for an object and applies want_found_object to decide whether it should be packed from there.

nodes.name: want_object_in_pack_mtime
nodes.summary: Searches all packs (with MRU caching) for an object and decides if it belongs in the new pack, returning the chosen pack and offset.

nodes.name: want_object_in_pack
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper over want_object_in_pack_mtime with no mtime constraint.

nodes.name: create_object_entry
nodes.summary: Allocates a new entry in to_pack for an object, filling in type, name hash, delta-islands data and its source pack.

nodes.name: add_object_entry
nodes.summary: Adds an object to the packing list unless it is a duplicate or filtered out, creating its object_entry.

nodes.name: add_object_entry_from_bitmap
nodes.summary: Bitmap walk callback that adds each object reported by the bitmap index to the packing list.

nodes.name: pbase_tree_cache_ix
nodes.summary: Maps a tree object ID to its slot in the small preferred-base tree cache.

nodes.name: pbase_tree_cache_ix_incr
nodes.summary: Advances to the next slot of the preferred-base tree cache for linear probing.

nodes.name: pbase_tree_get
nodes.summary: Looks up or reads a tree object into the preferred-base tree cache, evicting an unreferenced slot when needed.

nodes.name: pbase_tree_put
nodes.summary: Releases a reference to a cached tree, freeing it if it was a temporary entry.

nodes.name: name_cmp_len
nodes.summary: Returns the length of the leading path component of a name (up to newline or slash).

nodes.name: add_pbase_object
nodes.summary: Descends a preferred-base tree along a path and adds the matching entries to the packing list as likely delta bases.

nodes.name: done_pbase_path_pos
nodes.summary: Binary search in the sorted array of path hashes already processed for preferred bases.

nodes.name: check_pbase_path
nodes.summary: Returns whether a path hash was already handled and inserts it into the sorted done list if not.

nodes.name: add_preferred_base_object
nodes.summary: For a path, walks every cached preferred-base tree to add objects at that path as delta base candidates.

nodes.name: add_preferred_base
nodes.summary: Registers an edge tree (from the other side of a thin pack) as a preferred base and caches it, bounded by the delta window.

nodes.name: cleanup_preferred_base
nodes.summary: Frees all preferred-base trees, cache slots and the done-path list.

nodes.name: can_reuse_delta
nodes.summary: Decides whether an on-disk delta can be sent as-is, checking that the base is also being sent or is allowed as an external base.

nodes.name: prefetch_to_pack
nodes.summary: Batch-fetches missing promisor objects for entries added to the packing list so later reads do not fetch one by one.

nodes.name: check_object
nodes.summary: Inspects an entry's on-disk form to learn its type and size and whether its existing delta can be reused, populating the delta tree.

nodes.name: pack_offset_sort
nodes.summary: Comparator ordering entries by pack, then offset, to read packs sequentially.

nodes.name: drop_reused_delta
nodes.summary: Removes a planned reused delta: unlinks from the sibling list, restores real size and type, resets depth.

nodes.name: break_delta_chains
nodes.summary: Depth-first walk of reused delta chains that cuts cycles and chains exceeding --depth.

nodes.name: get_object_details
nodes.summary: Runs check_object over all entries in pack offset order and then breaks delta cycles and sets the delta depth.

nodes.name: type_size_sort
nodes.summary: Comparator that orders objects by type, name hash, size and recency for the delta window search.

nodes.name: delta_cacheable
nodes.summary: Decides whether a computed delta is worth caching in memory given size ratio and the delta cache limit.

nodes.name: oe_size_less_than
nodes.summary: Compares an entry's size to a limit with the same size-limit shortcut as oe_size_greater_than.

nodes.name: oe_set_tree_depth
nodes.summary: Stores the tree depth of an entry in a lazily allocated side array.

nodes.name: record_tree_depth
nodes.summary: Computes a tree's depth from its path (number of slashes) and records it for later delta-island ordering.

nodes.name: oe_get_size_slow
nodes.summary: Reads an object's real size from its pack entry header (delta data size for deltas) when it is not stored inline.

nodes.name: try_delta
nodes.summary: Attempts to create a delta of one window entry against another, applying size, depth and cache heuristics and keeping it if smaller.

nodes.name: check_delta_limit
nodes.summary: Recursively finds the maximum depth under an entry in the delta tree to enforce the depth limit.

nodes.name: free_unpacked
nodes.summary: Frees an unpacked window slot's delta index and data buffer and returns the memory freed.

nodes.name: find_deltas
nodes.summary: Sliding-window search over a sorted list: for each object loads it and tries to delta it against previous window entries, writing the best delta.
