nodes.name: init_threaded_search
nodes.summary: Initializes the mutexes and condition variable used by the threaded delta search.

nodes.name: cleanup_threaded_search
nodes.summary: Destroys the mutexes and condition variable of the threaded delta search.

nodes.name: threaded_find_deltas
nodes.summary: Thread entry that repeatedly takes a slice of the work list and runs find_deltas on it, waiting for work-stealing when idle.

nodes.name: ll_find_deltas
nodes.summary: Splits the delta candidates across threads, balances work with progressive re-splitting and joins the threads.

nodes.name: add_tag_chain
nodes.summary: Adds an annotated tag and the chain of tags it points to when the pointed-to object is in the pack.

nodes.name: add_ref_tag
nodes.summary: Ref iterator callback implementing --include-tag: adds tag objects whose peeled target is being packed.

nodes.name: should_attempt_deltas
nodes.summary: Decides whether an object is a delta candidate: skips reused deltas, tiny objects, no-delta attributes and non-valid types.

nodes.name: find_deltas_for_region
nodes.summary: Path-walk delta search for one region: collects eligible entries and runs find_deltas on that list.

nodes.name: find_deltas_by_region
nodes.summary: Runs path-walk delta search over a slice of regions with progress reporting.

nodes.name: threaded_find_deltas_by_path
nodes.summary: Thread entry that claims regions from a shared queue and runs find_deltas_by_region on them.

nodes.name: ll_find_deltas_by_region
nodes.summary: Distributes path-walk regions among worker threads, with work stealing, for the by-path delta search.

nodes.name: prepare_pack
nodes.summary: Gathers object details, sorts candidates and runs the (threaded) delta search before the pack is written.

nodes.name: git_pack_config
nodes.summary: Config callback reading pack.* settings such as window, depth, threads, compression and bitmap options.

nodes.name: add_object_entry_from_pack
nodes.summary: Callback for --stdin-packs that adds each object in an included pack and seeds the revision walk with its commits.

nodes.name: show_object_pack_hint
nodes.summary: Revision walk object callback for stdin-packs that fills name hashes of already-added objects as a delta hint.

nodes.name: show_commit_pack_hint
nodes.summary: Revision walk commit callback for stdin-packs (no per-commit work needed).

nodes.name: pack_mtime_cmp
nodes.summary: Comparator ordering stdin packs by ascending mtime.

nodes.name: stdin_packs_include_check_obj
nodes.summary: Include check for revision walk: includes an object only if it is in an included stdin pack.

nodes.name: stdin_packs_include_check
nodes.summary: Include check for commits during the stdin-packs walk based on the commit's pack.

nodes.name: stdin_packs_add_pack_entries
nodes.summary: Sorts the named packs by mtime and adds the objects of each included pack to the packing list.

nodes.name: stdin_packs_read_input
nodes.summary: Parses pack names from stdin, marking each as included or excluded (closed or open) and resolving them against loaded packs.

nodes.name: read_stdin_packs
nodes.summary: Implements --stdin-packs: reads the pack list, adds their objects and optionally walks history for name hints.

nodes.name: add_cruft_object_entry
nodes.summary: Adds an unreachable object to the packing list for a cruft pack, recording its mtime and source.

nodes.name: show_cruft_object
nodes.summary: Revision walk callback adding an object and its mtime for cruft enumeration.

nodes.name: show_cruft_commit
nodes.summary: Revision walk callback adding a commit for cruft enumeration.

nodes.name: cruft_include_check_obj
nodes.summary: Include check that limits a cruft walk to objects not in fresh packs.

nodes.name: cruft_include_check
nodes.summary: Include check for commits during cruft enumeration.

nodes.name: set_cruft_mtime
nodes.summary: Callback that sets the cruft mtime of an object found by the unseen-recent traversal.

nodes.name: mark_pack_kept_in_core
nodes.summary: Marks or unmarks the named packs as kept in memory so objects in them are skipped or considered.

nodes.name: enumerate_cruft_objects
nodes.summary: Enumerates cruft by adding objects from unpacked packs and all loose objects to the packing list under a progress meter.

nodes.name: enumerate_and_traverse_cruft_objects
nodes.summary: Adds recent unreachable objects, then traverses from them so reachable-from-cruft objects are included too.

nodes.name: read_cruft_objects

nodes.summary: Recursively builds the cache tree from a tree object so a fresh checkout has valid cached trees.

nodes.name: prime_cache_tree
nodes.summary: Primes an index's cache tree from a tree object after a checkout or reset.

nodes.name: find_cache_tree_from_traversal
nodes.summary: Finds the cache_tree node matching the current tree traversal position.

nodes.name: cache_tree_matches_traversal
nodes.summary: Returns the cached entry count when the traversal entry's tree ID equals a valid cache-tree node, else 0, letting callers skip a whole subtree.

nodes.name: verify_one_sparse
nodes.summary: Checks that an index entry found at a cache-tree directory path is a sparse directory entry, erroring otherwise.

nodes.name: verify_one
nodes.summary: Recomputes a tree hash from index entries and compares it with the cached ID for a node, recursing into subtrees.

nodes.name: cache_tree_verify
nodes.summary: Verifies the entire cache tree against the index, restarting if the index must be expanded.

nodes.name: chunk-format.h
nodes.summary: Declares the chunk file API used by multi-pack-index, commit-graph and other chunked formats: a table of contents of ID, offset and size entries for writing and reading chunks.
nodes.languageNotes: Header-only in this batch; chunk-format.c in another batch defines these functions.

nodes.name: init_chunkfile
nodes.summary: Creates a chunkfile for either writing (with a hashfile) or reading (NULL hashfile); the two modes must not be mixed.

nodes.name: commit-graph.c
nodes.summary: Implements the commit-graph file: a chunked, memory-mapped on-disk cache of commit parents, root trees, dates, generation numbers and changed-path Bloom filters that speeds up revision walks. It both reads (load, parse, chain of split layers, lookup/parse commits from the graph) and writes (collect commits, compute topological levels and corrected-commit-date generations, merge split layers, emit chunks) and verifies the file.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of commit-slab macros (define_commit_slab) for per-commit side data and of a chunk-format table of contents; big-endian values are read with get_be32 and written with hashwrite_be32.

nodes.name: git_test_write_commit_graph_or_die
nodes.summary: Test hook: when GIT_TEST_COMMIT_GRAPH is set, writes a commit-graph of all reachable commits (with Bloom filters if requested by env) and dies on failure.

nodes.name: set_commit_pos
nodes.summary: Records the order in which a commit OID was seen in a commit-pos slab so later code can sort commits by pack order.

nodes.name: commit_graph_position
nodes.summary: Returns the position of a commit inside the loaded commit-graph from the per-commit slab, or COMMIT_NOT_FROM_GRAPH if it was not loaded from a graph.

nodes.name: commit_graph_generation
nodes.summary: Returns the cached generation number of a commit from the slab, or GENERATION_NUMBER_INFINITY when none is known.

nodes.name: commit_graph_data_at
nodes.summary: Returns the commit_graph_data slab entry for a commit, creating the slab chunk on demand and initialising every new graph_pos to COMMIT_NOT_FROM_GRAPH.

nodes.name: commit_gen_cmp
nodes.summary: qsort comparator that orders commits by generation number (lower first) and falls back to commit date; used while computing Bloom filters.

nodes.name: get_commit_graph_filename
nodes.summary: Builds the path of the single-file commit-graph under an object source (objects/info/commit-graph).

nodes.name: get_commit_graph_chain_filename
nodes.summary: Builds the path of the commit-graph-chain file that lists the layers of a split commit-graph.

nodes.name: commit_graph_compatible
nodes.summary: Decides whether commit-graph can be used or written in a repository, returning 0 when replace refs, grafts, substituted parents or a shallow clone would make cached parents wrong.

nodes.name: open_commit_graph
nodes.summary: Opens a commit-graph file and fstat()s it, returning 0 and closing the descriptor on failure.

nodes.name: load_commit_graph_one_fd_st
nodes.summary: Checks a commit-graph file is large enough, memory-maps it, closes the descriptor and parses it into a struct commit_graph tied to an object source.

nodes.name: graph_read_oid_fanout
nodes.summary: Chunk reader for the OIDF chunk: checks size, stores the 256-entry fanout table and num_commits, and verifies fanout values are non-decreasing.

nodes.name: graph_read_bloom_index
nodes.summary: Chunk reader for BIDX: validates that the changed-path Bloom filter index has one entry per commit and records its start.

nodes.name: graph_read_bloom_data
nodes.summary: Chunk reader for BDAT: reads the Bloom filter header (hash version, number of hashes, bits per entry) into bloom_filter_settings and keeps a pointer to the filter data.

nodes.name: parse_commit_graph
nodes.summary: Validates the commit-graph header (signature, version, hash version, chunk count), reads the table of contents and the required OIDF/OIDL/CDAT chunks, then optional generation data, extra edges, base-graph and Bloom chunks.

nodes.name: load_commit_graph_one
nodes.summary: Opens and loads one commit-graph file by name and remembers its filename on the resulting struct.

nodes.name: validate_mixed_generation_chain
nodes.summary: Walks a chain of split graphs and, if any layer lacks corrected-commit-date generation data, disables generation data reading for the whole chain.

nodes.name: validate_mixed_bloom_settings
nodes.summary: Compares Bloom filter settings across layers of a split chain and drops the filters of any layer whose hash version, hash count or bits per entry differ, with a warning.

nodes.name: add_graph_to_chain
nodes.summary: Links a newly loaded graph layer onto the chain after checking its base-graph chunk matches the OIDs recorded in commit-graph-chain and updating num_commits_in_base.

nodes.name: open_commit_graph_chain
nodes.summary: Opens the commit-graph-chain file, treating an empty file as missing and warning when it is shorter than one hash.

nodes.name: load_commit_graph_chain_fd_st
nodes.summary: Reads each hash line of commit-graph-chain, finds the matching graph-<hash>.graph in some object source, links the layers with add_graph_to_chain and reports whether the chain was complete.

nodes.name: load_commit_graph_chain
nodes.summary: Loads the layered commit-graph described by the chain file of an object source, or returns NULL if there is none.

nodes.name: read_commit_graph_one
nodes.summary: Loads the commit-graph of one object source: tries the single commit-graph file first and falls back to the split chain.

nodes.name: prepare_commit_graph
nodes.summary: Lazily loads the repository commit-graph once, honouring core.commitGraph, GIT_TEST_COMMIT_GRAPH, disabled state and compatibility checks, and caches the result in the object database.

nodes.name: generation_numbers_enabled
nodes.summary: Reports whether the loaded commit-graph stores non-zero generation numbers by inspecting the first commit entry.

nodes.name: corrected_commit_dates_enabled
nodes.summary: Reports whether the loaded commit-graph provides generation data v2 (corrected commit dates).

nodes.name: get_bloom_filter_settings
nodes.summary: Returns the changed-path Bloom filter settings of the first layer in the chain that has them.

nodes.name: close_commit_graph
nodes.summary: Clears the commit-graph slab and Bloom filter state and frees the loaded graph chain of an object database.

nodes.name: load_oid_from_graph
nodes.summary: Finds the layer that holds a graph position and reads the commit OID from its OID lookup chunk, dying if the position is out of range.

nodes.name: insert_parent_or_die
nodes.summary: Resolves a parent position to a commit object, records its graph position and appends it to the parent list being built.

nodes.name: fill_commit_graph_info
nodes.summary: Fills commit date, graph position and generation number of a commit from its commit-data entry, reading corrected-date offsets and overflow data when present.

nodes.name: fill_commit_in_graph
nodes.summary: Fully parses a commit from the graph: sets date and generation, clears the tree, and rebuilds the parent list from the two parent slots and the extra-edges chunk.

nodes.name: search_commit_pos_in_graph
nodes.summary: Binary-searches each layer of the graph chain for an OID and returns its global position (layer offset plus lexical index).

nodes.name: find_commit_pos_in_graph
nodes.summary: Returns a commit position from the slab if already known, otherwise searches the graph for its OID.

nodes.name: repo_find_commit_pos_in_graph
nodes.summary: Public lookup that loads the repository graph if needed and returns the layer and position holding a given commit.

nodes.name: lookup_commit_in_graph
nodes.summary: Looks up a commit by OID in the commit-graph (optionally checking that the object exists) and returns a parsed struct commit without reading the object database.

nodes.name: parse_commit_in_graph_one
nodes.summary: Parses one commit from a specific graph if it is not yet parsed and is present in that graph.

nodes.name: parse_commit_in_graph
nodes.summary: Entry point used by parse_commit: loads the graph if needed and parses the commit from it, with a test hook that dies when GIT_TEST_COMMIT_GRAPH_DIE_ON_PARSE is set.

nodes.name: load_commit_graph_info
nodes.summary: Fills only graph position, date and generation of an already-known commit if it is in the commit-graph.

nodes.name: load_tree_for_commit
nodes.summary: Reads the root tree OID of a graph commit from its commit-data entry and stores the looked-up tree in the commit.

nodes.name: get_commit_tree_in_graph_one
nodes.summary: Returns the tree of a commit from one graph, loading it lazily and bugging out if the commit did not come from the graph.

nodes.name: get_commit_tree_in_graph
nodes.summary: Returns the root tree of a commit using the repository loaded commit-graph.

nodes.name: write_graph_chunk_fanout
nodes.summary: Chunk writer for OIDF: writes the 256-entry cumulative fanout table of the sorted commit list as big-endian counts.

nodes.name: write_graph_chunk_oids
nodes.summary: Chunk writer for OIDL: writes the sorted commit OIDs back to back.

nodes.name: write_graph_chunk_data
nodes.summary: Chunk writer for CDAT: for each commit writes root tree OID, up to two parent positions (flagging extra edges), topological level and 34-bit commit date.

nodes.name: compute_generation_offset
nodes.summary: Computes the corrected-commit-date offset (generation minus the 34-bit masked commit date) that is stored in the generation data chunk.

nodes.name: write_graph_chunk_generation_data
nodes.summary: Chunk writer for GDA2: writes a 32-bit corrected-date offset per commit, replacing too-large offsets with an index into the overflow chunk.

nodes.name: write_graph_chunk_generation_data_overflow
nodes.summary: Chunk writer for GDO2: writes 64-bit offsets for commits whose generation offset does not fit in 31 bits.

nodes.name: write_graph_chunk_extra_edges
nodes.summary: Chunk writer for EDGE: for commits with more than two parents writes the second and later parent positions, marking the last with GRAPH_LAST_EDGE.

nodes.name: write_graph_chunk_bloom_indexes
nodes.summary: Chunk writer for BIDX: writes the cumulative end offset of each commit Bloom filter in the data chunk.

nodes.name: trace2_bloom_filter_settings
nodes.summary: Emits the Bloom filter settings (hash version, hashes, bits per entry, max changed paths) as a trace2 JSON data event.

nodes.name: write_graph_chunk_bloom_data
nodes.summary: Chunk writer for BDAT: writes the three-word Bloom settings header followed by the filter bytes of every commit.

nodes.name: add_packed_commits_oi
nodes.summary: for-each-object callback that appends the OID of every commit-type object to the write context and records its pack order.

nodes.name: add_packed_commits
nodes.summary: Callback for iterating one pack: reads an object type from the pack at a position and forwards commits to add_packed_commits_oi.

nodes.name: add_missing_parents
nodes.summary: Adds every parent of a commit that is not yet marked REACHABLE to the OID list and marks it.

nodes.name: close_reachable
nodes.summary: Expands the set of commit OIDs to include all ancestors not already in the graph, using a temporary REACHABLE flag to avoid duplicates, with three progress phases.

nodes.name: compute_generation_from_max
nodes.summary: Computes a commit generation from the maximum generation of its parents, either topological level (v1) or corrected commit date (v2).

nodes.name: compute_reachable_generation_numbers
nodes.summary: Iterative depth-first pass that assigns generation numbers to every commit in a list once all of its parents have one, using callbacks to read and write the values.

nodes.name: compute_topological_levels
nodes.summary: Computes v1 topological levels for the commits being written, storing them in the topo-level slab.

nodes.name: compute_generation_numbers
nodes.summary: Computes corrected-commit-date (v2) generation numbers, resetting them unless trusted, and counts how many offsets will overflow 31 bits.

nodes.name: ensure_generations_valid
nodes.summary: Guarantees that all commits reachable from the given list have non-zero, finite generation numbers, using the configured generation version.

nodes.name: trace2_bloom_filter_write_statistics
nodes.summary: Logs how many Bloom filters were computed, skipped, truncated or upgraded as trace2 data events.

nodes.name: compute_bloom_filters
nodes.summary: Computes changed-path Bloom filters for the commits to write, in pack or generation order, honouring max_new_filters and counting statistics.

nodes.name: add_ref_to_set
nodes.summary: Ref iteration callback that peels a ref to its target and adds it to an oidset when the object is a commit.

nodes.name: write_commit_graph_reachable
nodes.summary: Collects every commit pointed to by a ref and writes a commit-graph that covers them and their ancestors.

nodes.name: fill_oids_from_packs
nodes.summary: Opens each named pack index, enumerates the objects in pack order and gathers commit OIDs into the write context.

nodes.name: fill_oids_from_commits
nodes.summary: Copies the OIDs from a caller-provided oidset of commits into the write context.

nodes.name: fill_oids_from_all_packs
nodes.summary: Scans every packed object of every object source and records commit OIDs for the graph.

nodes.name: copy_oids_to_commits
nodes.summary: Sorts and de-duplicates collected OIDs, parses each commit without using the graph and pushes it on the commit stack while counting extra edges.

nodes.name: write_graph_chunk_base_1
nodes.summary: Recursively writes the checksums of every base layer, oldest first, and returns how many were written.

nodes.name: write_graph_chunk_base
nodes.summary: Chunk writer for BASE: writes the hashes of lower layers and checks the count equals the expected number of layers.

nodes.name: write_commit_graph_file
nodes.summary: Creates the lock file or temporary layer, registers all chunk writers (fanout, OIDs, data, generation, edges, Bloom, base), writes the header and chunks, finalizes the checksum, and renames the layer and updates the chain file.

nodes.name: split_graph_merge_strategy
nodes.summary: Decides how many layers to keep or merge for a split commit-graph, based on size multiple, max commits and split flags, and prepares layer filenames and hashes.

nodes.name: merge_commit_graph
nodes.summary: Loads all commits of an existing layer that still exist in the repository into the commit stack so they can be merged into the new layer.

nodes.name: sort_and_scan_merged_commits
nodes.summary: Sorts the merged commit list by OID, drops duplicates and recounts extra edges.

nodes.name: merge_commit_graphs
nodes.summary: Merges the layers that fall above the chosen base into the new layer and records the new base graph and its filename.

nodes.name: mark_commit_graphs
nodes.summary: Touches the modification time of old layers that were replaced so they survive the expiry pass for a while.

nodes.name: expire_commit_graphs
nodes.summary: Deletes graph-*.graph files in info/commit-graphs that are older than the expire time and not part of the new chain, and removes the chain file for a non-split write.

nodes.name: write_commit_graph
nodes.summary: Main writer: validates config and compatibility, sets Bloom settings, gathers commit OIDs from packs/commits/existing graph, closes the set under reachability, computes levels, generations and Bloom filters, writes the file(s) and expires old layers.

nodes.name: graph_report
nodes.summary: printf-style helper that prints a verification problem to stderr and sets the global verify error flag.

nodes.name: verify_one_commit_graph
nodes.summary: Verifies one graph layer: checks checksum, OID order and fanout, then compares each commit tree, parents, generation and date against the object database.

nodes.name: verify_commit_graph
nodes.summary: Verifies a commit-graph and optionally its base layers, with progress output, returning non-zero on any inconsistency.

nodes.name: free_commit_graph
nodes.summary: Unmaps and frees a chain of loaded graph layers and their filenames and Bloom settings.

nodes.name: disable_commit_graph
nodes.summary: Marks the repository so that the commit-graph is no longer used.

nodes.name: write_commit_graph_context
nodes.summary: State carried through a commit-graph write: OID array, commit stack, split-graph layer bookkeeping, option bitfields, topological level slab, Bloom settings and statistics counters.

nodes.name: compute_generation_info
nodes.summary: Parameter struct for compute_reachable_generation_numbers holding the commit list, progress state and get/set callbacks for the generation value being computed.

nodes.name: common-init.c
nodes.summary: Process-wide startup shared by git builtins and helper programs: init_git sanitizes std fds, resets SIGPIPE, sets up gettext and trace2, initialises the_repository and the replace-ref environment, and records the original working directory.

nodes.name: setup_environment
nodes.summary: Applies environment-driven settings: disables replace refs when requested, sets the refs/replace namespace from GIT_REPLACE_REF_BASE, and turns off lazy fetch when configured.

nodes.name: init_git
nodes.summary: Common init for every Git process: initialises the trace2 clock and session, opens std fds, restores SIGPIPE, resolves the executable dir, sets locale and gettext, initialises the_repository, environment and attributes.

nodes.name: csum-file.c
nodes.summary: Buffered writer that computes a running hash (SHA-1 or SHA-256) of everything written, used for pack files, indexes and the commit-graph; also supports verification against an existing file, checkpoints for truncating, CRC32 of object data and checksum validation.

nodes.name: verify_buffer_or_die
nodes.summary: In check mode reads the same number of bytes from the existing file and dies if they are missing, truncated or differ from the buffer being written.

nodes.name: flush
nodes.summary: Writes a buffer to the file descriptor (after verifying it in check mode), dies on I/O errors such as ENOSPC, and updates the byte total and throughput progress.

nodes.name: hashflush
nodes.summary: Feeds the pending buffer into the hash context unless hashing is skipped, then flushes it to disk.

nodes.name: free_hashfile
nodes.summary: Discards the hash context and frees the buffers of a hashfile without writing anything.

nodes.name: finalize_hashfile
nodes.summary: Flushes data, computes the final digest, optionally appends it to the stream, fsyncs and closes the descriptor, verifies there is no trailing garbage in check mode, and frees the hashfile.

nodes.name: hashwrite
nodes.summary: Appends bytes to the hashfile buffer (optionally updating a CRC32), flushing full buffers directly from the input to avoid an extra memcpy.

nodes.name: hashfd_check
nodes.summary: Opens a hashfile that writes to /dev/null while comparing every byte with an existing file, to verify that regenerated content would be identical.

nodes.name: hashfd_ext
nodes.summary: Allocates a hashfile on a descriptor with the given hash algorithm, buffer size and optional throughput progress.

nodes.name: hashfd
nodes.summary: Creates a hashfile with default options (large I/O buffer, no progress) for a descriptor.

nodes.name: hashfile_checkpoint_init
nodes.summary: Initialises a checkpoint with an empty hash context of the same algorithm as the hashfile.

nodes.name: hashfile_checkpoint
nodes.summary: Flushes the hashfile and records its byte offset and a clone of the running hash state in a checkpoint.

nodes.name: hashfile_truncate
nodes.summary: Truncates the file back to a checkpoint offset and restores the saved hash context, undoing writes after the checkpoint.

nodes.name: hashfile_checkpoint_release
nodes.summary: Releases the hash context held by a checkpoint.

nodes.name: crc32_begin
nodes.summary: Starts accumulating a CRC32 over subsequently written bytes (used for pack index entries).

nodes.name: crc32_end
nodes.summary: Stops CRC32 accumulation and returns the checksum of the bytes written since crc32_begin.

nodes.name: hashfile_checksum_valid
nodes.summary: Recomputes the hash of all but the trailing hash-size bytes of a buffer and compares it to the trailing checksum.

nodes.name: csum-file.h
nodes.summary: Public interface of the checksummed buffered writer: struct hashfile, checkpoint and option structs, the finalize flags and big-endian write helpers.

nodes.name: hashfile
nodes.summary: State of a SHA-protected output file: descriptor, optional check descriptor, write buffer, running hash context, byte total, optional CRC32 and progress meter.

nodes.name: hashfile_checkpoint
nodes.summary: Saved byte offset and hash context of a hashfile, used to roll the file back with hashfile_truncate.

nodes.name: hashfd_options
nodes.summary: Options for hashfd_ext: a throughput progress meter and a buffer length.

nodes.name: hashfile_total
nodes.summary: Returns the number of bytes fed to the hashfile so far, including unflushed buffered bytes.

nodes.name: hashwrite_u8
nodes.summary: Writes a single byte through hashwrite.

nodes.name: hashwrite_be32
nodes.summary: Writes a 32-bit value in network (big-endian) byte order through hashwrite; used for on-disk formats.

nodes.name: hashwrite_be64
nodes.summary: Writes a 64-bit value in big-endian byte order and returns the number of bytes written.

nodes.name: delta-islands.c
nodes.summary: Implements delta islands for pack-objects: refs matching pack.island regexes are grouped into named islands, every reachable object gets a bitmap of islands, and deltas are only allowed between objects whose island sets are compatible, so a pack for one fork never depends on another fork private objects.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses khash maps (KHASH_INIT) keyed by string and OID, copy-on-write reference-counted bitmaps, and POSIX regcomp/regexec for island naming.

nodes.name: island_bitmap_new
nodes.summary: Allocates a reference-counted island bitmap, optionally copying an existing one (copy-on-write).

nodes.name: island_bitmap_is_subset
nodes.summary: Returns true if every island bit set in one bitmap is also set in another.

nodes.name: in_same_island
nodes.summary: Tells pack-objects whether an object may use another as a delta base: true if islands are unused, the target has no marks, or the base island set covers the target.

nodes.name: island_delta_cmp
nodes.summary: Compares two objects by island marks so that objects with more specific island sets sort first when choosing delta bases.

nodes.name: create_or_get_island_marks
nodes.summary: Returns the island bitmap for an object, creating an empty one in the island_marks hash map if needed.

nodes.name: set_island_marks
nodes.summary: ORs a bitmap into the marks of an object, sharing the parent bitmap copy-on-write and splitting before modification.

nodes.name: mark_remote_island_1
nodes.summary: Marks every object of one island with its island number, also marking tag targets and flagging commits of the core island as needing a bitmap.

nodes.name: resolve_tree_islands
nodes.summary: Propagates island marks from root trees down to subtrees and blobs, processing trees in descending depth order so that shared subtrees collect marks from every parent.

nodes.name: free_remote_islands
nodes.summary: Frees every island name, OID array and island record of the remote islands hash.

nodes.name: island_config_callback
nodes.summary: Config callback that compiles each pack.island value into an anchored extended regex and reads pack.islandCore.

nodes.name: add_ref_to_island
nodes.summary: Adds a ref target OID to the named island and accumulates a hash of the OIDs used later to detect duplicate islands.

nodes.name: find_island_for_ref
nodes.summary: Ref iteration callback that picks the last matching pack.island regex, joins its capture groups into an island name and adds the ref to that island.

nodes.name: get_core_island
nodes.summary: Looks up the island named by pack.islandCore, if any.

nodes.name: deduplicate_islands
nodes.summary: Removes islands whose accumulated OID hash equals an earlier one, sizes the bitmaps and marks the objects of each remaining island.

nodes.name: load_delta_islands
nodes.summary: Entry point: reads island config, groups refs into islands, deduplicates them, marks their objects and optionally reports how many islands were marked.

nodes.name: propagate_island_marks
nodes.summary: Copies a commit island marks to its root tree and its parents so that islands flow along history.

nodes.name: free_island_marks
nodes.summary: Releases all island bitmaps via reference counts and the hash map, then poisons the pointer to catch use after free.

nodes.name: compute_pack_layers
nodes.summary: Assigns each packed object to layer 0 (core island) or layer 1 so that the core island objects are packed first; returns the number of layers.

nodes.name: remote_island
nodes.summary: An island: a combined hash of its ref OIDs (for duplicate detection) and the array of OIDs that belong to it.

nodes.name: island_bitmap
nodes.summary: Reference-counted bit array with one bit per island, shared copy-on-write between objects.

nodes.name: island_load_data
nodes.summary: Scratch state used while loading islands: the island hash map and the compiled pack.island regexes.

nodes.name: delta-islands.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring the delta islands API used by pack-objects and bitmap code: loading islands, checking and comparing island membership, propagating marks and computing pack layers.

nodes.name: delta.h
nodes.summary: Interface of Git binary delta encoding: create a delta index from a source buffer, produce a delta for a target, apply a delta with patch_delta, and read the delta header sizes. Implemented in diff-delta.c and patch-delta.c.

nodes.name: delta_index
nodes.summary: Opaque handle for the hash index of a source buffer used to find matching blocks when creating deltas.

nodes.name: diff_delta
nodes.summary: Inline convenience that builds an index of the source, creates the delta for the target and frees the index.

nodes.name: get_delta_hdr_size
nodes.summary: Inline decoder of the variable-length (7 bits per byte) size fields at the start of a delta, called once for source size and once for target size.

nodes.name: promisor-remote.c
nodes.summary: Implements promisor remotes for partial clones: reads remote.NAME.promisor config, lazily fetches missing objects by spawning git fetch, and handles the protocol v2 "promisor-remote" capability (server advertisement, client acceptance policy, URL allow-lists, storing advertised fields).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses flexible array members (FLEX_ALLOC_STR) and string_list util pointers to attach structs to lists.

nodes.name: fetch_objects
nodes.summary: Spawns a `git fetch <remote> --stdin --filter=blob:none --no-tags` child process and pipes the requested object IDs into it to lazily fetch missing objects from one promisor remote; refuses when lazy fetching is disabled by environment.

nodes.name: promisor_remote_move_to_tail
nodes.summary: Unlinks a promisor remote from the list and re-appends it at the tail, used to make the extensions.partialclone remote the last one tried.

nodes.name: promisor_remote_config
nodes.summary: Config callback that parses remote.NAME.promisor and remote.NAME.partialclonefilter entries, creating promisor_remote nodes and storing each remote's partial clone filter string.

nodes.name: promisor_remote_init
nodes.summary: Lazily builds the repository's promisor remote list from config and appends the extensions.partialclone remote at the end so it is tried last.

nodes.name: promisor_remote_clear
nodes.summary: Frees every promisor_remote node (and its filter strings) and resets the list tail pointer.

nodes.name: repo_promisor_remote_reinit
nodes.summary: Discards the cached promisor remote configuration and rebuilds it from config, called after config was rewritten.

nodes.name: repo_has_promisor_remote
nodes.summary: Returns true if the repository has at least one promisor remote, i.e. is a partial clone.

nodes.name: repo_has_accepted_promisor_remote
nodes.summary: Returns true if any promisor remote has the accepted flag set by the protocol v2 promisor-remote capability exchange.

nodes.name: remove_fetched_oids
nodes.summary: Rebuilds an object ID array keeping only objects still missing from the object database (checked with SKIP_FETCH_OBJECT), returning the remaining count.

nodes.name: try_promisor_remotes
nodes.summary: Iterates promisor remotes (accepted ones or non-accepted ones) calling fetch_objects, pruning already-fetched OIDs after a failure, and reports whether everything was fetched.

nodes.name: promisor_remote_get_direct
nodes.summary: Public entry for lazy fetching: tries accepted promisor remotes first, then the rest, and dies if an object that is a known promisor object still cannot be fetched.

nodes.name: is_valid_field
nodes.summary: Filter callback for the sendFields/checkFields/storeFields lists that warns about and drops unsupported field names.

nodes.name: set_one_field
nodes.summary: Stores a config value into the filter or token member of a promisor_info depending on the field name.

nodes.name: set_fields
nodes.summary: Reads remote.NAME.FIELD config values for each requested field name and fills them into a promisor_info.

nodes.name: promisor_config_info_list
nodes.summary: Builds a list of promisor_info entries from config for every promisor remote that has a non-empty URL, optionally with extra fields such as filter and token.

nodes.name: match_field_against_config
nodes.summary: Compares one advertised field (filter or token) with the locally configured value for a promisor remote.

nodes.name: all_fields_match
nodes.summary: Checks that every field listed in promisor.checkFields in an advertised remote matches local config, either for one remote or any remote in ACCEPT_ALL mode.

nodes.name: allowed_url_free
nodes.summary: Callback that frees an allowed_url entry and its normalized pattern.

nodes.name: load_accept_from_server_url
nodes.summary: Loads every valid promisor.acceptFromServerUrl entry from config into a list of allowed URL patterns.

nodes.name: match_pattern_url
nodes.summary: Runs wildmatch of a pattern fragment against a URL fragment given by lengths.

nodes.name: match_one_url
nodes.summary: Matches a normalized URL against an allow-list pattern requiring identical scheme and port, with wildcard matching applied separately to host and path.

nodes.name: sanitize_remote_name
nodes.summary: Turns a URL-derived buffer into a safe remote name: non-alphanumerics become single dashes, a "promisor-auto-" prefix is added, and the result is validated.

nodes.name: configure_auto_promisor_remote
nodes.summary: Writes config for an auto-accepted promisor remote: its URL (unless reused), remote.NAME.promisor=true and the advertisedAs name.

nodes.name: should_accept_new_remote_url
nodes.summary: Accepts an unknown advertised remote when its URL is on the allow-list, creating a local remote and recording its local name.

nodes.name: should_accept_remote
nodes.summary: Core policy function that decides whether to accept an advertised promisor remote based on promisor.acceptFromServer mode, known names and URLs, allow-list and field checks.

nodes.name: store_one_field
nodes.summary: Writes a changed advertised field value into remote.NAME.KEY config and tells the user what was stored.

nodes.name: valid_filter
nodes.summary: Validates an advertised partial clone filter by parsing it as a list-objects filter spec and warning on error.

nodes.name: valid_token
nodes.summary: Rejects advertised tokens that contain control characters.

nodes.name: promisor_store_advertised_fields
nodes.summary: Stores the advertised filter and/or token for an already configured promisor remote when promisor.storeFields allows it and the values are valid.

nodes.name: accept_from_server
nodes.summary: Parses the promisor.acceptFromServer config (None, KnownUrl, KnownName, All) into the accept_promisor enum.

nodes.name: filter_promisor_remote
nodes.summary: Client side core of the capability: parses the server advertisement, applies acceptance policy to each remote, stores fields, reloads config, and marks accepted remotes with their advertised filters.

nodes.name: promisor_remote_reply
nodes.summary: Prepares the client's reply to a server promisor-remote advertisement as a urlencoded semicolon-separated list of accepted remote names.

nodes.name: mark_promisor_remotes_as_accepted
nodes.summary: Server side: percent-decodes the names the client accepted and sets the accepted flag on matching promisor remotes, warning on unknown names.

nodes.name: promisor_remote_new
nodes.summary: Allocates a flexible-array promisor_remote entry for a name (rejecting names starting with a slash) and appends it to the tail of the config's linked list.

nodes.name: promisor_remote_lookup
nodes.summary: Linearly scans the promisor remote list for a remote by name and optionally reports its predecessor for list surgery.

nodes.name: repo_promisor_remote_find
nodes.summary: Initializes the promisor list if needed and returns the named promisor remote, or the first one when no name is given.

nodes.name: fields_from_config
nodes.summary: Reads a comma-separated field list from a config key into a string list, trims empty items, and drops invalid field names.

nodes.name: initialize_fields_list
nodes.summary: Lazily initializes a case-insensitive string list of field names from a config key exactly once.

nodes.name: promisor_remote_info
nodes.summary: Server side: builds the urlencoded, semicolon-separated "promisor-remote" capability value (name, url, filter, token) from config when promisor.advertise is on.

nodes.name: valid_accept_url
nodes.summary: Parses one promisor.acceptFromServerUrl value (optional name= prefix plus URL pattern), validates the remote name and control characters, and normalizes the pattern.

nodes.name: url_matches_accept_list
nodes.summary: Normalizes a URL and returns the first allow-list entry whose pattern matches it.

nodes.name: promisor_remote_name_from_url
nodes.summary: Derives a candidate remote name from a normalized URL (host, port, path, minus .git) and sanitizes it.

nodes.name: handle_matching_allowed_url
nodes.summary: Chooses a free local remote name (adding -N suffixes up to 20 attempts, reusing a same-URL remote) and configures it as a promisor remote.

nodes.name: parse_one_advertised_remote
nodes.summary: Parses one comma-separated advertised remote (name, url, partialCloneFilter, token) with percent decoding and rejects entries without name or URL.

nodes.name: store_info_new
nodes.summary: Allocates a store_info holding current config for promisor remotes and flags for which fields (filter, token) may be stored.

nodes.name: promisor_remote_construct_filter
nodes.summary: Combines the advertised filters of accepted promisor remotes into one list-objects filter spec string (used for --filter=auto).

nodes.name: promisor_remote_config
nodes.summary: Per-repository list head of promisor remotes: a pointer to the first node and a pointer to the tail slot used for O(1) appends.

nodes.name: promisor_info
nodes.summary: Description of a promisor remote exchanged in the protocol capability: advertised name, local name, URL, partial clone filter and token.

nodes.name: allowed_url
nodes.summary: One entry of promisor.acceptFromServerUrl: optional remote name plus a normalized URL pattern.

nodes.name: store_info
nodes.summary: Context for storing advertised fields: repo, current config info list and flags saying whether filter and token may be stored.

nodes.name: promisor-remote.h
nodes.summary: Public API and struct promisor_remote (linked list node with filter, advertised filter and accepted flag) for lazy fetching from promisor remotes and for the promisor-remote protocol capability.

nodes.name: promisor_remote
nodes.summary: Linked list node for a promisor remote: next pointer, configured and advertised filters, accepted flag and flexible name.

nodes.name: protocol-caps.h
nodes.summary: Declares cap_object_info, the server-side handler for the protocol v2 "object-info" command that reports object metadata for requested object IDs.

nodes.name: protocol.c
nodes.summary: Selects the Git wire protocol version: reads protocol.version config on the client, parses the GIT_PROTOCOL environment variable on the server, and interprets the server greeting on the client.

nodes.name: parse_protocol_version
nodes.summary: Maps the strings "0", "1", "2" to the protocol_version enum, else protocol_unknown_version.

nodes.name: get_protocol_version_config
nodes.summary: Client side: reads protocol.version config (or the GIT_TEST_PROTOCOL_VERSION env var) and defaults to protocol v2.

nodes.name: determine_protocol_version_server
nodes.summary: Server side: splits the GIT_PROTOCOL environment variable and selects the highest version= value requested by the client, recording it in trace2.

nodes.name: determine_protocol_version_client
nodes.summary: Client side: reads a "version N" line from the server's first response and returns the protocol version, dying on unknown or explicit v0.

nodes.name: protocol.h
nodes.summary: Defines the protocol_version enum (v0, v1, v2, unknown), the default git:// port, and the functions that choose a protocol version on client and server.

nodes.name: protocol_version
nodes.summary: Enum of wire protocol versions v0, v1, v2 and an unknown value.

nodes.name: refspec.h
nodes.summary: Declares struct refspec_item and struct refspec (parsed fetch/push refspecs) with functions to parse, append, match and apply them, including negative refspecs and ref-prefix computation for protocol v2.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses bitfields in struct refspec_item to record force, pattern, matching, exact_sha1 and negative.

nodes.name: refspec_item
nodes.summary: A parsed single refspec with force, pattern, matching, exact-sha1 and negative flags and src/dst/raw strings.

nodes.name: refspec
nodes.summary: A dynamic array of refspec_item for fetch or push plus the hash algorithm.

nodes.name: remote-curl.c
nodes.summary: Implements git-remote-http(s), the HTTP(S) transport helper: it speaks the remote-helper protocol on stdin/stdout and performs ref discovery, fetch and push over smart HTTP (stateless RPC with pkt-lines, gzip, chunked POST) and dumb HTTP/WebDAV using libcurl.
nodes.languageNotes: Many static helpers share file-level globals (url, options, last_discovery) because the helper is a short-lived process.

nodes.name: set_option
nodes.summary: Handles one "option NAME VALUE" command from the transport-helper protocol (verbosity, progress, depth, deepen-since/not/relative, followtags, dry-run, push-option, cas, atomic, object-format, etc.), updating the global options struct.

nodes.name: free_discovery
nodes.summary: Frees a discovery record (buffers, refs, shallow OIDs) and clears the cached last_discovery pointer if it matches.

nodes.name: show_http_message
nodes.summary: Prints a text/plain HTTP error body (re-encoded) to stderr as "remote:" lines for the user.

nodes.name: get_protocol_http_header
nodes.summary: Formats the Git-Protocol: version=N HTTP header when a protocol version above 0 is requested.

nodes.name: check_smart_http
nodes.summary: Decides whether an info/refs response is smart HTTP by checking the x-SERVICE-advertisement content type and the "# service=" packet or "version 2" line.

nodes.name: output_refs
nodes.summary: Writes the discovered refs (and optional :object-format line) to stdout in the transport-helper list format, including symref lines.

nodes.name: rpc_read_from_out
nodes.summary: Reads one pkt-line from the child process into the RPC buffer, optionally prefixing the four-hex length header, and reports its packet status.

nodes.name: rpc_out
nodes.summary: libcurl read callback that feeds buffered request data to the HTTP POST body, refilling from the child's pkt-lines until a flush packet.

nodes.name: rpc_seek
nodes.summary: libcurl seek callback that rewinds within the initial RPC buffer for re-sending a request, failing if the body is too large.

nodes.name: check_pktline
nodes.summary: State machine that validates streamed response data as well-formed pkt-lines (length header then payload) across arbitrary chunk boundaries.

nodes.name: rpc_in
nodes.summary: libcurl write callback that writes response bytes to the child's stdin, optionally checking pkt-line framing, ignoring HTTP error bodies.

nodes.name: run_slot
nodes.summary: Runs one libcurl active slot and reports an "RPC failed; HTTP/curl" error when it does not succeed.

nodes.name: probe_rpc
nodes.summary: Sends a small "0000" POST to the service URL to probe authentication before sending a large chunked request.

nodes.name: post_rpc
nodes.summary: Sends one RPC request over HTTP POST: buffers the request, picks chunked, gzip or fixed-length encoding, handles 100-continue and re-authentication retry, and streams the response back.

nodes.name: rpc_service
nodes.summary: Spawns a helper git process (e.g. send-pack or fetch-pack in stateless-RPC mode), loops reading its requests and POSTing them to the service URL, then collects the result.

nodes.name: fetch_dumb
nodes.summary: Fetches objects over dumb HTTP using an http walker for the requested heads, rejecting shallow options.

nodes.name: fetch_git
nodes.summary: Builds a fetch-pack --stateless-rpc command line from the current options (depth, filter, shallow, etc.) and runs it through rpc_service against git-upload-pack.

nodes.name: parse_fetch
nodes.summary: Reads the batch of "fetch OID NAME" commands from the transport-helper protocol on stdin, builds the ref list, runs the fetch and prints a blank line on success.

nodes.name: parse_get
nodes.summary: Handles the "get URL PATH" command by downloading a file from a URL to a local path.

nodes.name: push_dav
nodes.summary: Pushes over WebDAV by spawning git http-push with the options and refspecs.

nodes.name: push_git
nodes.summary: Builds a send-pack --stateless-rpc command line from push options (thin, atomic, signed, cas, push-options) and runs it through rpc_service against git-receive-pack.

nodes.name: push
nodes.summary: Chooses smart HTTP (push_git) or WebDAV (push_dav) for a push after discovering refs from receive-pack.

nodes.name: parse_push
nodes.summary: Reads "push REFSPEC" lines from stdin, runs the push and prints per-ref status results back to git.

nodes.name: stateless_connect
nodes.summary: Implements the stateless-connect command for protocol v2: verifies the server speaks v2 and then relays the client's pkt-line requests as repeated HTTP POSTs.

nodes.name: cmd_main
nodes.summary: Entry point of git-remote-http(s): sets up the repo and options, resolves the remote URL, then reads transport-helper commands (capabilities, list, fetch, push, option, connect) from stdin in a loop.

nodes.name: parse_git_refs
nodes.summary: Parses a smart HTTP discovery buffer through a packet_reader: for protocol v0/v1 reads the ref advertisement into a ref list, for v2 leaves capabilities for later.

nodes.name: detect_hash_algo
nodes.summary: Guesses the remote's object hash algorithm for dumb HTTP from the length of the first advertised object ID, defaulting to SHA-1 when no refs exist.

nodes.name: parse_info_refs
nodes.summary: Parses the dumb HTTP info/refs file (hex OID, tab, ref name lines) into a ref list, sets the repo hash algorithm, and adds HEAD via http_fetch_ref.

nodes.name: discover_refs
nodes.summary: Performs the GET of info/refs?service=..., handles HTTP errors and redirects, detects smart vs dumb HTTP, parses refs, and caches the result as last_discovery.

nodes.name: get_refs
nodes.summary: Discovers refs from the git-receive-pack service for push or git-upload-pack service for fetch and returns the ref list.

nodes.name: options
nodes.summary: Global state of the remote-curl helper holding the options received through "option" commands (verbosity, depth, filter, push options, hash algo, and so on).

nodes.name: discovery
nodes.summary: Cached result of the info/refs request: service, raw buffer, parsed refs, shallow OIDs, protocol version and smart-HTTP flag.

nodes.name: rpc_state
nodes.summary: State of one stateless RPC conversation with the child process: service URL and headers, request buffer, pipe fds and framing flags.

nodes.name: check_pktline_state
nodes.summary: Incremental parser state for validating pkt-line framing in streamed responses.

nodes.name: rpc_in_data
nodes.summary: Callback data passed to libcurl write function pairing an rpc_state with its slot and pkt-line checker.

nodes.name: remote.c
nodes.summary: Core remote and branch configuration: reads remote.*, branch.* and url.*.insteadOf config into remote_state, resolves remotes and upstream/push tracking branches, matches refs for fetch and push refspecs, computes ahead/behind status, and implements compare-and-swap push options and stale-ref detection.
nodes.languageNotes: Per-repository state lives in struct remote_state with hashmaps for remotes and branches; many helpers take or return linked lists of struct ref.

nodes.name: remotes_hash_cmp
nodes.summary: Hashmap comparison callback that compares remotes by name, either against a name/length key or against another remote entry.

nodes.name: remote_clear
nodes.summary: Frees all heap members of a struct remote: name, urls, push and fetch refspecs, proxy settings and server option lists.

nodes.name: add_merge
nodes.summary: Appends a branch.NAME.merge value as a new refspec_item source to a branch's merge array, growing it as needed.

nodes.name: branches_hash_cmp
nodes.summary: Hashmap comparison callback that compares branch entries by name, against a name/length key or another branch.

nodes.name: rewrites_release
nodes.summary: Frees all url.<base>.insteadOf rewrite entries and zeroes the rewrites struct.

nodes.name: handle_config
nodes.summary: Central config callback that fills remote_state from branch.NAME.*, url.BASE.insteadOf/pushInsteadOf, remote.NAME.* (url, push, fetch, mirror, tagopt, prune, proxy, etc.) and remote.pushDefault keys.

nodes.name: alias_all_urls
nodes.summary: After config is read, applies insteadOf and pushInsteadOf rewrites to every remote's url and pushurl lists.

nodes.name: read_config
nodes.summary: Lazily loads remote configuration into the repository's remote_state once: resolves the current branch from HEAD, reads config with handle_config, and rewrites URLs.

nodes.name: validate_remote_url
nodes.summary: Implements transfer.credentialsInUrl: scans each remote URL for an embedded password and warns or dies (printing a redacted URL) depending on the configured value.

nodes.name: remote_is_configured
nodes.summary: Returns whether a remote was configured, either specifically in the repository config or anywhere.

nodes.name: for_each_remote
nodes.summary: Loads config and calls a callback for every configured remote until one returns non-zero.

nodes.name: handle_duplicate
nodes.summary: Resolves two fetch refs that map to the same local tracking ref: dies on conflicting fetches, warns about unusual tracking, or frees the duplicate.

nodes.name: remote_has_url
nodes.summary: Returns whether the remote has a given URL in its url list.

nodes.name: remote_has_push_url
nodes.summary: Checks whether the remote's effective push URLs include a given URL.

nodes.name: ref_push_report_free
nodes.summary: Frees a linked list of ref_push_report structures (ref name and old/new OIDs).

nodes.name: remote_find_tracking
nodes.summary: Maps a ref through the remote's fetch refspecs to find its tracking (or source) side.

nodes.name: free_one_ref
nodes.summary: Frees a single struct ref along with its peer ref, symref, status and push report data.

nodes.name: free_refs
nodes.summary: Frees a whole linked list of refs.

nodes.name: count_refspec_match
nodes.summary: Counts how many refs match a push pattern, treating matches outside refs/heads and refs/tags as weak so ambiguity is detected; returns the unique match.

nodes.name: tail_link_ref
nodes.summary: Links a ref at the tail of a list and advances the tail pointer to its next field.

nodes.name: try_explicit_object_name
nodes.summary: Tries to treat a push source as a revision/object name (or empty for delete) and allocates a ref carrying the resolved OID.

nodes.name: match_explicit_lhs
nodes.summary: Resolves the source side of an explicit push refspec to exactly one local ref or object name, erroring when none or several match.

nodes.name: show_push_unqualified_ref_name_error
nodes.summary: Prints the detailed error and hints when a push destination is not a fully qualified ref (heads vs tags), based on the type of the pushed object.

nodes.name: match_explicit
nodes.summary: Matches one explicit non-pattern push refspec: resolves the source, guesses a fully qualified destination, creates the destination ref when needed and links it to the source.

nodes.name: add_to_tips
nodes.summary: Adds a commit to a stack of tips and marks it with TMP_MARK unless it was already added.

nodes.name: add_missing_tags
nodes.summary: Implements push --follow-tags: finds local annotated tags not on the remote that point to commits being sent and adds them to the destination list.

nodes.name: check_push_refs
nodes.summary: Validates that the source side of every explicit push refspec resolves to something locally.

nodes.name: match_push_refs
nodes.summary: Computes which remote refs will be updated by a push: applies explicit refspecs, then matching, pattern and mirror rules, adds missing destination refs and tags and prunes.

nodes.name: set_ref_status_for_push
nodes.summary: Sets each ref's push status (up to date, rejected non-fast-forward, stale, needs force, remote updated, deletion) based on old/new OIDs, force flags and compare-and-swap expectations.

nodes.name: set_merge
nodes.summary: Resolves branch.NAME.merge entries through the remote's fetch refspecs to local tracking refs (for the upstream) once per branch.

nodes.name: branch_has_merge_config
nodes.summary: Returns true if the branch has branch.NAME.merge configuration.

nodes.name: branch_merge_matches
nodes.summary: Checks whether the n-th merge refspec of a branch matches a given ref name.

nodes.name: get_fetch_map
nodes.summary: Builds the list of remote refs to fetch (and their local tracking refs) for a refspec, handling patterns, exact OIDs, HEAD default, and missing-ref policy.

nodes.name: get_remote_group
nodes.summary: Config callback that reads remotes.NAME entries and splits the whitespace-separated list into remote names.

nodes.name: add_remote_or_group
nodes.summary: Adds the members of a configured remote group, or a single configured remote, to a list of names.

nodes.name: resolve_remote_symref
nodes.summary: Fills in a symref ref's OID by looking up its target in a ref list, returning non-zero if the target is missing.

nodes.name: stat_branch_pair
nodes.summary: Counts commits ahead and behind between a branch and its upstream by running a revision walk over the symmetric difference.

nodes.name: stat_tracking_info
nodes.summary: Computes ahead/behind counts of a branch relative to its upstream or push destination and returns the upstream name.

nodes.name: format_branch_comparison
nodes.summary: Writes the "Your branch is ahead/behind/diverged" text with advice hints about push, pull and divergence.

nodes.name: format_tracking_info
nodes.summary: Formats the tracking summary of a branch against its upstream and push destination for git status and checkout output.

nodes.name: one_local_ref
nodes.summary: Ref iteration callback that appends valid local refs to a growing list of struct ref.

nodes.name: get_stale_heads_cb
nodes.summary: Ref iteration callback that marks a local remote-tracking ref as stale when no matched remote ref still exists for it.

nodes.name: clear_cas_option
nodes.summary: Frees all compare-and-swap entries of a push cas option and resets it.

nodes.name: parse_push_cas_option
nodes.summary: Parses a --force-with-lease style argument into refname and expected OID entries, handling "no value", "ref" and "ref:value" forms.

nodes.name: parseopt_push_cas_option
nodes.summary: parse-options callback wrapper for the --force-with-lease option.

nodes.name: is_empty_cas
nodes.summary: Returns true if no compare-and-swap option was requested.

nodes.name: remote_tracking
nodes.summary: Looks up the remote-tracking ref for a refname using the fetch refspecs and reads its current OID.

nodes.name: peek_reflog
nodes.summary: Reflog iteration callback that records the timestamp of the newest entry and stops.

nodes.name: check_and_collect_until
nodes.summary: Reflog iteration callback that collects local commits until it finds the remote commit or passes the remote ref's reflog timestamp.

nodes.name: is_reachable_in_reflog
nodes.summary: Checks whether the remote-tracking commit is reachable from any collected reflog commit of the local branch, for --force-if-includes.

nodes.name: check_if_includes_upstream
nodes.summary: Marks a push ref as unreachable when the local branch's reflog does not include the remote-tracking tip.

nodes.name: apply_cas
nodes.summary: Fills a ref's expected old OID from explicit --force-with-lease entries or from the remote-tracking ref.

nodes.name: apply_push_cas
nodes.summary: Applies compare-and-swap expectations to every ref of a push and runs the force-if-includes reachability check where requested.

nodes.name: remote_state_clear
nodes.summary: Releases all remotes, branches hashmap, rewrites and cached names held in a remote_state.

nodes.name: chop_last_dir
nodes.summary: Removes the last path or colon-separated component from a remote URL string, handling relative and scp-like URLs.

nodes.name: valid_remote_name
nodes.summary: Returns whether a name is usable as a remote name by checking that a refs/remotes/NAME/test fetch refspec is valid.

nodes.name: alias_url
nodes.summary: Finds the longest matching url.BASE.insteadOf prefix and returns the rewritten URL, or NULL if none match.

nodes.name: make_remote
nodes.summary: Finds a remote by name in the hashmap or allocates and registers a new one with fresh push/fetch refspecs.

nodes.name: find_branch
nodes.summary: Looks up a branch by name and length in the remote_state hashmap.

nodes.name: make_branch
nodes.summary: Finds or creates a struct branch with its refs/heads refname and inserts it into the hashmap.

nodes.name: make_rewrite
nodes.summary: Finds or creates the rewrite entry for a url.BASE prefix.

nodes.name: warn_about_deprecated_remote_type
nodes.summary: Emits a deprecation warning about remotes defined in .git/remotes or .git/branches files.

nodes.name: read_remotes_file
nodes.summary: Reads a legacy .git/remotes/NAME file (URL, Push, Pull lines) into a remote's urls and refspecs.

nodes.name: read_branches_file
nodes.summary: Reads a legacy .git/branches/NAME file as a remote with a single URL and default fetch/push refspecs.

nodes.name: valid_remote_nick
nodes.summary: Rejects remote names that look like paths (leading dots or slashes) before looking for legacy remote files.

nodes.name: remotes_remote_for_branch
nodes.summary: Returns the remote name configured for a branch, or the only remote, or "origin" as the default.

nodes.name: remote_for_branch
nodes.summary: Public wrapper that loads config and returns the remote name for a branch.

nodes.name: remotes_pushremote_for_branch
nodes.summary: Returns the push remote for a branch from branch.NAME.pushremote, remote.pushDefault, or the normal remote.

nodes.name: pushremote_for_branch
nodes.summary: Public wrapper that loads config and returns the push remote name for a branch.

nodes.name: remote_ref_for_branch
nodes.summary: Returns the upstream ref name (merge ref) of a branch or, for push, the destination derived from push refspecs.

nodes.name: remotes_remote_get_1
nodes.summary: Core remote lookup: resolves the default remote name, makes the remote, reads legacy files, treats the name as a URL when unconfigured, and validates URLs.

nodes.name: remote_get
nodes.summary: Returns the struct remote for a name (or the default remote) for fetch operations.

nodes.name: remote_get_early
nodes.summary: Returns a remote using only early config, before the repository is fully set up.

nodes.name: pushremote_get
nodes.summary: Returns the remote to use for pushing, honoring push-specific defaults.

nodes.name: ref_remove_duplicates
nodes.summary: Removes duplicate entries of a fetch ref map that map the same remote ref to the same local ref, dying on conflicts.

nodes.name: push_url_of_remote
nodes.summary: Returns the remote's pushurl list when set, otherwise its url list.

nodes.name: alloc_ref
nodes.summary: Allocates a zeroed struct ref and copies the given ref name into its flexible array.

nodes.name: copy_ref
nodes.summary: Duplicates a struct ref including its name, symref, peer ref and OIDs.

nodes.name: copy_ref_list
nodes.summary: Deep-copies a linked list of refs.

nodes.name: guess_ref
nodes.summary: Guesses a fully qualified destination name (refs/heads or refs/tags) from what a peer ref resolves to.

nodes.name: get_ref_match
nodes.summary: Finds the destination name for a source ref according to the refspec items (matching, mirror or pattern) in the given direction.

nodes.name: find_ref_by_name
nodes.summary: Returns the ref with an exact name in a ref list.

nodes.name: repo_branch_get
nodes.summary: Returns the struct branch for a name or HEAD, creating it and resolving its upstream merge refs.

nodes.name: branch_get
nodes.summary: Public wrapper returning a branch of the main repository by name or HEAD.

nodes.name: repo_default_remote
nodes.summary: Returns the default remote name of a repository based on the current branch configuration.

nodes.name: repo_remote_from_url
nodes.summary: Finds the name of a configured remote that has a given URL (after insteadOf rewriting).

nodes.name: branch_get_upstream
nodes.summary: Returns the fully qualified remote-tracking ref of a branch (branch@{upstream}) or records a specific error.

nodes.name: repo_remote_for_push_tracking
nodes.summary: Maps an unconfigured URL remote to a configured remote with the same single push URL, to find its tracking refs.

nodes.name: tracking_for_push_dest
nodes.summary: Maps a push destination ref to the local tracking ref using the remote's fetch refspecs.

nodes.name: branch_get_push_1
nodes.summary: Computes the tracking ref that a bare push of a branch would update, based on push refspecs, mirror mode and push.default.

nodes.name: branch_get_push
nodes.summary: Public wrapper returning the push-side tracking branch (branch@{push}) or an error message.

nodes.name: get_expanded_map
nodes.summary: Expands a wildcard fetch refspec against the remote's refs into fetch ref entries with local peers.

nodes.name: find_ref_by_name_abbrev
nodes.summary: Finds the best-scoring ref in a list for a possibly abbreviated name using refname_match ranking.

nodes.name: get_remote_ref
nodes.summary: Finds a remote ref by a possibly abbreviated name, where HEAD is a special case.

nodes.name: get_local_ref
nodes.summary: Allocates a ref for a local name, prefixing refs/, refs/heads/ as appropriate for abbreviated names.

nodes.name: resolve_compare_branch
nodes.summary: Resolves a status.compareBranches entry (@{upstream} or @{push}) to a branch ref name, warning on unsupported values.

nodes.name: get_local_heads
nodes.summary: Returns a ref list of all valid local refs by iterating the main ref store.

nodes.name: guess_remote_head
nodes.summary: Guesses which remote ref HEAD points to when the transport cannot say, matching the default branch name or the OID of HEAD.

nodes.name: get_stale_heads
nodes.summary: Finds local remote-tracking refs that no longer have a matching ref on the remote (for fetch --prune).

nodes.name: add_cas_entry
nodes.summary: Appends a new compare-and-swap entry for a refname to a push cas option.

nodes.name: remote_state_new
nodes.summary: Allocates and initializes a remote_state with its remotes and branches hashmaps.

nodes.name: relative_url
nodes.summary: Resolves a (possibly relative) submodule URL against the superproject's remote URL, walking up path components with chop_last_dir.

nodes.name: counted_string
nodes.summary: A string with explicit length, used for insteadOf prefixes.

nodes.name: stale_heads_info
nodes.summary: Callback state for finding stale tracking refs: matched remote ref names, refspec set and tail pointer of the result list.

nodes.name: check_and_collect_until_cb_data
nodes.summary: Callback state for the reflog walk of --force-if-includes: remote commit, collected local commits and timestamp limit.

nodes.name: remote.h
nodes.summary: Declares struct remote, struct branch, struct ref, remote_state and the API for looking up remotes, matching refs for push and fetch, upstream/push tracking branches, tracking info, and push compare-and-swap options.

nodes.name: remote_state
nodes.summary: Per-repository remote and branch tables with insteadOf rewrite lists and the current branch.

nodes.name: follow_remote_head_settings
nodes.summary: Enum of remote.NAME.followRemoteHEAD policies.

nodes.name: remote
nodes.summary: A configured remote: name, URLs, push URLs, fetch and push refspecs, tag and prune options, proxy and server option settings.

nodes.name: ref_push_report
nodes.summary: Linked list entry describing the result of a push for one ref.

nodes.name: ref
nodes.summary: A ref as exchanged with a remote: name, old and new OIDs, peer ref, symref, push status flags and fetch-head status.

nodes.name: branch
nodes.summary: A local branch with configured remote, push remote and merge (upstream) refspecs.

nodes.name: remote_group_data
nodes.summary: Callback data for reading a remotes.NAME group into a list.

nodes.name: match_refs_flags

nodes.name: push_cas_option
